Chapter 34: Episode 33: The Bridge Bike Gang

With fond memories of the Safari Zone behind them, and gaining new friends and Pokemon, Mew and her friends continue on their Pokemon Journey as they walk down the streets of the city.

"Feels weird to be back in a city, huh, guys?" Mew asks.

"Sure does. Being out in the jungle was great, but it's kinda nice to come back to civilization," Misty answers.

Mew turns to her Pokemon and Tomo, Hey, Pikachu, Eevee, Tomo. Let's have a humongous meal when we get to the Pokemon Center."

"Piii Pika Pika!" (Mm, sounds delicious!) Pikachu happily says.

"Eevee!" (Yummy!) Eevee says.

Tomo smiles and says, "Yeah."

Then Misty says, "I want a hotdog!"

"I want a deep dish, extra cheese pizza. Mm!" Brock replies.

The group continues to walk down the road and plan to have something to eat at the Pokemon Center. When something catches their attention.

"Hey, what's that thing?" Mew asks.

"What thing?" Brock wonders.

"Let's go see!" Mew says, and runs ahead.

"Wait for us, Mew!" Misty says as she and the others hurry after her.

Mew and the others continue to run down the road until they spot a bridge that is across the water. Mew and her friends are amazed to see it.

"Wow, look at that!" Mew says, amazed.

"Pika!" (Golly!) Pikachu says.

"Vee!" (Wow!) Eevee says.

"Really big," Tomo replies.

"That's an amazing bridge!" Misty says.

Brock looks at the map and says, "So, it's being completed already."

Misty looks at Brock with a confused expression, "Huh?"

Brock looks at the map and then looks at the bridge, "Hey, The map says it's still under construction, but if it's completed, we can go straight to Sunny Town on the opposite shore without going all the way around!"

"Great! We'll cross the bridge, and get to the next town. Come on, let's go!" Mew says, excited.

"Pika!/Eevee!" (Alright!) Pikachu and Eevee cheer.

Soon, Mew and her friends reach the Toll Booth operator, however, they end up receiving some bad news "Toll booth operator: Well, I'm afraid the bridge isn't completely finished. See there?"

The group looks ahead to see the construction on the bridge.

"That means we can't take the shortcut," Brock says.

"Even if it were finished, this bridge is only for cars, anyway," The Toll Booth Operator says.

"The bridge is only for cars? Couldn't we just walk across it?" Mew asks, confused.

"Well, this bridge is over ten miles long. It'd be dark before you reach the other side," Toll booth operator.

"Ten miles long?" Misty says, a little surprised.

"Course, you might be able to cross if you had bicycles," The Toll Booth Operator says.

"Bicycles?!" Mew says, surprised and nervous.

Soon, two people riding bikes cycle by and say hello to the operator who is named Norman.

"I thought you said the bridge isn't finished," Misty replies.

Norman answers, "The road isn't finished, but the bicycle path is."

Then two more people on bikes ride by.

"If you had bikes, you could cross too," Normal says.

"I see," Mew says, sounding nervous.

"Yeah," Misty says.

Soon, Mew and her friends find themselves at a bike shop to see the bikes.

"It's no use, we can't afford these," Mew says.

"Pika," (Oh, rats.) Pikachu says.

"Eev," (Oh man.) Eevee says.

"That bad," Tomo replies.

Soon, the group feels discouraged about them unable to get bikes, so they can't cross the bridge.

"Let's go to the Pokemon Center and figure out a plan," Mew says.

"Sounds good to me," Brock says.

"I'll probably come up with a brilliant idea," Misty replies.

Soon, Mew and her friends arrive at the Pokemon Center and decide to have some lunch as they think of a plan.

Mew turns to Misty and asks, "Thought of anything yet."

"Sadly no, but I'm still thinking of it," Misty says.

"Me either, and I'm a little nervous about riding another bike," Mew says.

"Why's that?" Brock asks.

"Well, it's kind of a long story, but in short. I never really rode a bike before, and only watched Gary and his friends ride on. In fact, the only bike I ever rode was Misty, before Pikachu fried it," Mew says.

"Huh? You mean my bike is actually the first one you ever ridden, and you still used it to take your Pokemon to the Pokemon Center?" Misty says, confused.

"Yeah. Sorry I never told you that," Mew says.

Misty sighs, "Sometimes you do the craziest things without thinking, even if it is for good intentions."

Mew giggles in reply

Just then, Nurse Joy walks to them and is looking really glum.

She asks, "Excuse me? If you could spend some time, would you mind helping me out?"

Brock quickly becomes smitten and runs to Joy, "Please, let me help! I just love caring for Pokemon! It's my life. Please! Please, Miss. Miss. Uh, by the way, are you by any chance related to the Joy in Gringy City?"

"I'm her cousin," Joy answers, a little nervous.

"Ah, but you're much, much prettier than she is," Brock says.

"That's just fine, but," Nurse Joy says, and picks up her clipboard.

Then says in concern, "I'm worried about the Pokemon in Sunny Town, just over the bridge, that's very sick."

Soon, the group becomes curious to hear Nurse Joy's statement.

Then Nurse Joy hands the group a tray that has the bag with the Pokemon medication inside, "I need someone to deliver this medicine to the Pokemon Center in Sunny Town. Normally, I'd go myself, but I'm too busy with sick Pokemon to leave the Center right now."

"It's just over the bridge, right?" Mew asks.

"That's right," Nurse Joy answers with a nod.

"But we don't have any bicycles," Misty says.

"No problem! I'll let you use some of our bicycles," Nurse Joy says.

The group is surprised and glad to hear what Nurse Joy says.

Mew quickly agrees, "We'll do anything we can if it's to help a sick Pokemon!"

"Even if that means we'll have to zip across the bridge on bikes!" Misty says.

"That's great! The bikes are in the parking lot, and thank you!" Nurse Joy happily says.

Mew takes the medicine and puts it in her bag. Then the three head off to the garage to get bikes.

Brock who remains behind says, "I'd be happy to stay here and help you if you need me."

"Come on, Brock!?" Misty says, and pulls Brock away by the ear.

Soon, Mew and her friends are riding on the bikes to Sunny town. Mew is riding on one with Tomo sitting at the back metal seat, and Pikachu and Eevee are sitting on baskets.

Mew laughs with glee and says, "Hurry up, guys!"

"Hurry! Hurry!" Tomo says.

Misty and Brock have to share a twin bike.

Misty whines, "Brock! I'm the one doing all the pedaling!"

The group of friends are actually having a lot of fun riding on the bike that will lead them to Sunny Town to help the sick Pokemon.

"You see? We're getting to cross the bridge after all!" Mew says.

"Right, Mew! We sure got lucky!" Misty says.

"Pikachu!" (That's for sure!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (Yeah!) Eevee says.

Mew and her friends continue to ride on the bike over the bridge to get to Sunny Town. However, on a rubber raft under the bridge, Team Rocket is spying on them, yet again.

"They're riding on the bike path across the bridge," Meowth says.

Jessie says with confidence and holding the binoculars, "Ha. We've got them right where we want them."

"You think we got a chance this time?" Meowth asks.

"Well it's not like this place is new to us, you know," James says as he paddles.

"You could almost call it our home town. Isn't that right, James?" Jessie says.

"So we'll have the home team advantage," James says, confident.

Then Jessie says, "James, prepare to attack!"

"I'm a little busy here," James says, sweating bullets.

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends have stopped for a break and are having some drinks.

Mew finishes her drink and says, "This is a great workout!"

"Yeah! And since we lucked into those bikes, it won't be long till we're in Sunny Town," Brock says.

"Right, Brock!" Misty says.

"Bike riding is fun," Tomo says.

"It sure is," Mew says.

Mew and her friends and Pokemon finish their drinks and toss their cans in the bins. Soon, the group got on the bikes and are ready to go.

"Okay, time to hit the road," Mew says.

Suddenly, the group hears something and their heads to see a group of bikers coming in their direction. They all wear black and other gangster like appearances. One of them is also holding a flag.

Concern, Misty asks, "Uh oh! Who are they?"

"It's a bicycle gang!" Brock says.

"A bicycle gang?" Misty nervously replies.

"I think we better get outta here," Brock says.

However, Mew and the others find themselves surrounded by the Bike gang.

One of the gang members who is the leader with red fire like hair removes his sunglasses and says, "I don't think I've seen you before."

"Right. Uh, we're not really from around here. So, uh, see ya," Mew says.

Mew and her friends are about to leave, but the leader says, "Hold it!"

Causing them to halt.

"You ain't gonna cross this bridge without a proper introduction," The leader says.

"That's right! The gang says.

Mew rishes to them, "Uh, hello!"

"Hi," Tomo replies.

"Pika," (Hello.) Pikachu says.

"Eev." (Hi)" Eevee says.

Misty rushes to the leader, "It's a pleasure."

"Very nice to meet you," Brock does the same.

Then they all hop on the bikes, "See you again sometime!"

But the leader angrily says, "That's no introduction!"

Just then, a female biker with long green hair and blue eyes walks over and says, "When we say introduction, we mean Pokemon battle."

"A Pokemon battle?" Mew says, concern.

Seeing there is no way out of it, Mew says, "Alright, I accept."

Brock blushes seeing the girl and says, "I'd do anything for an introduction to a girl like you."

Then rushes to her, "Would you go out with me?"

The girls and Pokemon groan and fall over in embarrassment. Tomo is a little confused. However, the girl gang member attacks Brock with a bike.

She turns away with a huff and her arms crossed, "Get lost, loser! I only care about my bike and my gang!"

Brock lifts his head up, "Is that a no?"

"Alright, let's get started, then we'll see who's the master?" Mew sternly says.

"Heh. You think you can play with the big boys? I'll send you home crying," The leader says.

Then throw his Pokeball, "Golem, go!"

The Pokeball opens to reveal the Biker gang leader's Pokemon. It's a bipedal tortoise-like Pokémon with a spherical body covered by a shell of plated, green rocks. Its body is so hard that even dynamite cannot scratch it. Its head protrudes from the center of the shell. The head has a flat snout with two pointed teeth in the lower jaw and red eyes. It has short arms that have three claws and two legs with feet that have four claws in front and one in back. The head and limbs are light brown in color

"A Golem, huh," Mew replies.

She takes out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Golem, the Megaton Pokemon and the final evolved form of Geodude. A Ground and Rock Type. Once a year it sheds its bedrock shell and grows larger."

"Okay then," Mew says.

Then throws her Pokeball, "I choose, Bulbasaur!"

Then Mew comes out of its Pokeball.

Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, Vine Whip!"

Bulbasaur attacks, but Golem curls itself up in defense.

The leader remarks, "Your Pokemon needs more practice! That wimpy Vine Whip attack's never gonna get through Golem's shell!"

Then calls out, "Golem, Tackle attack!"

Then Golem rolls to Bulbasaur, but Mw calls out, "Dodge!"

Bulbasaur dodges the attack.

Mew then has another idea and calls back her Pokemon, "Return, Bulbasaur!"

Then throws another one, "Charmander, I choose you!"

Then Charmander comes out.

Mew calls out, "Charmander, Ember!"

Charmander spins around and throws the attack, but Golem's shell protects itself.

"Heh! Trying to heat things up? It ain't gonna happen! Go, Golem! Rock Throw, now!" The leader says.

Golem leaps in the air and tries to land on Charmander, but it dodges.

Mew calls out, "Charmander, Flamethrower!"

Charmander breaths out the attack and hits Golem in the face.

Then Mew calls out, "Charmander, Fire Spin, now!"

The attack then lands on Golem.

Then the leader calls out, "Golem, Tackle attack, now!"

Golem begins to roll around and is still on fire.

Mew cries out, "Charmander, run!"

Charmander dodges the attack, but begins to roll straight to its trainer and the rest of the gang. Soon, they are running in a panic.

The leader holds his Pokeball and calls out, "Golem, return!"

"Uh, I wouldn't do that if I were…" Mew calls out in a panic.

But Golem is already back in it's Pokeball. Soon, the heat begins to flow through the Pokeball and the leader continues to toss it back and forth because of the sudden increase in the heat.

The female biker then says, "Now it's my turn to show you! I choose you, Cloyster. Crush this wimp!"

Then Cloyster comes out of its Pokeball.

Misty steps forward and says, "It's a water Pokemon, just leave it to me!"

"Okay, you go Misty," Mew says.

The gangster girl laughs, "You battle? This should be quick."

Misty then thinks of an idea, "Which should be best against Cloyster's hard shell? I know!"

Then brings out her Pokeball, "Starmie, go!"

However, Psyduck decides to come out of his Pokeball on his own, causing Misty to collapse in disbelief.

Then shouts at him, "Psyduck, what are you doing here? I wanted Starmie, not you!"

Psyduck turns to Misty.

Misty sighs and says, "Well, now that you're out, give it a try."

Psyduck begins to walk on to the battlefield.

Soon, the gang begins to laugh.

One of them says, "I ain't never seen such a pathetic Pokemon!"

Misty sighs, feels embarrassed and Mew is annoyed by the gang insulting him.

Another says, "My gut hurts!"

Misty then calls out, "Psyduck, use your Tail Whip attack."

Psyduck then begins to use its Tail Whip attack, but that makes the gangster laugh even more.

"Pika Pi. Pikachu," (Those guys shouldn't laugh. They'll see what he's capable of.) Pikachu sternly says.

"Eevee. Eevee Eev Eevee." (Yeah. They just need to see Psyduck's Psychic abilities.) Eevee says.

"You can say that again. They just need to see Psyduck's real powers," Mew says.

Psyduck begins to walk backwards moving its tail towards Cloyser. However, when one of Cloyster's spikes prick Psyduck, it begins to panic, making the gang laugh more.

Mistu angrily calls out, "And you were supposed to be attacking. Psyduck, Scratch it, now!"

Psyduck begins to scratch, but ends up hurting itself.

Misty thinks, "Ah, let em laugh. Just wait until they see Psyduck's real power."

When Psyduck stops running, Misty calls out, "Psyduck, use your Disable attack!"

However, Psyduck doesn't attack.

Misty is beginning to get frustrated, "Just attack, you dumb duck! Go on and use your Confusion attack!"

Psyduck nods his head, but doesn't remember how to use it.

Misty sighs, "Can't you remember your own attacks?"

"Misty, it's because its headache isn't bad enough yet." Brock says.

"He's right. Remember back at the Fuchsia Gym. Psyduck didn't release any Psychic attacks unless his headache is painful enough to release it. And that happened after Psyduck was attacked so badly, Mew says.

That gives Misty an idea and calls out, "Come on, Cloyster! Score a knockout! Go for the head! Go for the head!"

"They're even starting to cheer for our side!" The leader laughs.

The girl gangster says, "Cloyster, clamp it with your shell!"

Cloyster then opens its shell and comes up to Psyduck from behind. Then it clamps Psyduck's tail, causing it to be in pain.

The girl gang member says with a grin, "Looks like this battle's over."

Misty shrugs her shoulders, "Psyduck needs help!"

Then picks up the bike, "I'll have to give it a headache myself!"

Brock quickly holds Misty, "Don't do it, Misty!"

Suddenly, they begin to hear a siren coming from the distance. That catches Mew and her friends, and the Biker Gang's attention.

"Looks like the next town wants to rumble!" The leader says.

The sirens get louder as the source is getting closer.

Mew asks, "Who is that?"

Soon, the siren sounds aren't coming from a rival gang or the police, but from Team Rocket dressed as part of a biker gang and riding on unicycles.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Meowth is on a unicycle too, and dressed as a ringmaster.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Soon paper cups are laid on the ground in a rode and Team Rocket rides around them.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight!

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

Then cracks the whip.

"Tyra, it's been a while," Jessie says, removing her sunglasses.

Then the female gangster girl, who is named Tyra says with admiration, "Big Jess!"

James removes his sunglasses as he says, "You're looking good, Chopper."

"Little Jim!" The leader, Chopper says with admiration as well.

"Big Jess and Little Jim? What's that about?" Mew asks, very confused.

Jessie laughs and says, "Well, nerd, we had a pretty bad reputation here back in the old days.

Tyra says, "You were Big Chainer Jessie! Big Jess was really cool, swinging her chain around as she rode her bicycle!"

Then Chopper says, "And then there was Little Trainer James! Little Jim was the only one in the bike gang, who had to use training wheels."

Mew and her friends are able to reach Sunny Town, are able to make it through the storm, and save the sick Pokemon. The Biker Gang has brand new heroes So everyone is happy… well almost.

Chapter 35: Episode 34: Ditto's Mysterious Mansion

On a bright and sunny day, Mew and her friends are traveling down the road to their next part of their Journey. Suddenly, dark clouds begin to travel across the sky where they're at, and a drop of rain hits Pikachu on his head.

Pikachu looks up, "Pika?" (What's that?)

"Eevee…" (Uh oh.) Eevee says, looking up.

Soon, Mew and the others notice the rain as well

"A storm?" Mew says, confused.

Soon, the rain comes down harder and the group begins to run away to find shelter.

"Let's get out of this!"

The group looks ahead to notice a white building with a red roof.

"What's that?" Brock wonders.

"I don't like the looks of it," misty says.

"I don't think we have much of a choice," Mew says.

The group agrees to the idea and hurry toward the building. They barge through the doors and run inside. Pikachu and Eevee shake the water off their body.

Mew looks around and calls out, "Hello? Sorry for barging in!"

The group looks around to see a theater close by and walk over for a look.

Everyone nods their heads in reply.

Suddenly Pikachu notices something, "Pikachu!" (Look you guys!)

The group turn their heads to see another Pikachu and another Eevee.

"Where'd that other Pikachu and Eevee come from?" Mew says, confused.

The two Pikachu and Eevee copy everything Mew's Pikachu and Eevee do.

"How cute!" Misty says, and walks over to them.

Misty goes over and picks up the other Eevee and Pikachu.

"Hi there!" Misty says.

Misty's happiness soon changes to surprise and shock to see that Pikachu's face is different from Mew's.

Misty panics and drops the Pikachu to the floor, "What is this?! What's wrong with it?!"

"What's wrong Misty?" Mew asks.

"That Pikachu doesn't look right!" Misty answers.

The others look to see what Misty is talking about.

"Could be a new type of Pikachu," Brock wonders.

"Never heard of a Pikachu with that kind of face," Mew says.

"Hey, what are you doing here?" Someone asks.

The group turns their heads and becomes shocked to see a trainer that looks exactly like Mew

"Hey, Mew, that girl's dressed just like you!" Misty says, surprised.

Mew steps forward and asks, "Who are you?"

"Tell me who you are," The mysterious person says.

"I'm Mew from Pallet Town!" Mew says.

"Duplica," The person says in Mew's voice.

Then walks over and reveals her true voice, "From The House of Imite."

"Imite? Like, imitate? Is that why you look just like me?" Mew asks, confused

"That's right," Duplica says.

"At least we know that this is a girl," Misty says.

"But she may be a little young for me," Brock says.

Misty bluntly says, "You're sad."

Then she walks to the Pikachu with a strange face, "Aw. It still hasn't gotten over that old habit."

The Pikachu then glows and transforms into a pink blob, much to everyone's surprise.

"It's a Ditto," Mew says, surprised.

Misty turns to the Eevee she is holding, "So then, this Eevee is really…"

The Eevee then transforms into a blue blob that is similar to the pink one.

"And that's a Shiny Ditto," Brock says, surprised.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Ditto, the Transform Pokemon. A Normal Type. It is able to rearrange the cells of its body and assume any form. Its only attack is Transform."

Misty then pets the two Dittos as she laughs and says, "Squishy."

"And Ditto can make itself look just like anything!" Mew says.

Brock places his hand under his chin, "Yeah, but It's face stayed the same. When it transforms, shouldn't it be able to change completely?"

"Yeah, it still can't change its face," Duplica says.

"Sound kind of odd, but Ditto is a unique Pokemon. It's one of the only few that can only transform like this," Mew says.

"A transforming Pokemon. It's only attack is to copy other Pokemon. That's all it does," Brock says.

"Isn't that enough?" Misty asks.

"It is. Ditto may not be able to learn other attacks, but Transformation is a powerful asset for Ditto. Depending on the Pokemon Ditto can change into, it can also use the attack from the Pokemon it copied from," Mew says.

"You knew a lot, huh?" Duplica asks, impressed.

"Well, Professor Oak read to me about Ditto, they're very rare and unique too, including a shiny one. Of course, it also helps if the trainer can also know the attacks the Pokemon uses," Mew says.

"It can imitate attacks?" Misty asks.

"They do more than just look like a Pokemon," Mew says.

"That's right," Duplica says, happily.

Sometime later, Duplica brings Mew and the others to her costume room and she has a lot of them.

"Wow! What are all these clothes for?" Misty says, amazed.

Duplica runs to the racks and comes back on the other side to be dressed as Nurse Joy,

"Don't worry, I'll take good care of it," Duplica says, imitating Nurse Joy.

Then Duplica runs into the rack again and is now Officer Jenny.

Duplica says, "My name is Jenny, you're under arrest for Pokemon poaching."

The Pokemon and Tomo clap and cheer for Duplica's talent.

"Great imitation!" Misty happily says.

"Very good, but she doesn't capture the more adult charm of the real Joy and Jenny," Brock says.

Misty looks at Brock embarrassingly and sweat drops.

"With all these costumes, I can imitate just about anybody. Watch!" Duplica says.

Then runs to the rack again, and comes out dressed as Misty. She winks and laughs.

"She's me!" Misty says, surprised.

"You're amazing. Duplica," Mew says.

"Thanks," Duplica says.

"So Duplica, have you used Ditto in battle before?" Mew asks.

"I do sometimes," Duplica says.

"I'll bet you know any Pokemon's potential attacks. You could order Ditto to use the strongest attacks possible according to the Pokemon form it takes," Mew says.

"That's right! I guess that means Duplica must know every attack and every Pokemon there is," Misty says.

Then Brock says, "You must have studied a lot, Duplica, to be able to battle in any situation like that."

"Oh, stop it, guys! You're making me blush," Duplica says.

"It looks like you got another rival, Mew. Duplica would make a great Pokemon master," Misty says.

"No way!" Duplica denies.

"Huh?" Misty says, confused.

Then Duplica says, "I just want to become the greatest Ditto master."

"A Ditto master?" Everyone says, confused.

"You got it! And I wanna be a big star!" Duplica says.

"You see, I started this Imite House because I like to imitate Pokemon. This place is so flat and boring, but people pass by here all the time. I thought maybe when they stop here for a rest, I could entertain them," Duplica says.

Mew suspects, "I guess it didn't come easy when they see Ditto couldn't do his transformation perfectly."

"Yes. When people watch Ditto, they don't want to see an imperfect transformation. This little one is trying its hardest to master Transform perfectly, but its face still stays the same," Duplica says.

The Pink Ditto looks depressed.

"I guess being a Ditto trainer's tough," Mew replies.

The Blue Ditto comes to its friend and tries to comfort it.

"That's sweet," Misty says.

"Is this Ditto one of your Pokemon?" Brock asks.

"No. This Ditto is wild and it comes here once in a while. It's actually been trying to help my Ditto perfect transformation, but it's hard work," Duplica says.

"That was a touching story," Meowth says.

"What? Who are you?" Duplica asks.

Chapter 36: Episode 35: Electric Soldier Porygon

The long long journey of Mew and her friends has brought them to a town called Matcha City. Their journey has its ups and downs, but they are always able to find a way to make the best of it. Of course, Pikachu and Eevee are tired as Misty let's Psyduck drink from the water fountain, and Mew, Tomo, and Brock are having a snack.

Pikachu turns to Mew, "Pika Pika." (Mew, I'm tired.)

"Eevee Eevee." (I'm tired, too.) Eevee replies.

"I know. We're all very tired. We'll get to the Matcha Pokemon Center right away.

In the Pokemon Center of Matcha City, there seems to be trouble going on. Nurse Joy receives a phone call.

Nurse Joy picks up the phone and answers, "Yes? This is the Matcha City Pokemon Center. What? Another Pokemon that should have transferred didn't get there?"

Soon, Nurse Joy begins to receive other calls as her Chanseys continue with their work.

She picks up another phone and says, "I'm investigating it now, so please wait a while longer."

She then hangs up one of the phones and picks up another, "I'm very sorry! We'll work it out very soon."

That's when Mew and her friends walk into the center to notice Nurse Joy is having a tizzy. "I wonder what's going on?" Brock replies.

"It seems quite noisy," Misty says.

"It looks like Nurse Joy must be very busy today," Mew says.

Suddenly, someone says, "That is impossible! I built this transfer machine myself!"

The group turns their heads to see a man with green color hair, and wears swirly glasses with an orange shirt and lab coat.

The man types on the computer and says, "There are no problems in the hardware or the programming!"

"But complaints have been coming in all morning," Nurse Joy says.

MMew and her friends step into the computer room to see the Pokeballs being transported and Nurse Joy is with the man.

Mew walks over and asks, "Nurse Joy, what's happening here?"

"What hasn't been happening? I want to know, too…" Nurse Joy says.

For example, when we transfer a Pokemon as rare as, say Ninetales, the Pokemon that arrives at their destination is switched and the original never gets there at all. Anyway, it looks like a bug in the system is causing it," Nurse Joy says.

Mew and her friends are shocked to hear it. Just then, the scientist leans to the computer to notice a red section of the program appears. It looks like it's been blocked by something.

"This is…" The man says.

He then realizes, "No way, that can't… could it be?"

Suddenly, Nurse Joy asks, "Akihabara-hakase? What did you find out?"

The scientist Akihabara nervously says, "Err… no… nothing really."

"A computer virus could have caused it," Brock says.

"What Computer virus?" Tomo asks.

Mew turns to Misty, "Misty, what's a computer virus?"

"A Computer Virus is kind of like a flu virus. It spreads to computers and causes them to go wrong or even shut down. " Misty says.

Suddenly, Brock asks Joy, "Have you tried using a vaccine program?"

"Vaccine program?" Mew and Tomo say, confused.

"It's kind of like medicine, only for computers," Misty says.

Suddenly Akihabara shouts, "Impossible! The Pokemon Transfer Machine used advanced circuits! No virus could just get inside that easily."

"But in reality, it did happ…" Nurse Joy says.

But the scientist shouts, "There's no way! It couldn't be so!"

Then hurries outside of the room as Nurse Joy calls out to him, "Professor! What's the cause of the incident!"

"And he is…?" Brock asks.

"Akihabara-hakase. He developed the program for the transfer system. He's a famous professor, even though he might not look it," Nurse Joy says.

"Just now, he looked like he'd figured something out!" Misty says.

"And then took off…" Tomo adds.

Mew then says, "I think he knows what is going on, but didn't want to tell us. I say we go find him and get some answers."

Soon enough, Mew and the others head off search for. Akihabara. Mew looks at the map Nurse Joy has given to them to see which way they need to go. Soon, the group comes to the stop. They look at the house, and then the map, then look at the house again.

"Yeah. Here it is," Mew says.

The place is actually a large green brick mansion with a purplish-pink roof with a gate and brick wall at front.

"Akihabara-hakase's laboratory," Mew replies.

The group enters the mansion to see it's dark inside.

"Excuse me, Mr. Harbara," Mew calls out.

The group then walks down the hall to see a few lights are on.

"This is wrong, just walking into someone's house because we feel like it," Misty says, concerned.

"I know, but we need to talk to him right away. He knows something about the problem at the Pokemon Center and we need to know why," Mew says.

Suddenly, Misty, Brock, and Tomo stop in fright. Pikachu and Eevee become surprised too.

"What's wrong?" Mew asks.

Misty points forward causing the others to turn in her direction. What they see is a giant head version of the scientist that makes them freaked out.

The head says, "People who just walk into my house get this!"

Then opens its mouth to chomp on them.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu! Eevee! Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu and Eevee spring into action and use Thunderbolt on the robot, shattering it. Then the head comes back together.

He says, "Just kidding! That stuff has no effect!"

"It restored itself?" Misty says, shocked.

"Just what is it?" Mew asks, shocked.

Suddenly, Brock notices something, "Look at that!"

What they see is a small robot and it has a small projector on top of it.

"With that machine, he's making a realistic image in midair," Brock says.

The head says, "So you found me out? You all seem pretty smart. Well then, follow me!"

The machine then rolls away. Mew and the others decide to follow it. They follow the robot to a strange large container or a test tube.

The robot says, "Come on, get in! Don't you have some business with me?"

The group looks at each other with concern, but decides to step inside the tube anyway.

"It's dark," Mew says.

"I can't see a thing," Misty replies.

"What are you talking about?" Mew asks.

Suddenly, a Pokemon appears in front of them. It has a pink polyhedral body with a blue front, blue triangular prism feet, and a blue rectangular prism tail. It has a pink, polyhedral head that ends in a blue beak and has hexagonal eyes. That makes Mew and her friends become surprised.

"I guess I have no choice but to explain it," Akihabara says.

Then shows the screen of what happened along with three familiar figures, Team Rocket.

The screen plays as Akihabara explains,"A strange group snatched my prototype Porygon. They used the transfer to the PC world… In other words, they went into the electronic world. Those people must be in there stealing Pokemon as they are transferred.

Mew and the others are shocked to see the ones who have taken the Porygon and went into the system.

"It has to be them," Misty says..

"Bad Team Rocket. We must stop them," Tomo says.

"Is there no way to do it?" Mw asks.

The machine begins to turn on as the scientist says, "You guys will enter the electronic world for the sake of scientific progress."

The group of friends and Pokemon look at each other with a nod.

The upper part of its torso has short ruffles at the top similar to a dress. Its wide hips are made up of six segments and resemble the flesh of a mangosteen. The mission has been a success and the Pokemon Transporter is fixed. Mew has caught a Porygon and Bounsweet has evolved into Steenee. Even the Pokemon are able to feel better thanks to Nurse Joy. Then that is where we need to go," Mew says.

Mew looks at her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Eevee evolves into one of several Pokemon, depending on what stone is used on it. Using a Fire Stone will yield Flareon, the Flame Pokemon. A Water Stone yields Vaporeon, the Bubble Jet Pokemon. A Thunder Stone yields Jolteon, the Lightning Pokemon. A high bond of friendship during the daytime and with an optional Sun Shard yields Espeon, the Sun Pokemon. A high bond of friendship during the nighttime and with an optional Moon Shard yields Umbreon, the Moonlight Pokemon. When an Eevee is near a Moss Rock or is exposed to a Leaf Stone, it evolves into Leafeon, the Verdant Pokemon. When an Eevee is near an Ice Rock or is exposed to an Ice Stone, it evolves into Glaceon, the Fresh Snow Pokemon. When an Eevee knows a Fairy type move and has a high level of affection or friendship, it evolves into Sylveon, the Intertwining Pokemon."

Chapter 40: Episode 39: Wake Up Snorlax

One again, Mew along with Eevee, Pikachu, Misty, Brock, and Tomo continue on their journey. Pikachu and Eevee are fast asleep on Mew's shoulder or backpack. Suddenly, the group sees an old man with long white hair covering his eyes and a long beard. He is wearing a green robe with a blue jewel necklace.

The old man sees them and says, "Groovy! Greetings, children of the universe."

"Hello. Are you all by yourself?" Misty asks

"I have my music," The man says, brings out a yellow flute that has a Pokeball on it.

Soon, the man begins to play music, much to the friend's delight. Soon, the Pokemon begins to wake up as they let out yawns.

"Wow!" Mew says.

"That was nice!" Misty says.

Then the old man says, "Now that you've heard my music, you have to give me some food."

Soon, the group becomes confused.

"We thought it was free!" Misty replies.

"Isn't my flute playing at least worth a sandwich?" The old man asks.

Mew then says, "We'd like to give you something to eat, but we don't even have anything to eat ourselves."

"No food at all," Tomo adds.

The old man asks, "Not even a cookie?"

"Cookie? We don't even have crumbs," Brock says.

The group then heads off, but because they haven't eaten anything, they feel that they don't have the energy to move.

Mew groans, "I'm so hungry!"

"Tomo very hungry," Tomo says.

Suddenly, Eevee notices something and points out, "Eevee Eevee." (Look over there.)

The group turns their heads to see a town is up ahead. Meanwhile, Team Rocket isn't far from behind and is listening to the old hippie too.

"And I'm starving," Misty says.

"It seems that everyone else in town is too," Mew says.

Suddenly, an old man approaches them, "My friends, what's the matter?"

"We've been looking all over for food in this town, but, there's nothing to eat," Brock says.

"We're so hungry we can hardly move," Misty says, feeling tired.

Soon, the old man invites them to his home where he gives them food to eat. Even the Pokemon are able to eat.

"So you and your friends are on a Pokemon journey together," The old man, who is actually the mayor of the town.

Then Misty asks, "What's wrong with this town? There's no bread in the bakery."

"And there aren't any vegetables at the market," Brock says.

"Not even any fruits or berries," Mew adds.

"The water in the river has completely dried up, killing all our produce. So food in our town has become very, very hard to come by. It's hard enough to keep food for ourselves to eat," The mayor says.

The group soon grows concerned to hear this. This town sounds like it's in real trouble.

Seeing their expressions, the Mayor says, "Oh, please, don't worry. Our family can live off our food stores for quite a while yet."

"But I don't remember the weather being any drier this year than it usually is," Misty says.

"It rained just like it always does," Brock adds.

"It's not the rain," The mayor says.

Soon, the Mayor shows them the river that is practically empty.

"This is the river that used to flow through our town. For some reason, it suddenly stopped running two weeks ago," The mayor says.

Mew notices the plants drying up, "The plants! They're all dried up!"

"Pika pika," (How terrible.) Pikachu says.

"No. This is a serious problem," The mayor says."

"Mew stands up and says, "Let's go check it out!"

Soon enough, Mew and the others are able to get out of the bushes of thorns.

The group notices something ahead and walks over. What they find is a Pokemon and it's huge. huge, bipedal, dark blue-green Pokémon with a cream-colored face, belly, and feet. Its body is composed of mostly its belly, as its limbs are comparatively small. Its head is large with small, pointed ears and two pointed teeth protruding from its lower jaw. It has round feet, which both have three claws and a circular brown paw pad, and short arms with five claws on each hand. It snores loud and it's sleeping. Then scratches it's tummy with his paw.

"Let's try," Mew says

Mew then throws the Pokeball at Snorlax, but it simply rolls and bounce down on its tummy.

"That didn't work," Mew says.

"Give it a big wet one, fella!" James says.

Meowth turns to his teammates in rage, "Why do I have to be the one to kiss that big lumux?!"

Jessie begins to chuckle nervously, "So we can bring that Snorlax back to the boss."

"Hey, you don't look half bad, Meowth," James says with the same expression as Jessie.

"Keep your eyes to yourself!" Meowth angrily says.

Soon Jessie and James pick up Meowth.

"Pucker up!" Jessie says.

James adds, "Give it a smack attack right on the lip!"

"Disgusting! I quit! No way! The hygiene!" Meowth panics as he squirms to break free.

However, Jessie and James force Meowth towards Snolax and give the giant Pokemon a kiss. Soon enough, Snorlax begins to stir.

"Is it?" Mew asks, shocked.

"That kiss may have done it!" Misty adds, just as surprised.

However, Snorlx snows a strange look on his face, like he is traumatized or disgusted.

"It looks like it's been poisoned," Misty says.

"How'd you look if you got kissed by Meowth?" Brock questions.

"I'd look for a new mouth," Mew says with a grin on her face.

Tomo, Pikachu, and Eevee begin laughing.

"Hey! Wake up, you big lug!" Meowth screams and kicks Snorlax.

But Moewth bounces off and lands on the ground while Snorlax rolls over to its right. Suddenly, Mew notices something under Snorlax.

"Huh, what's that?" Mew wonders, and picks up the object under Snorlax.

"What'd you find, Mew?" Brock asks.

Seeing the sign, Mew reads, "It says, 'do not disturb.'

"It's like those signs you hang on hotel doors," Misty says.

Then Brock says, "Turn it over, Mew."

Mew turns the sign around and says, "In case of emergency, please use a Poke Flute to wake."

"A Poke Flute?" Misty says, confused.

Then Brock says, "That's right! Now I remember, I heard once that you play a Poke Flute to wake up a Snorlax!"

Mew takes out her Pokedex and Dexter says, showing the picture of the flute, "The Poke Flute is used to wake sleeping Pokemon. Snorlax will only awaken to this flute."

Seeing the picture Mew realizes, "Wait a minute, didn't we've seen this flute today.

Soon Misty remembers as well, "Oh! It looks just like the one that old hippie had!"

"Right! Come on, let's go find him!" Mew says.

With that, Mew and the others hurry to go find the old man, leaving Team Rocket behind who has heard the conversation.

"Poke Flute?" Jessie says, confused.

Then James says, "Hippie?"

Jessie and James soon members the hippie with the flute and come to the same conclusion, "The music man!"

"Oh no, we let them get ahead of us!" Jessie quickly says.

"Let's hurry!" James replies.

Soon, Jessie and James hurry off to find the old man too.

Meowth scurry from behind, "Wait for me!"

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends are able to find the old hippie at the same place where they first met him.

"What's the rush, dudes?" The hippie asks.

"Thank goodness you're still here! Please, sir, we have a favor to ask of you," Mew says.

"Ask away," The hippie says.

"Just come with us!" Mew says.

"Hey hey! Chill out, my friend!" The hippie.

Team Rocket soon comes rushing in.

"Hi again," Jessie says.

And takes the hippie's hand, "Please come with us."

"We really need your help," James says.

Mew takes the Hippie away, "Hey! Let go of him right now! We got to him first!"

"The first are the worst!" Jessie says.

"Enough of this! Arbok, go!" Jessie says, and throws her Pokeball.

Arbok comes out.

Mew then calls out, "Teddiursa, I choose you!"

Teddiursa, use Dynamic Punch!"

Teddiursa then charges at Jessie's Arbok and gives it a powerful punch. That sends Arbok crashing to Team Rocket and that sends Team Rocket flying.

Team Rocket screams, "Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Seeing Team Rocket is gone, Mew says, "Great! Now's our chance."

Soon, Mew and her friends return to the spring with the hippie to help with their situation.

"Please, play your Poke Flute to wake this Snorlax," Mew replies.

"Hey, you've gotten a lot bigger since I saw you last, Snorlax. Your girth is blowing my mind," The Hippie says.

Confused, Misty asks, "You mean you know this Snorlax?"

"I don't just know it, this Snorlax is mine. This little dude loves to snooze. I can't even take it for a walk, I just come to wake it up once a month. I'm running a little late this month, though," The Hippie says.

Mew then says, "Your Snorlax is stopping the water from flowing into town. We gotta move it out of the way."

"No problem. I can do it," The Hippie says.

The old man begins to play his Poke Flute, and Snorlax's ears twitch as he scratches his tummy. Soon, Snorlax sits up and stretches his arms like he is exercising.

"Guess that did it," Brock says.

Soon, Snorlax walks off.

"Later, Snorlax!" The Hippie says.

Misty soon notices something isn't right, "Look! The water still isn't coming out!"

"Look at that!" Brock says, seeing the problem.

What they see are more thorns blocking the river.

Misty groans in frustration, "Not more thorns!"

"That means, we'll have to clear out all of these thorns before the river can start flowing into town again!" Mew says.

"What a job!" Brock says, tired.

Suddenly, they notice the thorns are beginning to move, and turn to see Snorlax eating them.

"Chow down, Snorlax. Looks like you got a case of the munchies," The Hippie says.

"Look! It's eating the thorns!" Misty says.

"Thorns are Snrolax's favorite snack item," The Hippie says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Snorlax's hunger isn't satisfied until it consumes nine-hundred pounds of food, then it goes back to sleep."

"That's Snorlax being Snorlax. When it isn't sleeping, it's eating. And when it's not sleeping, it's eating."

Snorlax continues to eat all the thorns that are in the forest. Soon, the thorns are being cleared up and the river begins to flow normally again, much to the group's delight.

"Look guys! The river's back to normal again!" Mew says.

"Pika!" (Alright!) Pikachu happily says.

"Eevee!" (We did it!) Eevee says.

Soon, the river reaches the town and it begins to flow normally.

The mayor happily says, "Thank goodness! The river's flowing just like before! How can we thank you?"

"It wasn't just us," Mew says.

Then Misty says, "The Snorlax helped out, too."

Mew and her friends smile with glee and things have worked out for everyone, except for Team Rocket. Team Rocket are hobbling through the woods after recovering for the attack they received.

"I'm getting tired of always being beaten," Jessie says, tired.

"I'm as tired as Snorlax," James replies.

Soon, Team Rocket meets the hippie again.

Jessie asks, "Hey, there. What happened to Snorlax?"

"Me amigo? Snorlax are all those thorns and it's caught in some Zs," The Hippie says, turning to Snorlax to see he's back to sleep.

"It went back to sleep?" James says, dumbfounded.

"Mm Hmm. It'll be awhile before it wakes up," The Hippie says.

"About how long?" Jessie asks.

"Well, let's see. This one wakes up about once a moon," The Hippie answers.

Team Rocket is in disbelief after hearing how long Snorlax can sleep. Soon, the timer belonging to the Hippie goes off.

"Well, I gotta split. Wake up another Snorlax. Keep on trucking, dudes," The Hippie says, as he laughs and walks away.

Soon, Team Rocket falls over in disbelief.

"Should we try to capture the Snorlax?" Jessie asks.

"I ain't kissing it," Meowth says.

Then James says, "We better kiss it goodbye."

Soon, Snorlax turns his body and ends up squishing Team Rocket with a thud. As the journey continues.

Chapter 41: Episode 40: Showdown at Dark City

Their next adventure takes place in front of a broken sign that says, Dark City. In fact, that is where Mew and her friends' destination is. They see the place looks deserted, almost like a ghost town. Yet, they decide to walk into the city to see if they can find somewhere to have lunch.

Brock says, "This place gives me the creeps. It's the middle of the day and there's nobody around. What's the deal?"

"Yeah," Mew says.

Suddenly, they see a little boy running out from one of the buildings.

But the mother rushes him inside saying in fright, "Get back inside this house right now! What if there are Pokemon trainers out?"

Hearing that makes the group of friends confused.

"Why would she be afraid of Pokemon trainers?" Misty wonders.

"Something's strange is going on here," Mew says.

"Very strange," Tomo replies.

Suddenly, rocks begin to fly out of nowhere. Pikachu and Eevee quickly dodge and climb on Mew's shoulders.

"Hey!" Mew angrily says.

The group looks up to see figures disappearing before they can get a look. Not pleased, Pikachu and Eevee climb up to the roof and give the attackers the Thundershock treatment. The beings fall to the ground to reveal three little boys who fall on some hay.

"They're, little kids!" Brock says, surprised.

Mew sternly asks, "Hey! What's the big idea throwing rocks at us?!"

"Chu! Vee!" (Yeah!) Pikachu and Eevee add, sternly.

The boy with blue hair asks, "You guys are Pokemon trainers, right?"

"Um yeah. My name is Mew, and I like to become a great Pokemon trainer" Mew says, confused.

"I'm Brock, and I wanna become the world's best Pokemon breeder," Brock says.

"And I'm gonna be a Water Pokemon Master! My name's Misty," Misty says.

However, the boys look at the group with anger and prepare to attack them with sticks. Suddenly, out of the Pokeball, Teddiursa begins to attack the three boys on their heads. The little Teddiursa continues to throw punches on their heads in anger. The three boys soon rub their heads in pain. Teddiursa stops with his arms crossed and turns away with a huff.

"Wow! That Teddiursa is tough," Brock says.

"Well with Mew being threatened, Teddiursa decides to come to her rescue and save us," Misty says.

Teddiursa happily jumps to Mew and the girl catches the baby bear Pokemon in her arms.

Mew giggles, "Thank you, Teddiursa, but you didn't have to beat them up."

"Teddi Teddiursa," (Just trying to protect you mama.) Teddiursa says.

"It's a nice thought, but we could handle it," Mew says.

The boy with the red hair says, "That really hurt. Also, we don't care who you are. If you have a Pokemon, you better get out of town."

The boys nod their heads.

"Why? What's wrong with Pokemon?" Mew asks, calmly.

"Boys," Someone calls out.

Just then, a man hurries over wearing an apron as he says, "I apologize. These children don't mean to cause you any trouble. Come to my restaurant and I'll explain everything."

"Well, okay," Mew replies.

Soon, they are in the restaurant where they are offered some lunch.

The owner says, "In Dark City there are two Pokemon gyms, the Yas gym and the Kaz gym. The two gyms are in the middle of a gang war and they'll hire any wandering Pokemon trainers as soldiers to battle for them."

"I get it, so that's why there's nobody out on the streets here," Mew says.

As the group eats, a person wearing a mask, sunglasses, a dark coat, and a hat is having some coffee. Pikachu holds the ketchup bottle and squeezes a little on Eevee's lunch. Eevee lets Pikachu know it's enough and Pikachu continues to eat the ketchup.

"But I don't see. What's the point in fighting each other like this?" Brock asks.

"They claim that whichever gym wins will become an official Pokemon gym," The owner says.

"But that sounds silly. I mean, sure becoming an official Pokemon Gym could be a big honor, but it doesn't mean you have to fight in a street fight for it," Mew says.

"I agree," Brock says.

"Yeah, there's no point in fighting over it," Misty adds.

Suddenly, they hear the sound of glass breaking and a lot of noise coming from outside.

"Huh? What was that?" Misty asks, surprised.

The blue haired boy, Zack says, "It's them!"

"Them? You mean?" Mew asks, realizing what the boy means.

"Yes. The Yas and Kaz gyms are fighting again. If you don't want to get dragged into this, you better go upstairs and hide," The owner says.

Mew and the others hurry upstairs so they won't be seen. Outside, there is a group wearing blue jumpsuits with a K on it.

The Kaz leader says, "Get ready! Today, the Kaz gym's gonna crush you!"

The otherside shows a group wearing green overalls and a yellow long sleeve shirt with Y on the overalls.

The Yas leader says, "Guess again! The Yas gym will wipe you out!"

Then Kaz Leader calls out, "Go, Electabuzz! Thunderbolt, now!"

Then the Electabuzz from the Kaz zaps the Yas soldiers.

Yas leader calls out, "We can't let them win! Attack, Scyther!"

Scyther attacks and causes a nearby building to collapse on top of the Kaz soldiers. Soon, many people run away from the area in a panic. From the window, Mew and her friends are shocked.

Brock turns to the kids, "Is it always like this?"

Sadly, the boys nod their heads in reply. Then Mew and her friends turn to the window.

"Now I can understand why everyone around here hates Pokemon trainers," Brock says.

"That's not even a Pokemon battle! It's more like a street fight!" Misty says.

Seeing this makes Mew angry, "Those bullies! They don't understand what it really means to be a Pokemon trainer!"

Suddenly, they hear the noise coming from downstairs. The restaurant owner is being attacked by three Kaz soldiers, but they look familiar.

The smallest attacker says, "Hey, cook! Give me the lunch special for thirty people."

"We've got to be the Kaz gym in less than an hour," A female attacker says.

The tallest attacker says, "Throw in an order of onion rings while you're at it."

"I'd like to, but, you see, the Kaz gym hasn't paid its bill in over two years," The restaurant owner says.

Mew and the others watch quietly from upstairs.

Mew softly says, "There's something familiar about them."

The female attacker angrily says, "What?! Are you telling us we can't put this on our tab?!"

"Do you realize we're Kaz gym bodyguards? Give us the food or else!" the purple haired attacker says.

The owner panics, "I'd like to, but I can't. I don't want any trouble!"

"You won't give us lunch, but you don't want trouble, huh?" The shortest member says.

Then the female member says, "You're talking to the wrong customers if you don't want any trouble."

The restaurant owner panics, "Please, leave me alone! I don't want any trouble!"

With that word sends temptation in the two's ears.

"Trouble?" The woman questions.

"Trouble? I can't resist, Jessie," The man says.

"Neither can I! Prepare for trouble!" The woman says, and turns off her disguise to reveal Jessie.

"Make it double!" The man does the same, taking off his disguise.

Soon, they're revealed to be Team Rocket, much to Mew, her friends, and the Pokemons' shock.

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Both Pomemon come out of their Pokeballs and attack the restaurant owner. The mysterious customer steps back from the fight.

"It's Team Rocket! I knew it!" Mew says, coming down stairs.

Brock brings out his Pokeball, "I'll handle this."

"Tomo help too" Tomo says.

Both of them call out their Pokemon, "Go, Vulpix/Growlithe!"

Then both Pokemon come out.

Brock and Tomo call out, "Use Flamethrower!"

With that, Vulpix and Growlithe fire their flamethrower attack at Team Rocket.

Meowth stands up and says, "Rare." Same goes with Weezing and Arbok.

"Medium," Jessie says, looking in the mirror.

James stands up, completely burned, "Well done."

Soon, Team Rocket retreats from the scene.

"Nice to see you leave!" Misty calls out.

Then Mew says, "Don't come back anytime!"

Then Mew turns to the owner and asks, "Are you alright?"

"Thank you for saving my restaurant," The owner says in gratitude.

"It's no trouble, but you should really thank Vulpix and Growlithe," Mew says.

Vulpix and Growlithe happily bark in reply.

Suddenly, someone says, "That was great!"

Everyone turns her heads to see a female trainer with blue hair and purple eyes. Judging by the appearance and the uniform she is a member of the Yas gym.

"I saw everything that happened!" The girl happily says.

The group becomes confused, but Brock approaches the young lady and asks, "Excuse me, is there someway we can help you, miss?"

"Those were some of the strongest bodyguards from Kaz gym! How did your friend overpower them so easily? She must be a very gifted, very famous, Pokemon trainer," The girl says, making Brock blush.

The girl happily begs, "Please! Please! You must tell me your names!"

Before Brock can answer, Mew steps in and says, "Can you give us a few minutes?"

Mew drags Brock away and with Misty, Tomo and the Pokemon, they all form a separate circle.

"What do you think?" Brock asks.

Misty says, "If we get mixed up in this gang war, it could ruin our reputations as Pokemon trainers."

"It will be best to come up with fake names and see what she wants," Brock says.

"Right," The girls reply.

Mew turns to the girl and says, " Um well, you see, my name is… my name is Aurora… Aurora Veil. And the little guy with me is… Spark…"

"Sparks," Tomo says.

Misty is confused, a weird idea for a name, but using the name of a Pokemon move is better than nothing.

"Well then, my name is Aqua Rings," Misty says.

Still blushing, Brock is not saying a word. Misty nudges at him until he comes out of his daze.

Then Brock says, "And I'm Stone. Stone Edge."

Happy, the girl says, "Oh Aurora, Spark, Aqua, and Stone would you consider joining our cause at the Yas gym? Unlike those animals from the Kaz gym, we at Yas are truly worth of becoming an official Pokemon gym."

"Uh, well. You better ask Aqua," Mew replies.

Misty says, "Well, we can't do it! Isn't that right, Stone Edge?"

But Brock quickly says, "We'll do anything we can to help."

Misty falls over in disbelief while Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee groan with annoyed expressions. Tomo is confused.

Misty says, annoyed, "Brock just can't say no to a pretty girl."

"But it might give us more information about the Yaz gym," Mew says.

Soon, Mew and her friends arrive at the Yas Gym that is kind of like a dojo. They walk inside to see so many Yas gym members working out like lifting weights.

"Please, come right in," The girl says.

They walk down the hall until the girl leads them to the Yas leader lifting weights and has his Scyther next to him.

The girl bows her head, "Yas leader, let me introduce you to a great trainer. This is Pokemon trainer, Aurora Veil. She's brought three disciples to help us."

Brock becomes dumbfounded, "She brought us."

Misty giggles.

The girl then says, "I saw them defeat the bodyguards from Kaz gym like they were nothing! They're really strong trainers."

"I'll decide how strong they are. Scyther, go!" The Yas leader calls out.

Scyther leaps out and begins to attack.

Mew quickly acts, "Eevee, use Iron Tail!"

Eevee jumps in and uses Iron Tail on Scyther, sending it to the wall. Then that happens, a jar of paint falls on top of it, covering the eyes. Soon, the Pokemon looks round to see everything looks red to it, and soon it goes crazy at it's trainer.

Yas leader: Scyther, what is it?

Soon, Sycther begins to attack as his trainer dodges the attack.

Soon, Sycther returns to its Pokeball.

Mew then decides to ask, "First, I have one thing to ask you. Why's it so important that this should become an official Pokemon gym?"

"That answer should be obvious. What faster way is there to make money in today's world then by becoming an official Pokemon gym?" The Yas Leader says.

Mew lowers her head and clutches her fist. The Yas Gym Leader is only doing this for money. And he's doing it by getting into fights with another gym and causing people and Pokemon to be hurt. He doesn't care about what happens to the Pokemon or people who are caught in the crossfire.

Mew then answers, "Well, if that's your reason, I won't become your bodyguard."

"What?" The Yas Leader asks.

"Pokemon are not just tools for fighting or a way of making money. Pokemon are meant to be friends with people. I know because I work together with my Pokemon. We've been through so much and mean a lot to me. I refuse to become part of a gym that uses Pokemon for street fighting and causing harm to others. That isn't the type of trainer I want to be. I won't help you," Mew sternly says.

Misty, Brock, and Tomo nod their heads with smiles. They suspect Mew will refuse if Pokemon are forced to battle like this.

However, the Yas Leader says, "If you won't join us, we'll make sure you don't help anyone else! Yas gym, attack!"

Soon, the doors open to reveal the Yas gym trainers. They send out their Pokemon, a Mankey, Machoke, Hitmonlee, and a Hitmonchan.

Mew sternly huffs, "Hmph! Pikachu! Eevee! Use Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu and Eevee jump in the air and electrocute everyone in the room, including the Yas Leader. Then Mew and the others hurry back to the restaurant. Of course, Mew is still not happy with the Yas Gym Leader, not at all.

"That was a close save, Mew," Misty says.

Tomo says, "Mew did good."

"That Yas gym plays rough," Brock says.

"I think the Kaz gym plays the same way," Mew replies.

"They think Pokemon battling's like plain old fighting. Imagine if they became an official Pokemon gym. In my opinion, I doubt either one of them would become official gyms with that kind of attitude. And they don't care who gets in their way," Mew says.

The boy with blue hair says, Kaz and Yas keep getting stronger Pokemon, and they wreck our town with their fighting!"

"If this keeps up, people will think all Pokemon trainers are dangerous," Brock says.

"And they'll think the same way about Pokemon," Misty adds.

Mew then says, "Well, I have enough about this. I think it's about time someone taught those two gym leaders a lesson."

"But how?" Tomo asks.

Mew remembers what happened when Pikachu attacked Scyther and paint fell on its face.

Suddenly, Mew realizes, "Paint!"

Mew quickly brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Scyther and Electabuzz are both rare Pokemon. They are able to distinguish colors and become enraged by the color red."

"Like the paint," Brock says.

That's when Mew has an idea, "If we work together, we just might be able to beat them!"

Meanwhile in the Yas Gym, the leader has an announcement.

The Yas leader says, "Listen up! The Pokemon League inspector will be coming through town any minute. We have to run those Kaz gym losers out of town before he gets here."

In the Kaz gym, the leader has the same announcement, "Pokemon League inspector is on his way! We have to completely crush those Yas gym trainers, and show em we're the best! This town's only big enough for one gym!"

Back in town, Mew, Eevee and Pikachu are working on the weather pole, while Brock, and the kids nail the boards. Everyone does their part to work on getting barrels of paint and tomato sauce ready. Even the Pokemon Grooky, Raboot, Sobble, Teddiursa, and some more are helping. Soon, their plan is in motion.

"Alright. Weather looks fine, and everything's all set and ready to go!" Mew says.

Soon, the Kaz and Yas gym armies take their places on the opposite sides of the street, and are ready for the battle before the Inspector arrives. Mew and her friends are in position for their plan.

"I'm only gonna say this once to you guys! Kaz gym's gonna be the official gym of Dark City! Save yourself some trouble and clear out, now!" Kaz Leader says.

However, Yas leader says, "I'm afraid you have things all mixed up. You're the ones who had better clear out, and fast! Leave now, or we'll crush you like the slimy insects you are!"

Kaz Leader says with furry, "Now you're gonna be sorry you ever hear the name of Kaz gym!"

"Today's the day we finally destroy you once and for all!" Yas leader says.

Kaz leader angrily says, "I've heard enough! Electabuzz, go!" and throws his Pokeball.

"Get them, Scyther!" Yas do the same.

Soon, both Electabuzz and Scyther come out of their Pokeball. The soldiers send out their Pokemon and attack Electabuzz.

Chapter 42: Episode 41: The March of the Exeggutor

Mew and her friends have been working very hard on their Pokemon journey, and haven't been able to get some rest in relaxation, but now they are in luck. They've arrived in a town the same day a carnival has arrived. There are rides, games, food, and so many performers. In fact, there's a big crowd today.

Brock is awestruck by the pretty girls, "Look at all of those beautiful girls."

"And check out all of the rides and shows," Misty says.

With that, the group then split up to have some fun. They go on different rides, have all kinds of food, and play different kinds of games. Misty decides to have Sobble out for him to have fun too. At first, Sobble is a little timid to be in a big crowd, but as long as he's with Misty, Sobble is at ease. Sometime later, Misty and Sobble are having ice cream.

"That one was great, wasn't it? Which one do you want to go on next?" Misty replies.

Before Sobble can answer, a woman's voice shouts, "I've had it! I quit!"

Misty and Sobble turn to see a woman dressed as a Vulpix while a man that looks like a magician is bowing and begging her. Next to him is a Pokemon, she recognizes it to be an Exeggcute.

"Please, don't leave me! I promise to pay you as soon as I can!" The man begs.

The woman sternly says, "Then pay me right now!"

"I can't just now, but I promise as soon as I get some paying customers I'll pay you," The man sadly says.

But the woman refuses, "And just who do you think is gonna come watch your lousy show?!"

The man continues to beg her, but she smacks him in the face.

"I've heard your promises before! Humph! Goodbye," The woman says and leaves the scene.

"Don't leave, I need you," The man sadly says.

Misty walks over to him and asks, "Excuse us, are you alright, sir?"

"You're a kind person, aren't you?" The man asks, depressed.

"Well no, not especially," Misty says.

And such a beautiful girl. You'd help me out, wouldn't you? I need your help so badly. And you'd be so perfect," The man says, and collapses on the ground.

The man turns to Misty, "You're the only one who can help me now."

"Keep an open mind," The man says.

"Uh huh," Misty says with a nod.

Mew and the others hurry to see Melvin trampled on the ground.

"Kanga," (You're welcome.) Mama Kangaskhan says.

Back at the carnival, everyone is having a wonderful time. That is, until they notice something heading their way.

Someone asks, "Hey, what's that noise?"

But someone says, "No, those are Exeggutor!"

The Exeggutor herd continue to march and run as fast as they can through the carnival making everyone scream and panic. When Mew and the others arrive, the carnival has been destroyed.

"You can't! Those Exeggutor are under hypnosis, they don't realize what they're doing! It's not their fault!" Mew angrily says.

"Who cares?! We can't let em cause anymore damage to the town! Now get outta here and fast!" The Carnival owner says and hurries off.

"Soon the group stand in front of the stamp as they are coming in their direction.

Three of them come to a stop.

Tomo then brings out his Pokeballs, "Tomo help too."

All the Pokemon come out as their trainers call out, "Use Flamethrower.

Soon, all the Pokemon continue to perform their flame attack, stopping the many Coconut Pokemon. However, they're are so many of them. And the Pokemon are starting to get tired. Mew and her friends hurry to their Pokemon to see how tired they are. However, Charmander and Raboot struggle to stand and don't plan on giving up.

Melvin says feeling depressed, "I know I can't do it!"

"You CAN do it! Just look at Charmander, Raboot, and the rest of the Pokemon. If they worked that hard, then you have to at least try!" Misty says.

Melvin looks to see the Pokemon are getting tried, but are refusing to give up.

Determined, Melvin says, "Then I'll give it my best shot!"

"Okay everyone, let's do it," Mew says.

All the Fire Pokemon and Melvin nod their heads and perform the attack.

Melvin calls out," Raging Fire"

With that, the fire of the attack and Melvin's trick combine to create a river of fire and awaken all of the Exeggutor, including Team Rocket.

"Who?" James says, confused.

Jessie asks, "What?"

"Where?" Meowth adds.

Soon, the herd begins to march back to the forest, carrying Team Rocket with them.

Then turns to the others with glee, "I did it! I really did it!"

"Yeah! Great job, Melvin!" Mew says.

Soon, Melvin's Exeggutor steps forward.

Melvin hugs it with glee, "Exeggutor! Your Hypnosis spell is broken! This is so wonderful!"

Right at this moment, the time bomb goes off.

"Wow! That was a close call!" Misty says.

"You're right. Thank goodness no one was hurt," Melvin says.

Mew hugs Charmander and Raboot, and pets Arcanine, "You both did a terrific job."

Tomo hugs his Pokemon, "You all did great."

"You all did very good out there," Brock says to his Pokemon.

Suddenly, Charmander and Raboot begin to glow.

Mew gasps in surprise, "Charmander… Raboot…"

"Charmander and Raboot? They're both?" Misty says, surprised.

"They're evolving!" Brock says.

Charmander soon evolves in front of the group. Charmander is now a bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. It has dark red scales and a cream underside from the chest down. It has narrow, blue eyes and a long snout with a slightly hooked tip. On the back of its head is a single horn-like protrusion. It has relatively long arms with three sharp claws. Its short legs have plantigrade feet with three claws and cream-colored soles.

Robot also evolves with Charmander. Now Raboot is a bipedal, rabbit-like Pokémon. Most of its torso and head, as well as its arms and tail, are white, long white ears, the insides of which are yellow. Its eyes, which have red-orange pupils and white irises, have a deep navy pattern below them and yellow eyebrows above them. These eyebrows connect at the nose, which is red-orange, and form a "crown", which connects to the red-orange tuft of hair sticking out from its forehead, similar to a flame. It has two whisker-like tufts of white fur on each side of its face. Over each shoulder is a navy patch of fur, resembling a shoulder brace, which continues down the torso and connect at middle of the chest, creating what resembles a sports tank top. This navy-colored fur is also seen on its lower torso, creating what resembles a belt. The fur on its lower body is colored red-orange and resembles a pair of pants, with yellow pockets and ending in yellow tufts at the knees, with little tufts of fur on the backside of its thighs. Its ankles and feet are colored navy-blue and tipped red-orange at the toes.

Everyone is astonished to see the double evolution.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Charmeleon, the Flame Pokemon. A Fire Type. It has razor sharp claws and its tail is exceptionally strong."

Then turns to Raboot's evolved form, "Cinderace, the Striker Pokemon. A Fire Type. Cinderace uses Pyro Ball to create a soccer ball of fire that it kicks at its opponents, often leaving them with a burn."

"Charmander. Cinderace. You both evolved. Congratulations guys," Mew says, and hugs her Pokemon.

Charmeleon and Cinderace smile and hugs Mew back.

Later in the evening, Mew and her friends head off while Melvin and Exegguctor follow their own path.

"Never forget your dream!" Mew says.

"Practice makes perfect!" Misty says.

"See you in the big time!" Brock says.

"Thank you! All of you!" Melvin says.

Mew and her friends say, "Goodbye!"

It has been a big day. They have fun in the carnival, help Melvin the Magician stop a herd of rampaging Exeggutor, and Charmander has evolved into Charmeleon while Raboot evolved into Cinderace. They sure had a fun and busy day. Meanwhile, Team Rocket is being carried away by the Exegguctor heard and is unable to escape. As the Journey continues.
