Chapter 50: Episode 49: Pokemon Paparazzi

On a beautiful and sunny day, Mew and her friends stopped at an open field, having a relaxing picnic lunch.

Misty picks a piece of rice ball, "Okay, Togepi. Open wide."

Togepi does so and Misty feeds the piece to Togepi. Togepi takes a bite and chews it.

"Now, make sure to chew every bite," Misty says, and Togepi is thrilled because of the taste.

Mew takes bite of the rice ball, "These rice balls are pretty good."

"Of course they are," Brock says.

And prepare another one and use martial arts, "When you got lemons, you make lemonade. And when you got rice, you make rice balls! Eat up, everybody! There's plenty more where that came from!"

As Mew and the others are having their lunch, they are unaware that they are being closely watched by a complete stranger. Whatever the being is or what is plotting, seems to be using something to get a closer look at Mew. Then lower the camera to see Pikachu.

The stranger quietly says, "Okay. I have the Pikachu in my sights. Now, don't move."

Suddenly, Mew spots a strange device hiding in the bushes that catches her attention.

Mew whispers to her friends, "Hey guys, I think someone is spying on us?

"Where?" Misty asks.

Mew gently points to the bushes, "Over there."

The group turns to notice something behind the bushes.

Tomo whispers, "Is it Team Rocket?"

"Possibly," Mew says, and brings out her Pokeball.

Then then opens her Pokeball and Squirtle comes out of it.

"Squirtle," (Hi everyone.) Squritle says.

"Hi Squirtle. Listen, we need you to aim your Water Gun at that bush," Mew says, pointing to the direction.

"Squirtle," (Got it.) Squirtle says.

Squirtle then sprays the Water Gun and suddenly hears someone screaming.

Along with shouting, "Quit it! Stop spraying me!"

Mew says, "Okay Squirtle, that's enough."

Squirtle stops spraying Water Gun. Turns out the mysterious intruder is actually a boy who has black colored eyes, brown hair and brown eyebrows. He is wearing a red and light red striped shirt, blue shorts, brown shows, a green bag, and has a camera.

Misty walks over and asks, "Is everything okay?"

The boy checks the camera and says, "It's okay! It's working just fine!"

"I wasn't asking about your camera, I was worried about you!" Misty says.

"But, you see, this camera is my life," The boy says.

"We're sorry about spraying you like that. We thought you were someone else. My name is Mew and this is my Partners: Pikachu and Eevee," Mew says.

"Pika," (Hi.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Hello.) Eevee says.

"I'm Tomo," Tomo says.

"I'm Misty and this is Togepi," Misty says.

"And I'm Brock," Brock says.

"It's nice to meet you, and no hard feelings. My name's Snap, Todd Snap, and I love taking pictures," Todd says.

"Photos?" Tomo says confused.

Then Todd says, "You should consider it an honor that I want to take a picture of your Pikachu."

"Pika?" (Picture?) Pikachu replies.

"Oh, really?" Misty says.

"If you wanted to take a picture, why didn't you just ask us first?" Brock replies.

But Todd says, "I didn't want Pikachu to know I was taking pictures of it. I never liked them to look posed. You see, I am the number one Pokemon photo master!"

"Did he say.." Misty and Brock say, confused.

"Master?" Mew and Tomo add, confused.

Soon, Mew and her friends join Todd at his small white house that has a red roof and a chimney, where they can finish their lunch and Todd offers them drinks.

"You may not recognize my name, but I'm sure you've heard of the photographer who took the only known of the legendary Pokemon, Aerodactyl," Todd say

Everyone looks confused.

Misty turns to Brock, "Have any of you?"

"Not me," Brock answers.

Todd falls back in disbelief, but quickly gets back up, "How is it possible that they've never heard of me?!"

Then hurries off. He soon returns with the magazine and opens it on the table, "Here. Look at this issue of Pokemon Times! That's my picture of an Aerodactyl!"

He then opens the magazine to see Todd's photo and the silhouette of an Aerodactyl.

Seeing the photo, Mew realizes, "Hey! That's me!" pointing to the photo.

"What are you talking about? This is Aerodactyl, the ancient Pokemon," Todd says, confused.

"I know about that, but see the one Aerodactyl is hanging on to. That's me. What's more, I caught that very Aerodactyl in your photo," Mew says.

Misty looks at the photo and says, "You're right, it is."

"It's the same Aerodactyl," Brock says.

"Yeah," Tomo says.

Hearing the conversation, Todd asks, surprised, "Wait, you're saying that you caught an actual Aerodactyl? The same one I took a picture of?"

"Yeah. It happened when we were at Grandpa Canyon," Mew says.

"And each of us have found Pokemon fossils from there," Misty says.

"Not only that, Mew didn't just catch a living Aerodactyl, but a living Omanyte and Kabuto as well," Brock says.

"And her Charizard evolved and beat Aerodactyl, and we got Togepi's egg from the canyon," Tomo adds.

"Wow! That's amazing. Do you have them right now?" Todd asks, excited.

"Sure. I'll show you," Mew says.

Then tosses her Pokeballs in the air, "Come on out!"

With that, the three Prehistoric Pokemon come out of their Pokeballs.

Todd is amazed, "Wow! Your Aerodactyl is so big. And your Omayte and Kabuto are amazing."

Todd then begins to take pictures of them with his camera.

Omanyte turns to Todd and waves its small tentacles at him.

"Omanyte is saying hi," Mew says.

"Well then, hi to you too," Todd says.

Omanyte continues to wave with glee. Aerodactyal walks to Mew and snuggles Mew's head with his muzzle. Kabuto crawls to Pikachu and Eevee to say hello.

Mew says, "We're trying to keep a low profile on where they come from. To be honest, there are actually more of those Pokemon from the canyon, it will be terrible if anyone knows about it and will try to capture them. So you have to promise not to tell anyone where I got them from, sounds fair," Mew says.

"You have a deal. I'm also sorry I scared you guys. Let me make some breakfast for you. You like pancakes?" Todd says.

"Thanks Todd, that's very nice of you," Mew says.

"I haven't had pancakes in a LONG time!" Brock says.

"That sounds great, Todd!" Misty says.

"Okay! And I'm sure you won't mind if I take Pikachu's picture," Todd says, and turns to Pikachu.

"Pika?" (Picture?) Pikachu says, confused.

"Don't worry. I'll be sure to capture your best side," Todd says.

"Pi? (Huh?) Pikachu says, confused.

Soon enough, Mew and the others are having pancakes and are beginning to eat it. Even Pikachu and Eevee, along with Aerodactyl, Omanyte, and Kabuto are enjoying the delicious pancakes.

"These pancakes taste great," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads in agreement.

"You have to give me the recepie!" Brock says.

While Mew and the others are eating the food, Todd then changes the lens on his camera. Then has the camera points to Pikachu, but the Pikachu notices him.

"Okay, Pikachu. Keep eating. Just pretend I'm not in the room, alright? Relax, just act natural," Todd says.

Pikachu smiles, feeling embarrassed. Soon, the others notice what is going on and Todd tries to get a picture of him.

"That's fabulous. Now, smile. Smile. This is gonna be great!" Todd says.

Todd presses the button allowing the camera to take their picture, but Pikachu shocks him by accident.

"Pi! Pikachu!" (Oh! I'm sorry!) Pikachu panics.

Mew covers her mouth as she lets out a chuckle, "The camera's shutter must've scared them. We don't get our picture taken too much."

"Pika," (Yeah.) Pikachu sadly says.

"There's nothing to be afraid of, Pikachu," Todd says.

Then has his camera ready, "let's try again. Okay, smile."

Pikachu shyly smiles and feels embarrassed.

Todd then drops his knees, "I'm sorry, I can't work like this."

"What do you mean, Todd?" Brock asks.

"Pokemon should be photographed naturally, not posing. It's the only way I want my pictures of Pokemon!" Todd says.

Confused, Misty asks, "Why is it such a big deal that the Pokemon pose or don't pose?"

Todd then points to the photos, "Take a look at those photographs over there!"

Mew and her friends look at all the wild Pokemon on the wall. There are two Eevees, a Mankey, Pidgey, Dugtrio, and they all look natural.

Todd continues, "They're all Pokemon. Living in their own natural habitats. Those aren't poses, look how peaceful they are. Don't those shots show Pokemon the way they ought to be?

Seeing them, Brock says, "Wow! I've never seen Pokemon pictures like THAT before!"

"They all look so cute and carefree!" Misty says.

"Yeah, they're happy!" Tomo says.

"Wow! Your pictures are wonderful," Mew happily says.

"With my pictures, I can show the whole world how happy and beautiful Pokemon are in the wild," Todd says.

"Yeah!" Mew says.

"That's great!" Misty replies.

"You have a real talent for showing Pokemon the way they should be seen," Brock adds.

"That's why I never want to shoot a Pokemon that's posed and looks sad and scared," Todd says.

"Pika," (Golly.) Pikachu says, amazed.

Togepi and Eevee think the same.

"Hmm, well, my Pikachu has a little problem about being photographed. Maybe you can take pictures of my other Pokemon," Mew suggests.

"That's very nice, but, no thanks! I only want to take pictures of Pikachu." Todd says.

"What's so important about taking Pikachu's picture?" Misty asks, confused.

"Well, you see.. I can't tell you why." Todd replies.

"How come?" Tomo asks.

"That's all I can say. I have to take Pikachu and that's all there is to it!" Todd says.

"This is going to be tough. The chances of getting Pikachu's picture without freaking out, it's well, close to zero," Mew says.

But Todd laughs and is up for the challenge, "You just watch! I'll capture you, Pikachu, like no other photographer could capture you!"

Nervous and frightened, Pikachu says, "Pi. Pika." (Uh, okay.)

Soon, Mew and her friends are hitting the road. They follow the river, but little do they know. Todd is nearby and is waiting for the perfect moment to get a picture of Pikachu. He then starts to remember the reason why he had to take Pikachu's picture.

Flashback:

Todd ends up meeting an old couple sometime ago.

The old woman says, "You must help us. We really need you to capture this Pikachu."

"Oh, please! This Pikachu's so important to us," The man says, giving him the photos.

"Pikachu?" Todd says, and it turns out the photos are of Mew and her Pikachu.

Seeing the position of the photos, Todd thinks, "Hmm. These pictures rot."

"Please. Grant this old woman one last wish before she passes on," The old woman says in tears.

Soon, her husband and the pet Meowth begin to cry as well.

Todd thinks, "It's so sad. They must've raised a Pikachu just like this one. I'll do it. I'll use my camera to capture Pikachu on film for them."

Then Todd tells the old couple, "Don't worry! I'll take the job!"

"You mean you'll do it?" The man says.

"I'll capture the Pikachu perfectly!" Todd says.

Soon, the old couple and Meowth cry for joy.

"Thank goodness we found you before it was too late," The old woman happily says.

"We're very grateful. We'd appreciate it if you don't tell anyone we've been here," The old man says.

"No problem. I would never reveal my clients' identities!" Todd says.

Flashback ends:

"I have to grant the old woman's wish. I have to capture the perfect picture of Pikachu," Todd says.

Meanwhile, inside a building, the old couple turns out to be Team Rocket in disguise. No doubt another plan to capture Pikachu from Mew.

As they eat, Jessie asks, "Alright, Meowth, where'd you find this Snap kid? Can he get Pikachu?"

"It says in the Pokemon Times that this kid's the best at capturing Pokemon," Meowth says, holding a magazine.

"And he did show us that huge photo album with all the Pokemon he said he'd taken," James says.

"He even said he wanted to take a shot at Pikachu, or something like that," Meowth says.

Soon, Jessie and James begin to fight over the last piece of meat on the table.

"Let me have it!" Jessie angrily says.

"I need protein!" James demands.

Ultimately, Jessie is victorious.

Defeated, James whines, "You're not acting like a nice old lady!"

"That's because I'm not nice," Jessie says.

Then takes off her disguise, "or old!"

James takes off his disguise, "Time to lose the guy's disguise!"

"Surprise surprise!" The two Team Rocket members announce.

"Yeah, right," Meowth says.

Later down the road, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and Tomo are washing their faces while Brock, Misty, and Togepi are relaxing.

Suddenly, Todd appears from the trashcan and shouts, "Hold it right there!"

Todd snaps the picture, but misses as Pikachu quickly moves out of the way, "Hey! What?"

Mew giggles, "You gotta be quicker!"

Todd tries again, and this time he is hanging upside down on a tree.

"Ready?" Todd asks, getting Pikachu's attention and snaps the picture.

Sadly, he misses, "Ah, not again!"

"Missed again," Mew says with a giggle.

Even Tomo and Eevee are laughing.

Determined Todd says, "I'll get that picture if it's the last thing I do!"

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is digging another pitfall for Mew and the others to fall in.

"Remember the last time we made a trap like this, Meowth?" James says, enjoying the pit trap scam.

"Yeah, I really dug it!?" Meowth says, with a chuckle.

"Why don't you try more digging and less talking?! Those twerps are on their way and they'll be here any.." Jessie says, but is cut off when dirt is thrown on her face.

Suddenly, James hits something with his shovel as he digs.

"I think I, just discovered something!" James says.

Jessie looks down in the hole, "What are you stopping for? Keep digging!"

"Roger!" James and Meowth say.

They soon set the trap and cover the trap with dirt, branches, and leaves, and more. Then they all quickly hide in the bushes.

Suddenly, Meowth notices someone up ahead, "Huh? It's that Todd kid! Hurry up! Disguises on!

Jessie and James notice and quickly put on their disguises, but end up wearing the wrong one.

Look at yourselves," Meowth says, and falls over, embarrassed.

Then says, "You got em mixed up!"

Jessie and James quickly switch disguises as Todd arrives on the scene.

"I'm sorry, I haven't taken that Pikachu for you yet," Todd says.

"We're sure you'll get it sooner or later," Jessie says.

"And just as a little insurance policy, we even dug this tra.." James says.

Jessie quickly covers his mouth, to not spoil the plan. Then Jessie drags James away with Meowth following close behind.

Todd feels a bit of the ground and says, "This dirt is soft. Maybe a good place to wait for Pikachu. Alright!"

Todd then sets his equipment, "Tripod, check. Camera, check. Lens, check. Okay! Now I'm ready!"

Then looks through the camera to see Mew and the others heading in their direction.

"Right on time," Todd says to himself.

Coming towards Todd and the trap, Mew and her friends are walking towards it. Pikachu however is peeking out of Mew's bag and looks around to see if Todd is nearby. Then ducks back in.

"Pikachu must really hate cameras. I've never seen him act so nervous before," Brock says.

Misty sighs and says, "It's too bad Snap won't get the kind of picture he's so great at."

"I know Todd means well, but he's taking this a little too far. He's so busy wanting to get a photo that he doesn't seem to understand how Pikache is feeling about this," Mew says.

Todd hears this and has him thinking, "I don't understand Pikachu's feelings?"

"I do hope Todd will give this up, I don't know how much Pikachu can taaaaaaaaa…." Mew says, and screams as she falls.

Misty, Brock, Tomo, and Eevee fall down as well.

Todd gasps, "They're gone!"

"Ow! My arm!" Tomo yelps.

"Who's idea was it to put a hole in the road?" Mew yelps.

"Yeah. Who else would have an idea like that?" Brock questions.

Misty answers, "Just, Team, Rocket."

Meanwhile, Team Rocket noticed that the plan actually worked.

"We finally caught them!" Jessie happily says.

"They fell for our trap!" James says, looking through the binoculars.

"Usually, we're the ones to fall in," Meowth says.

"I can't wait! Soon, we'll have our Pikachu!" Jessie says, excited.

Todd looks down from the hole.

"Let's watch and learn from the expert," Jessie says.

"It's capture time!" James says.

Looking down, Todd asks, "How'd you get down there?"

"Easy, we fell," Mew says.

"You've gotta get us out of here!" Misty says.

"I think I have a rope," Todd says.

Just then, Pikachu pops out of Mew's backpack.

"Are you okay, Pikachu?" Mew asks.

Pikachu answers, "Pikachu!" (I'm just fine!)

Todd notices Pikachu and quickly brings out his camera, "That's the Pikachu I wanna capture!"

"Great! Now throw us that rope!" Misty shouts.

In the bushes, Team Rocket notices something is off.

"What is that boy doing?" Jessie asks.

"He's taking a picture of Pikachu," James says.

Then the two glare at the Pokemon comrade, "Meowth."

Mewoth quickly brings out the magazine and turns the pages."The magazine says he's.."

Then finds the photo with Todd holding his camera, "The best at capturing Pokemon, ON FILM?!"

That's when Mewoth realizes his mistake, "Ah, now I get it! The article said that he's good at capturing Pokemon on film. I thought he actually captures them! An amusing mistake!"

Furious James and Jessie angrily say, "You're the mistake!" and punch Meowth in the air.

Mewoth screams, "Meowth!"

Meanwhile, Todd preps his picture of Pikachu.

"Alright. Hold it," Todd says, and snaps a picture.

He finally has the picture, and happily says, "I did it! Now, just a few more…!"

But soon notices something underneath Mew, it looks like bricks and they're beginning to crack.

"Oh no!" Todd panics and throws the rope down to them.

He cries out, "Grab the rope! The bottom of the pit is crumbling! You gotta get out before it falls through!"

Before they have the chance, the floor breaks down from under Mew and Pikachu and they fall in and splash in the water.

Misty panics, "Mew!"

"Pikachu!" Brock panics.

Todd quickly climbs down with Tomo and Eevee behind him.

Mew and Pikachu hold on to the bag.

"Pikachu, don't let go!" Mew says.

"Pika!" (No problem!) Pikachu cries out.

"Mew! Eevee! calls out.

The two then turn to see their friends hurrying to save them.

"Are you okay?!" Todd asks.

"Yeah, we're okay!" Mew answers.

"Grab onto something, quick! There's not much time!" Todd panics.

Mew and Pikachu are confused and turn their heads to see the end of the tunnel and it leads to a waterfall. Mew and Pikachu gasp in shock. Mew then begins to swim with Pikachu on her head, but they are not getting father.

Mew panics, "There's nothing to grab onto!"

"We gotta think of something, fast!" Todd says.

Mew continues to swim as he says, "Hold on, Pikachu!"

Mew continues to swim as fast as she can as Pikachu hangs on to her. Todd then has an idea on how to save them.

He brings out his tripod with his camera on it, "Mew grab a hold!"

Mew then quickly grabs the strap of Todd's camera and grabs on, and just in time as he goes over the falls. Mew looks up to see Todd, Tomo, and Eevee holding on to the tripod and the ladder

"Mew! Hang on!" Todd calls out.

"Okay!" Mew calls out.

But notices, "But, your.. Your camera is ruined! You sacrificed your camera to save us?"

"Don't you worry about my camera, Mew! You just worry about holding on!" Todd says.

"Okay!" Mew says.

Todd and the others begin to pull the tripod with the camera and Mew begins to climb on the camera.

Suddenly, they hear a familiar voice, "You did a great job for us, Todd!"

Todd and the others look on the other side to see Todd's client.

Old Woman:

Prepare for trouble!

Old man:

Make it double!

Old Woman:

To protect the world from devastation!

Old Man:

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Old woman:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

Old Man:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Soon, the two remove their disguises to reveal Team Rocket.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Todd is shocked to see the elderly couple's true form.

Mew exclaims in shock "Team Rocket!"

"Not them again!" Tomo adds.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender, now, or prepare to fight!

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

"And we just netted ourselves a Pikachu!" Meowth says, and extends a kind of net. Then scoops Pikachu up.

"Pikachu!" Mew panics.

"Why did you trick me?!" Todd asks.

"You tricked us first, little shutterbug. We wanted you to TAKE that Pikachu, not take it's picture!"

"But thanks for helping us snap up the real Pikachu," Meowth says.

"And just to show our gratitude, why don't you have one of these?" James says, and pulls out a bomb.

Then throw it at them. The bomb explodes, shaking the tripod Mew is holding on. Todd and the others refuse to let go as their feet begin to slip.

James then pulls out another bomb, "Looks like I need a little work on my aim."

Then throws another one, soon one after another.

"Todd! Tomo! Eevee!" Mew panics.

Meanwhile, Pikachu continues to squirm in the net as he is trying hard to break free.

Meowth laughs and says, "Squirm all you want! You'll never get out of this rubber bag!"

"Could we wind this up, now, please?" Jessie asks.

"Will do!" James says, and brings out another bomb.

Mew grits her teeth and knows that she needs to do something. She notices Todd's camera and has an idea.

"And the final pitch!" James says, about to throw the bomb.

But Mew shouts, "Hold it!

Team Rocket soon sees Mew is holding Todd's camera, ready to take a picture.

"Okay, everyone, just smile for the camera! You're gonna love this shot!" Mew says.

James smiles and laughs sheepishly.

"What's the magic word?" Mew asks.

"Cheese!" James and Meowth say as they smile.

Jessie is fixing up her makeup, "Let me just take a shine on that.."

"Now, look to the right," Mew says.

Team Rocket turns their heads to see the bomb and it's about to go off. And in seconds, it goes off with a bang. Soon, Team Rocket is covered in dust and burnt marks.

"Oh! Look at, my face!" Jessie screams, looking at her face in the mirror.

Then turns to James, "You ruined the shot!" and kicks James' back

That gives Todd, Tomo and Eevee, enough time to pull Mew back to solid ground.

"Thanks guys," Mew says.

Then turns to Team Rocket, "Okay, guys. Let's give Team Rocket our best shot!"

Mew then throws her Pokeball, "Bulbasaur, go!"

Bulbasaur then comes out of the Pokeball.

Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, Razor Leaf, now!"

Bulbasaur unleashes the attack on Team Rocket, and begins to panic.

"Cut it out!" James panics.

One of the leaves manages to cut the rubber bag Pikachu is in.

Mew shouts, "Run for it, Pikachu!"

"Pi! Pikachu!" (Right! Here I go!) Pikachu says, and escapes.

Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, use Vine Whip!"

With that, Bulbasaur performs Vine Whip and chases Team Rocket.

James screams, "Let's get out of here!"

Team Rocket is forced to dive into the river to escape.

"Let's get to the water!" Meowth panics.

They all jump into the water and move along with the current. However, they see something worse than the Pokemon attacking.

"A waterfall!" Team Rocket panics.

They all fall down the waterfall as they scream, "Team Rocket is falling down again!"

"Nice work, Mew!" Todd says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

Mew calls back their Pokemon, "Bulbasaur, return."

Bulbasaur returns to his Pokeball.

Suddenly, they hear Brock call out, "Hey Mew, Tomo! Todd! Over here!"

"Are you all okay?!" Misty asks.

Mew says, "You missed all the excitement!"

"You should have brought a camera!" Todd says.

The two become confused. Pikachu climbs above the wall and jumps down into Mew's arms. Eevee jumps on Mew's shoulder and is happy to see Pikachu safe.

Later on, Todd sets up his camera for a special photo.

"I don't usually photograph humans, but this time, I'll make an exception! I wanna remember my new friends forever!" Todd says.

"Get my good side!" Misty happily says.

"Okay, get ready!" Todd says, setting up the camera and the timer.

Todd then rushes over to them, but slips on a rice ball and crashes into the gang. Soon, everyone begins to laugh as the photo has been taken. Everything has been rough today, but it shows that a picture is worth a thousand words, and the photo of them smiling and laughing, definitely shows them.

Chapter 51: Episode 50: The Ultimate Test

One day, everyone happily shouts, "Let's eat!"

And soon, everyone begins to eat their sandwiches.

Misty then asks, "You know, you haven't gotten a badge in a long time, Ash. You think you'll ever get another one?"

Mew swallows her sandwich and says, "Well, it's still far to get to Cinnabar Island, so probably not for a while. With all the trainers I've been battling as of late, I've been gaining skills, especially. And you've been helping me train my Water Type Pokemon too."

"That's true. But excluding me and the other trainers, how much skill does it take to beat Team Rocket?" Misty replies.

Mew giggles, "Yeah. They don't do well in battling, especially with us."

"So I guess you'll be using Water Type Pokemon for the Cinnabar Gym," Todd says.

"Yeah. Cinnabar Island is a Fire Type gym so Misty has been helping me with my Water Pokemon," Mew says.

"So which you're going to choose?" Brock asks.

"I haven't decided yet," Mew says.

Suddenly, Todd has an idea, "Hey Mew, why don't you just get yourself admitted?"

"Uh, admitted?" Mew says, confused.

"Take the Pokémon League Admissions Exam," Todd says.

"The Pokémon League…" Mew says, confused.

"Admissions Exam?" Misty adds, just as confused.

"Pika?" (What's that?) Pikachu asks.

"Togepi?" (What is it?) Togepi asks.

"Eevee?" (What is it?) Eevee asks.

"So what is it?" Mew asks.

"It's a place where people are able to take an exam and those who pass get to be admitted to the Pokemon League. You seem to know a lot about Pokemon, so I think you can pass the test with no trouble," Todd says.

"It sounds kind of boring. I like to travel to gather badges and have battles," Mew says, not very impressed.

"Maybe you should give it a try?" Misty suggests.

"You can learn more about being a trainer that way, and probably learn more about Pokemon," Brock says.

"I think you'll do great," Tomo says.

Mew thinks a bit and says, "Okay, I'll give it a try."

Mew and the others follow Todd to the Pokemon League Admissions Center for the Admissions test. There, they meet with the Head Instructor of the course.

"Here at the Pokemon League Admissions Center, we evaluate applicants based on the combined written and practical skills exam. And those who pass receive this badge," The Head instructor says.

Then holds a badge saying, "Qualifying them for the Pokemon League."

Mew and the others are in awe to see the badge.

"Take this," The instructor says and gives Mew a tag that has the number seven on it. "It's your testing number."

"Thank you," Mew says, taking the tag.

Suddenly, someone says in distress, "Oh no! I wanted number seven!"

Mew places the tag on her shirt, but notices a stranger watching her. She turns her head to see the person. When the stranger notices her, she sheepishly turns to her paper so she can fill it out.

She says as she writes, "Age, seventeen. Profession, diva."

Mew thinks, "Is that Jessie from Team Rocket? What is she doing here?"

Misty looks around and says, "Wow, look at all the different kinds of people showing up for the exam!

"Yeah. I'm guessing this place is kind of popular," Mew says.

Brock soon notices Nurse Joy and falls in love, "Oh, Nurse Joy!"

"Yeah, but which one?" Mew questions.

The group is about to leave.

Just then, the Instructor says, "Just a minute! You'll have to leave your Pokeballs here with me."

"Why?" Mew asks.

"You're not permitted to use your own Pokemon during the exam," The instructor says.

"Um, okay. But is it alright if my friends watch my Pokemon instead?" Mew answers.

"But of course. Gook luck Ms. Mew," The instructor says.

Mew removes her backpack and gives it to Tomo while Pikachu and Eevee sit next to Misty.

Soon, Mew and the others meet up with Nurse Joy as Todd takes pictures.

"So you wanna become a Pokémon master too, huh Nurse Joy?" Mew asks.

"Well, it has always been a dream of mine," Joy happily says.

Still head over heels, Brock asks, "So uh, where are you from Nurse Joy?"

"I'm Nurse Joy of the Fuchsia City, Joy's sister to the Vermilion City Joy's," Joy answers.

"Ah, you're the most beautiful one yet!" Brock says with his cheeks flushed.

"That's what you always say Brock," Misty comments.

"Tokipriiii!" (Brock looks funny!) Togepi happily says.

"I came here for the exam because my work keeps me too busy to travel very much," Joy explains.

Brock quickly nods her head, "Uh huh, uh huh."

"This exam is really a great idea," Misty says.

"Yes. It's perfect for people who's age or health keeps them from traveling around," Joy explains.

Brock nods his head, "Uh huh, uh huh."

Joy then adds, "And it's also nice for people like me who can't ever seem to get away from work."

"I can feel it! I'm sure you're gonna pass the test!" Brock happily says

"I hope you're right," Joy happily says, embarrassed.

Todd walks over and says, "That's make a nice human interest shot!"

Mew giggles and says, "Save your film for Pokémon."

Soon, Mew and Todd turn their heads to see a familiar boy wearing round glasses and a school uniform of some kind. The boy sees Mew, quickly turns around, and quickly leaves.

Mew thinks, "Wait a minute, is that James from Team Rocket? First Jessie and Now James. But, what are they doing at the exam?"

The boy then passes the paper to the instructor, "Here's the exam form."

"Fine. Let's see. Your name is James," The man says, taking and looking at the exam.

The boy reveals to be James, panicking, "Will you please keep it down?"

The girl from before turns her head and asks, "Is that?"

"Hey! Get lost, old bat!" James says, trying to get her to shoo.

But the girl feels offended, "Old?! Bat?!"

With that, she drags him outside with rage as James panics.

James panics, "What are you?! Unhand me, you! Please, let me go! Come on!"

The stranger drops James to the ground and removes her glasses, "So, I'm an old bat, am I?!"

James stands up and says, "You're Jessie! That outfit is atrocious!"

"And what are you doing here?" Jessie asks, putting her glasses on.

"What am I doing here? Well, truth to tell, I, not unlike many other people, dream of becoming a Pokemon master. Make fun if you must!" James says, determined and laughs.

"No, you're doing just fine on your own," Jessie comments.

"I want to live my dream instead of my.. My reality," James says.

Jessie calmly says, "I can see why."

James turns to Jessie and asks, "What's your reason for being here?"

"I simply wanted to add another talent to my very impressive and extensive resume. As you know, I'm already an accomplished hostess, florist, costume designer, wine expert, beautician, style consultant. In fact, one of the only things I'm not.." Jessie says.

But before Jessie can finish, Meowth appears and finishes Jessie's sentence, "Is a Pokemon master!"

Jessie and James panic and startled, "Meowth?!"

"What are you doing here?!" Jessie asks, frightened.

"Looking for you. The one who suddenly remembered an important engagement," Meowth then.

He turns to Jessie, "This seems suspiciously unlike a visit to your sick uncle's bedside."

Then turns to James, "And I thought you had a dental appointment."

"Well, I…" James says, weary.

Then calmly says, "It was just such a beautiful day.."

"We decided to have a picnic," Jessie adds.

"Don't try to fool me!" Meowth angrily says and scratches both their eyes.

Then demands, "Come clean, what are you doing here?"

"Mind your own business!" Jessie says in rage

James brings out a yarn ball and says, "Take this and leave us alone!"

Then tosses it and Meowth begins to chase after it. That causes Jessie and James to make a break for it.

"Hurry up!" Jessie panics.

"The exam's about to start!" James adds.

Soon enough, Mew, along with Jessie and James are in the exam room to take the test.

"The first test will measure your overall knowledge of Pokemon! Ready? Begin!" The instructor says.

Mew nods her head.

Then Lickitung appears on the screen, "Lickitung's tongue is twice the length of it's body. True or false?"

"Hmm, I remember seeing Lickitung when Jessie caught it. And even the Pokedex said that it's more than twice the length of its body. So it has to be false," Mew says and presses the button.

Then the computer shows Vulpix and says, "A Kanto Region Ninetales evolves from A Kanto Region Vulpix only by use of a Fire Stone. True or False?"

"That's true," Mew thinks and presses the true button.

The computer shows Hitmonlee on the screen, "Hitmonlee is also known as 'The Punching Demon.'"

Mew thinks, " Hitmonlee is known as the Kicking Fiend while Hitmonchan is known as the Punching Demon. I've seen them before."

Mew then presses false.

The computer says as it shows a picture of Magikarp, "The only attack Magikarp originally knows is Splash. True or False?"

Meanwhile, Jessie and James continue to take the exams. In fact, Jessie is only pressing true on all the questions. Time has gone by and the second exam is about to begin.

The instructor says, "Now, we will measure your ability to recognize Pokemon! Please name the Pokemon by identifying its silhouette or any part of its body as it is displayed here!"

"So I have to remember a Pokemon's appearance, silhouette or any of its body parts," Mew thinks.

"Here's the first question," The instructor says.

Just then a black circle appears on the screen, "Identify this Pokemon."

"Hmm, it could be a Voltord or an Electrode, but that seems too obvious. Hmm, maybe I need to focus on their point of view," Mew thinks.

Then remembers, "Wait, Misty's Jigglypuff is round from a top view."

Then taps on the screen and has a picture of a Jigglypuff.

James answers, "Ah, how simple. It's a Pokeball, without a doubt."

Jessie says, "Obviously, it's an Electrode."

Hearing James and Jessie, Mew thinks, "An Electrode is a good guess, but a Pokeball…"

"And the answer is a.. Jigglypuff seen from above," The instructor says, the answer is soon shown on the screen.

Mew blinks her eyes in surprise because she has the right answer. James and Jessie nearly fall out of their seats in disbelief that they have the wrong answer.

"Next question. What Pokemon displays this pattern?" The instructor says.

Then shows a swirl that starts from the right.

James answers, "It must be an Omanyte shell!"

"It's an Arbok when it's all coiled up," Jessie says.

"Hmm, the only Pokemon with those patterns is Poliwag, Poliwhirl, and Poliwrath. Back when Poliwhirl was Poliwag, it used to have that pattern, so it has to be it," Mew says, selecting Poliwag.

The instructor says, "The correct answer: Poliwag."

Jessie and James fall out of their seats in disbelief. Mew simply smiles to have the right answer again.

The instructor says, "As any master would know, when Poliwag evolves into Poliwhirl, the swirl on its stomach reverses direction."

The rest of the gang are watching through the glass window.

"Hey, this is hard," Misty says.

"And it's getting harder by the minute!" Brock says.

"Pika," (No joke.) Pikachu says.

"Hope Mew will do fine," Mew says.

Chapter 52: Episode 51: The Breeding Center Secret

Continuing on their journey, Mew and her friends decide to take a break. Their friend, Todd, a photographer, decides to take some Pokemon pictures.

"Come on, turn around, Togepi. Now, don't be shy. Turn and say 'Togepi'." Misty says as Togepi sits on her lap

Togepi happily turns around and says, "Togepi!" (I'm Togepi!)

Then Todd takes pictures of Togepi.

"Great! That was a cool shot," Todd says.

Suddenly, they hear a voice, "Now, a Pokemon weather update!

The group turns to see the T.V screen on one of the buildings showing the weather.

The weather anchor says, "Our area will remain clear and sunny today with highs in the upper seventies.

"Sounds like good weather!" Mew says.

"Pikachu," (Pretty, too.) Pikachu agrees.

"It should be great for taking pictures," Todd says.

After the weather, a commercial comes up, "Pokemon love power! Find it at our Five Star Breeding Center, where every Pokemon is treated like a loved one."

Then the commercial shows a Charmander, "This guest evolved into a Charmeleon, and then into a Charizard, in just a few short days. At the Five Star Breeding Center, a little pampering goes a long way. Let our experts provide your Pokemon with our loving care. So why go through all the fuss when you can bring your Pokemon to us?"

"What's that?" Tomo asks.

"Looks like somebody just opened up a new breeding center," Brock says.

"Breeding Center?" Mew says, confused.

"The newest thing! Breeding Centers raise Pokemon for kids who can't themselves. It's like a Pokemon spa," Todd says.

"A really excellent breeding center can even help your Pokemon evolve," Misty says.

"Wow! Let's go check it out!" Mew says, interested.

"Yeah," Tomo replies.

Mew and her friends decide to check out the breeding center. Soon, they see the place is crowded. In front of the center, there is a woman with gold hair in long low pigtails, purple eyes, and wears triangle magenta earrings. She is also wearing a lab coat.

The lady in front of the building says, "There's no need to push! We have plenty of rooms left in our luxury suites! We guarantee your Pokemon will soon be like new, and some may even evolve!"

"She seems really nice," Misty says.

Brock takes a closer look and is head over heels for her.

"And do you know why we're so popular? It's because we believe in love," The woman says.

She picks up a trainer's Sandshrew and says, "We feel every Pokemon is lovable. We believe in Pokemon love power!"

"Love power!" A man says.

The man is also wearing a labcoat as well. He has maroon colored eyes and green hair.

Brock blushes and says, "Love. Power."

"Wow! She sure knows how to attract customers," Todd says.

"Yeah," Misty says, suspiciously.

In the center, there is a large pack of people ready to send their Pokemon

"Our next guest," The woman says

"Right this way, please," The man says, putting his Pokemon on the conveyor belt.

He pushes the button and the Pokemon rolls right inside.

Misty comes to the front desk, "I have a Pokemon, too!"

Shocked and slightly embarrassed, the woman says, "Well, you're in the right place."

"So, what do I have to do to check my Pokemon in here?" Misty quickly asks.

Mew walks over and asks, "Misty, you're leaving one here?"

"Yep. I'll give it a try," Misty answers.

"But, which Pokemon? Not your Staryu!" Todd replies.

Then Brock says, "Togepi's too young."

Misty answers as she places Psyduck on the table, "My Psyduck! I wanna leave my Psyduck here with you."

"It's so cute. Don't you just adore those eyes? They're bright and bouncy as ping pong balls!" The woman says, looking at Psyduck.

"Yeah, and I wish I had a paddle," Misty mutters.

"So, then, is there anything special you'd like us to do?" The woman asks.

"For starters, you might try knocking some common sense into its big, empty head," Misty says.

Then harshly ruffles Psyduck's head, "There's an awful lot of unused space in here!"

The woman looks over and says, "That's strange, it looks intelligent to me."

Todd and Brock nearly fall over.

"And you have to change this clueless looking face," Misty says, stretching her Pokemon's face.

"I think Psyduck is already fine," Mew comments.

"Funny you should say that. Our motto here at the breeding center is: 'A little Pokemon love power works miracles'." The woman says, and holds out a peace sign.

Soon, Psyduck is given tag #12, and ride on the conveyor belt to the back of the center.

Mew calls out, "Have fun, Psyduck."

"Bye, Psyduck. Good luck," Misty says.

Soon Psyduck disappears to the back of the store.

Later on, Mew and the others are walking down the street.

"Psyduck will prove if that place is any good," Misty says.

"Do you think Psyduck will be okay?" Mew says.

"I'm sure Psyduck will be fine, Mew. Don't worry," Misty says.

"Well, I think Psyduck has some good points," Mew says.

"That's true. I caught Psyduck so I'll still keep him, even if he is annoying," Misty says.

Todd then stops in front of a restaurant, "That looks tasty."

The group stops and looks to see the restaurant themselves.

"Hey, it's a restaurant!" Brock says.

"Come to think of it, I'm really starving!" Misty says.

Soon, Mew notices, "Hey, look at this!"

The group looks at a sign, which makes Misty happy, "All you can eat, for free?! Alright! I'm heading straight for the desert bar!" and chuckles with a grin.

Confused, Mew asks, "It can't really be free, can it?"

But Todd says, "There's gotta be a catch. Like, you gotta order ten dinners to get one free."

"I'd eat 10 dinners if they came with 10 deserts," Misty says.

Mew turns to Misty with a confused face.

Just then, the chef comes out of the restaurant with laughter and says, "No need to eat that much, unless ya'll really want to! The buffet is free on one condition!"

"What's the condition?" The group asks.

"Well, just show me my favorite Pokemon and I'll treat you to all the food you can eat! Plus, all the desserts you can eat, too!" The chef answers.

"Your favorite Pokemon, huh?" Mew replies.

"I'm sure one of us has your favorite!" Misty says.

Mew throws all her Pokeballs, "I'll go first," With that, Mew releases all of her Pokemon. Even Pikachu and Eevee present themselves to the chef.

"My, you sure have some unique Pokemon, but none of these are my favorite," The chef says.

"Oh well," Mew says.

Brock then says, "I'll go next!"

"Me too!" Tomo replies.

Then releases all of their Pokmemon, and has been presented to the chef.

"You sure have interesting Pokemon as well, but none of them is it," The chef says.

"Well, how about my Pokemon? I even got Togepi." Misty replies, and releases all her Pokemon.

"None of them is my favorite, but you came close," The chef says.

"Came close?" Misty says, confused.

"Yes. Your Golduck is nice, even though it's not my favorite. However, it's the closest to my favorite," The chef says.

"Golduck is close to your favorite?" Todd says, confused.

The group begins to think as they try to understand what the chef means.

Suddenly, Mew realizes that not only they have one more pokemon in their group, but it's as close to Golduck as it can be.

"I got it… Psyduck! Psyduck is your favorite Pokemon, isn't it?" Mew asks.

"You are correct, miss," The chef says.

And shows the picture of Psyduck, "That's my favorite Pokemon."

"You're a Psyduck fan?" Brock asks, surprised.

Seeing the picture, Todd says, "Hey! That looks like a picture I took!"

"I think Psyduck is the greatest thing since the invention of the microwave oven! I'm such a big fan that whenever a customer brings in a Psyduck, I let em eat for free," The chef says.

Todd turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, how do you know his favorite Pokemon is Psyduck?"

"Well, nothing is closer to Golduck than a Psyduck," Mew says.

"She's right. Psyduck is Golduck's pre-evolved form," Brock says.

Misty turns to the chef and asks, "Sir, if we come back in a couple of minutes, will you be here?"

"Sure, I've gotta wait here for a delivery of fifty gallons of ice cream," The chef says.

"Yay! Yay! Yay!" Misty happily cheers with laughter and says, "Back in a flash!"

Then Misty runs off, Mew and the others hurry after her.

"That's typical. It figures Psyduck isn't around the one time I really need it!" Misty says.

"You're the one who left it at that center," Mew replies.

However, when Mew and her friend arrive at the center, there's a close sign in front of it.

"It's already closed!" Misty says, shocked.

"Guess we'll have to come back tomorrow!" Brock says.

Then Todd says, "We won't get that free buffet today."

But Misty says, "No way! I'm getting into that dessert bar now! There might not be any ice cream left tomorrow! Let's go see if there's a back way!" And stomps off.

Soon, they find a back room and Misty is banging on it, "Hello?! Anybody there?! I need to get the Pokemon I left here! Please open the door so I can get back to that dessert buffet!"

When Misty tries to open the door, she and the others are surprised to see that it's not locked.

"It's open," Misty says, confused.

Misty opens the door and peeks inside, "Hello? Is there anybody who can get my Pokemon? Is there anybody who can help me?"

The group soon walked inside and down the hall.

"There's nobody here," Mew says.

Misty soon opens another door, and calls out, "Is there anybody here who can help us?"

Soon, the group walks inside, "It's so dark, I can't see."

"Hey, I got a flashlight," Brock says, and brings it on.

When Brock turns on his flightlight, the first thing they see are cages. What shocked the group is to see the cages have Pokemon inside. The Pokemon their trainers have dropped off.

"What is this?!" Misty asks, shocked.

"It's the Pokemon!" Brock says.

"This doesn't look like a luxury hotel to me!" Tomo says.

"This is cruel! They're crammed into cages!" Todd says.

"Pika!" (How awful!) Pikahu says.

"Eevee!" (Those poor Pokemon!) Eevee adds, sadly.

Mew worriedly says, "This isn't a Breeding Center! It's a Prison!"

"These Pokemon don't look like they wanna smile for the camera," Todd adds.

Soon enough, Brock finds Misty's Psyduck.

Brock calls Misty, "Hey! Here's your Psyduck!"

Everyone hurries over to see something about Psyduck is different.

"I have to say, it looks a little smarter than when I dropped it off," Misty says.

But Borck says, "Take a closer look."

The group looks closer to see that Psyduck's eyes have been pulled up by tape.

"They just pulled its eyes back with tape," Brock says.

"That's terrible!" Misty says, and pulls the tape off of Psyduck.

"Psy-Yi-Yi," (I do not like being in the cage.) Psyduck says.

Mew translated, "Psyduck said he doesn't like being in a cage."

"I don't blame him," Misty says.

Soon the group hears a sound and looks up to see a crane carrying a cave and putting it on the conveyor belt.

"What's that?" Mew asks.

On the other side of the wall, the two employees are examining the Pokemon in the cage that is coming in. The one in the cage is Sandsrew."

"The next Pokemon's a Sandshrew," The male employee says.

The female one looks at the cage and says, "Looks like this one is in pretty good shape. It can be very useful, as long as we can teach it to use Fury Swipes."

"We've got an awful lot of Pokemon piled up in this dump," The man says.

"Yeah. Just goes to prove that a lot of Pokemon trainers are suckers. Now all we have to do is pick out the choice Pokemon and ship em out to the boss," The woman says.

"We'll be his absolute favorites!" The man says.

Then the woman says, "And we'll be in for a big bonus!

"This breeding center was a great idea!" The man happily adds.

Then they both say, "We believe in love power! That's because we love power!" And the two begin to laugh.

Unknown to them, Mew and her friends have heard everything.

Mew quietly says, "So it's all a big fake."

"We've gotta do something to stop them!" Misty adds, quite.

"We can't let them treat Pokemon like this!" Brock quietly adds.

Tomo, Pikachu, and Eevee nod their heads.

Just then, Todd quietly says, "Hey! I think I've got an idea!"

"Pika Pika?" (What's the plan?) Pikachu asks.

"Pikachu wants to know the plan," Mew replies.

Todd explains, "I'll take pictures of this place so that everyone can know what's happening."

"Yeah, that's a great idea," Misty says.

Meanwhile the two employers are now talking to their boss.

The boss says, "So, tell me. How is the breeding center scam going?"

"Very well. As planned, we've collected lots of promising Pokemon," The woman answers.

"Excellent. Send them to me, immediately. I want to pick the choice ones for myself," The boss says.

The two employees reply, "Yes sir!"

"I want to congratulate the two of you on your splendid work on this project. Unlike those other blundering idiots," The boss says.

"Just doing our job, but I don't know how you put up with that Jessie or her stupid partner, James. They're an embarrassment," The woman says.

Then the boss says, "They are completely unreliable. It's a good thing we didn't tell them about this plan. They would have ruined it. Butch. Cassidy. You know I'm counting on you."

The two answer, "Yes sir."

The woman Cassidy says, "We won't disappoint you."

Then the video call ends.

Meanwhile, Todd holds out his camera and takes pictures of the Pokemon in cages so they can be used as evidence.

Misty points to the conveyor belt, "Todd! Take a picture of that! There!"

"Hmm. Okay," Todd says, and takes the picture.

However, Butch notices the flash of Todd's camera, "Huh?"

"What, Butch? Something wrong?" Cassidy asks.

"I thought I saw something back there! It looked like a flash," Butch answers.

The group becomes worried to hear Butch's statement.

Butch then leaves the room and says, "I better go check it out."

The group soon becomes scared to see Butch approaching the door and prepares to open it.

Butch then opens the door, but Mew and her friends are nowhere to be seen. He soon notices a flash and walks over to see Pikachu trying to use a shock attack from a cage.

"The light was only from this Pikachu," Butch says to himself and leaves the room.

Once Butch is gone, Mew lets Pikachu out of the locked cage, "You pulled it off, Pikachu."

"That was too close," Misty quietly says.

"I think I have all the shots I'm gonna need," Todd quietly says.

Then Brock says, "Good, we better get out of here, quick."

"Yeah," Tomo says.

"Wait! We can't! Psyduck!" Misty worriedly says, and rushes to Psyduck.

Mew asks, "What's wrong?"

Misty then pulls the bars and says, "The cage is locked. I can't just leave Psyduck trapped in this awful place."

"Psyduck," (Thank you.) Psyduck replies.

Suddenly, the window close by is beginning to shake.

"Uh, what's that?" Tomo asks.

"I think someone's coming in. Hide," Mew says, and everyone does just that.

Entering the building through the window is Jessie, James, and Meowth from Team Rocket.

"Be quiet as a mouse," Jessie whispers.

"Did you say Meowth?" Meowth asks.

"This way," Jessie whispers.

"This is so... exciting!" James says, rather loud.

And Meowth hits him with a mallet.

Meowth whispers, "Keep quiet, James Bond!"

Mew and her friends are shocked to see Team Rocket is here as well.

"Breaking into this breeding center was genius. It's a burglar's dream," Jessie says.

Meowht looks around and says, "I told you this place was gonna be packed with Pokemon."

"And we're gonna steal every last one," Jessie says.

"That'll put us on the boss' good side," Meowth says.

"But we've never been on his good side before," James says.

Sometime later, James begins to pick the lock, "Almost got it".

"All the Pokemon we could ever want," Meowth says.

"Hey!" Mew angrily says, and startiles Team Rocket.

"What are you doing here?" Todd demands.

"I'd put that very same question to you!" Meowth says.

Mew quietly says, "Keep in down! You'll get us all in trouble!"

"How did you get in here anyway?" Jessie quietly asks, angrily.

"Don't tell me you goody-goodies decided to become baddy-baddies!" Meowth says.

"You better not try to take over our territory!" Jesse says.

"I knew all along we couldn't trust you!" James shouts.

"Will you shut up?!" Mew whispers.

Misty quietly says, "This time you're in way over your heads."

"She's right. We better get these Pokemon outta here fast or we're all in danger," Brock adds.

Jessie quietly says, "I know what you're doing. You're trying to trick us into helping you steal all these Pokemon for yourselves."

"Fine! Believe what you want!" Misty quietly says.

"Let's just get out of here before…" Mew says.

Suddenly, the lights turn on, and Cassidy and Butch spot them.

Cassidy says, "I knew there was something rotten back here! And I was right! Looks like rats had snuck in here."

"What should we do?" Butch questions.

"We'll exterminate them!" Cassidy says.

"We're not afraid of creeps like you!" Mew angrily said.

"dLet's mix it up!" Meowth panics.

Then Cassidy says, "You don't know who you're dealing with!"

But we'll be glad to show you!" Buch says.

Suddenly, they begin to perform Team Rocket's Motto

Butch and Cassidy:

Prepare for trouble and make it double!

They remove their disguises and reveal they are wearing Team Rocket uniforms. Mew and her friends are shocked to see that they're part of Team Rocket as well.

Cassidy:

To infect the world with devastation!

Butch:

To blight all people in every nation!

Cassidy:

To denounce the goodness of truth and love!

Butch:

To extend our wrath to the stars above!

Cassidy:

Cassidy.

Butch.

We're Team Rocket, circling Earth all day and night!

Butch:

Surrender to us now, or you will surely lose the fight!

Cassidy:

That's right!

Then Raticate drops in between the two.

"Copycat!" Meowth shouts in anger.

James asks, "Does this mean you belong to Team Rocket, too?"

Cassidy says, "Jessie! It's been a while."

That makes Jessie growl.

James turns to Jessie and asks, "Do you know that girl?"

"She used to hang around with me. She was jealous because I'm so beautiful," Jessie says, bitterly.

"You haven't changed a bit, unfortunately for you," Cassidy says.

Jessie angrily says, "And you're still a selfish little brat! How dare you use that motto!"

"It's an outrage! It took us months to find a motto we could swipe!" Meowth shouts in anger.

Then Cassidy says, "Save your arguments for the boss when he finds out you're stealing his Pokemon."

That's when the three begin to panic.

"We're in trouble!" Meowth says.

"The boss is really ticked off that he hasn't heard from you! He thinks it's insulting! Butch says.

"But we can't call him until we do something wrong right!" James says.

Then Cassidy says, "We got this mission because the boss couldn't trust you. When he finds out that you managed to bungle it anyway, well, I hate to think what might happen to you, but I suppose getting thrown off the team is the best you could hope for after this. Isn't that right, Jess?"

Jessie growls in anger as Meowth forces her and James to the ground, "We'd be infernally grateful you could forget this ever happened!"

As Meowth talks, Mew and her friends try to sneak past them and towards the front door.

Cassidy chuckles and says, "What's it worth to you?"

Brock slowly opens the door, and Cassidy hears it.

Cassidy quickly turns to them, "Not so fast, children! Now that you know our little secret, I'm afraid we can't let you leave."

Seeing Cassidy's back is turned, Meowth says. "Let's make a run for it."

The group retreats until James stops for something.

James opens the cage and is surprised, "It evolved into a Victreebel! Isn't that just…."

But James' new Pokemon bites him on the head as his colleagues drag him and his Pokemon off.

Meanwhile, Mew and the others are hurrying down the hall and see the trap door.

"There's the exit!" Mew says.

Suddenly, the cage drops and almost catches all of them. Misty, Togepi, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and Tomo turn to see Brock and Todd are trapped.

Everyone agrees and hurry out to hide just as Cassidy and Butch enter the hall.

Suddenly, Butch notices, "What's that?" and takes Todd's camera.

Misty, Mew, and the others are able to get away from the Breeding Center before they are seen. Sadly, Todd and Brock have been taken away by Officer Jenny, and they manage to convince her that they were trying to rob the Pokemon inside, unknown that it's a lie. Mew and the others know that they need to come up with a plan.

"We gotta convince Jenny that Brock and Todd are innocent and tell them what's really going on," Misty says.

"The only way we're going to get them out of jail and stop Team Rocket is to free the Pokemon they captured and get Todd's camera back. It has all the proof we need," Mew says.

The next day, Misty wears a hat over her head and a jacket so she can't be recognized.

Misty then whispers, "Okay, Pikachu."

Pikachu then comes out and heads behind the desk. Then Togepi pops his head out.

Mew then takes out, "Espurr, use Psychic to teleport yourself in the cage and teleport the Pokemon out. We need a few to testify."

Espurr appears from the Pokeball and uses it's Psychic attacks to teleport himself in the cage and then himself and some of the Pokemon out.

Misty walks back and forth, "Pikachu sure is taking a long time. I wish he would hurry."

Meanwhile, Pikachu looks in the other room and finds the camera, "Pika!" (Ah ha!)

Cassidy gives Misty Psyduck, "I'm afraid there wasn't time to give your Psyduck a proper facial, so there hasn't been much improvement. Don't you have to leave?"

Suddenly, she feels a tap on her leg, and Misty turns to see Pikachu has the camera in his paws.

Pikachu quietly says, "Pika." (Got it.) making Misty smile.

Suddenly, Cassidy asks, "Is something wrong?"

That leaves Cassidy confused. Misty is able to meet up with Eevee and Tomo.

Misty looks to see an Oddish, Sandshrew, Exeggcute, a Staryu, and a Poliwag.

Back in the warehouse, Cassidy and Butch enter the room.

Cassidy and Butch turn to see Mew in the room with Espurr and Shaymin.

"Don't change the subject. You either release those Pokemon, or we'll do this the hard way," Mew says.

Butch thows his Pokeball, "Cloyster Go!"

Butch and Cassidy release their Pokemon.

"Alright Espurr! Shaymin! You ready?" Mew says.

Espurr and Shaymin nod their heads.

Cassidy calls out, "Raticate, use Hyper Fang!"

Mew calls out, "Espurr, use Psybeam! Shaymin, use Magical Leaf!"

With that, all four attacks begin to go out at once.

Meanwhile in the Police Station, Brock and Todd are trying to convince Jenny what's really going on at the center.

"Those two at the breeding center are the criminals!" Brock says.

"That's right! Not us! Just go there and see for yourself!" Todd says.

Meanwhile, James is busy admiring his new Victreebel, "Wow! It grew into a fabulous Victreebel! It's so big and strong and healthy looking! Friendly, too!"

But his Pokemon chomp on his head, much to Jessie and Meowth's dismay.

But Jenny is not buying it, "If you're trying to win sympathy, it won't work. The judge is gonna throw the book at you Pokemon snatchers."

That's when Misty stomps in, "You're making a mistake!"

"You got the wrong crooks!" Tomo adds.

"Pika Pika!" (They're innocent!) Pikachu says.

"Eev Eev!" (Set them free!" Eevee adds.

"Misty! Tomo! Pikachu! Eevee!" Brock says, relieved.

Misty walks over and says, "These guys have been telling the truth, Officer Jenny!"

Then Misty brings out the photo, "And these photographs prove it!"

"Oh! What a cute little Pikachu!" Jenny says, happily.

Misty looks at the photos to see that they aren't the right picture.

She quickly puts them in her bag, "Ah! Wrong pictures."

And brings out the real pictures, "Look at these."

Officer Jenny looks at the evidence photos and is shocked, "Oh no! That's terrible!"

"That place isn't a real breeding center, they just steal the best Pokemon that are brought in!" Misty says.

Jenny turns to Misty, "Those two told me the center was like a Pokemon spa."

"That was a lie!" Misty says.

"They cram Pokemon into cages!" Todd says.

"Pika Pika!" (They're both awful!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (They're nothing but crooks!) Eevee adds.

Tomo turns to the other Pokemon, "These are the Pokemon from the Breeding Center! They know the center is bad!"

The Pokemon from the Breeding Center nod their heads.

"It's true, honest," Jessie says.

James agreed, "Yeah, we're good guys!"

Misty crosses her arms and says, "Please! They broke into the breeding center just to steal Pokemon."

With that, Team Rocket fall to the floor, seeing that they aren't buying it

At the center, Mew continues to battle with Cassidy and Butch.

"Raticate, use Quick Attack!" Cassidy calls out.

Mew calls out, "Espurr, use Swift!"

Espurr uses Swift, but Raticate dodges and smacks into Espurr, and sends him crashing to the ground.

Cloyster performs the attack and strikes at Shaymin. Both Pokemon are still standing on your feet, but struggle to battle.

"And soon they'll belong to us," Butch adds.

"Shaymin!" (That's right!) Shaymin says.

Espurr struggles and is able to stand on his two feet. He then lets out a cry, "ESPUUUUUUURRRR!"

Just then, Espur begins to glow, catching everyone by surprise.

"Espur?" Mew says, surprised.

Cassidy becomes shocked, "What is that?"

"Don't tell me…" Butch says.

Soon, Espur's shape begins to change as he continues to glow. Soon, Espurr is now a predominantly dark blue Pokemon with green eyes with light blue sclerae. The tuft of fur between its ears is white and curves slightly to the side and the collar around its neck is white with several stray tufts of fur. It has pointed ears with white at the fold and on the tips of its ears; there is also a white ring near the tips of its ears. Its tails are also pointed with white tips and a white ring near the end. There is a tuft of fur on each hip and it has white paws.

Mew smiles, "Espurr, you evolved!"

Mew brings out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Meowstic, the Constraint Pokemon and the evolved form of an Espurr. A Psychic Type. When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust. Its appearance varies, depending on gender."

"Meowstic," (You got it.) Meowstic says.

Meowstic's tail glows and slams the attack on Raticate and Cloyster. Both Pokemon then crash to the ground, but are struggling to continue fighting.

Just then, the door slams open and Tomo's voice calls out, "Pikachu. Eevee. Double Thunderbolt!"

And then, Pikachu and Eevee appear and use Thunderbolt on both the Pokemon. They both are now unable to battle.

Cassidy says, shocked, "Raticate got fried!"

Mew turns to see Misty, Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, along with Brock, Todd, and Officer Jenny.

Meowstic then uses his Psychic powers to lift Cassidy and Butch in the air. Soon, the bad guys are tied up, thrown in the police van, and off to jail. Mew, and her friends see the bad guys being taken to jail.

Misty turns to the others, "Pikachu's the one who snuck into the breeding center and got the camera back."

Jenny walks over and says, "You all did a great job! Now, we'll return all the Pokemon to their rightful owners!"

Soon enough, the group arrives at the restaurant and are eating up a storm. Since they have Psyduck with them, they are able to eat for free."

Misty finishes her ice cream, she lifts the bowl and says, "More ice cream!"

"Take it easy!" Mew says.

"Yeah, leave some for the other customers," Brock says.

"Eevee Eevee," (They have a point, Misty.) Eevee says.

"And all of it's free, since you brought this cute little Psyduck to visit my restaurant," The Chef says, snuggling Psyduck

In jail, Team Rocket are already busting out and are digging a tunnel

Jessie angrily says, "I can't stand it here! There's not a single mirror in our cell!"

"I refuse to wear those horrible prison uniforms!" James says.

Meowth says, "And I wouldn't give this food to a Muk!"

"We shouldn't have tried to steal from that friend of yours, Jessie!" James complains.

Jessie shouts in rage, "I'll show her who's the queen of mean!"

Later on, Mew and the others reach a crossroads.

"I guess you guys are heading for Cinnabar Island, right?" Todd says.

"That's right!" Mew says.

"Well, I think I'm gonna head up to the mountains, so I can take some new shots of wild Pokemon," Todd says.

"That's great," Brock says.

"We'll all miss you," Mew says.

Todd nods his head in reply.

Jessie shouts, "James! Watch where you're throwing that dirt!"
