Chapter 53: Episode 52: Riddle Me This

Mew and her friends are riding on the ship to head to their next destination, Cinnabar Island. It's where Mew will be challenging for her seventh badge. The group are relaxing outside as they feel the wind in their hair and wait til they get to the island.

"I can't wait till we get to Cinnabar, it's supposed to be beautiful," Misty says.

"It's got an awesome volcano. Best of all, its Pokemon Research Laboratory is one of the best in the world. Trainers come from all over to learn the latest Pokemon techniques," Brock says.

"Yeah. Professor Oak said that's where we can get our fossils restored. And the Cinnabar Gym is where I'm going to get my seventh badge," Mew says.

Tomo and the Pokemon look at the sea.

Suddenly, they hear Gary's voice, "Hey Mew, you're here too!"

Mew and her friends turn their heads to see Gary Oak and are dressed for vacation.

"Gary? You're going to Cinnabar Island?!" Mew asks, surprised

"That's right," Gary says.

Mew asks, "Are you here for your next Gym Battle too?"

"Oh, so you didn't know. Pokemon trainers haven't gone to Cinnabar Island since you and my grandfather's days as a trainer!These people are all tourists. Cinnabar Island's a resort!" Gary says.

"A resort?" Mew and Tomo say, confused.

Then Gary says, "Actually, I've earned so many badges already, I'm taking a break to work on my tan."

Mew giggles, "A tan huh?"

"From what I've heard, Cinnabar Island doesn't even have a Pokemon gym anymore," Gary says.

"Really? That's too bad," Mew says.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends arrived at Cinnabar Island. To their surprise, Gary is right, the place looks more like a Resort.

"Maybe Gary was right," Mew says.

"This place is a tourist trap," Misty says.

"Might as well look around," Brock says.

The group then begins to look around the island, and so far, all they mostly see are tourist attractions like stores, souvenir shops, restaurants, and even resort hotels.

Brock looks around and says, "No sign of a Pokemon gym, but there sure are a lot of tourists around here. There're so many nice islands, I wonder why this one became so popular."

Suddenly, someone stops in front of them. It's a man with long brown hair, a brown mustache, wearing sunglasses, a green beaded necklace, a red short, and black pants.

The man says, "The answer is a riddle. What do tourists think is hot and cool?"

"A riddle?" Mew says, confused.

Soon, group begins to think

Then Misty says, "Hot springs are really hot, and.. And tourists think they're cool!

The man says, "That's right! You see, friends, because of the volcano, there are lots of hot springs here on Cinnabar Island. And every year, more and more tourists come to visit em. Now, they've even taken over Cinnabar Island. Trainers don't come anymore."

Then dramatically says, "Tourists! They've ruined the island!"

Mew then asks, "Is the Pokemon gym still here? I want to battle and earn a Volcano Badge?"

"I heard that the gym leader was a guy named Blaine," Misty says.

"His gym, is right where you put your glasses," The man says.

Then Mew says, "In front of your eyes?"

"You're right!"" The man says.

Then points at the front, "Blaine's gym is right in front of your eyes!"

The group looks at the front and becomes shocked. The gym looks demolished.

"Pika?! Eev?!" (What in?!) Pikachu and Eevee say, shocked.

"That's it?" Brock says, shocked.

"It's a wreck," Misty says,

"Blaine got tired of battling tourists who cared more about postcards and T-shirts than about Pokemon. That's when he abandoned the gym," The man says.

"But I'm not a tourist on vacation. I've trained hard so that I can earn a Volcano Badge," Mew says.

"I'm afraid you came to the wrong place, my friends," The man says.

Misty says, "Don't worry Mew, I'm sure we'll think of something."

"Mew?" The man says, confused.

Then ask, "You wouldn't happen to be Mew from Pallet Town?"

"Yes. I am, But how did you know?" Mew says.

"Let's just say I knew Professor Oak and said that you and your friends have Pokemon fossils," The man says.

Tomo says, "We do."

"There's a Pokemon Lab not far from here that has just the thing to restore your Pokemon," The man says.

Then Mew a card, "Here's my card. If you need anything."

Mew takes the card and reads, "The Big Riddle Inn."

"An inn? How can you run a hotel and then blame tourists for ruining the island? That doesn't make any sense to me," Misty says.

But when the group looks ahead, they see that the man is gone.

"He's gone!" Mew says.

Then Brock says, "I wonder how he disappeared like that."

"Well then, let's go to the Pokemon Lab and see if we can get our fossils restored. Then we'll find a place to stay the night," Mew says.

With that, Mew and her friends head off to the lab, unaware that Team Rocket is close by.

"Not one cookie sold. Our snack stand's a flop. Isn't that just our luck, James?" Jessie says.

James says, "I'll say it is, Jessie. And we're right near that lab and it's packed with powerful Pokemon."

"Guess that's how the cookie crumbles," Meowth says.

Mew and her friends soon arrived at the Pokemon Lab. The group walks inside to see there are many different Pokemon training and scientists studying them.

A scientist walks over and says, "Hello, what can I do for you?"

"Hello. My name is Mew and these are my friends, and we're here to have our fossils restored," Mew says.

"Of course. I've already been notified of your arrival," The scientist says.

Soon, the group comes across a large machine.

"This is my Resurrection Machine. With it, we can restore ancient fossils and the Pokemon will come back to life," The scientist says.

Then asks, "So, who will start?"

Mew steps forward, "I'll go first."

Then present her fossil to the scientist.

The scientist says, "My, that is a nice looking Root fossil."

The scientist then places the fossil in the machine. Then activates the machine. Everyone watches the machine do it's work. Just then, the machine dings, and the door opens to reveal the restored Pokemon. Mew's new Pokemon is a somewhat plantlike Pokémon with eight dark-tipped, pink petal-like tentacles protruding from an opening on top of its head. Inside the pitch-black opening are two glowing, yellow eyes. Its head is purple with yellow eyespots resembling targets. The head is connected to the body by means of a yellow stem. The body itself is purple and semi-spherical, and has four stubby roots.

"And now you have a restored Lileep," The scientist says.

"Aww," Mew says and brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Lileep the Sea Lily Pokemon. A Rock and Grass Type. In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close."

Mew smiles at her Pokemon and says, "Hi Lileep, it's nice to meet you.

Lileep looks at Mew and hugs her head with its tentacles. Mew giggles in reply. The others are very impressed.

Misty then brings out her Fossil, "I like to go next."

"Okay. And my, that is a big Cover fossil you got," The scientist says.

The scientist takes the fossil and puts it in the machine. Sometime later, the machine opens and the Pokemon is restored. It's a reptilian Pokémon resembling a baby leatherback sea turtle. Its body is blue with black spots on the edges of its flippers. Its black shell has six circular indentations in it. It has a black upper beak and a mask that covers most of its head. It has a light blue patch underneath its eyes.

"And now, you got a Tirtouga," The scientist says.

Misty walks to her Pokemon, "Hello Tirtouga."

The Pokemon crawls to Misty and even though it's rather shy. It shows a small smile. It also allows Misty to pet its shell.

"So that's a Tirtouga," Mew says.

Dexter says, "Tirtouga, the Proto Turtle Pokemon. A Water and Rock Type. This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey."

"I'll go next," Brock says.

Sometime later, Brock has his fossil restored. Brock's Pokemon is a small, yellow, ceratopsian-like reptilian Pokémon. It has white toes and a white bump on its back. Shieldon has a dark-gray elliptical face, with a prominent white brow and a white rim on its black snout.

"Wow. I got a Shieldon," Brock says.

Sheidlon comes to Brock and jumps into his arms.

Mew uses her Pokdex and Dexter says, "Shieldon, the Shield Pokemon. A Rock and Steel Type. It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attack from behind."

"And finally it's Tomo's turn," Misty says.

"Yeah," Tomo happily says.

Tomo has given his fossil to the scientist and puts it in the machine. Once it's done, Tomo's Pokemon is alive, and it's kind of bigger than Tomo. It's a bipedal, dinosaurian Pokémon that resembles a large theropod. Its body is grayish-brown with a small hump on its back, and its belly and lower jaw are a lighter gray. The head is large in proportion to its body and has a blunt snout with a ridge above the nostrils. Two teeth are visible in the lower jaw, while the upper jaw has two tooth-like spikes. On top of its head are two orange spikes and it has a black around the lower edge of each eye. Around its neck is a spiky ruff of white, primitive feathers. It has tiny forelimbs with two white claws each. The hind legs are more developed and have rectangular, armor plating over the knees, three white claws on each foot, and a smaller, fourth digit lacking a claw off to the side. Its tail is short with an orange spike near the tip.

The Pokemon comes to Tomo, picks him up with his teeth, and puts Tomo on it's back. Tomo laughs with a smile. Pikachu and Eevee climb on it's back as well.

Mew uses her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Tyrunt, the Royal Heir Pokemon. A Rock and Dragon Type. Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago."

"I have to admit, we sure end up with unique Pokemon. And many are so cute," Misty says.

"I think Tyrunt really likes Tomo," Mew says.

The group soon laughs with smiles on their faces.

Later in the evening, after having their Pokemon restored and having them placed in their Pokeballs, Mew and her friends are at a small park to relax a bit.

"That was fun, huh guys," Mew says.

"It is. We got new Pokemon," Tomo says.

"Yeah, but I'm getting kind of hungry," Misty says.

"Me too. We should find a place to stay for the night, but I feel the Pokemon center and the hotels are filled," Mew says.

Just then, Brock asks, "Hey Mew, what about that card that old guy gave you?"

"You're right," Mew says.

Then takes it out, "Must be directions to his hotel."

The group looks at the card and Brock notices something odd about it, "Huh? That's strange. If you look near the swing, you'll see my hands. Or at least my face."

"Another riddle?" Tomo replies, confused.

Brock turns to his left, "There's a swing over there, but I don't see anybody's hands or face."

"You'll see my hands, or at least my face," Misty says to herself.

Then Misty has an idea, "I've got it! He means a clock!"

"You're right, Misty. A clock is the right answer," Mew says.

Then looks up, "And I see one there."

The group looks up to see a clock in front and there's a building.

Misty says, "You can see the hands and face of a clock. That must be the Big Riddle Inn!"

Soon enough, Mew and her friends arrive at the building and soon meet the man from before.

The man says, "Once again, Misty came up with the correct solution."

"That was an easy one," Misty says.

"As a prize, I'll give you all free rooms at the hotel," The man says.

"Oh thank you," Mew says.

Suddenly, everyone's stomachs begin to growl.

The man suspects, "Well, guess you want dinner, too."

"Right," Mew answers.

Meanwhile, at the Pokemon Research Lab, there are several Pokemon who are practicing fighting, work outs, swimming, etc. However, outside of the lab, Team Rocket's hot air balloon is hovering over it, with them inside. And once again, Team Rocket performs the motto.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Meowth then lands on them, interrupting the motto, "Blast off at light speed, prepare to fight, and all that other junk! Let's rob that Pokemon lab."

"Bombs away!" Jessie commands.

"Roger!" James replies.

With that, Team Rocket drops a bomb on the lab.

Back at the Big Riddle In, the phone begins to ring.

"I'm coming! I'm coming!" The man says.

Then answers the phone, "Thank you for calling the Big Riddle Inn. Be our guest, and we'll keep you guessing."

In the dining room close by, Mew and her friends are having dinner.

Tomo asks, "Aren't you hungry, Misty?"

"I just wanna go to bed," Misty says, tired.

Suddenly, they hear the man say, "That's awful!"

Sensing trouble, Mew asks, "Is something wrong?"

"The Pokemon lab is being attacked by a balloon!" The man answers.

Mew and the others become shocked to hear what is happening, and they have a feeling what balloon it is.

Back at the Pokemon Lab, Team Rocket has captured the Pokemon in a net and lifting them up to the balloon

"Just a heave and a ho!" Jessie says, and laughs.

Then James says, "And up all the Pokemon go!"

James and Meowth begin laughing.

"This sure beats selling cookies!" Jessie comments, and laughs along with them.

Soon enough, Mew and her friends arrive at the scene.

"I knew it, it's Team Rocket," Mew says.

"They're floating away!" The man says.

"I'm about to burst their bubble!" Mew says.

Then throws her Pokeball, "Pidgeotto, Meowstic, go!"

Then Pidgeotto and Meowstic come out of his Pokeball.

"Pikachu, Eevee, you and Pidgeotto go help save the Pokemon," Mew says.

"Pika!" (Gotcha!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (You got it!) Eevee says.

Pikachu and Eevee jump on Pidgeotto's back and they fly up to the balloon to rescue the Pokemon.

Team Rocket continues to pull up the Pokemon as they say, "Heave and ho and away we go!

However, they notice Pikachu and Eevee, riding on Pidgeotto

Jessie worriedly says, "Oh no!"

"It can't be!" James says, shocked.

Meowth panics. "Yes it can!"

Pikachu and Eevee then both perform Thunder Shock/Thunderbolt on Team Rocket, making them drop the next with the Pokemon.

Mew calls out, "Meowstic, use Psychic to catch the Pokemon."

Meowstic then uses her Psychic abilities to catch the Pokemon and gently place them on the ground.

"Okay Eevee, now use Swift!" Mew calls out.

Eevee then performs Swift and attacks the balloon. The Swift makes a hole in the balloon and Team Rocket is sent flying.

Team Rocket screams, "Looks like we're blasting off again!"

Once Team Rocket is gone, the Pokemon happily celebrates. The man watches as Pidgeotto descends to Mew and the Pokemon happily greets her.

The man walks over to Mew and says, "Thanks for saving the Pokemon, Mew. You all deserve a big reward, so I'll let you in on a little secret. Blaine built a gym that tourists never see.

The group lights up in excitement to hear the news.

"He did?" Mew asks, excited.

The man nods his head, and says, "It's in the place where firefighters can never win."

"Another riddle? What kind of reward's that?" Tomo asks, confused.

"Maybe if we answer the riddle, we'll know where the gym is," Mew says.

Later on back at the Big Riddle In, Mew and her friends are taking a bath in the Hot Springs where it's divided into two separate pools. The boys are staying on one side, and the girls stay on the Pokemon.

Tomo says, "I can't figure it out."

"It's where a firefighter can never win," Brock says, remembering the riddle.

Brock then asks, "Where could that be?"

"Where could a firefighter never win? Maybe someplace that doesn't have enough water," Misty says, wondering about the riddle.

"Then it must be a place that is very very hot," Mew adds.

"What kind of place is that?" Tomo asks.

"A place where a firefighter can never win. It has to be a place where there isn't enough water, and it must be very hot. The only place where I can think it's hot is…" Mew says.

Mew soon realizes, "A volcano!"

"Huh?" The group says, confused.

Mew says, "Blaine's Pokemon Gym must be in a volcano."

"A volcano?!" Misty asks, surprised.

"It's a place where firefighters can never win because it's boiling hot, and there isn't much water there. Plus, I read that the Cinnabar Gym is a Fire Type gym, so what better place for a Fire Type Gym Leader than a place where it's always hot," Mew says.

"That sounds like a great answer, but how are we going to know for sure?" Brock wonders.

Misty soon notices someone is missing, "Togepi?"

Mew points in a certain direction, "He's over there."

Misty turns to see Togepi, "What are you doing, Togepi?"

The girls look to see that Togepi is looking at the Gyarados fountain.

Misty walks to Togepi, "Togepi, move away! That water's boiling!"

Yet, Togepi leaps onto the fountain and jumps on it excitedly. Suddenly, the head moves down and a secret door appears in the base of the volcano, destroying the barrier wall of the hot springs. However, the boys and girls see that with the barrier destroyed, they see each other, and they all let out screams.

After the little situation, Mew and her friends dry themselves, put on their clothes, and walk down the secret passage. Yet as they walk down the tunnel, they realize the place is getting warmer.

Misty says, "Phew. Is it just me, or does it seem to be getting hot down here?"

"Oh, it's getting hot alright," Brock says.

Soon, the group reaches the bottom of the stairs to see a metal door.

"It's a door!" Tomo says, and about to reach it.

But Mew stops him, "Wait Tomo, the door might be hot."

Right on cure, the door opens to reveal a battlefield that is suspended over the lava. Mew and her friends are astonished to see it.

"Wow! A Battlefield in the Volcano!" Tomo says, amazed.

"This must be Blaine's gym!" Mew says.

"No firefighter could win in this place!" Brock says.

"There's sure not enough water to put out a volcano," Misty says

Just then, the lights turn on and the man from before is revealed to be on the other side of the battlefield

"I guess you solve my riddle," The man says.

"Pika?" (That guy?) Pikachu says, confused.

"Eevee Eev?" (What's he doing here?) Eevee wonders.

"What is he…" Mew about to speak, and realizes something,

Just then, the man says, "It's not a hat, but it keeps your head dry. If you wear it, it's only because you already lost it."

Then Misty answers, "It's a wig! A wig isn't a hat, but it keeps your head dry in the rain. And the only reason you wear a wig is if you already lost your hair.

"And Misty's done it again!" The man says.

"Good job, Misty, and I also figured something else out," Mew says.

"I believe you have figured out another answer," The man says.

Mew turns to the man, "Yeah. It actually took me a while to figure it out, but now I understand… You're Blaine, the Cinnabar Gym Leader, aren't you?"

"You are correct, Mew," The man says.

Then he removes the wig, mustache, and sunglasses, "I am Blaine the Gym Master."

Misty, Brock, Tomo, and the Pokemon become surprised.

"I wear a wig because I'm Blaine the Gym Master," The man says.

The group kind of understands, but kind of doesn't.

Then Blaine asks, "Now then, which one wants to battle me three on three?"

Mew steps forward, "I will!"

"Careful, he must raise some awesome fire Pokemon in this volcano," Brock.

"Use your water Pokemon, Mew," Misty says.

"Don't worry, I know which Pokemon to use," Mew says.

Blaine then calls out, "Ready to begin?"

"Ready when you are!" Mew says.

"Fine! I've already selected my first Pokemon! Ninetales, go!" Blaine says, and throws his first Pokeball to reveal Ninetales.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Ninetales, the Fox Pokemon, and the evolved form of Vulpix. A Fire Type. Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystic power."

"Alright then, I better be careful, even if Water is strong against fire, I better keep on my toes," Mew says.

She then throws her Pokeball, "Poliwhirl, I choose you!"

"A water type, how predictable," Blaine says.

Then calls out, "Go, Ninetales, Fire Spin, now!"

"Fire Spin is Ninetales' most powerful attack!" Brock says.

Ninetales then launches the attack.

Mew calls out, "Poliwhirl, use Hydro Pump!"

Poliwhirl then performs the attack and both attacks collide with each other. The water quickly turns to steam, but the water of the Hydro Pump continues to flow. Soon the Hydro Pump is able to counter Ninetales Fire Spin attack. Then the Hydro Pump strikes at Ninetales with full force and Ninetales is knocked out.

"Alright, Mew got it," Misty says.

Blaine then calls back Ninetales, "Return Ninetales."

Then turns to Mew, "That's one tough Poliwhirl you got."

"Thanks," Mew says.

"Poliwhirl!" (Alright!) Poliwhirl happily says.

Mew then calls back Poliwhirl, "Return Poliwhirl."

Then it goes back to his Pokeball.

Then Mew calls out, "Gyarados, Go!"

Gyarados then comes out of his Pokeball.

"So you've chosen a Gyarados," Blaine says.

Then calls out, "Rhydon, go!"

With that, Rhydon comes out of the Pokeball. It's a large, gray, bipedal Pokémon with features similar to both dinosaurs and rhinoceroses. It has narrow, red eyes and two fangs in its upper jaw, a snout is a cream-colored horn, which is smaller on a female than a male. There are several other spikes and projections on its head: on top is a spike that curves forward, two triangular points resembling ears on the sides, a wide, wavy crest under each ear, and spiky ridges on each cheek. It has a cream-colored abdomen divided into strips by thin divots. A rocky plate on its chest slightly overlaps its abdomen. There is a row of spikes down its back and they have a long tail with thin, black stripes.

"Rhydon huh," Mew says.

She takes out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Rhydon, the Drill Pokemon and the evolved form of Rhyhorn. A Ground and Rock Type. Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.

Blaine calls out, "Rhydon, Fury attack!"

Rhydon begins to charge for the attack.

Mew calls out, "Gyarados, use Protect!"

Gyardos then performs the attack, and is able to escape the Furry Attack.

"Hey, pretty impressive!" Blaine says, impressed.

Then calls out, "Rhydon, use Hammer Arm!"

With that, Rhydon begins to perform Hammer Arm and heads to strike at Gyarados.

Mew calls out, "Gyarados, use Aqua Tails!"

Gyarados then is able to perform Aqua Tail just as Rhydon performs its attack. The two attacks collide with one another and the both struggle to keep it up. Finally, Gyarados is able to counter Hammer Arm and sends it back.
"Now Gyarados, Whirlpool!" Mew calls out.

Gyarados then performs Whirlpool and strikes at Rhydon with full forms. Soon, Rhydon lands on the ground and has been defeated.

Blaine then calls back Rhydon, "Rhydon, return!"

Then calls it back, "I'll have to choose another Pokemon."

"Okay, Gyarados, return," Mew says, and calls back her Pokeball.

Then brings out her other Pokeball, "Now to make this interesting. Time to fight fire with fire. Go Charizard!"

Mew then calls out Charixard, and Charizard then lets out a roar.

"Okay Charizard, ready to battle?" Mew asks.

Charizard nods his head in reply.

Just then, Blaine says, "This Pokemon is too hot to handle! And it has a power that should interest you, because it turns all its opponents into ash!"

"Is it a little too hot to be solving riddles?" Tomo asks.

Blaine calls out, "I choose, Magmar!"

Just then, the lava begins to rise, shocking everyone.

"Magmar?" Mew says, surprised.

The lava soon falls back to reveal the Magmar that is revealed.

"Wow! That Magmar is pretty big," Mew says.

She brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Magmar, the Spitfire Pokemon. A Fire Type. Its body is like a furnace, making Magmar a living inferno. It has been discovered only near active volcanoes."

Mew looks up to notice Charizard has the fire in his eyes. Magmar also has the same fire in its eyes as well.

"What's up with Charizard?" Tomo asks.

"I think Charizard can tell Magmar is strong. I say Charizard is more than eager to battle," Brock says.

"Yeah. Look at the fire in his eyes," Misty says.

Charizard and Magmar look at each other and show the determined fire in their eyes. One thing for sure, this is going to be one fired up Pokemon Match. Will Mew be able to earn her seventh gym badge?

Chapter 54: Episode 53: Volcanic Panic

Still in her Pokemon Gym Battle, Mew has called out Charizard and Blaine has called out Magmar. Now it's Fire vs. Fire in this Pokemon match. Charizard and Magmar glare at each other with determination and fire in their eyes.

Mew then calls out, "Charizard, Flamethrower attack!"

Charizard then performs Flamethrower. Magmar performs the same attack. When both attacks collide, an explosion occurs, much to the group's surprise.

Then Blaine calls out, "Okay, Magmar, that Charizard is good, but it can't compete with your skills! Fire Blast it, now!"

Magmar then launches the attack.

"Quick Charizard, block the attack!" Mew calls out.

Charizard then uses his strength to block the fire blast.

"You can do it! Don't give up, Charizard!" Mew calls out.

The attack nudges Charizard to the edge of the stadium. However, Charizard is able to toss the Fire Blast upward into the sky.

Blaine calls out, "Magmar, Skull Bash attack!"

Magmar then charges and attacks it.

"Charizard, use your wings to help repel the attack!" Mew calls out.

Chairzard then spreads his wings to get balance, and pushes his claw feet against the wall. Charizard then pushes Magmar much to it's surprise and flies in the air. Then dives down at it on the battlefield.

"Magmar!" Blaine calls out.

The dust clears to see the two Pokemon locked up and glare at each other. Magmar lets go of Charizard, allowing Charizard's own moment to send him to the edge of the pillar. Then Magmar appears behind it.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, behind you!"

Magmar then grabs hold of Charizard.

Mew then has an idea, "Charizard, take Magmar to the sky!"

Chaizard then spreads his wings and flies up above the volcano.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, let's show Magmar your aerial Submission attack!"

Charizard then spins around in a circle making Magmar dizzy.

"Charizard, Seismic Toss!" Mew calls out.

Charizard flies higher and higher into the air. Then Charizard begins to perform a look around and around in a circle. Charizard then grab's Magmar's arm and throws him down and straight into the lava to create a powerful splash from under the battlefield. Charizard then lands on the battlefield. Suddenly, Magmar rises from the lava and lands on the battlefield. Mew and the others are surprised, and Blaine makes a smirk on his face.

Charizard and Magmar stare each other down for the longest time. But then, Magmar collapses face down, meaning Charizard has won the match. Charizard lets out a roaring Flamethrower in victory.

"Way to go!" Mew cheers.

Pikachu says, "Pikachu!" (Nice going!)

"Eevee!" (You did it!) Eevee happily cheers.

Blaine then returns Magmar to its Pokeball.

He turns to Mew and says, "Congratulations, Mew."

"Thanks," Mew says.

Just then, Charizard lands next to Mew and snuggles her with glee.

Mew giggles, "That tickles Charizard."

Mew continues to laugh as Charizard snuggles her with glee.

After the battle, the group in the dining room of the Big Riddle In.

Blaine says to Mew, "And now, I have another riddle for you, Mew."

"Huh?" Mew says, confused.

Then Blaine tells her the riddle, "What is it that is always red but has no words?"

Then brings out the badge, "Ha! The answer is a Volcano badge!""

The group becomes dumbfounded and are a bit embarrassed.

"And you have earned this one," Blaine says.

"Thanks a lot, Blaine!" Mew says, and takes the badge.

Suddenly Tomo, Pikahu, and Eevee let out a yawn.

Mew giggles and says, "Looks like someone's tired."

Then Togepi yawns as well.

"Looks like Togepi is tired as well," Misty says.

Brock looks at the clock on the wall to see that it's almost midnight.

"It's no wonder, we had one very eventful night," Brock says.

"Yeah. I'm feeling tired myself as well," Mew says.

Misty yawns, "I could use some sleep myself."

"Well then, you all be sure to have a good night's sleep and see you all in the morning," Blaine says.

The group nod their heads and head to bed for the night.

The next day, Mew and her friends are sitting in the hot springs while the Pokemon are happily relaxed, even Charizard is relaxed in the hot spring.

"You all did a great job everyone," Mew says.

Then pets Charizard on the head, "And you fought hard battling Magmar. You all earned a nice relaxing bath."

Charizard growls in reply, Gyarados and Poliwhirl agree.

Misty giggles and says, "The Pokemon sure looks relaxed."

"They earned it after battling in a volcano," Brock says.

Just then, Poliwhirl comes out of the water and up to Mew.

"Hi Poliwhirl, what's up?" Mew asks.

"Poliwhirl Poliwhirl," (Can I have the Water Stone you still have? I think I'm ready.) Poliwhirl says.

Mew nods her head and says, "Of course."

Mew then brings out her bag and digs inside of it.

"What are you doing, Mew?" Misty asks.

"Looking for the Water Stone. Poliwhirl likes to evolve into Poliwrath and he feels that he's ready," Mew says.

Then hold out the Water Stone, "Here you go."

Poliwhirl is happy and takes the Water Stone in his hand. Then, Poliwhirl begins to glow along with the Water Stone. Soon, Poliwhirl's shape begins to change. Soon, Poliwhirl is now a blue, bipedal Pokémon with a round body and muscular arms. It has bulbous eyes that protrude from the top of its head and its belly is covered by a white and black swirl. There appear to be white gloves on its hands, and it has rounded, digit-less feet.

"Poliwrath!" The newly evolved Pokemon says.

"Poliwhirl is now Poliwrath," Misty says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Poliwrath, the Tadpole Pokemon, and the final evolved form of Poliwag. A Water and Fighting Type. Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches."

Polwrath then jumps back in the water and continues his relaxation. Mew and the others laugh in reply.

Meanwhile, on the other side of the barrier wall, there are two bamboo shoots popping out of the water with two familiar figures under them… The familiar figures are Jessie and James from Team Rocket.

Breathing through the shoot, James says, "It's getting warm down here."

"I know, but we have to get used to the heat," Jessie says.

James complains, "It's getting hotter!"

"Stop complaining!" Jessie says.

The two soon start struggling for air when Meowth comes in, and cheers and shouts until they can't stand to be in the water anymore. They soon rise out of the water gasping for air.

Mewoth then questions, "If you two can't stand the heat in this hot spring, how're you gonna stand it inside of that volcano?""

"How else can we kidnap Magmar?" James says.

"We've got to have Magmar and beat Pikachu!" Jessie adds.

"I got a plan to snag Magmar. We'll go down to the volcano and tell Magmar it won some phony prize, and then, when it's guard is down, we'll use our freeze blaster! Now, where am I gonna get gloves with three fingers?" Meowth says.

Jessie chuckles, "We'll have our own Pok-cicle!"

James chuckles, "A Magmar-ita!"

Sometime later, Team Rocket heads down into the volcano with a special machine that will help them capture Magmar. Soon, they arrive at the door where the battlefield is.

"Here we go," Meowth says, and places his paws at the door.

However, when he tries to open it, his paws begin to burn.

Meowth screams in pain, "My paws got burned! Freeze blast em, quick!"

Soon, Team Rocket burst through the door and into the battlefield.

Jessie calls out, "Hello?! Is Magmar home?!"

Meowth then dresses up and announces through a microphone, "Time to present our winner with the Pokemon Sweepstakes grand prize! A trip for two to Mount Vesuvius! We've come here to the home of our lucky winner, Magmar."

Before Meowth can continue, Jessie and James stomp on him.

"Why do you always have to hog the spotlight, Meowth?!" Jessie angrily says.

"Give us a chance!" James adds.

Soon enough, Magmar rises out of the lava, frightening Team Rocket. Magmar comes out to see what the commotion is about.

James sheepishly says, "Here's our..."

"Winner," Jessie nervously says.

Meowth calls out, "Don't just stand there gawking at it! Freeze blast it before it's too late!"

With that, Team Rocket points out their Freeze Blaster at Magmar

"Chill out!" Jessie says.

"Once we get through with you, Magmar, we'll slide you back to the boss like a giant hockey puck-emon," James says.

With that, Jessie and James activate the machine and aim it at Magmar.

"Magmar, you're permafrost!" Jessie says.

Then Meowth shouts, "Ready, aim, freeze blast!"

With that, Jessie and James fire the Freeze Blast at Magmar, and successfully freeze it into a Pokemon Icicle. Team Rocket happily cheers.

"We've got a Pokemon on ice! Now the boss will treat us nice!" Jessie happily says.

"When we've shown him what we've done, our team will be number one!" Meowth says, waving fans around.

Team Rocket continues to cheer, but the heat from Magmar's body begins to melt and break the ice. Soon, Magmar is free, catching Team Rocket's attention.

"We interrupt this message to bring you a Magmar melt down!" Meowth says, shocked.

Then begins to panic and runs around waving the fans, "Hurry up! Freeze blast the whole place! Freeze blast the whole place!"

Jessie and James begin to fire more freeze blaster rockets throughout the volcano, freezing the rock walls. Back in the hot springs, Mew and the others hear blasting sounds and feel the ground begins to shake.

"Whoa! What's going on?!" Mew says, surprised.

"It sounds like an earthquake," Misty says.

Suddenly, bouncing out of the bushes and landing in the water are two Pokemon Eggs. One of them is white on the top and pale blue on the bottom, and patterns that look like ice. The other one is also white with an orange and gray pattern.

"What was that?" Brock asks.

Tomo hurries in the water and picks them up, "They're Eggs. Pokemon Eggs."

"Put them in your bag for safe keeping. We need to figure out what's going on," Mew says.

"Okay," Tomo says, and puts the eggs in his backpack.

That's when Blaine rushes in, "I was on my way to the laboratory when I heard all the noise! Of course, in a volcano, every room is a lavatory! Get it?"

"Now I see how you come up with those riddles!" Misty says.

"I think we better check on what's going on down there," Brock says, and the others nod their heads in reply.

Soon, Mew and the others follow Blaine down the stairs and into the battlefield. When they arrive, Blaine has been frozen with the cold air.

"Ice in a volcano? That's freezer burn!" Blaine says, somewhat frozen.

Mew comes over and says, "Maybe you should cool it with the jokes."

Brock soon sees the familiar faces, "Look who it is!"

"It's Team Rocket!" Misty and Tomo say.

The group look to see Team Rocket firing their blaster all over the volcano.

Meowth continues to call out, "We gotta get that Magmar! We gotta get that Magmar!"

Team Rocket continues to fire the missiles all over the volcano that it begins to get covered in ice.

"What's gonna happen to this gym if it's filled with ice?!" Blaine says.

Tomo then answers, "It'll be a snow cone!"

But Blaine says, "I wasn't making a riddle! Freezing all this hot rock can set off a chain reaction deep inside the volcano!"

Soon enough, the volcano begins to rumble, catching Team Rocket's attention.

James asks, "What's going on?"

"I think we're cracking up!" Jessie answers,

Soon enough the ice and the wall begins to crack and break apart, and the volcano begins to rumble more.

"I was afraid of this! The ice is cooling off the rock, it's cracking apart!" Blaine says.

"Isn't the ice just gonna melt?" Mew asks.

But Blaine says, "It's happening too fast! The rock is already shattering! Lava will flow through cracks in the rock, the surge will cause a huge volcanic eruption!"

Mew and her friends are shocked by Blaine's statement. Meaning, the volcanic eruption could destroy Cinnabar Island. Soon, the inside of the volcano cracks more and the steam begins to escape through the cracks. The rocks fall into the lava, and the lava begins to fall into the pool, much to everyone's terror. Soon, the battlefield begins to fall into the pool with Magmar still on it, but Magmar jumps off as the battlefield touches the lava.

"My gym is destroyed!" Blaine says.

Soon, Team Rocket begins to panic.

"Hey! You know where we are?" Meowth panics.

"Between a rock.." James says, scared.

"And a very hot place!" Jessie screams.

Soon, Team Rocket is sent blasting off by the rock they're standing on and the large amount of steam pushing them up.

Team Rocket screams, "Looks like Team Rocket's freeze blasting off again!"

Soon, the rocks everyone is standing on begins to slide all over the place. The lava soon begins to gush out of the large cracks in the wall.

Blaine notices it, "Oh no! Lava's starting to burst through the cracks! I'm afraid it's only a matter of minutes until the volcano blows!"

"What can we do?!" Brock asks.

"Pikachu!" (Stop it fast!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eev!" (Before the place blows up!) Eevee says.

"Pikachu and Eevee say that we need to stop it fast before the volcano blows it," Mew says.

Misty screams, "They don't need to tell us twice."

Blaine turns to Magmar, "Magmar, if you pile up rocks in the crater, it might be enough to block the lava flow!"

Soon, Pikachu and Eevee begin to do the job themselves. They each carry the rock to the edge where the large crack is.

But Blaine stops them, "Wait! Only a fire type Pokemon can withstand the heat from that lava!"

"A fire type Pokemon?" Mew replies.

Mew then calls out, "Charizard, I choose you!"

With that, Charizard comes out, "Charizard, help Magmar to block the crater and stop the lava flow!"

Charizard nods his head and begins to work on the situation with the rocks. He picks up the rocks with Magmar and throws them into the lava. The two Pokemon continue to throw rocks down into the lava to stop it flowing, but there are too many coming out.

"It's not working! Let's run for it!" Misty says.

"When the volcano blows, there won't be any place to run. If Magmar can't stop it, this island will be destroyed," Blaine says.

"We've got to do something!" Brock says.

"We're going to need more help," Mew says.

Brock then brings out his Pokemon, "Okay, Onix, Rhyhorn, and Geodude, rock Pokemon can take heat! I'll bring out Slugma and Vulpix to help out as well. Go!"

Mew then brings out, "Cinderace, Pansear. Arcanine. You help too!"

"Growlithe. Ponyta. You too!" Tomo says.

"And Staryu, you can help them all keep to cool while working. Go!" Misty says, and tosses her Pokeball.

"You too, Squirtle!" Mew says, and throws her other Pokeball.

Pikachu and Eevee quickly instruct the others what they need to do. Then they head off to work. All the fire type and Rock Pokemon, including Pikachu and Eevee put the rocks into the lava. Squirtle and Staryu help spray the rock Pokemon, Eevee, and Pikachu who are close to the lava.

"Now, that's what I call teamwork!" Mew says.

"They're all working together!" Misty happily says.

Brock says, "Keep up the good work!"

"Go Go!" Tomo calls out.

Suddenly, Misty notices Togepi is trying to help too, but ends up losing his balance and falls into the lava.

But Misty quickly saves him, "Togepi!"

She quickly pulls him up and says, "You're a little too little."

Mew and the others watch as the Pokemon continue to throw the rocks down into the lava. They continue to block the lava until the lava is no longer seeping through. The rocks have formed into a wall where the lava is unable to get through.

"You all were awesome," Mew says.

"That was too close, " Brock says.

Blaine walks over and says, "I don't know how to thank you all."

"It's no trouble. We're glad to help," Mew says.

Then Blaine says, "I might actually know just the reward for you, and one last riddle for you. It's something that has a round and oval shape, comes in very different colors, and it's how Pokemon comes to this world."

"Another riddle?" Brock says, confused.

"An Egg. A Pokemon Egg," Mew says.

"You are correct," Blaine says.

After the event with the volcano, the group is in front of the Big Riddle Inn. Blaine hands Mew a Pokemon Egg. The Pokemon Egg is light red color and on the bottom of the egg has a yellow pattern that is like fire.

"Here you go, one Pokemon Egg," Blaine says.

Mew then takes the Egg, "Thank you."

Then remember, "By the way, we also found two more eggs that fell in the pool."

Tomo then takes the two eggs out of his backpack and shows them.

"Those look interesting, never seen these ones before. But since you found them, they're yours to keep," Blaine says.

"Thank you," Tomo says.

Suddenly, both Pokemon Eggs begin to glow and soon crack, catching everyone's attention. Soon enough, both of the Eggs Tomo is holding hatch.

One of them is a fuzzy, moth larva-like Pokémon. It has blue eyes in a shadowed face. Its white mane of fuzz encompasses its head and the upper half of its body, while its lower half is brown. It has three pairs of small black legs. There are five red, slightly whorled horns on the sides of its head.

The other is a small, larval Pokémon. Most of its round white body is covered by a translucent shell of icy spikes. Its exposed head features two black eyes and round mouthparts. Four short legs are located underneath its body.

"Aww, they're so cute," Mew says.

"I have to admit, they are cute, even though they're bug types," Misty says.

"But what are they?" Brock wonders.

Mew holds out the Pokedex to the fuzzy moth one and Dexter says, "Larvesta, the Torch Pokemon. A Bug and Fire Type. Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves. This Pokemon Originated in the Unova Region.

"And what about the other one?" Misty asks.

Mew holds the Pokedex and Dexter says, "Snom, the Worm Pokemon. And Ice and Bug Type. It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps."

"Hi Larvesta. Nomn. It's nice to meet you," Tomo happily says.

The two Pokemon look at Tomo and snuggle his cheeks. One of his cheeks feels a little hot, and the other feels a bit cold. Mew and the others giggle with glee.

Mew then says, "Now then, we just need to figure out where we can go for the next gym battle."

"Well, we could always go to the gym back in Viridian City," Brock says.

"I never knew about that. Did any of you?" Mew says, confused.

"Everybody knows about that gym. Viridian is where Pokemon trainers go to try and earn their Earth badges," Misty says.

"Oh. I guess I never knew that because well, we kind of got off on a crazy adventure when we first met," Mew says.

Misty says, "Yeah. Talk about a crazy first meeting."

"How come?" Tomo asks.

"Well, it's kind of a long story, but in short, it's kind of how Pikachu, Eevee, and I first met Misty on our way there. And at the Pokemon Center in Viridian City is where we first met Team Rocket," Mew says.

She scratches the back of her head and nervously giggles, "And it's also happened when, well, Pikachu accidentally turned Misty's bike into burnt toast."

"Yeah. You're still gonna pay me back for it!" Misty says.

"And I said I promised I'll find a way to pay for a new one," Mew says.

"I hope you will," Misty says.

Then Mew says, "Come on, we better get going. It's off to Kanto and making our way to Viridian City."

Mew then runs ahead. Misty, Brock, Pikachu, and Eevee hurry after her. Things have been very eventful, Mew has earned a Volcano Badge, Tomo has two new Pokemon Eggs, the group also gain living Prehistoric Pokemon from their fossils, and they ended up with a relaxing time on the island. Now, Mew and her friends are off to Viridian City so Mew can earn her eighth and final badge. As the journey continues.

Chapter 55: Episode 54: Beach Blank-Out Blastoise

After winning a Volcano Badge from the Cinnabar Gym, Mew and the others are in a drastic rush to the ferry that will leave Cinnabar Island to get back to the mainland. They run as fast as they can because it's the last ferry off the island.

Misty calls out, "Wait! Don't leave without us!"

"Stop the boat!" Mew calls out.

The group hurries down the stairs and runs to the beach.

Mew continues to call out, "Hold on! We're coming! Hey! Hold that boat!"

"Wait for us!" Tomo adds.

The group continues to run as fast as they can. Suddenly, a Pokemon rushes in Mew's way and the girl bumps into it. Soon after, Brock sets the Pokemon up so that it's spinning. The Pokemon is a bipedal, indigo Pokémon similar to a turtle. It has brown eyes, a dark blue streak on each cheek, and two sharp teeth protruding from its upper jaw. It has three clawed fingers and pointed toes. On each side of its head are feather-like ears covered in pale blue fur. A brown shell with a pale yellow underside encases its body. A thick, white rim separates the upper and lower halves of the shell. Poking out of the bottom of the shell is a thick, wavy tail that also has light blue fur.

"Are you okay?" Misty asks.

Mew sits up, "I'm okay, but what did I trip on?"

"Wow, a Wartortle. Talk about your rare Pokemon!" Brock says.

Mew turns to see the Turtle Pokemon who is very dizzy, "It is a Wartortle."

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Wartortle, the Turtle Pokemon and the evolved form of Squirtle. A Water Type. It's long, furry tail is a symbol of its age and wisdom."

Wartortle begins to talk in a panic. However, Wattle is talking so fast that it's hard to understand what Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and Tomo are saying."

"What's it saying?" Misty asks.

Soon, Seel and Brionne stop glowing and now are in a new shape. Seel has evolved into a white coated color of Mew's Dewgong.

Brionne has evolved into a marine Pokémon that resembles a cross between a sea lion and a mermaid. Most of its body is white, but it has a long, fishlike tail. It has a long snout with a round, pink nose, bright blue eyes with long white eyelashes, and long light blue hair trailing off the back of its head. A tiara-like structure rests on its forehead, consisting of a line of pearls with a pink sea star at one corner and a thin, transparent blue fin extending back over its hair. Its hair is contained to a ponytail by two strings of pearls. On its body are three fins similar to the one on its crown: one that drapes around its shoulders and chest, one around its waist where the fishtail begins, and one near the tip of its tail. It has long front fins with three digits.

Misty says, amazed, "Seel evolved into Dewgong!"

"Alright, Arbok, go get those two annoying seals now! Go!" Jessie commands.

Meowth panic, "No! No! Watch out! Don't come any closer!"

Soon the audience applauded for the fantastic performance. Everyone decide to wave with glee

Chapter 57: Episode 56: Electrical Power Plant Shelter

After reaching the mainland, Mew and her friends continue to make their way to Viridian City so Mew can compete for her eight and final badge. Right now, Mew decides to have some training for her Gym Battle. Brock is busy making some lunch, while Misty watches Tomo play with Meloetta and the younger Pokemon: Cleffa, Dratini, Igglypuff, Mudkip, Togepi, Shuckle, Larvesta, Snom. Tomo and the Pokemon are having a lot of fun.

In the open field close by, Mew is doing some training with her Pokemon: Pikachu, Eevee, Shaymin, Ivysaur, Wartortle, Roserade, Pidgeotto, Primeape, Skitty, Silcoon, Kakuna, Sandshrew, Magnemite, Primeape, and Tyrogue. Some of the little ones: Galarian Ponyta, Teddiursa and Axew want to train too.

Mew calls out, "Okay Shaymin, use Magical Leaf. Haunter, use Shadow Ball!"

Shaymin then performs Magical Leaf and Haunter performs Shadow Ball at each other. Both attacks collide with one another.

Primeape and Tyrouge begin to practice their fighting moves against each other.

Roserade then performs the attack.

"Now Skitty, use Swift! And Flabébé, use Fairy Wind" Mew calls out.

With that, Skitty performs Swift at the Petal Dance, but has been counter. Then Flabébé performs Fairy Wind and is able to counter Petal Dance.

"Skitty, dodge!" Mew calls out, and Skitty dodges the attack.

Mew turns to Primeape as Teddiursa runs over, "Okay Primeape, Teddiursa is going to battle now."

Primeape nods his head and faces the little bear.

Mew calls out. "Teddiursa use, Headbutt!"

Teddiursa charges to perform the attack.

"Okay Primeape, block the attack!" Mew calls out.

And Primeape blocks the attack as Teddiursa strikes.

Misty and Brock turn to see Mew and her Pokemon training.

"Mew sure is fired up," Misty says.

"Yeah. Mew just needs one more badge so she can compete in the Pokemon League, so she and her Pokemon are training hard," Brock says as he finishes making the sandwiches.

Then says, "And even hard working trainers need to have a lunch break."

"That's true," Misty says.

Then Brock calls out, "Alright everyone, lunch is ready!"

Mew, Tomo, and all the Pokemon hear Brock calling them.

Mew turns to her Pokemon, "Okay everyone, it's time for a lunch break."

Tomo, and the Pokemon answer with yes and cries with glee. Soon enough, everyone is having sandwiches or Pokemon food with some berries and drinks.

"These sandwiches are great," Mew says.

"Yeah. They're the best," Misty says.

"Glad you like it, and there's plenty," Brock says.

"I'll have seconds," Tomo happily says.

Mew giggles with a smile.

Then turns to the Pokemon, "How's the food taste?"

"Pika Pika," (The food is delicious.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee, (And the food is really yummy.) Eevee adds with a smile.

"After finishing eating, we should go to Viridian City," Brock says.

"Sounds good," Mew says.

Mew and the others continue to have their lunch until they have their fill. After having lunch, they pack their things, call their Pokemon in their Pokeballs and continue to make their way to Viridian City to get to the Viridian Gym. The group soon begin to walk through Viridian Tunnel which is a bit of a walk. They soon walk out of the tunnel and begin to make their way to Viridian City. Suddenly, dark clouds roll in, and rain begins to come down at an instant. That catches Mew and her friends by surprise as they're getting rained on.

"It's a big storm!" Misty panics.

"More like huge. It's practically pouring," Brock says.

"But we're almost to Viridian City. We might still be able to make it if we run for it," Mew says.

"Let's hurry," Brock says.

With that, the group begins to run in the big storm. Since they're close to Viridian City, they figure running for it is the best they can do. However, the wind begins to blow hard and the rain is pouring faster than before. Just then, the storm blows so hard that Tomo and Meloetta end up blown off the train and into the river.

Mew gasps, "Tomo! Meloetta!"

Just then, Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew end up being blown into the river, followed by Brock, Misty, and Togepi. Everyone is able to rise to the surface of the river, but are being pulled away by the fast current.

"The current is pulling us too fast!" Misty panics.

"It's hard to swim!" Tomo adds, frightened.

Mew then brought out her Pokeball, "I got an idea… Ditto!"

Ditto is released from the raft and lands on Mew's head.

"Ditto, turn into a raft, please hurry!" Mew calls out.

Ditto sees the trouble and acts fast. Ditto then turns into a rubber fast. Mew quickly climbs in. She then quickly picks up Pikachu and Eevee along with Tomo and Meloetta.

Mew reaches her hands out to her friends, "Brock! Misty! Take my hand!"

Brock and Misty quickly grab Mew's hand, and the young girl pulls them into the raft.

"Thanks Mew," Misty says.

"That was quick thinking," Brock says.

"Togepi," (Chilly.) Togepi says, and lets out a sneeze. Then shivers.

Misty looks worried, "Poor Togepi."

"I wonder where we're going," Mew replies, looking ahead of the river.

"I don't know, but the water is very cold, and the rain isn't making it better for us," Misty says.

The group waits patiently as they drift down the river. Soon enough, the rift stops at the shore and the group walk off of the raft. The raft changes back to the shiny blue ditto.

Mew picks up Ditto who is tired, "Thank you Ditto. You get a good rest."

Then puts Ditto back in its Pokeball.

Misty looks around, "I wonder where we are. Probably far from Viridian City."

"Maybe, but we need to find a shelter," Mew says.

"You mean there?!" Tomo calls out.

The group turns to see Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Tomo ahead of them and hurry over. Soon, the group looks ahead to see a large building. It has stone walls with a large round and rectangle shaped roof. The roof also is yellow and light green, and there are large electrical wires coming from the sides of the wall.

"What is that place?" Misty asks, weary.

Even Togepi is scared, "Togeprrrriiiii!" (It's scary!)

"I think this is the old Power Plant," Brock says.

"Power Plant?" Mew says, confused.

"What's a Power Plant?" Tomo asks.

"It's a building where electricity is generated for distribution. They're used to power up machines, buildings, and other places in the city. I heard this one was shut down and abandoned when a new one was built," Brock says.

"It doesn't look like the doors are boarded in, so we can use it for shelter," Mew says.

Misty is shocked, "What?! You want us to stay there?!"

"We might not have a choice. From the looks of this storm, it might go one for a while," Brock says.

"It will be best to stay here until the storm clears," Mew says.

Misty sighs, "You're right."

"Let's go," Tomo says, and sneezes.

"We better hurry inside before we all get colds," Misty says.

With that, the group hurries inside to get away from the rain. Brock is able to open the door easily and the group hurry inside. Brock runs inside and closes the door when everyone else is inside. When they hurry in the building, the place looks very dark and dirty.

"It's really dark in here," Tomo says.

"I can't see a thing," Misty says.

Mew then brings out her Pokeball, "I know just the thing. Magnemite."

Mew then releases Magnemite from its Pokeball.

"Magnemite, use Flash," Mew calls out.

Magnemite then uses Flash and allows everyone to see.

"Great idea Mew. Let's get things settled in for the night," Brock says.

Mew and the others begin to set things. They unroll their sleeping bags, grab a few flashlights and a lantern to light up the room, and another few essentials to make their night in the building comfortable. Since there is more light, Mew returns Magnemite to its Pokeball and everyone is sitting on their sleeping bags as they try themselves off.

"That was too close," Mew says.

"Yeah. Togepi is very soaked," Misty says, and dries her little Pokemon with a towel.

Tomo dries off his hair as he sees Meloetta doing the same.

"You okay there, Meloetta?" Tomo asks.

Meloetta nods her head, "Mel Mel," (I'm okay.)

They soon hear thunder crashing and the rain pouring outside and look to see the rain is really coming down.

"It doesn't look like the storm will be clearing soon," Misty says.

"It will be best to stay here. It's going to be a long night," Mew says.

Agreeing to the idea, the group decided to have some rest until the rain stopped. Unknown to them, something or someone has been spying on them and watching from the darkness.

Sometime later, the rain continues to pour outside and it doesn't look like it's going to clear anytime soon. Still in the abandoned Power Plant, Mew and the others are taking a nap for a while. Well, everyone except Misty. She feels so uneasy about being in the building that she can't seem to get to sleep.

"This place is very creepy. I… I don't think staying here is a good idea," Misty nervously says.

Suddenly, Misty hears a strange sound that makes her spooked, "Wh-what's that?!"

She then sits up and begins to look around to hear the strange noise. Even if she's frightened, Misty wonders if she imagines it. Suddenly, she hears the sound again, freaking her out.

Misty then turns to Mew and shakes her on the shoulder, "Mew, wake up. I think we're not alone here."

"Five more minutes," Mew mutters in her sleep.

Misty then hears the sound again and panics loud, "Wake up! Now!"

Soon, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, Brock, Tomo, and Meloetta wake up. Even Togepi wakes up to see his mommy is awake.

"Misty, what's wrong?" Mew asks.

Tomo then yawns and says, "I'm still a little tired."

"I hear something," Misty nervously says.

"Hear what?" Brock asks.

"I… I don't think we're alone in this place…" Misty nervously says that her mouth quivers.

Just then, they hear a banging sound, causing everyone to jump in fright.

"What in the world was that?" Brock asks.

"I'm guessing there really is someone else here," Mew replies.

Frightened, Misty says, "I told you!"

"But what's making that sound?" Tomo asks.

"I think we should find out," Mew replies.

After not being able to get some sleep and after hearing the strange noise, Mew and her friends decide to look around the old building to see what's making the strange noise. Mew and Brock each hold out their flashlights, and Mew also calls out Magnemite to use Flash to help get some light in the hall. The hall looks very old, like it hasn't been used in years. There are some leftover wires, old machines, and a few doors.

Misty gulps nervously and says, "This place looks very creepy."

"You're right. This place looks very old and rundown. It looks like a place for Ghost Pokemon to live," Mew says.

Misty shivers at the thought, "I really hope we don't run into any of them here."

"We might, but maybe the place isn't as abandoned as we thought it was," Brock says.

Just then, they hear a loud and strange crashing sound.

"What was that?!" Tomo exclaims in surprise.

"It's coming from down the hall," Mew says.

Mew and the others rush down the hall and turn to the corner. They soon stop in their tracks to find a group of Electric Pokemon: A four Voltorb and three Electrodes, two Electabuzz, two Raichus, three young Pikachus, and an oddly colored geodude.

The Geodude has a more silvery appearance, with black eyebrows and strands of short black hair. It's fingers are fused together like gloves, excluding the thumb and index finger.

"Wow. Look at all the Pokemon," Tomo says.

"And they're electric type Pokemon," Mew says.

Brock then notices, "And that Geodude looks a lot different than my Geodude."

Mew then brings out her Pokedex, "Let's see what Dexter says."

Mew then presents the Pokedex to the Geodude and Dexter says, "Geodude, the Rock Pokemon. A Rock and Electric Type. Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism."

"A Rock and Electric type? That's weird," Misty replies.

"Maybe it's like how my Ponyta is. Remember, the Ponyta I got was a Galarian Version," Mew says.

"I think she's right. Pokemon can have different appearances depending on which region it lives in," Brock says.

"But where does Geodude live?" Tomo asks.

"Let's see," Mew says.

Dexter continues, "This Geodude is an Alolan Form from the Alola Region. Even among the same species of Pokémon, there can still be minor differences, depending on the region where they live or are raised. These differences are called regional forms."

"Alola huh. It's like your Ponyta that is a Galarian Form," Misty replies.

"Yeah, but it's kind of cool to see it have eyebrows," Tomo says.

Confused, Brock wonders, "Those are eyebrows?"

"I wonder what they're doing here?" Misty replies, curious.

Mew looks forward and notices some of the debris of the old building has fallen and all the Pokemon have gathered.

"I don't know, something must have happened," Mew says.

Misty looks up to see the hole on the ceiling, "It looks like the roof of the Power Plant must have fallen off the roof and crashed to the ground."

"I'm going to see what's going on," Mew says, and steps forward.

Mew then walks down the hall to talk to the Electric Pokemon, but Misty grows concerned, Tomo and Brock feel the same. As Mew walks towards the electric Pokemon, one of the Raichus turns its head and grows weary to see Mew coming forward. The other Electric Pokemon become alerted and look to see Mew. Many of them step forward and let out some electric sparks to scare Mew off.

Mew calmly says, "It's okay. I'm not here to cause any trouble, I like to know what's going on. You all seem worried about something."

The larger Electabuzz steps forward and asks, "Elect Elect Electabuzz?" (What are you humans doing here?)

"Well, my friends and I got washed down the river and we decided to stay here for shelter from the rain. We didn't know anyone else was living here," Mew says.

"Elect Electabuzz Elect Electa. Electa Electabuzz," (I see, the storm is awful outside. I suppose it is understandable.) Electabuzz says.

Mew then asks, "I'm glad you think so. My friends and I heard a loud noise and we can guess it was you guys and the roof collapsed. Was there something wrong here? Do you need anything?"

Electabuzz," (Come here.) Electabuzz says.

Mew then walks with Electabuzz to the collapsed debris.

Suddenly she hears a loud, "Pika! Pika Pi!" (Help! Someone help!)

Mew becomes alert to hear the cry, and leans towards the debris.

Then the cry comes out again, "Pika Pika!" (Please help!)

"I see, one of your friends got stuck on the other side of the debris," Mew replies.

The Electric Pokemon nod their heads in reply.

"Don't worry, my friends and I can help you," Mew says.

She turns to where her friends are and calls out, "Hey guys, there's no need to worry! These Pokemon need help!"

The others then hurry to where Mew and the others are to see the trouble.

"What happened?" Misty asks.

"One of their Pikachu friends is trapped on the other side of the fallen debris. We need to get it out of there," Mew says.

"That's terrible," Misty says.

"We gotta help it," Tomorrow replies.

Brock then brings out one of his Pokeballs, "Maybe our Pokémon can help us."

"I was thinking the same thing," Mew says and brings out two Pokeball.

Brock calls out, "Geodude, I choose you!"

"Sandshrew! Diglett! Come on out!" Mew calls out.

Soon both of them throw their pokeballs and their Pokémon appear.

Mew says, "We need you to dig through the debris, there's a Pikachu who's on the other side. It could hurt."

The Pokémon nod their heads in reply and begin to dig through the debris. The Alolan Geodude begins to help them out.

Mew turns to her friends, "Come on, we need to help."

Everyone nods their heads in agreement. Soon, Mew and the others, including the Wild

Pokémon begin to help them out. They either dig or move the less heavier piece of roof, stone, or debris out of the way. Pikachu and Eevee push the debris, even little Togepi and Meloetta are helping. Everyone continues to move the debris one by one. Until they're able to create a path to the other side.

"We're through," Brock says.

Brock soon turns his head to see the Pikachu that has been trapped and notices a large rock is on top of its tail. The Pikachu tries to pull its way out, or push the large rock, but it won't move and it's tail is trapped.

Brock turns to the others, "Guys, I found it. It's tail is caught under a large rock."

Brock climbs out of the hole with the two Geodudes. Mew, Eevee, Pikachu, and the others follow them out.

"The poor thing. It must have gotten stuck when the roof collapsed," Misty says.

Mew looks at the rock, "The rock seems big, but I think we can move it if we work together."

Misty, Tomo, and Brock join Mew and pick up the rock the best that they can. Soon enough, they're able to lift the rock off the Pikachu's tail and it's free. Once the rock is off of Pikachu's tail and seeing that it's tail is free, the Pikachu is able to hurry to the others with glee and the other Pokemon are glad to see the Pikachu is safe.

"Now we've gotten that taken care of, I think we should patch up the roof. The rain is still pouring outside," Brock says.

"You're right. The rain would flood in here," Misty says.

Mew then kneels to the Pikachu, "Are you okay Pkachu?"

"Pika Pika. Pikachu," (I'm okay. Thank you for saving me.) The Pikachu says.

"I'm glad to hear," Mew says, but soon notices a bruise on Pikachu's tail.

Then says, "But it looks like you got hurt. I got a few things that could heal that."

"Pika," (Okay.) The Pikachu replies.

Just then, Tomo's stomach begins to growl and becomes embarrassed, "I am getting kind of hungry too."

"Well then, we better get to work," Brock says.

Everyone agrees. Soon, they all call out their Pokemon to help. Brock, along with Grookey, Pansage, and Solrock help patch up the hole on the roof. He's also wearing a raincoat from the storm. Mew along with Pikachu and Eevee help tend to the Pikachu's injury. Misty with her Pokemon: Oddish. Golduck. Snover. Panpour, and Togepi, Tomo with his Mama Kangaskhan, and his Pokemon: Growlithe, Tangela, Buneary, and Tyrunt. And with the electric Pokemon are cleaning up the debris from the collapsed roof as Brock is patching it up. The group continues to clean up some of the old buildings and the roof until it's cleaned up.

Once the cleaning is done, Brock and Mew help prepare dinner while Misty, Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, Togepi, and the other Pokemon help set up the table, bowls, plates, and other essentials for dinner. Mew and Misty are also putting the different Pokemon food in the bowl, and special food for the Electric Type Pokemon.

Sometime later, dinner is officially ready.

"Alright everyone, dinner's ready," Brock says.

Soon, everyone begins to eat the dinner that's been prepared, and the Pokemon love the food that's been made for them. Outside of the Power Plant, the rain continues to pour down and it seems it will take even longer for it to be done. However, Mew and the others don't mind at all, they are safe and warm inside the abandoned building and now have met some good friends.

The next day, the storm finally comes to an end. The sun is shining bright as some of the drops of rain fall from the trees and plants, and the clouds are no longer in the sky, but a bright blue sky instead. Inside the building, Mew, her friends, and the Pokemon are fast asleep in the large room of the Power Plant, and are sleeping comfortably. Not long, everyone begins to wake up. They all begin to sit up and let out yawns and rub the sleep out of their eyes. Mew opens the door and the Pokemon run out to see the beautiful day outside, even Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Togepi decide to run out and enjoy the nice day.

Misty sighs happily, "The storm is finally over."

"And it's now a lovely day outside," Mew replies.

"Now that the storm is cleared, we can continue our way to Viridian City," Brock says.

"Yeah. And I can earn my eighth badge," Mew happily adds.

A little time later, Mew and her friends are ready to leave the old Power Plant and continue their journey.

"Thank you for letting us stay for the night," Misty says.

"Hope you all have fun," Mew says.

"Raichu Raichu Rai Rai Raichu," (Before you go, we want to give you something.) Raichu says.

Electabuzz and the other Raichu walk to Mew and Misty and they both have a Pokemon egg in their possession. Electabuzz is holding a slightly dark yellow egg with black markings on it. The Raichu is holding a Pokemon Egg that is yellow on the top and it's black on the bottom.

"Are these for us?" Mew asks.

Raichu nods its head in reply. Misty takes the egg that has yellow on the top and black on the bottom while Mew takes the egg that is all yellow with black markings.

"Thank you," Misty says.

Togepi happily says, "Tokepriii!" (Thank you.)

Meanwhile, Tomo is with one of the Voltorbs who shows a happy expression and nudges Tomo's leg.

"You wanna come with me, Voltorb?" Tomo asks.

"Voltrob," (Sure do.) Voltorb replies.

"Okay Voltorb," Tomo happily says.

He throws his Pokeball and it taps Voltrob. Then it goes in his Pokeball. With a few shakes and a click, Voltorb has been caught in the Pokeball.

Brock then kneels to the two Geodudes. He can see how his own Geodude and the Alolan Geodude get along with each other, even though they'e different.

"I can see you guys are getting alone," Brock says.

Both Geodudes nod their heads with smiles.

Then Brock asks, "Hey, how would you like to come with us?"

The Alolan Geodude becomes a bit confused.

"I know it's a bit out of the blue, but I can see how strong you are and that you get along with my Geodude. I do hope you don't mind," Brock says.

The Alolan Geodude thinks of it, and soon nods its head in reply.

"I promise to take good care of you," Brock says, and taps his Pokemon on the Geodude.

The Alolan Geodude goes in the Pokeball. With a few shakes and a click. The Alolan Geodude has been caught in the Pokeball.

Soon enough, Mew and the others wave goodbye to the Electric Pokemon as they leave the abandoned Power Plant. The Electric Pokemon call out and wave goodbye as Mew and the others continue their journey to Viridian City so Mew can compete for her eighth badge.
