Chapter 63: Episode 62: All That Glitter and They're Very Shiny

It's been a week since Mew has returned to Pallet Town, and continues on training for the Pokemon League at the Indigo Plateau. On this day's training, Mew's papa, Zeraora, decides to help out with their training. Mew has three of her Pokemon: Pikachu Tyrogue and Pansear for one team. Zeraora is with Primeape and Charizard from his team.

"Okay, we're making this a three on three battle. Now Charizard, Primeape, I like you to listen to papa's instructions."

Charlizard and Primeape nod their heads.

"Alright everyone, let's battle," Mew says.

With that, Mew and the Pokemon begin their training. Primeape charges towards Pikachu.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, use Quick Attack!"

Pikachu uses Quick Attack to speed around Primeape.

"Pansear, use Flame Blast!" Mew calls out.

Pansear uses the attack at Primeape, but Zeaora stops the attack with his Thunder Punch.

Mew calls out, "Okay Tyrogue, use Brick Break!"

Tyrogue then performs Brick Break at Zeraora. Tyrogue is able to strike Zeraora after the first few punches.

As Mew and her Pokemon train for the Pokemon League, Misty, Brock, Tomo, Eeve, Meloetta, and Mama Kangaskhan and Baby Kangaskhan are watching Mew battle.

"Mew and her Pokemon are really giving it their all," Brock says.

"Yeah. Her papa is also very strong," Misty says.

"He's amazing," Tomo says.

Then happily shouts, "Go Mew."

Misty and Brock giggle with smiles on their faces. They then continue to watch the match and see how the training is going.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the forest, it's usually peaceful and quiet in the forest of Pallet Town. Suddenly, five Pokemon are speeding through the forest in fear. One of the Pokemon looks like it's holding a rather large Pokemon Egg, that seems twice as large as a normal one in the arms. The Pokemon turns its head back in fear to see two men riding one motorbikes that can ride on the grassy woods easily. One of them then brings out what looks like a missile launcher and fires it. The Pokemon are frightened to see it and an explosion occurs when it hits the tree.

At the field where Mew and the others are, Mew along with her Pokemon, including Pikachu, Eevee, Zeraora notice the disturbance. Tomo, Meloetta, along with Mama Kangaskhan and baby Kangaskhan senses it as well.

Brock asks, "Hey guys, what's up?"

"What's wrong?" Misty asks.

"We sensed trouble," Mew says.

Meloetta notices and points out, "Loetta!" (Over there!)

Mew and the others turn to where Meloetta is pointing to. There, they see five Pokemon running out of the forest, much to the group's surprise.

The first is a bipedal, humanoid Pokémon whose body resembles a flowing gown. Most of its body is white, but its hair, arms, and the underside of its gown are arctic blue. Its hair curls over its face and down the sides of its head. Behind its orange eyes are short spikes, resembling a masquerade mask. It has long arms with three fingers on each hand and slender white legs. An orange, fin-like horn extends from its chest, and a shorter, more rounded horn extends from the back. A band of arctic blue on its chest extends to the center of the front horn and connects to its sleeve-like arms. And it's holding a Pokemon Egg that is twice its size.

The second Pokemon is a sleek, black body Pokemon with four slender legs and yellow eyes. It has two pairs of pointed teeth (one in the upper jaw and one in the lower jaw) which are visible when its mouth is open. It has long, pointed ears and a bushy tail, each with a blue band around them. Its forehead and legs have blue rings on them.

The third Pokemon is a quadrupedal, mammalian Pokémon covered in light-blue fur that can be frozen into sharp quills. It has long, pointed ears, dark eyes, and a small nose. A teal crest with two dangling flaps adorns its head, resembling hair or headgear. Glaceon has two dark blue, rhombus-shaped markings on its back; the tip of its tail, feet, and flaps are the same shade of blue.

The fourth one is a yellow Pokémon resembling a weasel and a sea otter. It has a white collar around its neck and two blue fins on its arms. It has a pale yellow colored spot above each eye and two black parallel marks on its cheeks. The underside of its face and stomach are also light yellow as are the tips of its two tails, and two light yellow color spots on their back.

The last one is a small, cherry-like Pokémon with a round, peach color body with two stubby feet. It has beady eyes and a reddish color stripe running down part of its face. It has a short stem with two big, yellowish-green leaves and a second, much smaller head growing out of it.

Seeing the Pokemon running, the group becomes confused.

"Wow. Look at those Pokemon," Misty says.

"And they're all Shiny Pokemon," Brock says.

"Yes but… something's wrong…" Mew replies.

Suddenly, two guys on motorbikes come out of the forest and one of them has a missile launcher on the back. The man with black sunglasses and buzz cut black hair brings out the missile launcher and launches it at the Pokemon. The missile springs out of a net and ends up catching the Cherry looking Pokemon.

Seeing this makes everyone, including the Pokemon, gasp in shock.

"Those guys are Pokemon Hunters!" Brock exclaims.

"They're trying to capture those Pokemon!" Misty adds.

"Those men are bad!" Tomo angrily says.

Mew then says, "Guys, we gotta help!"

Agreeing to the idea, everyone hurries over to save the group of Pokemon in distress.

Down below, the poachers continue to chase after the Pokemon. The poacher with the sunglasses fires the missile launcher again, and catches the other Pokemon in the net, all except the tall Pokemon with the egg in its arms. The Pokemon quickly turns to see its fellow Pokemon has been caught, and about to use it's Psychic abilities to free them.

The second poacher who has spiky black hair and an eye patch on its left eye brings out his Pokeball, "Oh no you don't!"

Then throws his Pokeball, "Go Skarmory!"

The buzz cut one throws his Pokeball, "Go Seviper!"

With that, both Pokemon have been released from their Pokeballs.

Seviper is a serpentine Pokémon that is usually depicted scrunched up like an accordion. It is mostly black in color but has several markings on its body. It has yellow hexagon markings that run from its head to its tail, small yellow bumps where it touches the ground, and various purple scar-like marks. It has elongated red fangs that protrude from its upper jaw and fierce red eyes. Its tail is partially red and has a blade-like shape.

Skarmory is a silver-gray, avian Pokémon with a long, metallic blue neck, legs, and tail. It has yellow eyes, a pointed beak with several pointed teeth, and a triangular crest on its head. There are red feathers under the sheaths that cover its sharp wings, and each feather can be moved independently.

"What are those Pokemon?" Misty asks.

"That's a Skarmory," Brock says.

"And a Seviper," Mew says.

Mew then brings out her Pokedex, and looks up the Skarmory.

Dexter says, "Skarmory, the Armor Bird Pokémon. A Steel and Flying Type. Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges."

Then Dexter says about Seviper, "Seviper, the Fang Snake Pokemon. A Poison Type. Seviper's swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose."

"Those Pokemon sure are sharp," Tomo says.

"And kind of strong," Brock adds.

Then the first poacher calls out, "Skarmory, use Drill Peck!"

Skarmory then uses Drill Peck and strikes at the Pokemon with full force, and knocks her down, but her egg is still in her arms.

Then the second Poacher says, "Seviper, use Wrap!"

And soon, the Seviper wraps itself around the Pokemon as it clutches her for protection. The two poachers leave their bikes to see the Pokemon they have captured.

"Looks like we've finally caught our little catch," The first poacher says.

The second poacher says, "It's been hard since they've escaped. It's worth it. Those Pokemon will fetch us a pretty nice price."

The Pokemon struggles to break free from the Seviper's grasp, but is unable to break free.

The spiky haired poacher turns to the comrades, "Get the truck while I'll keep an eye on these troublemakers."

Suddenly, Mew's voice calls out, "Eevee, use Swift!"

Eevee then jumps up and performs Swift on the Seviper, knocking it away from the Pokemon.

"What the…" The poachers exclaim.

They turn to see Mew and her Pokemon. Zeraora glares at the poachers with pure anger. To Zeraora, anyone who dares bring harm to the Pokemon in the forest will not be let go so easily. As the master of the forest, it's his job to protect the Pokemon in the forest and around Pallet Town.

"Alright, we're going to give you a fair warning. Either you leave this place and leave those Pokemon alone, or believe us you will regret it," Mew says.

Soon, the two poachers begin laughing, and that makes Mew's Pokemon and dad rather displeased.

"You think a little runt is going to stop us. And I must admit, you have some interesting Pokemon," The buzz cut man says.

Then the spiky haired one points to Zeraora, "Especially that one. It's rare to see a Zeraora here of all places. It'll be worth a fortune."

Zeraora growls in anger at that statement.

"Looks like we'll have to do this the hard way," Mew angrily says.

"We'll see about that girly," The spiky-haired guy says.

Then the buzz cut haired one calls out, "Seviper, use Bite!"

"Charizard, use Flamethrower!" Mew calls out.

With that, Charizard performs Flamethrower and attacks Seviper with full force.

"Skarmory, use Wing Attack!" The spiked hair one says.

Skarmary then uses Wing attack and aims at Charizard.

"Eevee, use Protect!" Mew calls out.

Eevee quickly gets in front of Charizard and uses Protect to repel the Wing Attack.

"Now Charizard, use Air Slash!" Mew calls out.

Charizard then performs Air Slash at Skarmory and strikes at it with full force.

"Seviper, use Poison Tail!" The buzz cut trainer says.

Seviper then performs Poison Tail at Eevee. Eevee falls to the ground and is poisoned.

"Eevee, are you okay?" Mew asks, picking Eevee up in her arms.

"Eevee…" (Not very good.) Eevee weakly answers.

Mew looks ahead, "Primeape! Pansear! Look out!"

Primeape and Pansear quickly dodge as Seviper slithers over to attack.

"Quick Pansear, use Fury Swipes!" Mew calls out.

Pansear then rapidly uses Fury Swipes at Seviper.

"Seviper!" It's trainer exclaims.

"Now Primeape, use Sevper the Seismic Toss!" Mew calls out.

Primeape then grabs Seviper and performs the Seismic Toss, knocking it out.

"You're doing great guys," Mew calls out.

Mew then brings it a Pecha Berry and presents it to Eevee, "Here you go Eevee, this berry will make you feel better."

Eevee then eats the Pecha Berry, she is healed from the poison instantly.

"Eevee!" (Ready to go!") Eevee happily says, and joins Pikachu.

Mew says, "Alright then. Pikachu and Eevee, use Thunderbolt on Skarmory!"

With that, Pikachu and Eevee perform Thunderbolt on Skarmory. Soon, Skarmory is knocked out. The poachers are frightened to see their Pokemon beaten. Zeraora then steps in and performs Wild Charge at the Pokemon and the poachers, sending them all flying with loud screams. Once they're gone, the Pokemon trapped in the nets are surprised to see what has happened.

"That was close," Misty says.

"And they didn't stand a chance," Brock says.

"Come on, we gotta free the Pokemon," Mew says.

Everybody nods their heads in reply.

Brock removes the net from the cherry like Pokemon, "There you go, you're free."

"Are you okay?" Misty asks the weasel Pokemon as she pulls the net off of it.

The weasel Pokemon nods his head in reply.

Mew and Tomo remove the net from the other two Pokemon.

"They do look tired, but they're not hurt," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee walk to the two Pokemon.

"Pika Pikachu?" (Are you okay?) Pikachu asks.

"Umbre Umbreon," (A little tired, but we're all fine.) The black Pokemon says.

Then the arctic blue one says, "Glace Glaceon. (Thank you for saving us.)

"Eevee," (It's no problem.) Eevee says.

Meanwhile, Zeraroa is looking at the Pokemon who has fallen. At first, the Pokemon feels a bit uneasy, but seeing how the human trainers are helping her friends and how concerning and ensuring Zeraroa is, She accepts Zeraora's paw and he helps her up. It's good to see she isn't hurt.

Mew turns to the others, "Looks like everyone is okay. We better get them to Professor Oak's lab and see if he and Daisy can give an examination."

Everyone nodded their heads. Mew returns Pansear, Tyrogue, and Primeape back in their Pokeballs. Then brings out Aerodactyl and Pidgeotto and leaves Charizard out of his Pokeball. Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and the cherry Pokemon ride on Pidgeotto. The two feline Pokemon, and the weapon Pokemon are on Aerodactyl. Zeraora, the Pokemon holding the egg, and Tomo are on Charizard. Mew also calls out Arcanine for herself, Misty, and Brock to ride on.

Unknown to them Jessie, James, and Meowth have seen the events and become interested by the Shiny Pokemon from the bushes close by.

"So, the twerps have found Shiny Pokemon, and some are so cute!" Jessie says.

Meowth has hearts coming out of his eyes, "And three of them are very lovely and pretty."

"Shiny type Pokemon are rather rare and will make great gifts for the boss," James says.

"Then let's grab those Shiny Pokemon and bring them to the boss," Jessie says.

"And let's grab Pikachu and Eevee while we're adding it," Meowth says.

And with that, Team Rocket begins to follow Mew and the others with the Shiny Pokemon along with Pikachu and Eevee are the targets.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends bring the Shiny Pokemon to Professor Oak's lab. Mew along with Professor Oak and Daisy are giving them examinations to see if they have any form of injuries on them. With Zeraora's help, the Pokemon Egg has also been examined and hasn't received any damage. Misty, the boys, Pikachu, and Eevee wait in the living room for Mew and the others for any results. Soon, the three walk to the living room to see the others.

"So how are the Pokemon?" Misty asks.

"They haven't received any serious damage. They only received some scrapes from the nets and were exhausted. It will be best to let them rest," Professor Oak says.

"What about the egg?" Tomo asks.

"The Pokemon Egg is fine, and I must admit, it looks larger than a normal sized egg," Daisy says.

"It will be best to let them rest for a day or so, and try to figure out what happened to them," Professor Oak says.

"Glad to hear they're alright," Brock says.

"Yes. We were worried when those poachers were after them," Misty says.

"But what Pokemon are they?" Tomo asks.

"Well, the one who is holding an egg is a Gardevoir. The two feline ones are both Eevee evolution forms. The one with the blue rings is an Umbreon, and the lighter blue one is a Glaceon," Mew says.

"What about the Pokemon with the collar around its neck? And the cherry like Pokemon?" Misty asks.

"The Pokemon with the collar is called a Buizel, and the Pokemon that looks like a Cherry is a Cherubi," Mew answers.

"Well they're definitely Pokemon from different regions. Umbreon were usually in Johto. Gardevoir is from Hoenn, and the other three originated from Sinnoh," Brock says.

"Wow! We come across a lot of Pokemon from different Regions," Tomo says.

"We sure have," Mew says with a smile.

Then Professor Oak says, "Still, we need to have these Pokemon protected in case the Poachers come back. I'm going to call Officer Jenny and notify her about the situation."

Then Professor Oak walks out of the living room to call Officer Jenny about the situation with the poachers.

"Hey Mew, where's Zeraora?" Misty asks.

"Papa is watching over them. He is the leader of the forest and wants to make sure they regain their strength," Mew says.

In the room where the Pokemon are resting, Zeraora watches over them to ensure their safety. However, his eyes are mostly on Gardevoir who is tending to the egg. The Gardevoir shows a calm reassuring smile on her face as she rubs her egg slowly and with a smile. Zeraora simply stares at Gardevoir as his cheeks slowly begin to blush. Gardevoir turns her head to see Zeraora making him turn his head away in surprise. Gardevoir smiles and then looks down on her egg, as her cheeks begin to blush as well.

Meanwhile in the living room, Mew and the others are having snacks and drinks that are placed on the table. Eevee, Pikachu, and Meloetta are having Pokemon food close by.

Me also looks at her Pokedex to see any information on the Pokemon.

Dexter says, "Gardevoir, the Embrace Pokémon. A Psychic and Fairy Type. Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power."

Then the information about Umbreon comes on, "Umbreon, the Moonlight Pokemon and the evolved form of Eevee. A Dark Type. Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon's waves. It lurks in the dark of night looking for prey. At the moment it pounces, the rings on its body glow dimly but ominously.

Then Dexter says about Glaceon, "Glaceon, the Fresh Snow Pokemon, and the evolved form of Eevee. An Ice Type. It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust."

And now, Buizel, "Buizel, the Sea Weasel Pokemon. A Water Type. It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on."

Finally, information about Cherubi, "Cherubi, the Cherry Pokemon. A Grass Type. It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients."

"Wow! It's amazing that we get to see those Pokemon. It's just too bad they were being threatened," Misty says.

"Yeah. We manage to save them, but I'm not sure if those poachers are willing to give up that easily," Mew says.

"Mew's right. Knowing those poachers, they might try to take the Pokemon," Brock says.

"I don't think we have much to worry, Mew and her Pokemon sent them flying," Misty says.

"Yeah. And it's really far too," Tomo says.

Soon, Tomo, Meloetta, and Togepi begin laughing.

"You're right about that. But still, knowing Pokemon poachers, they don't give up very easily, and they might try to come back," Mew says.

"That's true. Kind of reminds me of a certain group who never seems to quit," Misty says.

Suddenly, they hear a loud crashing sound, followed by Pokemon screams.

"What was that?" Brock asks.

"It came from the room where papa and the Pokemon are," Mew says.

Mew and the others hurry down the hall and Mew opens the door as she and her friends hurry inside. They become shocked to see a large hole in the wall, and the Pokemon, including Zeraora are gone.

"What a disaster!" Brock says, shocked.

"What happened to Papa and the Pokemon?" Mew asks, looking around in concern.

Suddenly, they hear more Pokemon cry and they run out of the hole of the building to see a large robot with large robotic arms and hands at the end.

"What is that thing?" Misty asks, shocked.

Suddenly, more robotic arms dive down and grab Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Togepi and takes them away

"Pikachu! Eevee!" Mew exclaims.

"Togepi!" Misty panics.

"Meloetta!" Tomo cries out.

The Pokemon are dragged into the air where the robot is.

"Hey! Give us back our Pokemon and our friends, and give back my papa!" Mew shouts in anger.

Suddenly they begin to hear familiar laughter. Then the hatch on the robot opens to reveal Team Rocket.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation.

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

Mew and her friends exclaim, "Team Rocket!"

"That's right twerps. We got your Pokemon, the Shiny Pokemon, and this brave, lightning Pokemon," Jessie says.

"They'll make great gifts for the boss," James says.

"And now we're going to be leaving with our prizes," Meowth says.

"You're not going to get away with this!" Tomo shouts.

"That's right," Mew says.

Mew then calls out, "Charizard, Aerodactyl, I choose you!"

With that, Charizard and Aerodactyl come out of their Pokeballs.

"Charizard, use Air Slash! Aerodactyl, use Air Cutter!" Mew calls out.

Charizard then uses Air Slash while Aerodactyl uses Air Cutter to cut off the robotic arms off of the machine, making Team Rocket panics.

Tomo quickly calls out, "Abra, Natu, hurry, use Psychic to catch everyone!"

Tomo throws his Pokeballas and Abra along with Natu come out and use their Psychic abilities to stop the Pokemon from falling and gently place them on the ground.

"Is everyone okay?" Mew asks.

All the Pokemon reply with nods and smiles with happy cries.

"They're all okay. That's a relief," Misty says.

"Don't worry, you'll be okay," Mew says.

Suddenly, they hear Jessie call out in anger, "How dare you steal something that we stole first?!"

"We saw those Pokemon and we plan on taking the shiny Pokemon," James says.

"We don't need to deal with annoying twerps!" Meowth adds.

"Just leave them alone. They already went through one dilemma today," Misty says.

"Just hand over those Pokemon or we'll crush you goodie goodies!" Jessie shouts in rage.

"Bui Buizal! Bui Bui Buiiii Buizel" (Forget it! My friends and I are not going anywhere with you, you nasty old witch!) Buizel angrily says.

Hearing what Buizel says makes Mew cover her mouth as she is trying her best not to laugh.

"What's so funny Mew?" Brock asks, confused.

"What did Buizel say?" Misty asks, curious.

"Buizel said that he and the others are not going anywhere. Then he called Jessie a nasty old witch," Mew translates.

Unfortunately, Jessie hears what Mew translates Buizel's statement, and is so angry that she is practically on fire.

"Wha-what did that sea weasel call me?!" Jessie asks, feeling pure rage.

Seeing Jessie angry makes James and Meowth very frightened.

"I think Jessie is about to explode," Meowth says.

"It's like she turned into a fire type Pokemon," James adds.

"Don't just stand there, get those Shiny Pokemon and turn that Weasel into a pancake!" Jessie furries.

James and Meowth quickly press the button on the control pad as they panic, "Yes ma'am!"

"The broken robotic arms retracts into the machine and brings out two giant hammers. They slam together and hammer the ground in front of the group, causing the ground to shake. Everyone panics in fright.

"I think we're in big trouble!" Misty says.

"Really big trouble," Tomo says.

Suddenly, a familiar voice says, "Not as in trouble as you're gonna be!"

Me and the others quickly turn to see the two poachers with their Skarmory and Seviper. But they have two more Pokemon with them. They have a Hitmonchan and a Magneton.

"It's the poachers from before!" Brock says, shocked.

The spiky haired poacher says, "That's right, we're here to take back our Pokemon."

"Fat chance! These Pokemon don't wanna go with you," Mew says.

"That's right. They don't want to be caught by the likes of you!" Misty says.

"Like we're going to listen to you annoying brats," The buzz cutted poacher says.

"Yeah. Shiny Pokemon are very rare and worth a lot on the Black Market. They make excellent money makers," The Spiky haired poacher says.

Mew clutches her fist in anger and says, "You two conniving creeps! You only think Pokemon is a way to make money!"

"Who asked you, you little brat," The buzz cutted poacher says.

Suddenly, James shouts from the machine, "Excuse us, are you forgetting that we're still here?!"

"That's right. We're here to capture those Shiny Pokemon and bring them to our boss," Jessie says.

"Yeah. And we don't need no lame brains getting in our way!" Meowth adds.

Misty turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, this is not looking so good."

"I know, we need to take care of those poachers and Team Rocket," Mew says.

Brock then brings out his Pokeball, "But we gotta protect the Pokemon."

"Brock and I will handle Team Rocket," Misty says, bringing out her Pokeball.

"Right. Then Tomo and I will handle the Poachers," Mew says.

Then turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "I'll need your help on this.

"Pika!/Eev!" (Right!) Pikachu and Eevee reply.

Tomo then brings out one of his Pokeball, "You got it sis."

Then calls out, "Go Tyrunt!"

With that, Tyrunt comes out of his Pokeball.

"Loetta!" (I'll help too.) Meloetta says.

The spiky haired poacher says, "Well well, looks like they got some more unique Pokemon, a Tyrunt and Meloetta are rather rare and it's easy money."

Meloetta huffs in anger, knowing that his statement is not something of a complement.

"Go Onix!" Brock calls out, and Onix comes out.

Then Misty calls out, "Tentacruel, I choose you!"

"Let's get them, Skarmory, uses Metal Claw. Hitmonchan, use Power-Up Punch," The spiky haired poacher says.

With that, both of the Pokemon begin to attack.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, use Thunderbolt. Eevee, use Swift."

Pikachu then uses Thunderbolt on Skarmory and Eevee uses Swift on Hitmonchan, and they're both direct hits.

The buzzcut poacher calls out, "Seviper, use Poison Tail. Magneton, use Discharge."

Both Pokemon charge at Tomo and his Pokemon.

Tomo calls out, "Meloetta, use Psybeam. Tyrunt, use Ancient Power!"

Meloetta then uses Psybeam at Seviper and Tyrunt uses Ancient Power at Magneton.

"Magneton, use Gyro Ball!" The buzz-cut poacher calls out.

Then Magneton uses the attack on Pikachu and Eevee, along with Meloetta. They are hit, but Pikachu and Tyrunt aren't too affected.

"Eevee, are you alright?" Mew asks, worried.

"Meloetta, are you okay?" Tomo asks.

Meloetta and Eevee get up and nod their heads in reply.

"Hitmonchan, use Ice Punch!" The spiky hair poacher calls out.

Mew calls out, "Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

Eevee then performs Thunderbolt.

Meanwhile, Brock and Misty are fighting against Team Rocket.

Brock calls out, "Onix, use Bind."

Onix then coils around Team Rocket's robot and binds it and it's robotic arms holding the hammers.

"James, get this rock snake off of it!" Jessie panics.

"I'm trying, it's holding us tight," James says, trying to use the controls.

Misty calls out, "Tentacruel, use Sludge Wave!"

Tentacurel then uses Sludge Wave to attack the robot, and the acid from the Poison wave ends up melting the hammers off of the handles.

"Now Onix, use Sand Tomb!" Brock calls out.

Onix moves out of the way, and performs the attacks at Team Rocket.

Zeraora helps Gardevoir and the other Pokemon get up and watch the battle between Mew and her friends, and the villains who are trying to capture them.

Zeraroa growls asking, "Are you all okay?"

"Gardevoir," (We're okay.) Gardevoir says.

Zeraora helps Gardevoir up and the two Pokemon notice how close they are to each other. They actually blush a little. They soon see the battle going on from different directions.

"Cher Cher Cheubi," (Mew and her friends are fighting hard to protect us.) Cherubi says, astonished.

"Glace Glace Glaceon," (We have to help them!) Glaceon says.

"Umbreon Umbre Umbre Umbreon," (You're right. They saved us before and they're saving us now.) Umbreon says.

"Brui Buizel!" (Let's fight back!) Buizel says.

"Gardevoir Gard Gardevoir" (Yes, I agree that it is what we can do to repay them for their kindness.) Gardevoir says.

With that Glaceon and Umbreon already race off to Mew and Tomo while Cherubi and Buizel are heading toward Brock and Misty.

At Mew and Tomo's battle, Mew asks, "Are you all okay?"

The Pokemon reply with a nod, but it's clear that they're exhausted.

"Give it up. There's no way you kids can beat us," The spiky-haired poacher says.

"So just give us the Pokemon and you won't have to feel your Pokemon defeated," The Buzz-cut poacher says.

Suddenly, Glaceon and Umbreon appear before them.

Glaceon then uses a powerful Blizzard attack that freezes the poachers' Pokemon in their tracks.

The two poachers are dumbfounded and begin to panic when Umbreon gives them a vicious glare. Then gives them a Dark Pulse that sends them crashing to the ground.

"Wow! Thanks guys," Mew says.

"Thanks for the help!" Tomo says.

Glaceon and Umbreon turn to the humans and smile in reply.

Misty and Brock soon see Buizel using Aqua Jet at the Robot that knocks it to the ground. Then Cherubi, then fires the robot with a Solar Beam. Then, Team Rocket are sent flying.

They soon scream, "We're blasting off again!"

After the defeat of Team Rocket and the poachers, apparently, the Pokemon actually decides to stay with them. Buizel decides to be with Misty. Cherubi decides to be with brock. Glaceon decides to be with Mew. Umbreon decides to be with Tomo, and surprisingly, Gardevoir decides to be with Zeraora and live with the forest Pokemon.

They soon meet with Officer Jenny who says, "I like to thank you for apprehending those poachers. They've been causing a lot of trouble around."

"It's no trouble, Officer Jenny, we're glad we can help," Misty says.

"And glad that the Pokemon are okay too," Mew adds.

"Yes. And from the looks of it, it also seems that they decide to be with you," Jenny says.

"Yep. They're our new friends," Tomo says.

"Well then, I wish you all good luck with your new Pokemon. I gotta deliver the poachers to custody," Jenny says.

Officer Jenny then goes in her Police van and drives away and takes the poachers to jail.

Mew sighs and says, "Talk about one crazy day."

"Yeah, but at the end, you did get some training done with battling the poachers and we got some new friends," Misty says.

The pets Buizel, "Right, Buizel?"

"Bui," (Right.) Buizel says.

"Hey Mew, where's your father?" Brock asks.

"Oh, He and Gardevoir are having a little relaxing time to themselves. I think they're both starting to… how you humans say it 'Hit it off.' Mew answers.

Soon, Brock and Misty smile as they understand the message, Tomo is rather confused about it.

Watching the sunset at an open field, Zeraora and Gardevoir are relaxing after the long day they have. Zeraora places his paw on Gardevoir's egg as Gardevoir rubs it with a calm smile. Then they lean together with smiles on their faces. As it turns out, love is beginning to blossom for those two Pokemon.

Chapter 64: Episode 63: Skwovet-ing Hunt

On a bright morning in the Oak Corral, Mew and her friends are helping Professor Oak feed the Pokemon. Since there are plenty of Pokemon at the Corral, it takes some time to feed them. Mew and the gang along with the Pokemon are each pushing a wagon of Pokemon food to give to the Pokemon.

"Wow! I never expected to carry this much Pokemon food," Misty says.

"That's true, but Professor Oak watches over the Pokemon for their trainers, including mine," Mew says.

"And the Pokemon need to eat, and I think there are more than plenty for them," Brock says.

Tomo says, "I can't wait."

"I'm sure the Pokemon are going to love it," Brock says.

"I agree," Mew happily says.

Soon, Mew and the others pass many of the Pokemon their Pokemon food. They place the bowl of Pokemon food on the ground or in the trees. Unknown to the group, as they give the Pokemon their food, something is hiding in the bushes, and wiggles it's small nose, and has its eyes on the food.

After hours of feeding the Pokemon, Mew and the others are resting under the tree close to the research center.

"Phew, that was a lot of work," Mew says.

"I'm tuckered out," Misty says, laying on her back with Togepi on her stomach.

"Toge Toge Togepriii!" (Tired Tired Tired!) Togepi happily says.

Misty turns to Mew, "How were you able to do it when you used to live here?"

"Well, I did have a little trouble at first, but it became fun. I love taking care of the Pokemon who live here. Even my friends from the forest," Mew says.

"But you also like to play with them. I like to play with the Pokemon in the forest too," Tomo happily says.

"I agree," Mew says.

Brock then asks, "So Mew, what Pokemon are you planning on training next?"

"I'm not sure yet," Mew says.

"As of now, Silcoon and Kakuna look like they're going to evolve very soon," Mew says, pointing to the tree.

The others look up to see Silcoon and Kakuna are flashing a glow.

"Yep. They look like they'll evolve very soon," Misty says.

Then Tomo asks, "So what Pokemon they'll evolve too."

"Well, we know that Kakuna will evolve into Beedrill," Mew says, and takes out her Pokedex.

She then logs into Beedrill's information and Dexter says, "Beedrill, the Poison Bee Pokemon, the evolved form of Kakuna. A Bug and Poison Type. Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear."

"Yeah. I'm still a little uneasy about Beedrill," Misty says.

"What about Silcoon?" Tomo asks.

Mew logs into Sillcoon's evolved form, and Dexter says, "Beautifly, the Butterfly Pokemon, and the evolved form of Silcoon. A Bug and Flying Type. Beautifly is recognized by the distinctive colorful pattern on its wings. Sweet flower nectar is its favorite food."

The others look at the Pokedex to see that Silcoon's evolved form is beautiful. It's a butterfly-like Pokémon with two pairs of wings. It has large blue eyes and black antennae with rounded tips. Its face, underside, and four stubby limbs are gray, while the rest of its body is black. The main body of its wings are black with large, yellow markings, and smaller red and blue markings. The upper pair of wings are larger and have a line of yellow along the top edge, while each of the lower wings have a long, round-tipped extension on the bottom.

"Wow. It's beautiful," Misty says.

"And it looks like they'll evolve very soon, from the looks of it," Brock says.

"Ciderace!" (Mew!) Cinderace's voice calls out.

Mew and the others turn to see Cinderace with Roserade, Krabby, Weepinbell, Steenee, and Shellos hurrying towards them in concern.

"Hey guys, what's going on?" Mew asks.

Soon, the four Pokemon begin to let out cry and chatter all at once. Mew is confused to hear so much crying and chattering.

Mew calmly says, "Guys, guys, one at a time. Calm down."

Soon, the Pokemon stop chattering and are able to calm down.

"Now then, can one of you tell me what is going on?" Mew asks.

"Steenee Steenee Steenee Steenee Steenee." (We don't know how, but many of the Pokemon's food have been disappearing before many of them can finish or even start eating.) Steenee explains.

"The Pokemon food disappearing?" Mew asks, surprised.

Misty and the others become surprised themselves.

Cinderace and the other Pokemon show Mew and the others about the situation. The group is shocked to see plenty of the bowls and plates for the Pokemon are empty, and the Pokemon are very glum and depressed.

"All the bowls are empty," Mew says.

"And the Pokemon look very sad," Tomo says.

"I don't understand, what could have happened to the Pokemon's food?" Misty asks.

"We gave them plenty of Pokemon food," Brock says.

Mew scratches her head, "We've fed them a good amount of food and we helped Professor Oak give the food to different Pokemon."

"Do you think a Wild Pokemon could have done it?" Misty suggests.

"It's possible. Wild Pokemon sometimes come to the Corral, even some of my friends. But… I don't think they would actually steal from the others. They know that," Mew says.

"Maybe it's a Pokemon not from around here," Brock suggests.

Then Misty says, "Maybe it's just a one time thing. We'll give the Pokemon their Pokemon food, and not worry about the ones that are missing."

"If you say so," Mew says.

However, by the next day, more Pokemon food are going missing, and plenty of the Pokemon are starving. Their stomachs are growling, and they feel tired and low on energy. Some of the Pokemon even decide to go to the forest to find food, and possibly, share some with some of the other Pokemon. Even some Pokemon get into fights and arguments. And there seems to be a lot of tension between the Pokemon living at the corral.

And so, Mew decides to call a meeting with her friends to discuss the situation with the Pokemon food going missing, and possible arguments between the Pokemon

"There's a lot of tension out there," Tomo says.

"More than we know. Something's strange is going on here," Mew says.

"You're right. We've given them more than enough and the food is still disappearing," Misty says.

"I'm starting to think someone's stealing their food," Mew replies.

"You mean one Pokemon's eating all of it?" Misty asks, confused.

Brock thinks and says, "Hmm… Someone who can really pack it away. Or maybe it's just some prank."

"That kind of prank's totally not cool. I hope it's not one of Haunter's pranks." Mew says.

Suddenly Haunter appears in front of Mew and gives it a big lick, causing her to become paralyzed.

"Haunter…" Mew says, dizzy and falls to the ground.

Pikachu angrily says, "Pika!" (Haunter!)

"Haunt?" (What?) Haunter asks, shrugging his arms.

Misty asks, "Are you okay, Mew?"

"Just a bit paralyzed at the moment, but I'll be fine," Mew says.

"Still, the Pokemon are really going at it, and a few fights have broken out," Brock says.

Mew sits up and says, "We've got a mystery to solve. They won't stop fighting until we figure out where the food's gone!"

"Maybe some unknown Pokémon has broken into the park and is stirring up all the trouble!" Tomo suggests.

"Maybe. Anything is possible," Mew says.

"How are we going to figure out who's been eating the food?" Misty asks.

"The only way I can think of is a stake out," Mew says.

Brock agrees, "I think you're right. If we leave some Pokemon food out in the other, whoever is taking the food will be drawn to it. Then we'll catch whoever it is in the act."

"Pika Pika," (Sounds like a plan.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Good idea.) Eevee replies.

"Loetta," (Okay,) Meloetta replies.

"Toge Togeprrri," (A stakeout!) Togepi happily cheers.

Later in the night, Mew and her friends are setting their plan in motion. Brock and Tomo set multiple bowls of Pokemon food out in the open, while Mew and Misty set up the tent. Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Togepi gather up leaves and branches to camouflage the tent so they can spy in secret.

"I think things are coming along," Misty says.

"Yeah. After we're done setting everything here, two of us can stay here and watch over the food while the rest will look around," Mew says.

Brock and Tomo return after setting up the different bowls of food.

"Alright, everything is ready," Brock says.

"All thePokemon food is set up," Tomo says.

"Okay. We just need to decide which teams and which shifts we should start," Mew says.

Suddenly, something ran past the bush very fast, startling the group.

"Wh-what was that?" Misty asks, frightened.

"I don't know," Mew answers.

Suddenly, something walking towards them to their surprise, they can see little Skitty and Wooloo standing in front of them. Everyone sighs in relief.

"It's Wooloo and Skitty," Mew says, able to breathe.

"They really scared us," Misty says.

"Let's start with the stake out," Tomo says.

Brock then brings out a cup with four straws inside, "And I know how we can decide teams."

"What are those four?" Tomo asks.

"It's how we're going to decide teams. Each tip has two colors, red and blue. Whoever gets which color will be in which team. And red will have the number 1 and blue will have 2. One one will start walking around and Two will stay at the tent," Brock says.

"Sounds fair," Mew says.

After picking different straws from the cup. Mew and Brock are a group while Misty and Tomo are another. Mew and Brock are the first to walk around the corral and the forest. They both have their flashlights.

Mew looks around and shines the flashlight around the area. She sees a few sleeping Caterpies, a Persian with baby Meowths. Some of Mew's Pokemon like Pansear, Cinderace, Shellos, and plenty of her other Pokemon around the area. Brock also looks around to find different Pokemon, trees, and berry bushes. Pikachu and Eevee are looking around as well and sniff around the area.

"Hmm, I don't see anything," Brock says.

"I know, but we still have some time before we switch with Misty and Tomo," Mew says.

"I do hope we'll figure out this mystery soon. We don't want to have a kind of riot," Brock says.

Mew nods her head, "Right."

Meanwhile, Tomo and Misty are sitting in the tent as they watch the Pokemon food and berries. Meanwhile, Meloetta and Togepi are fast asleep with a blanket covering them

Tomo yawns a bit and says, "This is kind of boring."

"I know. And I'm sleepy too," Misty says, and lets out a yawn.

After yawning, Misty says, "But we need to keep an eye on the Pokemon food and find the thief. We don't know if Brock and Mew will find it or not."

Suddenly, they hear a sound that frightens her a bit.

Misty asks, "What was that?"

"I don't know," Tomo replies.

Suddenly, they see something speed past them where the food is.

Misty becomes frightened, "What was that?"

Tomo leaves the tent, "I think we found our thief?"

Tomo then chases after the mysterious shadow.

"Tomo!" Misty cries out.

Tomo calls out, "Stay at the tent, I'll be right back." Then hurries off into the woods.

"Tomo wait!" Misty cries out, but Tomo is already gone.

She worriedly says, "Oh no."

Suddenly, Meloetta comes out and flies after Tomo.

"Meloetta!" Misty cries out, but Meloetta is already gone into the woods.

She then cries out, "Mew! Brock!"

Close to the campsite, Mew and Brock end up hearing Misty's voice.

"Was that Misty?!" Brock asks.

"I think it is. Let's hurry," Mew says.

Mew, Brock, and the Pokemon hurry down the woods and hurry outside to see Misty outside of the tent and look very concerned.

"Misty, what's wrong?" Mew asks.

"And where's Tomo?" Brock asks.

"The-the-ther-there-there's something that ran past here. And Tomo rains into the forest after it. And Meloetta chased after him," Misty says.

Mew and Brock grow concerned.

"We better go find them," Mew says.

"Right," Brock says.

Somewhere in the first, Tomo is running to find the mysterious shadow. Tomo runs as fast as he can, thinking that it might be the Pokemon Food Thief. Soon, Tomo stops at a cleaning and looks around to see the mysterious shadow is gone.

She calls out, "Hello! Where are you?!"

"Loett!" (Tomo!) Meloetta's voice calls out.

Tomo turns his head to see Meloetta flying towards her.

"Meloetta? What are you doing here? I thought you were sleeping?" Tomo asks, a little surprised.

"Meloetta Loetta Loetta Meloetta Meloetta," (I heard the commotion, and saw you ran into the woods, so I followed you to see if you're okay.) Meloetta says in concern.

Tomo smiles and says, "I'm okay, Meloetta. I just thought I saw something and it might be the thief. I thought it ran this way, but…"

Suddenly, they hear a rustling sound, and they quickly turn around and see the bush shaking a bit.

Tomo turns to Meloetta and places his finger on his lips. Meloetta understands and remains quiet. Then the two begin to sneak into the bushes. They tip toe, or in Meloetta's case, float towards the bush. After a moment of silence, they both pounce into the bushes and are letting out cries as they move around in the bushes. Soon, Mew, Brock, Misty holding the sleepy Togepi, Pikachu, and Eevee arrive to see the bush shaking.

"What's going on?" Mew asks.

"Something's up," Brock says.

Suddenly, Tomo and Meloetta come out and fall to the ground on their bottoms.

"Are you alright, Tomo?" Misty asks.

"Yeah. I think I got our little thief," Tomo says.

The group looks confused to see a small Pokemon in Tomo's arms. The Pokemon is a squirrel-like Pokémon. It is grayish-brown in color, with a large fluffy tail, which is dark-grayish-brown at the top. Along with a light-grayish-brown underbelly, and the color extends to its mouth and parts of its cheeks, two orange freckles underneath each eye and an orange nose. Its ears are similar in color to its tail, and they have orange insides. It's cheeks are puffed up like it has two round sides.

It smiles and says, "Skwovet."

The group including the Pokemon look at the mysterious Pokemon Tomo has in his arms.

"What kind of Pokemon is that?" Misty asks.

"I've never seen that Pokemon before," Brock says.

"It actually looks kind of cute," Mew says.

Then brings out her Pokedex, "Let's see what Dexter says."

Mew points the Pokedex towards the mysterious Pokemon and Dexter says, "Skwovet, the Cheeky Pokemon. A Normal Type. Skwovet keeps Berries in its cheeks, but if its stomach is already full, it can temporarily store food in the tufts of fur on its tail. Hiding and building up food stores is Skwovet's signature behavior."

"Hide and build up food? So this Skwovet is the thief?" Misty says, confused.

"It seems so," Mew says.

"That Pokemon took all the food by itself," Brock adds.

"I must admit, this is a bit of a shock," Misty says.

"Yeah. Although, it's actually very cute," Mew says.

Tomo turns to Skwovet and asks, "So Skowvet, what are you doing around here? I have never seen a Pokemon like you before."

"Skwovet Skwovet Skwovet," (Looking for food, gathering then, and storing them.) Skwovet answers.

"What did it say?" Brock asks.

"He said he's looking for food, gathering, and storing," Tomo answers.

"I guess it shows that he's responsible for the Pokemon food going missing," Misty says.

Just then, Skwovet leaves Tomo's arm and runs off.

"Hey, where's it going now?" Mew asks.

"Let's follow it," Tomo says.

The group then begins to follow Skwovet through the woods and soon are able to reach a small cliff side. They also see Skwovet climbing up it.

"What on earth is Skwovet up to?" Mew asks.

"Let's find out," Brock says.

Mew, and the others begin to climb up the small cliff and soon find a small tunnel, or some kind of hole. To the group's surprise, they can see all kinds of Pokemon food and berries.

"Woah!" Mew says, surprised.

"Look at all that Pokemon food and berries!" Misty says, surprised.

"That must be the Pokemon food and berries that were stolen from the corral," Brock says.

Suddenly, Skwovet arrives and spits out the Pokemon food from it's mouth. Then it turns its tail to the tunnel and shakes it for a bunch of berries and food to fall out of it. After it's done, Skwovet then climbs on Tomo's head, let's out a yawn, and begins to sleep on Tomo's head.

"I think we know how Skwovet is able to take the food without us noticing," Mew says.

"And how it got it here for that matter," Brock says.

Tomo begins to giggle as he sees Skwovet sleeping on his head.

The next day, Mew and the others introduce Skwovet to Professor Oak, and he is very interested.

"A Skwovet you say?" Professor Oak asks.

"Yeah. We found it last night and found out it was the one taking the Pokemon food. From what we understand, it's just following its instincts," Mew says.

"I see," Professor Oak says.

The group turns to see Tomo and Meloetta watching Skwovet eating the Pokemon food.

"Is the food good, Skwovet?" Tomo asks.

"Skwovet," (It's great.) Swovet happily answers, and continues eating.

The Pokemon continues to eat until it's done and has cleaned off its plate.

Tomo laughs with a smile, "You really like it huh."

"Skwovet," (I sure do.) Skwovet replies.

He then climbs on top of Tomo's head glee.

Mew giggles and says, "I think Swovet really likes you Tomo."

"You like me, Skwovet," Tomo asks.

Skwovet happily nods his head in reply. He then climbs on Tomo's right shoulder and snuggles him on his right cheek. Tomo laughs in reply.

"Aww, that's very sweet," Misty says.

"Yeah. It must really like you Tomo," Brock says.

Tomo laughs and says, "I like Skwovet too."

He then picks Skwovet from his head and holds it in his arms.

Then Tomo asks, "Hey Skwovet, do you want to stay with us?"

Skwovet becomes curious.

"It's okay you don't have to if you're not comfortable, but I do hope you can stay and I can give you all kinds of food. But, you need to promise that you can't take food from other pokemon. What do you think?" Tomo asks.

Skwovet instantly smiles and says, "Skwovet." (Okay.)

Tomo then brings out his Pokeball and says, "Okay. Pokeball, go." And throws his Pokeball.

The Pokeball taps on Skwovet and it's been put in the Pokeball. After it shakes a bit. The Pokeball stops and lets out a click sound.

Tomo picks up the pokeball and happily says, "Alright, I caught Skwovet."

Then calls out, "Come on out, Skwovet."

The Pokeball opens and Skwovet comes out of the Pokeball. Then Skwovet climbs on Tomo's shoulder again and snuggles his cheek. Tomo laughs with a smile.

Mew walks to the window and opens it to see Ivysaur and Wartortle.

"Wartortle Wartortle. Wartortle, Wart Wart Wartortle" (Kakuna and Silcoon. They're going to evolve.) Wartortle answers.

They finally evolved," Brock says.

Beedrill and Beautiful fly to Mew and snuggle her. She giggles with a smile.

Beedrill and Beautifly nod their heads with glee and snuggle with Mew some more, causing her to laugh.

Chapter 65: Episode 64: A Wonderful Mewful Birthday

One sunny afternoon, Mew along with her friends are watching the Pokemon, including their own enjoying themselves. They either play, practice their moves and attacks, sleep, and even sometimes have a snack. They relax on the grass as the sun sets in the sky.

"It sure is a nice day and the Pokemon look very relaxed too," Mew says.

"Yeah. It's great," Tomo says.

"I agree. It's nice to relax a bit," Misty says.

"True, but I should also continue training for the Pokemon League," Mew says.

"That's true, but it's good to enjoy what today is going to offer," Misty says.

Brock then turns to Mew and asks, "Hey Mew…"

"Yeah Brock?" Mew replies.

"I was just curious, you know since you've been raised by Pokemon for a long time. What's it like? And what's it like living with Professor Oak?" Brock asks.

"Oh, living with the Forest Pokemon and papa is really great, he and many of the Pokemon taught me all kinds of stuff like how to battle, swing on trees and branches, swim, and all kinds of stuff. After living with Professor Oak, he along with Gary, his sister, and mom taught me a lot of stuff, including better on how to read and write. And I learned a lot of stuff. I remember Gary telling me about a 'Birthday party,' for him," Mew says.

"That's nice. Birthday parties are loads of fun, you get to have cake, ice cream, play games, and even get presents," Misty says.

"And you get to spend time with friends and family. You also grow a year older each year," Brock says.

"Yeah. It sounds nice…" Mew says.

Then sadly says, "The truth is… I never had a birthday party before."

"You never had a birthday party before?" Misty asks, surprised.

"No. I never had. I guess thinking about it is making me a little sad," Mew says.

"I'd be sad too," Misty says.

"Why did you never have a birthday party?" Brock asks.

Mew answers, "Well, I really don't know when my birthday is. My papa found me when I was floating down the river when I was a baby."

"I see," Misty says.

Mew lets out a sad sigh as Pikachu and Eevee comfort her. Misty and Brock can see that Mew is a little sad, she doesn't have a birthday party or even know when her birthday is since she's a foundling.

Suddenly, an idea hits Misty then asks, "So if you don't mind me asking, when did your dad find you anyway?"

"Well, the day when my papa found me was also the day Professor Oak and Gary found me, and allowed me to stay with them. From the 'Calendar' the day my papa found me is… it's actually tomorrow," Mew says

Suddenly, she hears her stomach growling. Then Pikachu and Eevee's stomachs. The three begin to feel embarrassed. Misty giggles and soon hears her stomach growling as well. Then begins to nervously laugh.

"Well, I guess we can start making lunch," Mew says.

But Misty quickly says, "Hey Mew, maybe you do some training for the Pokemon League Brock and I go make lunch."

Then turns to Tomo, "You wanna come."

"Sure," Tomo says.

"Okay. It's probably a good idea," Mew says.

Mew then turns to Eevee and Pikachu, "Alright guys, let's get some training started."

"Pikachu," (Alright, let's go.) Pikachu says.

Eevee happily says, "Eevee." (Training time.)

Agreeing to the idea. Misty, Brock, and Tomo along with Togepi, Meloetta, and Skwovet are in the kitchen. Misty has explained to them about Misty's idea.

Brock turns his head as he cooks and asks, "A Birthday Party?"

"A Birthday Party. We can throw a Birthday Party for Mew. Since she never had a birthday party before because she never knew her birthday. I say it's time she has one," Misty says.

"It's actually a good idea Misty. I'm sure it will make Mew happy," Brock says.

"And it will be good to throw her one before the Pokemon League. Wishing her good luck," Misty adds.

Tomo happily says, "Let's throw her a party."

"Sure. And I can cook her and everyone all kinds of food," Brock says.

"And we can get the Pokemon to help her out," Misty says.

"We can ask Professor Oak if we can have the birthday party in his corral or in the forest," Brock says.

Just then, Professor Oak walks into the room, "Did I hear about a birthday party?"

Misty and the boys turn to see Professor Oak.

"Hi Professor Oak," Tomo says.

Then Misty says, "And yeah. We're actually going to plan a birthday party for Mew."

"That sounds like a splendid idea. It was very nice for Mew to live with us, and I guess I didn't get to ask about her birthday," Professor Oak says.

"Well, Mew doesn't know her birthday since she was a foundling. When she told us that tomorrow was the day her papa found her and came to live with her, I thought it would be a good idea to have a Birthday party as well as an anniversary party. Like a Birth-iversary," Misty says.

"I agree. I say it's about time we give Mew a special celebration. We should start preparing right away. I'll call Adriana and Daisy and see if they can help," Professor Oak says.

"And Meloette, Skwovet, and I could talk to the other Pokemon and see if they can help out too," Tomo says.

Then Misty says, "We can throw her a surprise party."

"We'll need to get plenty of food and decorations," Brock says.

Tomo turns to Professor Oak, "Can we have the party at the corral?"

"Of course," Professor Oak says.

"Then it's all settled, we're going to give Mew the best Birth-iversary ever!" Misty happily says.

Agreeing to the idea, Misty and the others begin to set up plans to put this surprise party in motion. Unknown to them, the familiar figures, mainly Team Rocket, are hiding in the bushes close to the kitchen window, and have heard everything.

"This is interesting, the Pokemon Tweprette never had a birthday party before," James says.

"And the other twerps are going to throw her a surprise party," Meowth says.

"It's kind of odd that she never had a birthday party before, but who cares," Jessie says.

Then Meowth has an idea, "Hey, why don't we give the Twerpette a present of our own."

"She's our mortal enemy! Why would we want to give her a birthday present?!" Jessie angrily asks.

Then James sighs, "It's not like they're going to invite us or anything."

"It won't exactly be a present," Meowth says.

"What do you mean, Meowth?" Jessie asks.

"What are you planning?" James adds, confused.

Meowth then says, "Just listen, by the end of this celebration we'll be able to swipe the twerps all their Pokemon."

James and Jessie chuckle with grins on their faces.

Time has gone by and after having lunch with Mew, Misty, Brock, Professor Oak, Adriana, and Daisy are working on the preparations for Mew's special birthday. Misty holds out the list of the party preparations.

"Alright, here's how it's going to go. Adriana will be making the cake," Misty says.

Adriana smiles and says, "Yes. I'm going to make a Pikachu and Eevee shaped cake for her. I'm sure she'll love it. And we'll be having berry flavored ice cream."

Misty then turns to Brock, "And Brock, you will help Adriana with the cake as well as other food preparations."

"Got it," Brock says.

Then turns to Daisy and Professor Oak, "The rest of us will work on decorations, games, music, and other needs."

"Of course," Professor Oak says.

Then Daisy says, "Don't forget that we need to get presents."

"Don't worry, Brock and I got a few ideas, and with help from some of the Pokemon, I know a few ideas for gifts," Misty says.

Tomo walks to Misty and asks, "Misty, what's my job?"

Misty kneels to Tomo and says, "You have the most important job. Mew can't know anything about this, so you're in charge of distracting her. Help her with her training with the Pokemon league, pick some berries from the forest, exploring, whatever you like. We need to make sure Mew isn't aware so her surprise party will be a surprise."

"Right," Tomo happily says.

Then Misty announces, "Alright, Operation Surprise Party is a go!"

At the Pokemon Corral, Mew is with Eevee and Pikachu as the help with the other Pokemon train. As of now, Zeraora is actually teaching Pikachu a move as Gardevoir holds her egg, and Eevee watches from close by.

Zearoa tells Pikachu and Mew with roars.

Mew and Pikachu answer, "Right!/Pika!"

Mew then calls out, "Alright Pikachu, use Thunder Punch!"

Piakchu begins to speed up as he clutches his paw and electricity travels to it. At the right time, Pikachu throws his fist at the tree, causing electricity to travel though it and the tree shakes.

Zeraora nods his head with satisfaction.

"You're doing great Pikachu, you're getting the hang of that Thunder Punch," Mew says.

"Pikachu," (Thank you.) Piakchu says.

Suddenly, they hear Tomo calling out, "Mew!"

Mew and the others turn their heads to see Tomo with Meloetta, Skwovet, Mama Kangaskhan, and baby Kangaskhan in her pouch.

"Hi Tomo, how are you doing?" Mew asks.

"Doing fine. I want to know if I can help you with your training," Tomo says, eagerly.

Mew giggles and says, "I don't mind. It will be fun to have an opponent."

"So what are you doing?" Tomo asks.

Mew turns to Zeraora and Pikachu, "Zeraora is teaching Pikachu how to use Thunder Punch, and he's getting better at it."

"Pika Pika. Pika Pikachu" (I sure am. I feel stronger now that I've learned a new move.) Pikachu says.

"That's great. So can we do some training, please?!" Tomo asks.

"Let's make this a double battle," Mew says.

"Yeah!" Tomo cheers.

Soon, Mew and Tomo are standing on opposite sides of an area of the field and ready for a double battle. Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, Skwovet, Zeraora, the two Kangaskhan, and Gardevoir are watching.

Mew then calls out as she throws her Pokeballs, "Skitty! Miltank! I choose you!"

The Pokeballs open letting Skitty and Miltank out.

Tomo calls out, "Stantler! Smeargle! Go!"

With that, Stantler and Smeargle are on the battlefield.

"Alright Tomo, I'll let you have the first move," Mew says.

"Okay. Then let's begin the battle," Tomo says with a nod.

Then calls out, "Stantler, let's start with your Tackle Attack on Skitty!"
Stantler begins to charge towards Skitty.

"Skitty, dodge and use Double Slap!" Mew calls out.

Skitty runs and dodges the attack. She then jumps up and performs Double Slap on Stantler.

Tomo calls out, "Stantler, use Headbutt!"

Stantler then performs Headbutt on Skitty, causing it to fall to the ground.

"Skitty, you're alright?!" Mew asks.

Skitty shakes her head and answers, "Meow!" (Okay.)

"Now Miltank, give it your Body Slam attack!" Mew calls out.

Miltank then charges and jumps into the air, and lands on Stantler with a powerful thud.

"Smeargle, give Miltank your Fury Swipe!" Tomo calls out.

With that, Smeargle gives Miltank the Fury Swipe.

"Skitty, Tackle on Smeargle!" Mew calls out.

Skitty then tackles Smeargle.

"You're doing good Tomo," Mew says.

"You too, sis," Tomo says.

Then Mew says, "But we still have a battle going on, so let's continue."

"Skitty, time to use your new move! Use Assist!" Mew calls out.

Skitty then performs Assist and then Air Slash has been performing striking both Stantler and Smeargle.

Tomo becomes shocked to see it, "But… how?"

"Assist is a move that allows the Pokemon a move from my other Pokemon, even some who aren't in battle. In this case, Skitty is able to use the attack from one of my Pokemon that can use Air Slash," Mew says.

"That's really cool," Tomo says.

"Yeah, but the move that appears during assist comes out randomly so it's hard to know which move it's going to use," Mew says.

Tomo nods his head, "Right."

And son, Mew and Tomo continue to have their Pokemon battle. Meanwhile, in Professor Oak's lab, Adriana and Brock are in the kitchen making food preparations. They have already gone to the store and bought their ingredients. Adriana is mixing the cake batter while Brock is chopping the vegetables.

Brock finishes and says, "There. That should do it."

Then turns to Adriana, "How's the cake doing?"

"The cake is doing fine. I think a chocolate cake will be perfect for her," Adriana says.

Coming into the kitchen, Misty is carrying a box full of decorations. Togepi walks behind her with a smile.

"I'm back, and I got all the decorations," Misty says.

"That's great. We just need to have them set up tomorrow," Brock says.

Misty then puts the box in the closet close by, "We just need to make sure Mew doesn't suspect anything so it won't ruin the surprise."

Professor Oak walks over and says, "I've just sent Aerodactyl and Charizard along with Wingull and Duckett to get the stuff we need."

"Great. This party is going to be really special," Misty says.

Brock asks, "Where do you send the Pokemon to get?"

"I kind of call in a few people and the Pokemon are traveling over to get some presents," Misty says.

Professor Oak smiles and says, "It's a good thing I've already got a gift in mind for Mew."

"What is it?" Misty asks.

"You'll have to wait until tomorrow," Professor Oak says with a smile.

Daisy soon walks into the kitchen herself with different bags of party supplies, decorations, streamers and goodies. Another bag has some fabric and other materials

"There. I think I got everything we need," Daisy says.

Misty asks, "What are those for?"

"Well, some are decorations and such, and the other has a few materials for Mew's present," Daisy says.

"That's good," Misty says.

Then walks outside, as she says to herself, "I wonder how Mew and Tomo are doing?"

Misty then walks outside and notices from a distance away, she can see Mew is having a Double Pokemon Battle with Tomo.

Misty giggles and says, "It looks like Tomo is doing a good job keeping Mew busy."

"Yeah. The Pokemon League is almost a month away, so I wouldn't be surprised if Mew wants to be ready for it," Brock says.

"Yeah. I wonder what the other Pokemon are up to. When I told them about the surprise party, they got very excited," Misty says.

"I wouldn't be surprised. After all, Mew has raised them with love and care. I wouldn't be surprised if the Pokemon are planning to give Mew a few presents themselves," Professor Oak says.

"You might be right," Adriana says.

And the Professor is right, after being told of the surprise party for Mew, the Pokemon decide to give Mew a few presents of their own. They gather berries, herbs, mushrooms, anything they can find in the forest for her. While Mew is battling with Tomo, the Pokemon are more than eager to give her presents.

Back at the lab, Brock and Adriana continue with the food preparations that can be done today and have everything else to be prepared the next day. Misty, Daisy, and Professor Oak have the decorations prepared for the place to be decorated. While everyone is preparing everything in the lab, Mew and Tomo continue to have their battle, and they are having a blast. The Pokemon from the forest, including Mew's Pokemon help gather some presents or things they can find in the forest. Charizard, Aerodactyl, and Wingull return with the presents in bags and other stuff.

After a very long day, and late into the night, Mew and Tomo are sleeping in their bed with their Pokemon. Misty and Brock take a peek to see them fast asleep. Brock then closes the door and they both walk down the stairs to see all the decorations are set up, cake is finished, and many of the presents are at the corner of the room.

"There. The party is all finished," Misty says.

"Everyone is decorated outside as well," Daisy says.

"And it's perfect for Mew's birthday tomorrow," Brock says.

"Now we just need to wait for tomorrow for the big day," Professor Oak replies.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the forest, Team Rocket are busy at work with a surprise on their own. They try to remain quiet as possible and make sure that it's all set for the big day.

The next day, Mew, Tomo, and the others are still fast asleep in the room. Until Mr. Mime walks inside and heads towards the bed.

Mr Mime shakes Mew's shoulder and calls out, "Mr. Mime. Mr. Mime. Mime Mr. Mime." (Mew, it's time to wake up. It's morning.)

Soon enough, Mew begins to wake up and turns to see Mr. Mime who is smiling at her.

Mew smiles and says, "Morning Mr. Mime."

"Mr. Mime," (Good morning.) Mr. Mime happily says.

Mew turns to see Tomo and the others waking up.

Tomo notices Mew up and happily says, "Morning Mew."

"Morning Tomo. Morning everyone," Mew replies.

Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Skwovet happily answer.

After Mew and Tomo change and get dressed, they walk down the stairs. Of course, Tomo is practically dragging Mew by her wrist.

"Come on sis, hurry up," Tomo says.

"Okay, okay," Mew replies.

Pikachu, Eevee, Meloetta, and Skwovet are very excited.

"You all look excited today," Mew says.

"That's because we got something for you," Tomo says.

"What?" Mew asks.

Tomo grins and says, "You'll see."

Soon, the group stops in front of the door that leads to the lab.

Tomo calls out, "We're here!"

"Okay. What's this about?" Mew asks.

"You'll see," Tomo says.

Tomo opens the door and walks inside with Mew and the Pokemon close behind. Mew then looks around to see no one is here, but sees a lot of decorations, tables full of goodies, and some food.

"What's going on?" Mew asks.

Tomo says, "Come outside, there's more."

Tomo opens the back door and runs through with the Pokemon. Confused, Mew decides to follow to see what's going on. To Mew's surprise, she sees Misty Brock, Tomo, Pikachu, Eevee, along with Professor Oak, Daisy, Adriana, and all of her Pokemon she has caught, and her friends from the forest.

Everyone shouts with excitement, "Surprise! Happy Birthday Mew!"

Mew becomes surprised to hear this, "What is this?"

"It's a surprise party for you, Mew," Misty says, holding a goodie bag.

Brock walks over with a party hat, "We thought it would be good to make this day your official birthday."

"Really? You all did this for me?" Mew asks.

"We thought it would be good to have a party today. Your friends and your Pokemon have worked hard to throw a party just for you," Professor Oak says.

Mew smiles and says, "I love it."

Just then, Pikachu, Eevee, Squirtle, Bulbasaur, and some of the smaller Pokemon give Mew small presents wrapped in leaves.

"Are all these for me?" Mew asks.

The Pokemon nod their heads with smiles.

"Thank you. You're all so sweet," Mew says.

"Well then, I say we get this party started," Misty says.

"Yeah!" Everyone cheers.

And with that the celebration starts.

Soon after, Mew has been given multiple presents from her friends, humans and Pokemon alike. After many of the Pokemom have given their presents, Misty decides to present her gift.

Everyone turns their heads to see something big and tall heading their way. It's rolling on four large wheels, and it seems to be pink and white, and has a red 'R' on it. On top, it has a Meowth head on a candle. When it arrives, it looks like a large birthday cake.

"What is that?" Mew asks.

"It looks like a giant birthday cake.

Suddenly, they begin to hear familiar laughter.

Then three familiar voices begin to perform their motto.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

"On no!" Brock says.

"Not them!" Misty adds.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation.

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Soon, the hatch opens to reveal Team Rocket inside the giant cake and show the controls.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

"Team Rocket!" Mew exclaims in shock.

"What are you crooks over here?!" Brock demands.

Jessie says through the speaker, "We heard that it's the Twerpette's birthday, so we decided to crash."

"And we decided to go festive and bring forth a Birthday Robot Cake," James says.

"And now we can start the celebration by taking all your Pokemon!" Meowth says, and presses the button.

The candles go out and vacuum hoses. Soon, they begin to suck everything in its path. Soon, many of the group's Pokemon are starting to get sucked in.

"They're taking all the Pokemon," Brock says.

"We gotta help them somehow!" Misty says.

"But what can we do, if we try to attack, some of the Pokemon who are trapped could get hurt!" Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee try to remain grounded, but soon are being carried away as well. Mew gapss and reaches out to them, but soon, she begins to get carried away as well. They all get sucked into the hose and trapped inside.

The group exclaims, "Mew!"

Mew, Eevee, and Pikachu fall through the tube and on the ground with a thud. They all sit up and are soon happily greeted by Ponyta, Wooloo, Cutiefly, Kabuto, Shiny Ditto, Blue Shellos, and Weepinbell.

"You're all okay," Mew replies.

Then looks around to see themselves trapped, "We gotta get out of here."

Soon, they see many of the Pokemon falling into the room, and it's starting to fill up. Meanwhile, Misty, Brock, Tomo, and the others are trying to get as many of their Pokemon as they can into their Pokeballs.

"We gotta get Mew and the other Pokemon out of there!" Tomo says.

"But we can't use any attacks that might hurt them!" Misty says.

Soon, Team Rocket laughs evilly.

"That's right. You can't do anything without hurting the birthday twerp," Jessie says.

"And your precious Pokemon inside," James says.

"Let's finish with our catch and take them to the boss," Meowth says.

Suddenly, someone calls out, "Shiftry, use Leaf Tornado!"

Before long, Tam Rocket has been striked by a Tornado that has leaves in it. The tornado carries them in the air and makes it fall to the side.

Everyone quickly turned their heads to see a familiar face, "Gary!"

Next to him are two Pokemon. The first is a bipedal, portly Pokémon that appears to be made of wood. A shaggy white mane covers most of its face and trails down its back. Long pointed ears poke out the top of its mane, and it has a long, pointed nose and a large mouth with teeth that are usually bared. Its eyes are yellow with black sclerae.

The second is a white, long-bodied Pokémon with a small head and small, triangular ears. Its forehead has a purple spot adorning it as well as a yellow one on its snout. It possesses a pair of long, yellow-tipped whiskers which have split ends. Its arms are almost completely covered by a large amount of fur that is tipped in purple and split at the end. Its torso has one purple ring of fur around its midsection. It also has purple fur on the bottom section of the torso, which resembles pants, and its bottom paws are clawed. It has a long, skinny tail that, like its paw fur, is tipped purple and split at its end.

Gary then calls out, "Mienshao, use Brick Break to free everyone."

The white and purple long bodied Pokemon jumps on to the side of the robot and uses Brick Break to break the machine to create a big hole. Inside, Mew and the others are surprised to see the Pokemon.

"Wow!" Mew says, amazed.

Mew then turns to the others, "Come on, let's go!"

With that, Mew and the Pokemon climb out of the hole of the robot and escape.

"Mew, you're all okay!" Misty says, relieved.

"We're fine, but what are those Pokemon?" Mew replies.

Just then, Gary hurries over, "It's mine."

"Gary! You're the one who got us out of there!" Mew says, relieved.

"Yeah. These are my Pokemon Shiftry and Mienshao," Gary says.

"Wow. They look great," Mew says.

Suddenly, they hear Jessie shouts, "Excuse me!"

The group turns to see Team Rocket are now standing on their toppled side robot.

"If you think we're going to let you get away with what we rightfully stole you're mistaken," Jessie angrily says.

"And that you had to destroy the robot we worked hard on making!" James says.

Meowth shouts, "Yeah! We're not letting these Pokemon set us up!"

Suddenly, Misty shouts in rage, "Silence! We're not going to let you get away with messing up Mew's birthday!"

Suddenly, Mew stands in front of them and says, "My Pokemon and I will deal with them!"

With that, Her Pokemon join in and are displeased to see them. Soon, Team Rocket becomes startled to see the group of Pokemon glaring at them.

"Alright everyone, let's get them!" Mew calls out.

With that, all of Mew's Pokemon begin to attack Team Rocket with their attacks at once, creating an extra powerful beam of attacks. Finally, Pikachu and Eevee perform Thunderbolt and give them the extra boost. Soon, they all strike at Team Rocket and set up a huge explosion, and they are sent flying.

"Woah!" Meowth screams.

"That smarts!" James says.

"Talk about an attack from all of her Pokemon!" Jessie screams.

They all scream, "Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Soon, they disappear into the sky and a speck of light appears where they are sent.

After the crazy battle, Mew and Gary are happy to see each other again.

"It's great to see you Gary, but I thought you were training," Mew says.

"Oh because Grandpa told me about a special birthday party for you and I decided to come," Gary says.

Then he reaches into his backpack, "And I've decided to get you a gift."

And gives Mew a black long box, and a small box. Mew then opens the long box to reveal a flute. It's yellow with red rings and gold rings and one of the ends has a Pokeball on it. She then opens the second one to reveal a red Pokeball with black line in the middle.

"Oh my. It's a Pokeflute," Mew says, taking out the flute.

Then brings out the Pokeball.

Gary says, "It's a Cherish Ball. I found it during my travels. This Pokeball is very rare and you can use it to catch certain Pokemon. I thought it would be the perfect present."

Mew smiles and says, "Thanks Gary."

Mew then hugs Gary with a smile. Then Pikacu and Eevee climb on Mew's shoulders and snuggle her, making her laugh.

Tomo hugs Mew and says, "Happy Birthday, Mew."

Then everyone says, "Happy Birthday!"

Mew giggles with a smile. Then she brings her Pokeflute, and begins to play the song Meloetta sings. Hearing the song, Meloetta begins to sing along. Everyone smiles and sits to watch the performance take place. Despite the hitches, Mew is able to have a very special and a very first birthday party. Of course, there's still a lot to do before the Pokemon League, but Mew knows that she has friends and Pokemon who will help and support her. As the journey continues.
