Chapter 75: Episode 69: To Master the Onixpected!

There's still weeks before the Pokemon League can take place. Even though Mew is doing her best to get some training done for the Pokemon League, she along with her friends are doing their best to get back to Pallet Town after the little fiasco that Team Rocket has gotten them into. Mew and her friends continue to walk down the trail.

Misty sighs, "I can't believe Team Rocket has sent us far from Pallet Town."

"You have to admit, Team Rocket really got us into a jam this time," Mew says.

"Pika pi," (You said it.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (I agree.) Eevee says.

Soon, Tomo says, "Hey Mew, I'm getting kind of hungry."

"Loetta," (Me too.) Meloetta says.

"Skwovet, (Me three.) Skwovet says.

"I guess we can all use something to eat. I wonder where we're at right now," Brock says.

Mew looks at her Pokenav and says, "According to the map, we're still way away from Pallet Town, but it appears we're heading towards Mt. Hideaway. I remember going there a few times with papa when I was little, and there's supposed to be a giant Onix supposed to live there."

"A giant Onix?" Brock says, curious.

"Yeah. Many of them live here, but I remember papa told me there was supposed to be an especially big one with scars on its face," Mew says.

"I sure hope we don't run into that Onix," Misty says, concerned.

"Don't worry, we won't have too much trouble. Some of the Onix and other Pokemon who live there I've known of and they won't do anything unless someone provokes them. Besides, it's basically our only path to Pallet Town unless you want to go the long way," Mew says.

"Well I guess we don't have too many options," Misty says.

"Up the mountain we go," Brock says.

Sometime later, Mew and her friends arrived at a rest area. The group is feeling a bit tired.

"That sure was a lot of walking. I feel kind of dandy right now," Misty says.

"And I'm starving," Brock says.

"Me too," Tomo says.

"I feel good after a little climb," Mew says.

Soon, the keeper of the rest area, an elderly woman, wearing a pink and blue color kimono and apron comes out with drinks and snacks on the tray.

With a smile, the keeper says, "Well, here we are."

"Thank you ma'am," Misty says.

With that, the group takes the drinks and begins to drink the beverages.

"You're welcome. I heard tell of a trio wandering rascals convorting with Pokémon in these parts, and they could be the varmints that keep stealing my muskrat meatballs," The keeper says.

She looks down to notice the meatballs are gone, and is shocked, "Those rascals! I can't figure…"

However, it reveals that the group has taken the meatballs and are eating them.

"These are pretty tasty!" Mew says.

"Just the right amount of muskrat," Brock says.

"They taste good," Tomo says.

Misty questions, "How hungry do you have to be to eat muskrat meatballs?"

Soon, they group and the keeper hear a sound coming from behind the station.

That alerts the keeper with a determined look, "There they are! It's them again!"

Mew and the others hurry to the back to see if the thieves are here.

Soon, Mew notices, "Hey, look!"

The group looks to see three people looking like they're wearing robs running away where the keeper's alarm system is.

The old lady soon chases after them with the broom, "Come on back here, you Poke-polecats! I'll teach you to move my victuals!"

Seeing them, Mew says, "Wait a minute, I know who they are!"

The three stop in their tracks, and they look more familiar.

The first turn their heads to reveal Jessie wearing a beard and mustache.

Jessie: (in an elderly voice)

Prepare for trouble, whippersnapper!

James: (in an elderly voice)

And make it double, young feller!

Jessie: (in an elderly voice)

To protect the world from devastation!

James: (in an elderly voice)

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Jessie: (in an elderly voice)

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James: (in an elderly voice)

To extend our reach to the stars above!

Jessie: (normal voice)

Jessie!

James: (normal voice)

James!

Jessie: (normal voice)

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James: (normal voice

Surrender now, or prepare to fight!

Meowth: (normal voice)

Meowth! That's flight!

"It's Team Rocket again," Tomo says.

Then Mew crosses her arms, "Those lame disguises don't fool us! What kind of trouble are you three up to this time?!"

"Sorry to disappoint you, we're just trying to get back to the basics," Jessie says.

"Since we always seem to lose to you twerps, we decided to seek Pok-enlightenment by living as poor hermits on this mountain," James adds.

Jessie lowers her head, "Yes, we didn't even bring any money for food."

"True. We're living off the land as nature intended," James says, lowering his head.

"Yeah, the land and this old lady's meat kabobs," Meowth says, and holds the bag of kabobs.

Seeing the proof the keeper charges at them, "I'll teach you, you mangy moochers!"

She then attacks Team Rocket. Smacking the bags of muskrat meatballs out of Team Rocket's hands and are forced to flee.

"Let's beat it!" Meowth screams as he and his colleagues run away.

Mew and the others are amazed.

"Pikachu," (Impressive.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Wow.) Eevee says.

"Togepriiii," (Funny.) Togepi says.

"Pichu Pichu," (They ran away.) Pichu says.

"Meloetta," (She's amazing.) Meloetta says.

"Skwovet," (She's tough.) Skwovet adds.

"You really showed them," Misty comments.

The keeper laughs and says, "I reckon you young'uns are heading up the mountain, are ya?"

"Yes," Mew says.

"Then I reckon you'll run into some of the giant Onix up yonder," The keeper says.

"How big are they?" Tomo asks.

"TVery large youngin. Grounds are good for growing around these parts, Onix jump up like victual heads. Yep. We're famous here for our overgrown Onix," The keeper says.

"Fertile soil makes them grow larger," Brock says.

"They must be scary," Misty says, worried.

"Don't worry none, missy. Those Onix may be overgrown, but they're as gentle as can be," The keeper says.

Mew turns to Misty and says, "Told you."

With that, Mew and the others continue to climb up the mountain, and it's very tiring.

"We've been walking for hours and we haven't seen one sign of the giant Onix," Brock says.

Mew soon notices, "Maybe not, but I do see proof that it's been here. Look."

Brock and the others look down and are surprised to see a large patch that travels in a straight line.

"You're right. I'd say this is some kind of track left by something really big," Brock says.

"Yeah. This is a clear sign that the Giant Onix lives around here," Mew says.

Suddenly, they feel the ground shaking.

"What's that sound?!" Misty asks.

Tomo soon notices something head, "Something's coming!"

Everyone looks to see an Onix coming in their direction. And it looks like it's two or three times as large as a normal sized one.

"Well, there's the giant Onix!" Misty says, shocked.

"Pika!" (It's huge!) Pikachu says, shocked.

"It's coming this way!" Brock panics.

"Don't worry, as long as we stay away from the path, we won't be in any danger," Mew says.

Mew and the others quickly step back and watch the giant Onix slither right past them and down the path. Everyone sighs in relief.

"Wow! That Onix was huge!" Tomo says.

"Loetta," (Really huge.) Meloetta says.

"Skwovet Skwovet," (Really really huge.) Skwovet says.

Mew says, "Yeah. I know that Onix. He's the boss around here. And the biggest one here."

"It's amazing. I'd love to study what makes the Onix grow so big up here," Brock says.

Misty then turns to Mew "I'm just glad you're here who knows the mountain areas. Otherwise, we would have been squished."

Mew looks to where the Onix disappeared to, "But still, there's something not right."

"What do you mean?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure. The giant Onix roars out like something's wrong," Mew says.

"You think something might have happened?" Brock asks.

"Maybe. I say we follow it and find out what," Mew says.

With that, the group follows the Onix trail down to the direction it's heading. They walk down the trail for the longest time, and are starting to feel tired.

"How much farther do we have to walk?" Misty asks.

"I'm sure it's not farther," Mew says.

"I hope so," Brock says.

Mew brings out her Pokenav, "According to this, if we keep traveling this way, we'll be able to find a path that could get us back to Pallet Town."

"Sounds good to me," Brock says

Suddenly, someone says, "Well, I didn't expect to find visitors on the mountain."

Mew and her friends turn their heads to see a tall and muscular man. He has long black hair, tied in a thick ponytail, which dangles down his back to his shoulder blades and longish thick sideburns. He has small dark eyes with prominent eyebrows, a small nose and a square jaw. He wears white trousers with a tattered waist and ankles that are held up by a black belt, shirtless and black wristbands on his wrists.

Seeing the person makes Brock shocked, "I don't believe it."

"What is it, Brock?" Tomo asks.

"Guys, this is Bruno. One of Kanto Region's Elite Four, specializes in Fighting Type Pokemon," Brock says.

That makes the group surprised. They are meeting with another Elite Four. First Lorelei at Seafoam Island, and now they're meeting Bruno in the mountains. Sometime later, Mew and her friends follow Bruno up the mountains.

"So, you're actually here to do some training?" Mew asks.

"Yes," Bruno says.

"Wow. First we met Lorelei and now we're meeting Bruno. I'm seeing so many people I haven't met recently," Mew says.

"I see. So you met Lorelei. I remember her telling me how she met a group of trainers and with their help saved a village that was buried in snow," Bruno says.

"That's us," Misty says.

"And it's a pleasure to meet you, Bruno. You look very strong," Mew says.

"And I'll bet your Fighting Type Pokemon are strong too," Tomo says.

"Thank you. So what brings you to the mountain?" Bruno replies.

Mew and her friend feel a bit skeptical about the question.

"It's a bit of a funny story, but there was a little incident and we were launched all the way to another city so we're trying to get back to Pallet Town," Mew says.

"Yeah. We flew pretty far," Misty says.

"And we've been trying to get back," Brock says.

Then turns to Mew, "But on the plus side, our friend Mew was able to squeeze in some training."

"Yeah. I'm training to compete in the Pokemon League Competition. And my friends and I have been training and doing some traveling," Mew says.

Then blushes, "Of course, my training has also been going off the rails from time to time."

"Thanks to Team Rocket," Misty mutters to herself.

"And we managed to head here and we heard about the Giant Onix in the area," Tomo says.

"We actually found one, but… but I can't stop thinking that something's wrong," Mew says.

Misty then says, "We've been following the trail until we met up with you."

"I see," Bruno says.

Then turns to Mew, "Well, I can tell that you seem to be a strong trainer and you raise your Pokemon with care."

"Thank you. I really love my Pokemon and I do my best to help them have happy lives," Mew says.

"And Mew also trains herself and her Pokemon hard and wants to do great for the Pokemon League," Misty says.

"We've been doing some training too," Tomo happily says.

Suddenly, Tomo feels his stomach growling. Mew and the others, excluding Bruno, simply laugh with grins on their faces.

"Sorry. I'm a little hungry," Tomo says.

"I guess it is time to start making dinner," Mew says.

The group agreed to the idea.

Mew and Brock along with Pikachu and Eevee go to the river and grab some buckets of water. Tomo along with Bruno carry the rocks over to a cave on the mountain. Then Mew chops some wood. Bruno also gets the fire started at the fireplace they made. Brock and Mew then cook some dinner. After dinner is ready, the group eats the soup and Brock's soup is good. The Pokemon are also having Pokemon Food with berries.

"It tastes great, Brock," Tomo happily says.

"I'm glad you like it," Brock says.

Bruno turns to Mew and asks, "So Mew, was it. What do you mean that you sense something wrong with the Giant Onix?"

"It's a bit hard to say. When it slither down the trail, it doesn't seem to be happy, almost like it was in some kind of pain," Mew says.

"In pain?" Bruno questions.

"Yes. I want to help it, but we don't know where it is," Mew says.

"And we still have no clue where it is," Misty says.

Bruno then asks, "And how do you know?"

"Well um, it's a bit hard to explain, but I'm kind of well, different from most trainers. Tomo is the same," Mew says.

"Sure you both are different, but you both are able to make use of your differences and that makes you who you are," Brock says.

"I know," Mew says.

Misty then says, "You see Bruno, both Mew and Tomo have been raised by Pokemon and are able to understand what they're saying. Mew lived in the forest of Pallet Town with Zeraora as it's guardian while Tomo used to live in the Nature Preserve of the Safari Zone with a herd of Kangaskhan."

"Understand Pokemon… that's quite a unique gift you both have," Bruno says.

Then says, "Either way, I can trust your instincts. Something might have happened with the giant Onix, and it will be best for us to find it and figure out what's wrong."

"I agree. And maybe we can learn more about it," Brock says.

"If it would let us," Misty says.

"Don't worry, the Giant Onix are really sweethearts. They wouldn't hurt anyone unless someone tries to attack them," Mew says.

Unknown to Mew and her friends, Team Rocket has been spying on them, and have heard everything, especially about the Giant Onix.

"Did you just hear what I just heard?" Meowth asks.

"All we have to do is capture the biggest giant Onix we can find and we'll be as strong as the Elite Four trainers!" Jessie says, eagerly.

"And we won't have to do any Pokémon training!" James adds.

Then all three laugh with glee, and have plans.

Later on, Team Rocket are in the search for the giant Onix, planning to capture it. They already find a large trail that also has trees that are either knocked down. So they begin to follow it.

"This track was made by that Onix?" James questions.

"Yeah. It must be humongous. The only way we could capture that thing is by total surprise," Meowth says, sounding worried.

"Don't you worry, we've got something Onixpected!" Jessie says with pride and brings out a bazooka.

Then she and James laugh, making Mowth sweat drops.

Meowth comments, "That joke is unacceptable."

Soon, Team Rocket is in a large rocky opening, waiting for the giant Onix to make an appearance.

"And now all we've got to do is wait for that rocky reptile to show its petrified puss," Jessie says.

Suddenly, the ground begins to shake and shows signs of the ground making big cracks. Team Rocket are soon ready to fire.

"Stone cold!" James says.

"Rock and roll!" Jessie adds.

Soon, the giant Onix rises from the ground, and Team Rocket are shocked by its massive size.

Meowth panics, "Let's forget it!"

But Jessie isn't backing down, "We came here to bag an Onix and that's just what we're going to do,"

Back at Bruno's training ground, Mew and her friends are about to be on their way and say goodbye to Bruno.

"Well Bruno, my friends and I still need to get going," Mew says.

"Thanks for letting us join you at your training," Misty says.

"It's no trouble," Bruno says.

Suddenly, they hear a loud explosion, catching everyone's attention.

"What was that?" Tomo asks.

"Was that an explosion?" Misty wonders.

"Sounds like trouble!" Mew says.

"Let's go!" Brock says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket fires the bazooka twice and the both strike at the giant Onix.

Jessie chers, "We hit it!"

"I've been shooting skeets since I was a tot, "James comments.

"Good aims, James!" Meowth complements.

However, when the smoke clears, the giant Onix is not affected. Soon it begins to pursue the frightened trio into running away. Soon, the group notices a cave ahead.

Meowth cries out, "Head for that cave!"

"Don't you know ladies go first?!" James screams running ahead.

James runs fast as well, "Etiquette, shmediquette!"

"Every Meowth for itself!" Meowth screams, running away.

Team Rocket continues to run away as the giant Onix gives chase. They soon run into the cave, and the rock snake Pokemon misses. However, it begins to go crazy bashes the rocky wall above the cave. Team Rocket screams in fear as the rocks are falling in the cave, worried of being sealed in, crushed by the rocks, or the Onix Soon, Mew, her friends, and Bruno arrive to see what is happening.

Brock says, "Those voices!"

"It's Team Rocket!" Misty says.

"Looks like they made that giant Onix really mad," Tomo says.

"We gotta help them!" Mew says.

"Eevee!" (I agree!) Eevee says.

"Pika!" (Right on!) Piakchu says.

"It's Onix versus Onix!" Brock says and throws his Pokeball.

Then Onix comes out.

"Rock Pokémon are weak against water Pokémon! Staryu, go!" Misty says, and calls out Staryu

"She's right! And two water Pokémon are better than one! Squirtle, I choose you!" Mew calls out.

Squirtle comes out.

"I'll help. Spheal, I choose you!" Tomo calls out.

With that, the Pokemon hurry down to confront the Giant Onix.

Brock calls out, "Onix, Tackle attack!"

Onix charges at the giant Onix, but the attack doesn't work.

"No use! That Onix is way too big!" Brock says.

In the cave, Team Rocket is panicking.

Jessie screams, "Help us, please!"

"Get us out of here!" James cries.

Outside, Misty calls out, "Staryu, try to weaken that Onix with your Water Gun attack, and hurry!"

Staryu strikes at the Water Gun, but has no attack because it blocks the attack with its tail.

"Staryu can't do it all alone! Maybe if your Squirtle and Spheal helped!" Misty says.

"Right! Okay, Squirtle, Water Gun!" Mew calls out.

Then Tomo says, "Spheal, use water gun too!"

Both Pokemon including Staryu use Water Gun on Onix.

"I think it's working!" Mew says.

"Those four are a great team!" Misty says.

Soon, Onix shakes the water as it's in pain.

Meowth sees the opportunity, "Jessie, James, now's our chance to run for it!"

But the two are already running.

Jessie calls out, "We're way ahead of you, Meowth!"

Seeing them retreating, Meowth cries out, "Hold it! Where're you going?! Wait for Meowth!" And hurries after them.

In the battlefield, Onix knocks the three water Pokemon with its tail, including Onix. Then smacks Team Rocket into the air.

Jessie screams, "I guess that's.."

"The end of.." James adds.

Then Meowth finishes, "Our tale!"

Then they all scream, "Looks like Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

Back at the battlefield, the Pokemon are badly hurt from the Onix's attack.

"I've seen a lot of Onix before, but I've never seen one nearly as big and powerful as this one!" Brock says.

"And I think Onix is badly hurt, by something, and I don't think it's just the water gun," Mew says.

Just then, the giant Onix charges and slams on the cliff. That causes Mew to fall and grab onto the horn of it's head.

The group panics, "Mew!"

Even the Pokemon cry out, (Mew!)

Mew panics as she holds on to the Onix's horn.

Mew calls out, "Onix, why are you so mad?! Are you hurt?!"

The giant Onix continues to roar in pain. Mew hears Onix's cries and her eye wide and understands. Unknown to Mew, Bruno looks at Onix with a serious look.

Bruno turns to everyone and says, "Recall your Pokémon. Me and Mew can handle this ourselves."

"Whatever you say!" Tomo says.

Hearing that, Mew calls back Squirtle, "Squirtle, return!"

Everyone else does the same, "Return, Staryu! Onix, return! Return, Spheal!"

Brock then asks, "Master, are you gonna use one of your fighting Pokémon, now?"

"And what kind of attack are you gonna use?" Tomo asks.

"Do you have a plan?" Tomo asks.

But Bruno answers, "I will use, no Pokémon."

Everyone is confused that Bruno is not going to use any of his Pokemon.

Then says, "Let's see what your friend does first."

Everyone is reluctant, but decides to listen. With that, Bruno and the others watch as they see Mew beginning to climb down as she hangs on to Onix's back. Onix continues to squirm around like crazy as Mew climbs down the back. The Onix continues to cry out in pain as Mew climbs down until she reaches a specific spot on Onix's body.

"Hmm, I see what the problem is," Bruno says.

Misty asks, "You do?"

"Watch and see what Mew does," Bruno says.

Everyone turns to see Mew reaches the spot and notices something.

Mew says, "It's okay Onix. I'll try to help you the best I can."

Mew then feels the giant Onix's body and down it until she notices something.

"Huh? What is this?" Mew wonders.

She reaches for it, but the giant Onix is squirming in pain.

"I know it hurts, but…" Mew says. Then struggles to pull. "It's… stuck…"

Brock calls out, "Mew, did you find out what happened?"

Mew calls out, "Guys, this Onix needs help! I think there's a Pokemon stuck between its body!"

"A Pokemon?!" Tomo calls out.

"Stuck between it's body?" Brock says, confused.

Mew pulls again, and says, "It won't come out."

Bruno then jumps down into the ravine and walks to where Mew and Onix are. But the Onix wiggles a bit in concern to see Bruno.

Bruno calmly says, "Onix, there's no reason to fear me. Now let me see…"

Onix looks at Bruno and decides to calm down. Then Bruno approaches where Mew is.

Bruno says to Mew, "Don't worry Mew, I'll take it from here."

Mew nods her head and moves out of the way. Then Bruno reaches inside that causes Onix to flinch in pain.

Mew rubs Onix's rocky body and says, "I know it hurts, but it will only hurt for a moment."

"She's right. This will only hurt for a moment," Bruno says.

Mew comforts Onix as Bruno pulls the kind of Pokemon out. Finally, Bruno is able to pull out the Pokemon much to the group's surprise. The Pokemon that's been stuck in there, is a Sandslash.

Sandshalsh happily says, "Slash slash slash!" (Thank you, so, much!)

"So you're what was troubling Onix all this time!" Bruno says.

"It's a Sandslash," Mew says.

Then brings out her Pokedex, "Sandslash, the Mouse Pokémon and the evolved form of Sandshrew. A Ground type. It attacks opponents with the quills on its back.

Bruno then places Sandslash down on the ground. Then Sandslash runs off, glad to be free and unstuck. Mew then climbs down to see Bruno.

She then pets Onix's on the side, "There you go."

"You should be fine now, Onix," Bruno says.

The Onix roars and says, (Thank you.)

Bruno chuckles and asks, "What do you think, Onix? You want to come along with me?"

The Onix nods its head agreeing to it.

Bruno then throws his Pokeball, "Pokéball, go!"

The Pokeball hits the Giant Onix and the Pokemon goes inside.

Then Bruno catches the Pokemon, "You're mine, Onix."

"You were great Bruno. If I didn't know it, I would say you have a feeling something was wrong with Onix when you saw it," Mew says.

"You might say that," Bruno says.

Then place his hand on Mew's head, "You did very good yourself. And you have a special gift that you used wisely."

Mew blushes and says, "Thank you."

"Mew!" Misty calls out.

Mew turns to see her friends hurrying to her.

"Are you alright?" Tomo asks.

"I'm okay. A little shocked from what happened, but I'm fine," Mew says.

"Still, you and Bruno were amazing, you were able to figure out that Sandslash was bothering Onix," Brock says.

"I'm just glad it's alright," Mew says.

Then turns to Bruno, "And has a tough trainer like you by it's side."

"Thank you, but I think you're a tough trainer as well. I believe that Humans and Pokemon must live and work, and share this world together. And they must care for each other. Just like you and your Pokemon. That is true strength," Bruno says.

Mew smiles as Pikachu and Eevee climb on Mew's shoulder.

Bruno then says, "I look forward to the day that we face each other in battle, Mew."

"So do I," Mew says.

"Be well," Bruno says.

He then jumps on the rocky cliff and over the cliff, leaving the group.

"Wow. He sure is something," Mew says.

"Yeah. I guess that's why he's an Elite 4 and he didn't need to battle Onix," Misty says.

"I guess learn something from this experience," Brock says.

"Yeah," Tomo says.

Mew and her friends laugh with smiles and soon on their way back to Pallet Town to continue training for the Pokemon League.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket finds themselves in deep trouble with a herd of angry Onix who do not like visitors.

Jessie worriedly says, "I think things are looking sort of rocky, don't you?"

"These Pokémon couldn't be bolder!" James comments.

"Maybe people take them for granite!" Meowth says.

Chapter 76: Episode 70: The Ancient Puzzle of Pokemopolis

One sunny day, somewhere in the forest outside of Pallet Town

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Agility attack!"

Pikachu sprints forward.

Then Brock says, ""Then we'll use an Agility attack, too! Vulpix, go!"

Vulpix dashes forward.

As it turns out, Mew and Brock are having a Pokemon battle. Pikachu vs. Vulpix. Mew continues to have her training and Brock agrees to be her opponent. A good day to continue training for the Pokemon League. Meanwhile, Tomo is playing with Eevee, Meloetta, Skwovet, Togpei, and Pichu. Misty is fishing as she turns to see the battle.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Thunder Shock attack!"

Pikachu charges up for his attack, and fires it at Vulpix. Vulpix quickly dodges the attack.

"Vulpix, Flamethrower!" Brock calls out.

Vulpix charges for her Flamethrower as Pikachu charges for another attack.

However, a Pokemon appears between the battlefield. It's a shadow-like Pokémon holding a golden mask that has a face on it. It has two shadowy, tendril-like arms and large, red eyes. It also has a small tail-like appendage that holds the mask. This shocks Mew and Brock.

Mew cries out, "Pikachu, hold it!"

"Vulpix, deflect it!" Brock calls out.

Both Pokemon aim their attacks away from the Pokemon and to the wall, causing a big explosion. Meanwhile, in a different part of the area, a woman with short blue hair and a red headband, wearing archaeological clothes hears the explosion. There are also other men who are wearing the same outfits, hear it too.

A man asks, "Huh? What was that?"

"I'm not sure," The woman answers.

Back at the battle field, the explosion breaks the wall and the debris has fallen to the ground, and it seems to uncover some kind of structure.

"Wow, Pikachu. Your attacks are getting pretty strong," Mew says.

"Pika," (I guess.) Pikachu replies.

Mew kneels down and picks up the Pokemon that has been knocked down by the attacks.

"Are you okay? You should be more careful," Mew says.

The Pokemon looks at Mew and says, "Yamask. Yamask. (Sorry. I was just passing through.)

"That's okay, just be more careful, okay," Mew says.

"Yamask," (Okay.) The Pokemon says.

"What kind of Pokemon is that?" Misty asks.

"It's a Yamask. It's very rare to see them around here," Brock says.

"It looks cool," Tomo says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex, "Yamask, huh."

Then Dexter says, "Yamask, the Spirit Pokemon. A Ghost Type. The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face. This Pokemon originated in the Unova Region."

"Neat," Tomo says.

Misty turns away from the others and says, "Looks like we accidentally uncovered something. But what?"

"Yeah," Mew says.

Brock walks to the ancient structure and says, " Looks like some kind of temple or something.

Brock moves some of the rocks and looks to find something inside, "Hey! Look at this!" and picks it up.

Misty, Mew, Tomo, and the Pokemon surround Brock and look at the object Brock has found. It's cylinder shape with two cones on both sides. It's a gold amber color with strange patterns on it. It also appears to have a blue gem or stone with a slot in the middle.

"It looks sort of pretty," Misty comments.

"Yeah, pretty weird!" Tomo says.

Mew looks at it, "Wonder what it is."

Suddenly, someone snatches Brock's hand, shocking the group. They turn to see a woman with short blue hair and wears a red headband and is dressed like an archaeologist. She observes the object with a magnifying glass.

Seeing what it is, the woman gets excited, "I finally found it!"

"You did?" Misty says, confused.

The woman turns around and calls out, "Professor! Look what I found!"

She hurries over and gives it to the professor.

The man, who she calls professor happily says, "Well, you've done it again! That's great work, Eve."

Then Brock comes over, "Uh, sir. I'm the one who found whatever it is that is! We were having a training battle and.."

The girl called Eve, interrupts and shakes Brock's hands, "Yes, thanks a lot. Couldn't have done it without you. Very helpful."

Then turns to the professor, "This is the discovery we've been hoping for! I can hardly believe we found it!"

"We found it," Misty mutters.

Then the professor happily says, "Congratulations. Your discovery proves your hypothesis beyond any doubt."

Mew and her friends are confused by this.

Then Eve says, "I think we should move the camp here, and begin a major excavation of the temple and the surrounding area.

The professor laughs and says, "Just take a look."

Eve looks to see the crew has already done so.

"Professor, you've already done it," Eve says.

Just then, Mew asks, "Um excuse us, ma'am."

Eve turns to notice the others, "Oh, hello. Can I help you?"

"Um yeah. I'm Eve, this is Pkachu, and Eevee, and this is Yamask," Mew says.

"I'm Tomo, this is Skwovet, and Meloetta," Tomo says.

"And I'm Misty, this is Togepi and Pichu," Misty says.

"And I'm Brock, it's nice to meet you," Brock says, blushing.

As Mew and her friends talk with Eve, Team Rocket is close by and have their binoculars focus on the ancient ruins.

Jessie laughs and says, "Looks like the twerp patrol is onto something. Something valuable."

"It could be a veritable vault of valuables!" James says.

"And now it's our vault," Meowth says.

Down at the excavation site, while the researchers dig up the ruins, Mew and her friends are in the tent with Eve. They are getting to know Eve and what she does. Plus, Eve is showing them the artifacts they found.

Mew looks at one of them, "You know, this statue looks like a Psyduck."

Then Misty says, "I remember reading about a hidden city where the people built temples to honor Pokémon."

"If they built a temple to honor Psyduck, they weren't hidden. They were lost," Brock comments.

Then Tomo asks, "What was the name of this city?"

"I think it was called Pokémopolis. And it got destroyed and then totally disappeared," Misty says.

Brock picks up the statue and says, "The people who lived there believed Pokémon were symbols of nature's power, at least that's how the legend goes."

Then comes to realize, "Hey! Maybe Pokémopolis was here!"

"We may have discovered the first positive proof of the real Pokémopolis! It's a real find!" Eve says, excited.

Just then, the professor runs inside the tent, "Doctor! Look here!"

The professor shows Eve the spoon that has the same color and pattern as the relic Mew and the others found.

"The same material as the other relic. Where was it?" Eve replies.

"Right near the original one," The professor says.

Eve takes the spoon and turns to the other relic, "The great two powers of destruction. These relics might be the key."

"The key?" Tomo says, confused.

"To what?" Mew wonders.

Then Misty asks, "Come, you called Eve doctor? She's way too young to be a real doctor."

"By age six, Eve was already an expert in ancient Pokémopolitian civilization. Her research revolutionized the field! She got her PHD at eight," The professor explains, making Eve blush a bit.

Everyone exclaims, "She must be a super brain!"

"Pika! Skwov! (Genius!) Pikachu and Skwovet say.

"Eev! Loetta!" (Super smart!) Eevee and Meloetta reply.

The professor laughs, "When she was nine, Eve wrote her best selling book on her new theories on Pokémop.." But is interrupted when Eve moves him out of the tent.

Embarrassed, Eve says, "Okay, that's enough about me, Professor. You've got work to do!"

And makes him leave the tent.

"Yes, doctor!" The professor says.

Meanwhile, Mew and her friends are baffled by Eve's accomplishments.

"Doctor," Brock says, smiling.

"Already," Mew replies.

"When I was eight, I used to be afraid of doctors," Misty says, feeling weary.

Eve turns to the others, "Please, it's no big deal. And it's not like I had perfect grades or anything. I got an A minus, once." And chuckles sheepishly.

As Eve makes the spoon in her hand move, the relic begins to react. Suddenly, Pikachu and Eevee notice it, but no one else does.

Mew notices and asks, "What's the matter, guys?"

"Pi. Pikachu," (I. I don't know.) Pikachu answers.

"Eevee," (Me either.) Eevee says.

Then Eve places a stone tablet on the table, "Here, look at this stone tablet I discovered."

"That writing. What does it say, Eve?" Misty asks.

Then Brock says, "Is it about Pokémopolis?"

Eve answers, "It says: 'Beware the two great powers of destruction. The shadow of the dark device will grapple with the prisoner of the unearthly urn. The sacred city will be no more, as day is swallowed up by night. Darker still for when they return to lay waste the world. But no human knows the secret to sooth the powers and guide them back to the shadow world.'"

Then explain, I've been trying to figure it out. It's one of the toughest mysteries I ever had to solve."

Mew and her friends are rather surprised.

And Brock leaps forward and says, "Eve, what are we waiting for? Let's both start digging and solve that mystery!"

Brock then rushes out with excavation tools in his hands.

Eve turns to the others, "Brock must love mysteries."

Everyone chuckles nervously.

"He loves something," Tomo comments.

Mew looks at the tablet and says, "You know Eve, that tablet sounds almost like a kind of warning."

"A warning you say. You might be onto something. But it raises the question of what kind of warning," Eve says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket continues to watch the action from the far.

Hearing the conversation, Meowth says, "I'd sure love to have lived in an ancient city that built temples to honor the great Pokémon."

He jumps on top of Jessie and James' heads and calls out, "Bow down, humans and obey!"

Then Jessie and James squish him. James uses his foot and Jessie uses her fist.

Later in the night, Mew and her friends are sleeping with Eve in the R.V. The Yamask decides to stay with them. As they sleep, the relic begins to glow and the spoon begins to move. Outside of the R.V. Team Rocket makes their move. They hold pieces of bushes as they do their motto.

Jessie: (quietly)

To protect the world from devastation.

James: (quietly)

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love.

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Jessie:

Jessie.

James:

James.

Meowth rushes to them and says, "Shh!"

Then quietly says, "Let's swipe all their swag and scram."

"Let's sneak into their camper and grab those relics," James says.

But Jessie says, "Those little trinkets aren't worth the effort. The really big stuff must be hidden deep within that temple, and I know just how to get it."

She brings out her Pokeball and calls out, "Go, Arbok."

With that, Arbok comes out of its Pokeball.

Jessie commands Arbok, "Arbok, burrow into that temple and bring back the most valuable treasure you can find."

Arbok then starts burrowing down underground as Jessie laughs in triumph.

"Well, soon, we'll all be filthy rich," Jessie says.

Then turns to James, "What wastefully extravagant things will you do with your share?"

"Well, first I'll pay the boss all the money I owe him," James says.

But Jessie angrily says, "What?! That's the most ridiculous idea I ever heard! Don't you know that with all that money, you won't have to do the decent things?!"

"If the treasure's large enough, I can make myself the boss," James says.

Then says in confidence, "The big enchilada!"

"The top tamale!" Jessie says.

"The king quesadilla!" James says.

Meowth shakes his head, "It's such a shame they're so power hungry."

And is annoyed that Jessie and James are hungry for power, but seems to also be hungry for food.

Jessie continues, "The grand guacamole!"

"The number one nacho!" James adds.

Just then, Arbok shoots out from the rocky wall.

Jessie happily says, "Aha! Here's Arbok!"

The group notices Arbok holding three small black spheres in its mouth.

Confused, James asks, "Wasn't there anything glitzier?"

"It sure looks mighty measly," Meowth comments.

Then Jessie asks, "You mean that's the most valuable treasure you could find?"

Suddenly, the three spheres begin to glow, and the glow envelopes Arbok and the spheres absorb it inside, much to Team Rocket's shock. Inside the camper, the artifacts are beginning to glow and react to the ones Arbok found. Back outside, the black spheres appear to be moving on it's own or some kind of invisible creature, its evidence are the footsteps it's making as it approaches Team Rocket, petrified with fear. They all scream and try to run away, but the spheres seem to petrify them.

"We're not moving!" Jessie panics.

"I'm catatonic!" Meowth says.

The creature continues to walk towards the petrified Team Rocket.

The next day, Mew and the others notice Team Rocket's handiwork.

"Eve, look!" Brock says.

"Giant footprints! And they're coming from the temple!" Eve says.

Soon Mew notices the black spheres, "What are those things?"

"This must be the dark device that's mentioned in the tablet!" The professor says.

"Let's analyze it in the camper," Eve says.

"Right," The professor says and picks up the device.

Suddenly, the device then absorbs him into it, shocking everyone who witnessed it. Soon, the device shows the professor trapped inside along with Team Rocket and Arbok.

"Team Rocket?!" Mew says, shocked.

"What are they doing in there?!" Tomo adds, stunned.

Eve cries out, "Run! Hurry!"

Everyone soon runs for their lives, but the creature of the dark devices freezes some of the workers. Eve along with Mew, her friends, and the Pokemon rush inside the camper. Mew and her friends watch in shock to see the workers being absorbed into the device. However, they turn around to notice the other artifacts are moving.

Outside, the creature is starting to take up a physical form. Inside the dark device, Team Rocket and the researchers are still trapped.

Jessie asks, frightened, "What's happening? Where are we?"

"Somehow, we've been transported inside the dark device. Fascinating," The professor says.

"I'd rather be at the beach," James says.

The device continues to go and soon it takes on the form of a Pokemon with a strange pattern on its body.

"Hey, look! It's a giant Gengar!" Brock says.

"How could a Gengar get to be so humongous?!" Misty asks.

"You're right. I've never seen a Gengar that size before! Haunter's friend was no bigger than me," Mew says.

Soon, the giant Gengar causes the clouds to gather and block out the sun.

"And it didn't have those weird markings on it," Mew says.

Then Eve says, "This must be what the tablet meant. The shadow of the dark device.

"I'm starting to think you're right," Mew says.

Then turns to the floating objects, "And maybe we're right in the middle of a mystery that's too scary to solve!"

Outside, the Gengar begins to grow bigger, and the effects spread across the sky. At the corral, Professor Oak, Krabby, and Muk take notice.

"Looks like a storm," Professor Oak says.

Meanwhile, Zeraora, and the forest Pokemon begin to notice as well, sensing something wrong.

Somewhere in the forest, Gengar walks through the forest with Mew and the others close behind.

"Gengar's going somewhere!" Eve says.

"It's probably gonna head straight for the nearest town, to wreck it!" Misty says.

"We've gotta stop it!" Mew says, and hurries off.

But Eve protests, "It's too powerful!"

"The nearest town is my home town," Mew says.

"But you won't be able to stop it!" Eve says.

"Maybe you're right, but we gotta do something!" Mew says.

Then hurries off, "Let's go, Pikachu! You too, Eevee!"

"Pika!" (On it!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (Let's go!) Eevee says.

Misty calls out, "Mew, I'm coming with you!"

"Me too!" Tomo says.

Misty and Tomo hurry after them.

Brock turns to Eve, "We'll go with them, you go back to the camper and try to figure out this mystery before it's too late!"

With that, the group hurries towards the giant sized Gengar. Meanwhile, the two artifacts continue to glow and move as they are levitating.

Back in the forest, the giant Gengar is toppling the trees with every step it takes. It even breaks power lines as it walks through. Soon, Mew and her friends are not far behind.

"I can handle this!" Brock says, holding his Pokeball.

Then throws it, "Onix, go!"

With that, Onix materializes from the Pokeball

Brock calls out, "Hurry, Onix! Go underground and block that Gengar!"

Onix then burrows underground.

Then, Mew throws her Pokeballs and calls out, "Pidgeotto, I choose you!"

Soon, Pidgeotto comes out of its Pokeball. Then Pidgeotto flies towards the giant Gengar.

Mew calls out, "Pidgeotto, Gust attack!"

Pidgeotto then performs Gust Attacks the best it can, but it doesn't seem to affect the giant Gengar. Then it's eyes glow, stopping Pidgeotto in its tracks. Soon, Pidgeotto is absorbed into the dark device.

Mew panics, "No!"

Meanwhile in the device, Pidgeotto falls unconscious and falls on top of Meowth.

"It's getting crowded in here!" James complains.

Jessie grabs Pidgeotto and shakes it, "Can't you battle better than that?! Especially you bumbling bird brain! I'm not looking to be stuck in this stomach forever!"

Outside, the Gengar continue to march towards Pallet Town, but Onix intercepts it by popping out of the ground.

Brock calls out, "Onix, use your Bind attack!"

Onix wraps around Gengar's leg, but gets absorbed into it's body. That causes the inside of the device to become more crowded.

"No!" Brock says, stunned.

"I don't think any Pokémon can stop that!" Misty says.

"We gotta stop it, somehow!" Mew says.

But Tomo asks, "But how?"

Meanwhile, inside th Gengar

Just then, the giant Gengar turns around to see Mew and the others. That causes the group to panic. Back in the camper, the device begins to glow again.

Outside of the camper, Mew and the others run away from the giant Gengar and hurry inside to see Eve is levitating in the air with the artifacts and her eyes are glowing yellow.

Brock cries out, "Eve!" and tries to save her, but the others stop him.

"No!" Misty cries out.

"You'll get caught in the spell, just like her!" Mew says.

"We can't let Eve get swallowed up, too!" Brock says.

"We'll think of someway to save her!" Tomo says.

But Brock calls out, "Let me go! I've got to save Eve!"

As the group talk, the glass dome covering the artifact Brock found shatters, and the spoon the professor has found is floating over Eve's hand. Soon, the spoon inserts into the slot on the other artifacts, emitting a glow and flying out of the camper. Moments later, Mew and the others find themselves on the ground with Eve free and in Brock's arms.

"Are you okay?" Brock asks, concerned.

"What happened? I can't remember a thing," Eve says.

Just then, Tomo notices, "Guys look!"

Mew and the others look to see a shadow coming out of the other artifacts. Soon, the artifacts take the form of another pokemon. The giant pokemon is a humanoid Pokémon with a large mustache. It has a long, thin snout, narrow eyes, ear-like spikes extending from the top of its head, and an additional spike protruding from each cheek. Covering its yellow, skeletal body are brown armor-like sections over its chest, shoulders, forearms, and knees. There are three toes on each foot, each of which has a white claw. Two of the toes face forward, while one faces backwards. It wields a silver spoon in each hand.

"Woah! That's an Alakazam!" Mew says, surprised.

But Mew says, frightened, "Don't you mean, Alacolossal?"

Mew gets out her Pokedex, and Dexter says, "Alakazam, a Psi Pokémon and the final evolved form of Abra. A Psychic Type. This Pokémon uses psychic attacks to overcome its opponents.

"Attacks must be a hundred times stronger from the super-sized Alakazam!" Mew says.

Just then, the giant Alakazam attacks, but Gengar side steps and a strange object forms when it impacts on the ledge. Then on the ground when the dodges again

"What are those?" Misty asks.

"I don't know, and I'm not so sure we want to find out," Brock says, worried.

The giant Gengar licks giant Alakazam, but it teleports behind the Gengar mid attack and uses its own. But Gengar retaliates, but Gengar blocks the attack. Soon, both Pokemon begin to use their attacks against each other.

That's when Eve remembers what she reads on the Tablet, "Beware the two great powers of destruction. The shadow of the dark device will grapple with the prisoner of the unearthly urn. The sacred city will be no more and day swallowed up by night. Darker still for when they return to lay waste the world."

Then remembers what Eve says, "You know Eve, that tablet sounds almost like a kind of warning."

That's when Eve realizes what the tablet means.

And explains to the others, "Now I understand! These two creatures destroyed the city of Pokémopolis and now they're going to destroy us!"

"We gotta stop them!" Mew says.

"But how?" Tomo asks.

"He's right! How could we stop them if the Pokémopolitans couldn't?" Misty says.

"I'm sorry. This is all my fault. I should never have tried to solve the mystery of Pokémopolis!" Eve says, feeling like this is her fault.

But Brock says, "Don't blame yourself, Eve! Archaeologists are supposed to solve mysteries!"

"He's right. You didn't know this would happen," Misty says.

"Yeah. None of this is your fault. You never expected this," Mew says.

Then Tomo says, "Yeah. I say its the ancient Pokémopolitans' fault for making their stupid tablet so hard to figure out!"

"Let's worry about that later. I might have an idea on how to stop it," Mew says, and brings out her Pokeballs.

Soon, Mew realizes, "You're gonna try catching them?!"

"They may be ancient and super powerful, but they're still Pokémon! Maybe we can catch them," Mew says.

Then throws her Pokeballs, "Go, Pokéball!"

Mew throws the Pokeball to capture the Pokeballs. However, they notice and use their powers to destroy the Pokeballs, much to the heroes' shock.

"Mew I want to save your home town, too, but these Pokémon are way too powerful for us to handle! Maybe we better get help!" Brock says.

Just then, the two giant Pokemon use their powers to petrify Mew and the others as Pikachu, Eevee, Yamsk, Skwovet, Meloetta, and Pichu head to the river.

"My, body's frozen! Brock says.

"Mine, too," Misty says.

Just then, Pikachu and the others hurry over.

Pikachu and Eevee cry out, "Pika Pi! Eevee!" (Mew!)

"The others escaped the spell," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Pikachu, Eevee, quick into the water."

"Pika!" (On it!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (Got it!") Eevee says.

Then they both head to the river.

Then Misty calls out, "Pichu, help Pikachu and Eevee."

"Pichu," (Okay.) Misty says.

Pikachu, Eevee, and Pichu jump into the river.

Then Mew and Misty call out, "Pikachu/Pichu, use Thunder Shock!"

Then Mew calls out, "Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

With that, they all perform their electric attacks and with the water, they sit the giant Pokemon with full force, freeing the group trapped under the spell. However, that shocked everyone trapped inside the black device.

Mew says, "Nice going, Pikachu! You too Eevee!"

Misty picks up Pichu, who is dizzy from the shock, "You did good too, Pichu."

The two giant Pokemon then begin to attack all over the place, and it destroys the camper. Mew and the others are able to hide behind a large boulder.

"We can't give up now!" Mew says.

"But, Mew, the tablet states nobody knows the secret to stopping these creatures from destroying everything!" Eve says.

"Eve's right, Mew!" Misty says.

Then Tomo has an idea, "I know, how about we get them to sleep. They gotta be tired by now."

"Great idea. Meloetta and Jigglypuff can use their singing to sleep," Mew says.

"Okay," Misty says.

Then throws her Pokeball, "Come on out, Jigglypuff."

With that, Jigglypuff comes out and says, "Jiggly." (Hi everyone.)

Misty kneels to Jigglypuff, "Jigglypuff, we need you and Meloetta's help on this one."

"They could be a heavyweight knockout!" Brock says.

While the two giants keep grappling with each other. Jigglypuff and Meloetta get on the cliff and prepare to sing as Mew and her friends are a short distance, but close to where the Pokemon are.

Okay, Jigglypuff and Meloetta, if this works, you'll be Pallet Town's favorite vocalists," Mew says.

Jigglypuff and Meloetta nod to each other and begin to sing their songs.

In the device, Team Rocket and Pidgetto applauded.

Jessie happily says, "That's the most beautiful music I've ever heard!"

"Yeah! Encore! Encore!" Meowth cheers.

Jigglypuff and Meloetta continue to sing, but they don't have any effect on the giants. However, the stone bell on top of the temple begins to react to the singing as Team Rocket begins to feel sleepy.

Meowth yawns and asks, "How come they're not getting sleepy?"

"Maybe Jigglypuff isn't loud enough," James suggests.

Then Jessie says, feeling tired, "I'd love to talk more, but I need my beauty sleep."

Soon, Team Rocket falls asleep with Pidgeotto and Onix.

Just then, Gengar pushes Alakazam back. The two Pokemon panic, and Meloetta picks up Jigglypuff as they fly away. Then join up with the others, both Tomo and Misty take their Pokemon in their arms.

"Are you okay, Meloetta?" Tomo asks.

Meloetta nods her head in reply.

"It's okay Jigglypuff, you did your best," Misty says.

"Now what?" Mew wonders.

Suddenly, Pikachu notices something, Pika Pi!" (Mew!)

The group looks to see the bell is floating towards the other giant Pokemon.

"What's happening now?" Tomo wonders.

The two Pokemon notice the bell approaching them. Soon, the bell glows and a giant Pokemon appears.

"Is that a Jigglypuff?" Mew asks.

"More like Bigglypuff?!" Misty says, surprised.

All the Pokemon are surprised, but Jigglypuff is the most astonished to see a giant version of her own kind is a giant sized Pokemon with the bell on its head. Then the giant Jigglypuff then grabs the bell as it falls off it's head. Soon, it begins to sing to the other giant Pokemon like the bell is a microphone. The voice is so loud that it's hurting everyone's ears. Soon enough, everyone begins to get sleepy, even the giant Pokemon are getting tired.

"That's the, secret that soothes the powers of destruction," Eve says.

"I'm feeling kinda soothed, myself," Brock says

"Yeah, me too," Mew says.

"Me, three," Misty says.

"Me, four," Tomo adds.

Soon everyone falls asleep due to the powerful song of the giant Jigglypuff. Soon, the storm clouds disappears. However, the show is short-lived when it notices the two giant Pokemon sleeping. It puffs up its cheek in anger and takes out the tip of the bell that actually holds a paint brush. Then it scribbles on their faces.

Then the Pokemon calls out, "PUFF!"

Later in the evening, everyone is starting to wake up.

Soon, Eve realizes something as she wakes up, "Wake up!"

Soon, Mew and the others wake up as well.

"Where's that, Jiggly-giant?" Mew wonders.

Meanwhile, back at the site, everyone who has been trapped in the dark device are now free, human and Pokemon alike. Soon, Mew and the others hurry towards them.

Mew calls out, "Hey!"

Dazed by what happened, James says, "What a nightmare."

"But it's over now," Meowth says.

Soon, they all begin to cry and hug each other as Jessie and James say, "We survived!"

Mew giggles and says, "Welcome back, Team Rocket."

They all stop crying and turn to see Mew. Then they quickly stand on their feet.

"It's her again!" James says.

"We'll let you and friends off easy, this time, twerp, but next time, you won't be so lucky!" Jessie says.

"Let's go!" James says.

Then they all rush off as they say, "Team Rocket's dashing off again!" and laugh.

"Pika Pika! (So long, losers!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee!" (See you when we beat you again!) Eevee says.

Then Misty wonders, "But what happened to Gengar and Alakazam?"

"Returned to the Shadow World, again, I guess," Eve suspects.

Then Brock says, "This is awesome. Eve, maybe a giant Jigglypuff was the protector of Pokémopolitan civilization!"

"If you're right, Brock, than it's also possible these relics were actually the first primitive Pokéballs!" Eve says, seeing the relics.

"Whoa! Really?" Mew asks, amazed.

"That'll be the next mystery I try to tackle. And," Eve says.

Then picks up the urn, "This could be the key that unlocks all the secrets of Pokémopolis!"

Mew smiles with glee as Yamask is still in her arms. After this little adventure, Yamask decides to come with Mew and others. They end up with another exciting adventure and Mew has made a new friend.
