Chapter 77: Episode 71: A Ghost of a Prank

On a cloudy day, Mew and her friends continue their journey as Mew and her Pokemon train for the Pokemon League, But today, Mew and her friends are heading towards Ladenver Town. Mew is holding a bouquet of flowers, Pikachu and Eevee are walking with little Axew and Haunter who is floating with them. Misty looks around to see the thick fog around the woods and is looking nervous.

Misty nervously says, "You know, these woods are more creepy than the last time we came here."

"I know what you mean. The fog seems thicker than usual. I can hardly see anything in front of my face," Mew says.

Tomo asks, "So Mew, why did we decide to come here?"

"We're going to visit Pokemon Tower to pay respect to Haxorus, Axew's mom. Then visit Haunter's friends," Mew says.

"Oh," Tomo replies.

Then sadly says, "I remember you telling me about the incident and what Axew have gone through."

"Yeah," Mew says.

Then Haunter picks up Axew and the two smile at each other.

"I thought it would be nice for Axew to see his mom once in a while and Haunter to see his friends," Mew says.

"And I'm sure Axew and Haunter are happy to see them again," Misty says.

"I think we're almost there. And we should be able to see it when we reach the edge of the woods," Brock says.

Mew and her friends continue to walk through the woods and soon reach the cliff. To the group's shock, they see that Lavender Town looks spookier than the last time they're here. The fog is practically covering the city, and the tower seems more frightening.

"What happened here?" Brock asks.

"It looks more scary than usual," Misty says, frightened.

"I don't know. Something's up," Mew says.

Not wasting much time, Mew and her friends are able to get to the Pokemon Center, even if it's foggy and spooky, they are able to find it thanks to the Pokenav. When they arrive, they decide to have some lunch as they try to figure out what is going on.

Misty looks out the window, "This place is even creepier than usual. Maybe we picked a bad time to come here."

"It may be creepy, but I did promise Axew to visit his mom and Haunter to visit his friends," Mew says.

Misty sighs, "I guess you're right."

"So this place hasn't always been spooky?" Tomo asks.

"Well, no. The place is usually foggy, but not this much," Mew says.

"She's right. And there aren't that many people around either," Brock says.

"This is getting weird," Misty replies.

Suddenly, they hear someone asks, "So the ghost of Lucario reappeared again?"

"Yes, and it's still haunting the town, fighting everyone, especially the Pokemon Tower," Another voice says.

The group turns their heads to notice two men and two women are having a discussion.

A man says, "Yes. And a lot of people are too scared to approach the tower. The ghost is frightening anyone who comes too close to it."

"I wonder why the ghost is here? It seems the situation is almost like the last time," A woman says.

"I don't know. I hope it will be over soon," The man says.

The group who is hearing the conversation is confused to hear another ghost situation has appeared.

Misty turns her head and says, confused, "Another ghost?"

"It seems so. And they said it's Lucario. They're rather around Kanto," Brock says.

"Lucario. I remember reading about that Pokemon," Mew says, bringing out her Pokedex.

Mew looks up on her Pokedex, and sees a picture of the Pokemon. The Pokémon, Lucario is a bipedal, canine-like Pokémon with predominantly blue and black fur. It possesses a short, round spike on the back of each forepaw, in addition to a third on its chest. It has red eyes, a long snout, and ears. When its mouth is open, two pairs of pointed teeth, one in the upper jaw and one in the lower, can be seen. It possesses cream-colored fur on its torso and blue fur on its thighs that resemble shorts. It has a medium-length tail of the same blue color as well. It stands on its toes rather than on its entire foot. It has developed four black appendages that hang down from its head.

Then Dexter says, "Lucario, the Aura Pokemon. A Fighting and Steel Type. Lucario uses a power called aura, which allows it to sense human feelings."

"It can sense aura, huh." Mew says, curious.

"Sounds kind of cool," Tomo says.

"Still, I'm curious about this spirit they're mentioning. Remember the incident with Haxorus and Team Rocket when we last came here," Brock says.

"Trust me, I think we all remember," Mew says.

"I wonder if Reina and Mr. Kyle can tell us something about the spirit of Lucario," Misty says.

"Well, the best we can do is go to the Pokemon House and see if they know anything," Mew says.

Soon enough, Mew and her friends are now out in the foggy town to make their way to the Pokemon House which is also Mr. Kyle's home, to see if he and Reina know anything about Lucario's ghost.

"I hope Mr. Kyle and Reina can tell us something about Lucario, or what's been happening around here," Brock says.
"Yeah. Maybe the Pokemon is having trouble finding peace, like what happened with Haxorus," Mew says.

"Pika Pika," (I agree.) Pikachu says.

Then Eevee wonders, "Eevee Eevee?" (I have to wonder why?)

Just then, Axew notices something or someone up ahead and points towards it, "Ax Ew Ew?" (Hey, who's that?)

"Who?" Mew questions.

The group looks ahead to notice someone is standing before them.

"What's that?" Tomo asks.

"It looks like a Pokemon," Brock says.

The Pokemon they're seeing a short distance away is small, even smaller than Tomo. It's a small, bright yellow, canine Pokémon. It has a gray torso and legs, a bright yellow tail, and a light blue collar. It has rounded bumps on the backs of its forepaws. It has a gray mask and orange eyes. It stands on its toes instead of its entire foot. It has developed two black appendages that hang down from its head.

""I never seen that one before," Misty says.

"What kind of Pokemon is it?" Tomo asks.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and says, "Let's find out."

With that, Dexter says, "Riolu, the Emanation Pokemon, and the pre-evolved form of Lucario. A Fighting Type. It can use waves called auras to gauge how others are feeling. These same waves can also tell this Pokémon about the state of the environment."

"So it's a Riolu. It's also rare to see a Riolu, especially her in Lavender Town," Brock says.

Tomo looks at the Pokedex and notices the picture of the Riolu is different from what they're saying. The Riolu on the Pokedex, is blue with black, a yellow collar, and red eyes.

"And the Riolu is a different color," Tomo notices.

"So it means that this Riolu is a Shiny Pokemon," Mew says.

"I wonder if that's why Lucario's ghost is haunting the city," Misty suspects.

"Maybe we can go ask it and find out," Mew says.

Just then, the small Riolu notices the group and grows a bit weary. So it runs away.

"Wiat Riolu, we need to talk to you," Mew calls out.

With that, Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, Axew, and Haunter hurry off to catch up with Riolu.

"Mew, wait up!" Brock calls out.

With that, Brock, Misty, Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet quickly hollow after them. The group continues to follow Riolu into an alley. Soon, Riolu stops to see the alley is blocked. Mew and the others come to a stop to see Riolu looking rather frightened, and scared.

"The poor thing, it must be scared," Misty says, feeling concerned.

"Maybe it's nervous to be around humans. Maybe it has something to do with the Lucario," Mew says.

"Mew, maybe you can have your Pokemon talk to Riolu, it might help," Brock says.

"I think it's a good idea," Mew says.

Suddenly, something begins to appear in front of them. The fog begins to get thicker around them, frightening the group.

"What's going on?" Misty asks.

"Where did this fog come from?" Tomo asks.

Brock soon notices something in front of them, "Uh guys, I think I know what's going on."

Mew and the others turn their heads to see a Pokemon known as Lucario is standing before them. Yet this one has a different color scheme. It has the same colors as the Riolu, even has the same orange color eyes.

"Is that… the Ghost of Lucario…" Misty asks, frightened.

"And that Lucario is a Shiny Pokemon," Mew says.

Just then, the Pokemon's spirit lets out a powerful growl and begins to use a powerful dark type attack and fire at them. Everyone quickly dodge the attack and panic. Then the Pokemon's ghost attacks them with the same attack. Everyone panics and screams and runs away in fear.

Mew screams, "Let's get out of here!"

"Why is that Pokemon attacking us?!" Misty panics.

"Run!" Tomo screams.

Soon enough, the groups are able to reach the Pokemon House. Mew quickly knocks on the door in a panic and soon enough the door opens to reveal Reina.

"Oh Mew, everyone. Welcome… back…" Reina says, but notices the frightened and tired looks on their faces.

Confused, Reina asks, "What happened?"

"It… it's a long… story," Brock says, tired.

"We… we were… attacked…" Misty panics.

Reina is confused about it, so she allows Mew and the others inside the Pokemon House. They soon have some tea and some snacks.

"You saw Lucario's spirit in town and the orphaned Riolu?" Rena asks, a little surprised.

"We did, and it attacked us," Misty says.

"I think it attacked us because we were too close to the little Riolu," Mew says.

"That seems to be the case. People who have been seen and attacked by the spirit have also seen the baby orphaned Riolu," Reina says.

"What happened?" Brock asks.

"The Spirit of Lucario was a Shiny Lucario that came to the area four months ago and lives in the mountains. Sadly, there was a landslide and Lucario was caught in it. However, we found out that it had a place to live and it had a baby. Many have tried to find the little Riolu, but every time someone gets close to it or the Pokemon tower where Lucario is resting in peace, its spirit scares everyone away," Reina says.

"That sounds sad. That poor Riolu," Misty says.

Mew crosses her arms and begins to think of something.

"What is it, Mew?" Brock asks.

"I don't know, something about this Lucario seems off to me. I mean, I never heard of Lucario using Nightshade before," Mew says.

Brock soon agrees, "You're right. I never heard of Lucario using Nightshade."

"Maybe because it's a ghost so it can use other attacks," Misty suggests.

"That can't be it. There has to be another explanation for it. And the only way to figure out what's going on, is to find Riolu," Mew says.

Misty soon notices, "Hey Mew, what happened to Hanter?"

Mew and the others notice that Haunter isn't among them anymore.

"Hey, where did Haunter go?" Mew asks.

"Axew is not here either," Tomo says.

"Maybe Haunter and Axew already went to Pokemon Tower," Brock says.

"We gotta find them," Mew says.

Meanwhile, Haunter and Axew are already at Pokemon Tower and see that no one is even around.

"Axew Axew Axew?" (I wonder what happened to that Lucario?) Axew asks.

"Haunter Haunter Haunter," (Not sure, but I don't think that Pokemon is really a spirit.) Haunter says.

Then floats to the tower, "Haunter." (Let's go.)

Axew simply agrees and walks inside the tower. They both walk inside and begin to explore the trail through the tower and head up to the upper floor. Haunter and Axew continue to make their way through the tower and climb to the upper floor. Suddenly, they begin to hear the sounds of weeping.

"Ew?" (What's that?) Axew wonders.

"Haunter Haunter Haunt," (I think we're not the only ones here.) Haunter says.

Haunter and Axew soon reach the next floor, and it's the one where Axew is familiar with. This is the floor where his mother's grave is. They both begin walking around and on the other side of the floor, close to the staircase, is the Riolu that is weeping and has its paws covering its eyes. The little Riolu is sitting on the floor and is very sad.

A little surprised, Axew says, "Ew Axew." (It's the Riolu from before.)

"Haunter Haunter?" (Wonder why it's here?) Haunter questions.

Axew looks to see Riolu is standing at a grave. Then ends up with a flashback of how sad he was when his mother died. To Axew, maybe the little Riolu feels the same way. Axew then begins to make his way towards the Riolu. The little Riolu is so in despair that it doesn't know Axew is secretly advancing to it.

Just then, Axew calmly calls out, "Axew?" (Riolu?)

The Riolu becomes startled and turns its head to see the Axew before her.

The little Riolu softly asks, "Ri Riolu?" (Who… who are you?)

"Axew. Ew Ew Axew. Ew Axew?" (I'm Axew. It's very nice to meet you. Can we talk?) Axew replies.

The Little Riolu feels a little reluctant about this, but seeing how nice Riolu is, it decides to give Axew a chance.

Meanwhile, Mew, Reina, and the others are now standing in front of Pokemon Tower and suspect this is where Axew and Haunter could have gone off to.

"You really think they could have gone in there?" Misty asks.

"It's the only place I can think of. This is where Haxorus' grave is and this is where Haunters' friends live. So I suspect they probably came here after we got separated" Mew says.

"She has a point," Reina says.

"Yeah. You're right," Misty says.

Togpei and Pichu are weary about the Pokemon Tower and quickly hide in Misty's backpack in fright.

"The poor dears," Mew says, worried.

Then Meloetta and Skwovet hide behind Tomo, frightened of the haunted house.

"This place does look creepy," Tomo says, feeling a little scared.

"I know. It looks more spooky than the last time we were here," Mew says.

Then says, "But we need to find Axew and Haunter. And maybe we'll find the little Riolu here as well," Mew says.

"Let's go find them before the ghost finds us," Brock says.

The group then begins to walk inside the Pokemon Tower, unaware that someone has watched them go inside the tower.

The person is an elderly woman with black eyes and grayish blonde hair. She has a long sleeve purple dress with a white collar and a gem pin in the middle, she has white apron, gray socks, and purple mary janes, the same color as the dress. She is also holding a cane in her hand as well.

"Hmmm," The elderly woman replies.

In the Pokemon Tower, Mew and her friends are walking around the tower and looking around. This time, they're able to have some flashlights and use them to see in the dark place.

Mew calls out, "Axew. Haunter."

"Haunter," Misty calls out.

Then Brock calls out, "Axew."

"Pika Pika?" (Where are you?) Pikachu asks.

Eevee calls out, "Eevee Eevee," (Where are you, guys?)

"I don't see them," Misty says.

"Maybe they're on the upper floor where Haxorus' grave is," Mew says.

"Maybe that's where they are?" Reina wonders.

"Only one way to find out," Brock says.

With that, the group continues to walk up the stairs to the floor where Haxorus' grave is. When they arrive up to the floor and where Haxorus' grave is, Haunter and Axew aren't there.

"They're not here," Reina says.

"That's strange. I was sure they were here," Mew says.

Then Brock suggests, "Maybe they're with Gastly and Gengar?"

"Then our best bet is to go to the top floor and see if they're there," Mew says.

Suddenly, the fog begins to roll inside the building.

"What's going on now?" Misty asks.

"I got a bad feeling about this," Mew says.

Just then, the ghost of the Shiny Lucario appears in front of them.

"It's Lucario's ghost!" Misty panics.

Just then, the Ghost of Lucario performs Nightshade and aims it towards the group.

"Look out!" Reina panics.

Everyone quickly dodges out of the way. Just then, the spirit of Lucario performs other attacks like Shadow Ball. Brock and Reina dodges the attack.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

With that, Pikachu and Eevee perform the attack. Suddenly, Lucario uses Psychic to repel the attack of Thunderbolt and have them move around it, and head towards Pikachu and Eevee, and strike them both.

"Pikachu! Eevee!" Mew panics, concern.

Mew kneels down to them in concern, "Are you both okay?"

"That Lucario is powerful," Misty says.

"I think you're right, but it's strange that it can use Nightshade," Brock says.

"You're right. Something strange is going on here," Mew says.

Quickly quickly dodge out of the way as the attacks Lucario continues keep coming at them. Suddenly, the ghost stops attacking and makes its way up the stairs. Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet see it going up stairs along with a mysterious shadow. Curious, Tomo and his Pokemon follow up the stairs after them.

Hiding behind the graves, Mew and the others, including the Pokemon are able to peek out to see the ghost is gone.

"Okay, I think I have enough of this! I say we get out of here!" Misty panics in fear.

"We can't leave now. Axew and Haunter are still here somewhere," Mew says.

Brock looks around and notices, "Wait, where's Tomo?!"

The girls look around to notice Tomo is gone.

"Oh no! Tomo!" Mew panics.

Tomo along with Meloetta and Skwovet secretly watch the ghost of Lucario up the stairs. Tomo and his pokemon continue to follow Lucario up until they reach the top floor. Once on the top floor, Tomo and his Pokemon quickly hide behind the pillar to see. Suddenly, they see something that is shocking. The Lucario jumps in the air and changes its shape entirely.

What they see is a slate gray, fox-like Pokémon with darkish gray and blue accents. Its ears are triangular with dark insides, and it has a large tuft of fur tipped with blue on top of its head. It has burgundy colored eyes with blue eyelids. There are circular, blue markings above the eyes that resemble eyebrows. Its muzzle is short and tapered with two small fangs seen in the upper jaw when its mouth is open, dark gray fur around its neck and four short limbs tipped with blue. Its tail is short and bushy.

"A Pokemon?" Tomo whispers.

Just then, appearing in front of the Fox Pokemon is a spherical Pokémon that appears to be covered by a gray cloth. Black rings surround its multicolored eyes, which have light-blue sclerae, dark-blue irises, and yellow pupils. Extending from the top of its head is a long, pointed horn.

Soon, the two look at each other and let out chuckles with grins on their faces.

Tomo turns to Meloetta and Skwovet, "We gotta tell the others about this."

Meloetta and Skwovet nod their heads in reply.

Tomo and his Pokemon are able to sneak away and quietly walk down the stairs. Mew and her friends look around to find Tomo and his Pokemon.

"Where could Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet have gone off to?" Misty wonders.

"Perhaps they went to the upper floor to follow that ghost," Brock says.

"We gotta find them, and fast," Mew says.

"You're going to need some help," An elder woman's voice says.

The group quickly turns their heads in fright to see the elderly woman with grayish blonde hair with a purple outfit and brown cane. They all sigh in relief to see that it's a grown woman and not another ghost.

"Oh, you scared us," Mew says.

The woman chuckles and says, "There's no need to apologize, but I can see that you have a little problem."

Reina is surprised, "Wait, aren't you Agetha? The Elite Four who specializes in Ghost Type Pokemon?"

The group becomes surprised to hear this woman is one of the Elite Four like Lorelei and Bruno.

"Yes. I am, and I couldn't help that you all have a ghost problem," The woman, Agetha says.

"Yeah. We do. Some of our friends have gone missing," Mew says, still a little surprised.

Then explains, "My Haunter and Axew might have come here alone. You see, my Axew's mother is buried here and Haunter has some friends here, so I suspect they are here."

"Then the ghost of Lucario keeps attacking us," Misty adds.

"And now we've got separated from Tomo, who was also with us, and his Pokemon," Brock says.

"I had a feeling you'll be running into trouble so that's why I've come," Agetha says.

"We could really use your help," Reina says.

"Yeah. And that ghost seems pretty powerful. And in fact, I don't think that ghost is really a ghost," Mew says.

"She's right," Tomo's voice answers.

Mew and the others turn their heads to see Tomo hurrying towards them as he runs down the stairs.

"Tomo, there you are!" Mew says, relieved.

"Where did you disappear to?" Misty asks.

"I'm okay, but I saw Lucario, that wasn't a ghost, it's a different Pokemon," Tomo says.

"You mean a Ghost Pokemon?" Reina asks.

"Not really, but a Ghost Pokemon was involved. The Lucario is actually a different Pokemon that was able to change its shape, but it's not a Ditto either," Tomo says.

"So in other words…." Brock says.

Then Misty cuts in, "We've been tricked!"

"Seems so, but why would two Pokemon go through the trouble to scare us?" Mew says, trying to think.

"I wonder if that Riolu knows anything about it," Brock says.

"Well, we gotta find that Riolu and find out. We also still need to find Axew and Haunter," Mew says.

Right on cue, they hear a familiar voice, "Axew!" (Mew!)

Mew quickly turns her head with a smile to see Axew and Haunter, what's more Gastly and Gengar are with them, and another Pokemon is with them.

"Axew, Hanter, there you are? And I see you two have brought you friends," Mew says.

Then Mew notices the Riolu next to Axew, "Riolu, what are you doing here?"

"Riolu Riolu. Ri Ri Riolu" (I was visiting my mom, until I met Axew, Haunter, and their friends,) Riolu answers.

"Axew Axew Axew Axew," (Turns out the ghost is actually its friends Zorua and Shuppet.) Axew says.

"Who?" Mew says confused.

Reina looks ahead, "Look over there."

The group looks ahead to see Lucario's spirit again.

"Oh no, it's back," Misty panics.

"And it's not looking happy," Mew says.

With that, Lucario begins to attack them with different attacks like Nightshade, psychic, and other kinds of attacks. Mew and the others quickly dodge away and continue to move away from the attack.

"We need to stop it somehow!" Reina says.

"I don't think I'm willing to talk," Brock says.

Agetha then brings out her Pokeball, "Well then, I think it's time to put an end to these games."

Agetha then throws her Pokeball and calls out, "Go Gengar!"

With that Agetha releases her Gengar.

Then Agetha calls out, "Gengar use Hypnosis!"

With that, Agetha's Gengar flies towards Lucario's spirit and begins to perform its Hypnosis attack. Soon the Lucario begins to change its shape to the small fox Pokemon and collapses on the ground. Soon, it falls into a deep sleep. With that, the other Pokemon appears and looks at its friend with concern. Seeing its friend asleep, Riolu hurries over to it as well.

"Wow. that must be a strong attack," Misty says.

Tomo walks over to the little Pokemon and picks up the sleeping Pokemon in her arms.

Tomo turns to the others and says, "Don't worry, your friend will be fine. To be honest, I kind of figured out it was your friend who was pretending to be Lucario."

Riolu and the other Pokemon are surprised to hear it.

As they leave, Axew explains that he and Haunter get separated after Lucario's first attack, and end up heading to Pokemon Tower. They all meet with Riolu and decide to hang out. As it turns out, Riolu is the child of Lucario that has lost it's life. Zorua and the Shuppet found it and they all stayed together. Turns out, the stuff that's been going is Zorua and Shuppet's form of prank.

Sometime later at the Pokemon House, the fog begins disappearing and the ghost problem has come to an end. Mew and the others watch the sleeping Pokemon until it begins to wake up. The Fox Pokemon wakes up to see the others and gets into a panic in fright.

Tomo kneels to the Pokemon and pets it, "It's okay. We're not going to hurt you."

"Yeah, but we didn't really appreciate you turning into a ghost and attacking us," Mew says.

Then turns to Riolu and the other Pokemon, "And that goes for you two as well."

Riolu and its friends bow their heads and apologize, even the fox Pokemon.

"I wonder what kind of Pokemon they are?" Misty asks.

"Axew said that they're called Zorua and Shuppet," Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Seeing it, Dexter says, "Shuppet, the Puppet Pokemon. A Ghost Type. Shuppet grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people."

"Sounds a bit spooky," Misty says.

Mew turns the Pokedex to the fox Pokemon.

Dexter says," Zorua, the Tricky Fox Pokemon. A Dark Type. Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child."

"Wow. So it's able to change its shape, even into Pokemon," Mew says.

Agetha says, "Well, it's glad to see the situation with the ghost has been solved, and I don't think they'll be doing that trick again."

Then turns to Mew, "I suspect that you're Mew from Pallet Town, correct?"

"Um yeah. How do you know?" Mew asks.

"Why my dear Professor Oak and I knew each other. We were rivals back when we were trainers," Agetha says.

"And you're still a strong trainer," Brock says.

"Thank you," Agetha says.

Just then, Riolu, Zorua, and Shuppet turn to Tomo and gather around him. Gengar and Gastly do the same with Haunter.

"I'm beginning to think these guys want to go with you," Brock says.

"Really? Mew asks.

Haunter Gengar and Gastly nod their heads. Then Haunter brings out the three Pokeballs.

"Hey," Mew says.

Gengar and Gastly use their abilities to tap on the Pokeballs and go inside. Haunter does the same. With that, Gengar and Gastly have been caught.

"I guess that answers my question," Mew replies.

Tomo turns to Riolu and it's friends, "You wanna come with me."

The three happily nod their heads.

Tomo brings out his Pokeballs, "Alright then. Welcome to the group."

Tomo then taps his Pokeballs on the three Pokemon and they go inside. With a click, they both are in their Pokeballs.

"Well, it looks like we have caught some new and old friends," Mew says.

Mew and Tomo release their Pokemon friends and begin to be with them with fun and excitement.

Agetha walks over to Mew and Tomo and says, "I can see that you truly cherish your Pokemon. I would like to give you and young Tomo something."

Mew and Tomo become interested and Agetha reaches into her pocket and gives Mew a light purple gem with a purple and red color design inside. Then gives Tomo a round gem that is pink with gray and yellow on the inside.

Mew becomes surprised, "Mega stones."

"That's right. They're for your Gengar and Shuppet. Mew, you have a Gengarite for your Gengar to Mega Evolve. And Tomo, you have Banettite for when your Shuppet evolves into Banette," Agetha says.

"Wow. Thanks Agetha," Mew says.

"Thank you," Tomo happily says.

After that, Mew along with her friends, even Agetha are in Pokemon Tower and pay their respect to Haxorus and Lucario. After that, Mew and her friends leave Lavender Town to continue their Pokemon Journey and train for the Pokemon League.

One day in Pallet Town, Mew and her friends decide to visit Professor Oak for some last minute advice since today, they're going to head to the Indigo Plateau for the Pokemon League competition.

"So you see Professor I do like to know what I need to do now?" Mew asks.

"Well Mew, you have trained as hard as you can, despite some drawbacks.

"Yeah. I am excited about competing in the Pokemon League, but to be honest, I'm also really nervous," Mew says.

"Don't be nervous, I'm sure you'll do the best you can in the Pokemon League. Now if you want to compete, I suggest you should get going. It's going to start really soon," Professor Oak says, right.

So then after gathering their backpacks along with having some of their supplies and other needs. Mew and her friends say goodbye to their friends, and Mew's father and friends, and begin to make their way to the Indigo Plateau..

Sometime later, Mew and her friends are making their way to the Indigo Plateau where the Pokemon League will take place. Their trip has taken them to a tall grass area.

Holding her Poknav, Mew says, "Seems like this place is a shortcut to the Indigo Plateau."

"I wonder how long it will take for us to get there?" Tomo says.

"It might take a while, but I'm sure we'll be there in no time," Mew says.

Suddenly, something dashes by Mew and her friends in the tall grass, making the group come to a halt.

"What was that?" Mew wonders.

Just then, a figure leaps out of the tall grass and into the air. Then lands in front of them. A short distance away, someone is standing in a battle position.

"Who's he?" Mew asks.

"No idea," Tomo relies.

There, they see a young man a few years older than Mew. He is wearing a green kimono with black kimono pants, and Japanese sandals. He also has long black spiky hair in a ponytail. He is also holding a sword.

Misty calls out, "What are you scaring us for?"

"Forgive me, I was simply testing you. You appear to be traveling to the Pokémon League competition. Am I correct in saying so?" The mysterious boy questions, putting the sword away.

"And what if we are?" Mew questions.

"Well, then. I, Otoshi, challenge you," The boy, Otoshi says, holding his swo

Mew and her friends are confused.

Even Pikachu and Eevee are confused, "Pika? Eev?" (Challenge?)

"I've trained for a long time all alone here in the mountains. But I seek one last battle to test my strength before the Pokémon League. Do you accept my challenge?" Otoshi says.

Mew thinks a bit and says, "Sure, I'll battle you."

"And whoever loses this battle must turn over all his Pokémon badges to the one who triumphs," Otoshi says.

"All my badges?!" Mew exclaims in shock.

Then denies, "You must be crazy! I've trained hard to earn these badges! They're very important to me! Plus, I need them to compete in the Pokemon League!"

"That's right! If Mew lost her badges, she wouldn't be able to compete in the Pokémon League!" Misty says.

Then Mew turns to her friends, "Come on, guys, we gotta go."

"Maybe so, but I'm not battling you," Mew says.

"Forget it! I'm not listening to a word you say! Goodbye!" Mew says, and walks off with her friends.

Otoshi then leaps in front of Mew and demands, "I suggest you have a battle with me, or I will not let you pass."

Mew can see how serious Otoshi is and it seems that he's serious about it.

"Marowak," (You're welcome.) Marowak says.

Otoshi asks, "Will you battle by my side in the Pokémon League?"

"Marowak" (I'd be honored.) Marowak says.

Soon, the two rekindle their friendship.

Mew says, "I'm glad you two are back together."

"Thanks to you," Otoshi says.

Misty then hands the box of his badges to Otoshi, "Here are your badges. Safe and sound."

Otoshi takes the box, "I will be forever in your debt. Now our dream of competing in the Pokémon League will come true. Isn't that right, Marowak?"

"Marowak," (That's right.) Marowak says.

Mew and the others smile.

Misty turns to Mew and says, "I'm sure happy we helped get those badges back.

"Yeah," Mew says.

Brock then says to Mew, "You know something, Mew? Even if we are late for the start of the Pokémon League competition, you did the right thing by stopping and helping somebody who really needed help."

"Thanks, Brock. I hope we do the right thing at the Pokémon League, too," Mew says.

"Pikachu," (I do, too.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee," (Me three.) Eevee says.

Soon, Mew and her friends parted ways from Otoshi and Marwak and continued their journey.

Later as the sun sets, Mew and her friends look yonder to see their destination.

"Hey, look! There's the Indigo Plateau!" Brock says.

"Let's go!" Mew happily says.

Mew and her Pokemon make a run to reach their destination and to the Pokemon League Championship.

Chapter 79: Episode 73: The Scaly Road to Victory

Continuing on their journey, Mew and her friends are still on the path of the Pokemon League Competition at the Indigo Plateau. Mew is still excited and nervous about competing in the league and having to face so many different trainers. Luckily, her friends' support has made her feel better.

Just then, Mew and her friends are now standing in front of the entrance to a large tunnel.

Misty reads the sign and says, "Victory Road. This must be the right place"

"According to the Pokenav, we're actually almost there. We just need to get through this tunnel," Mew says, looking at the Pokenav.

"Cool, we get to go through a cool tunnel," Tomo happily says.

"We're almost to the Indigo Plateau and to the Pokemon League," Brock says.

"We will have to be careful. There could be a lot of tunnels for us to go through," Mew says.

"Well then, let's go," Misty says.

With that, Mew and her friends walk into the tunnel of Victory Road and continue their journey to the Pokemon League. The group begin to follow the path in the tunnel and look around to see the many different Pokemon living there. Pokemon like Zubats, Golbats, Paras, Sandshrew, or other Pokemon that like to live in caves. Over time, Mew and the others notice something off because they end up finding themselves in front of a dead end.

"Huh? This isn't the way out," Misty says.

"Maybe we took a wrong turn. Let's head back and try another," Mew says.

And that's what they did. They go back and try a different direction, but they find themselves at a few different dead ends, a large river, a cliff, and other places. Soon, Mew and her friends find themselves completely lost.

Misty groans and says, "Oh no! Don't tell me we're lost again!"

"It seems so. And it appears my Pokenav is not picking up a signal in the cave," Mew says, having her Pokenav out.

Brock looks at the map and says, "It's a bit hard to read the map in this lighting."

"So what do we do?" Tomo asks.

"The only thing we can do. We'll have to go back to the entrance and see if we can get better readings in our direction," Mew says.

"Yeah. I don't want to be lost in this cave," Misty says.

With that, Mew and her friends begin to go back the way they came so they can get a better idea on finding their way to the other side. They've been walking for quite a while until they stop to feel the ground shaking.

"What's that?" Mew wonders.

"What's what?" Misty asks.

"I think Mew's right. I felt like the ground shook for a minute," Brock says.

Suddenly, the ground where they're standing gives weight and collapses. Soon, everyone begins falling down the tunnel as they scream in fear as they fall through the hole.

Suddenly, they hear a voice, "Hey, are you okay?"

Soon, Mew groans and begins to open her eyes as the voice asks again, "Are you all alright? That was a nasty fall you guys had."

Mew looks up to see a tall, thin man with bright scarlet red spiked hair, pale skin, and dark eyes. He wears a medieval-looking navy blue tunic with red-orange trim, a brown belt around his waist, and large black boots with orange two rings around the top of each boot. The cuffs of his long sleeves are black with orange zigzagging trim separating the cuff from the navy blue part of the sleeve. He sports a long, flowing cape around his neck which is black on the outside and crimson red on the inside.

Mew grunts and groans in pain as she begins to sit up.

The man helps her as he says, "Easy now. You might still be out of it from the fall you had."

Mew still feels a bit dizzy from the fall she has and looks to see the man helping her sit up.

She then asks, "Where… where are my friends?"

Suddenly, Mew begins to hear groans and grunts and turns to see Misty and the others regaining consciousness as well.

"Wha-what happened?" Brock asks, sitting up.

Misty places her hand on her head, "I think I hit my head."

"Ow! My head hurts!" Tomo says.

Soon, the other Pokemon begin to wake up as well.

"What happened?" Misty asks.

"Where are we?" Brock wonders.

Mew answers, "I have no idea."

Just then, the man says, "You all fell through the hole in the cave."

"A hole?" Tomo says, confused.

All four look up and are surprised to see the giant hole above them.

"We must have fallen deep underground," Mew says.

Misty pancis, "Don't tell me we're stuck down here."

"Don't worry, I know my way around the caves, so I can help you out," The man says.

Misty and the others turn to notice the man before them.

Then asks, "Still, are you and your Pokemon okay?"

"I think so," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee reply with a nod. So do Tomo, Meloetta, and Skwovet.

Then Mew begins her introduction, "I'm Mew, and these are my partners, Eevee and Pikachu."

Pikachu and Eevee reply, "Pika/Eevee." (Hello.)

"I'm Tomo, and these are my pals, Meloetta and Skwovet," Tomo says.

"Meloetta." (Nice to meet you.) Meloetta says.

"Skwov," (Hi.) Skwovet replies.

"I'm Misty, and these are Togepi and Picu," Misty says.

"And I'm Brock," Brock says.

"A pleasure to meet you guys. My name is Lance," The man says.

Hearing the name and seeing his appearance Brock asks, "Lance? You wouldn't have to be Lance of the Elite Four who specializes in Dragon Types."

"That's right," Lance says.

Mew and the others become surprised to hear that they have met the final of the Elite Four. Soon after the introduction, Mew and her friends walk with Lance down the tunnel a little as they discuss the incident.

"I see. So you're planning on competing at the Pokemon League at the Indigo Plateau, right Mew?" Lance asks.

"Yeah. I'm able to get my eight badges here to compete, but we ended up getting lost while traveling through victory road," Mew says.

"Not to mention falling down that deep hole," Misty says.

"And we need to find a way out of this cave," Brock says.

"And now we don't know about getting out of here," Tomo says.

"Don't worry, I think I can help you find the way out of the caves and get you to the right road to the Indigo Plateau," Lance says.

"Thanks Lance, but what are you doing here of all places?" Mew replies.

"Well, there's actually a special training course I have built here deep in the caves for wild and lost Dragon Type Pokemon," Lance explains.

"Really? A training course for Dragon Types," Brock says, interested.

"Yeah. You guys wanna see?" Lance answers.

"Yeah!" Tomo happily answers.

Soon, Mew and her friends are being escorted by Lance as they walk down the tunnel to find the training course for Pokemon.

But somewhere in Victory Road, the Team Rocket members, Cassidy and Butch are searching around for a special mission.

"Victory Road. Close to Kanto Region's Pokemon League. Sure bring back memories to when I was a young trainer," Cassidy says.

"Really? You competed?" Butch asks.

"Yes, but it was a long time ago. It's in the past now. Right now, we need to find that special Dragon Type training grounds," Cassidy says.

"Yeah. Think of all the Dragon Type Pokemon within these caves," Butch says.

Then Cassidy says, "But we have to be discreet about it. The Dragon Type Training course is run by none other than Lance, the Dragon Type Elite Four and G-Man."

"Right. We do not want to run into him," Butch says.

Cassidy and Butch continue to walk down the tunnel to find the training course.

Meanwhile, Lance leads Mew and her friends to the Dragon Type training ground. Mew and her friends are amazed to see the training course is also like an obstacle course, specialized for Dragon Type Pokemon. There are ramps, ropes, tunnels, slides, balancing beams, and trampolines. There's even a battlefield. There are also so many different Dragon Type Pokemon, some are also from different regions.

"Here we are. The Dragon Type Pokemon training camp," Lance presents the course to the group.

"Wow. There are so many different kinds of Dragon Type Pokemon," Misty says.

"Yeah. Many of the Pokemon are either wild Pokemon or orphans," Lance says.

"Orphans? That sounds sad," Mew says.

Just then, Borck says, "Hey Mew, you have a couple of Dragon Type Pokemon too."

"Yeah. Maybe they'll like to play on the training course too," Mew says.

Then Mew turns to Lance and asks, "Can I?"

"Sure," Lance says.

Then throws her Pokeball, "Alright then. Dratini. Axew. Go!"

With that, Dratini and Axew come out of their Pokeballs.

"Wow. You don't see many Axew's around here, and you have a nice Dratini, and a shiny one at that," Lance says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

Tomo then calls out, "Let me show you mine. Go Tyrunt!"

With that, Tyrunt comes out of its Pokeball and is happy.

Tomo pats Tyrunt, "Hi Tyrunt!"

The little Pokemon growls happily in reply.

"I never seen a Tyrunt before, and from the looks of it, I can tell you've been taking good care of it," Lance says.

"Thanks Lance," Tomo happily says.

Just then, a large Dragonite walks over.

Lance walks to it, and says, "This is my partner, Dragonite."

"Wow. It's really big," Tomo says.

"Yeah," Mew says.

Then says in thought, "Though, not as big as the Dragonite I met at Bill's lighthouse."

Misty says, "It looks really strong."

"Yeah," Tomo says.

Just then, Lance's Dragonite turns his head down to see the little Shiny Dratini looking at it with sparkles in its eyes, and the expression of admiration.

Mew giggles and kneels to Dratini, "I bet you like to be big and strong as Lance's Dragonite, huh?"

Shiny Dratini eagerly nods her head in reply.

"Axew Axew!" (I wanna be strong and evolve too!) Axew says, excited.

Mew giggles and pats Axew on the head, "Don't worry Axew, I know you'll become strong someday. And you'll evolve when you're ready."

"Axew," (Yeah!) Axew happily says.

Suddenly, Misty lets out a yelp in fright.

Mew turns around, "What's wrong, Misty?"

"So-So-Somthing's slimy is cl-climbing on my back!" Misty says, freaking out and her body shaking.

Just then, climbing on her right shoulder is a Pokémon that resembles a slug or a slime with beady black eyes. The lower half of its body is light purple, while the upper half is a paler shade of purple. Along the dividing line of the two colors are five large, green spots. The front part of this line is its mouth. On top of its head are two pairs of antenna-like horns; the hind pair is longer than the front pair.

"Goomy!" The Pokemon calls out.

"Wow! What is that Pokemon?" Tomo asks, surprised.

"I've ever seen that one before," Mew says, and brings out her Pokedex.

Then Dexter says, "Goomy, the Soft Tissue Pokemon. A Dragon Type. Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It's considered the weakest dragon Pokémon."

"The weakest?" Mew says, confused.

Misty calms down a little to see the Pokemon smile.

She smiles back and says, "Um hi, it's nice to meet you."

"Goomy," (You too.) Goomy happily says.

With that, it begins to nibble on Misty's ear, making her laugh uncontrollably.

She continues laughing and says, "Stop… tha-that tickles…"

Mew laughs and says, "I think that Goomy really likes you, Misty."

"I-I-I can tell…" Misty says, still laughing from Goomy nibbling on her ear.

"Yeah. It kind of did the same to me when I first met it," Lance says.

Just then, two more Pokemon appear towards Axew and Dratini.

One of them is a bipedal, blue, reptilian Pokémon vaguely resembling Pachycephalosaurus. It possesses a large, round snout, triangular eyes, yellow, circular ears similar to reptiles, and a yellow lower jaw with two teeth protruding upwards. Three thick, gray ridges cover the top of its head and continue downwards to cover its neck as well. There is a triangular patch of yellow on its underside. It has stubby, digit-less arms and short legs with two toes on each foot.

The second is a small blue quadrupedal Pokémon with black fur covering its head and neck, concealing everything but its mouth from view. The fur around its neck also has six purple spots encircling it, which resemble bruises. The hair on the top of its head takes the shape of a single small horn. It also has a short tail that appears to be bitten off.

"Wow. There's a Bagon here too," Brock says, interested.

"And a Deino," Mew says.

Mew then points her Poedex to the blue and gray Pokemon, Dexter says, "Bagon, the Rock Hard Pokemon. A Dragon Type. Whenever it sees bird Pokémon flying through the sky, it becomes envious and smashes its surroundings to bits with headbutts."

Brock kneels down and pets Bagon on the head, "You sure have a hard head. Bet you've been training."

The Pokemon Bagon smiles. Then runs to a small boulder and smashes it to show how strong it is.

Then Mew points to the other Pokemon, Dexter says, "Deino, the Irate Pokemon. A Dark and Dragon Type. When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory."

Tomo walks to the Deino, "Hi, I'm Tomo."

The Pokemon Dieno roars happily in reply. Meloetta, Skwovet, and Tyrunt go out to greet it as well and Deino is delighted.

Mew and her Pokemon see that her friends have made friends with a Dragon type. Mew turns her head to notice a Pokemon hiding behind one of the rocks close by.

The Pokemon hiding is a small, green Pokémon resembling a reptile or amphibian. It has yellow eyes, pink horns, and a light green tail with two hand-like protrusions at the front of its body, while its head is a darker green. Its tail also possesses a darker green area with three protrusions surrounding it.

Curious, Axew and Dratini make their way to the Pokemon. But when they try to say hi to the Pokemon, it quickly hides behind the rock, and shakes like a leaf, like it's scared. Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew approach it to see it a little scared.

"What's that Pokemon?" Mew wonders to herself.

She brings out the Pokedex and Dexter says, "Dreepy, the Lingering Pokémon. A Dragon and Ghost Type. After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas."

Lance walks towards them, "That Dreepy is new, so it can be shy when it comes to strangers."

"I see," Mew says.

Then she turns to the shy Pokemon and keels down on her knees. Once she sits down, and gives it a gentle and kind smile.

Then says, "It's okay. No need to be scared. We want to meet you."

The Pokemon, Dreepy, turns to Mew to see her, who is still holding a smile on her face. Dreepy slowly approaches Mew as the girl has her hand out. Then rubs its head against her hand. Mew smiles and gently picks up Dreepy.

"Hi Dreepy," Mew says.

The Pokemon smiles and says a little shyly, "Dreepy." (Hello.)

"You're so sweet," Mew says.

Axew, Dratini, Pikachu, and Eevee happily greet Dreepy. Deepy is a little shy, but with Axew and Dratini's help, Dreepy is able to open up a little more. Mainly because they're Dragon Pokemon too.

As Mew and her friends are getting acquainted with the Dragon Type Pokemon as Lance and Dragonite watch, Cassidy and Butch are able to find the entrance and see the obstacle course with the Dragon Type Pokemon on it.

"Finally. I thought we were going to get lost here," Cassidy says.

"At least we found it and now we find a lot of different dragon type Pokemon," Butch says.

Cassidy brings out her Pokeball, "Glad we're supplied with Ice Type and Fairy Type Pokemon. Weakening them will be a piece of cake."

"It will be like taking a candy from a Togepi," Butch says, holding out his Pokeball.

Cassidy and Butch smirk and plan to take the Dragon Type Pokemon.

Back at the training course, Mew and her friends are having fun with the Dragon Pokemon. When Goomy sees Togepi, it becomes scared and hides behind Misty.

"What's wrong Goomy?" Misty asks.

"I think Goomy feels a bit Timid around Togepi," Mew says.

"Togei?" (Timid?) Togepi says, confused.

Then it walks Goomy with curiosity, but it flinches in reply.

Misty kneels to Togepi, "Goomy, it's okay. Togepi just wants to be friends."

Goomy looks at Togepi who is very happy, with Pichu next to him. Goomy walks to Togepi and Pichu and the two begin to become friends.

"That's good to see them becoming friends," Brocks says.

"Yeah. I have to wonder why Goomy felt timid around Togepi," Misty replies.

"It's probably because Togepi is a Fairy type. Dragon Types are weak to Fairy Types after all," Mew says.

"She's right. Of course, Dragon types are weaker against Ice Type Pokemon," Brock says.

"Well, we don't need to worry about any Ice Type Pokemon here," Lance says.

Suddenly, they begin to hear loud explosions, and banging sounds.

"What was that?" Misty asks.

"I think we got trouble," Tomo says.

Somewhere at the training grounds, Butch and Cassidy are using their Pokemon to steal the Pokemon. Cassidy has her fairy type Pokemon: a Clefairy and a Mr. Mime. Bucth has Ice Type Pokemon: A Jynx and a Delibird. Cassidy and Butch have their Pokemon attack the Dragon Types. Even freezing them or making them fall asleep. Then have their Mr. Mime and Jynx levitate them to a large bag close by.

"Well, it looks like we're putting those Dragon Types on ice," Cassidy jokes.

"It's a Fairy good thing we brought our Pokemon that can defeat Dragon Types," Butch says.

"And there's nothing anyone can do about it," Cassidy says.

"Hey!" Mew's voice calls out.

Cassidy and Butch look ahead to see Mew, her friends, Lance, and the other Pokemon hurrying towards them.

"What are you doing with those Pokemon?!" Brock demands.

Seeing them, Misty gasps, "Oh no! Not you two!"

With that, they perform the Team Rocket motto.

Cassidy:

Prepare for trouble

Butch:

And make it double!

Cassidy:

To infect the world with devastation!

Butch:

To blight all people in every nation!

Cassidy:

To denounce the goodness of truth and love!

Butch:

To extend our wrath to the stars above!

Cassidy:

Cassidy.

Butch:

Butch.

Cassidy:

We're Team Rocket, circling Earth all day and night!

Butch:

Surrender to us now, or you will surely lose the fight!

Cassidy:

That's right!

"It's those guys from Team Rocket!" Brock says, shocked.

"Butch and Cassidy!" Tomo adds, angrily.

"I heard about your organization! You've been causing a lot of trouble in Kanto and stealing Pokemon from trainers!" Lance says.

"That's right. And now we're here to take these precious Dragon Types," Cassidy says.

"What are you going to do with those Pokemon?!" Misty demands.

"Why else? These Pokemon are perfect for Team Rocket and we'll present them to our boss," Butch says.

Mew brings out her Pokeball, "Not if we have anything to say about it! Charizard, Muk go!"

Soon, Charizard comes out of their Pokeballs.

"We'll help too. Go Tentacruel!" Misty says.

Brock calls out, "Go Rhydon!"

"Come on out, Growlithe and Riolu!" Tomo calls out.

Soon, all of Mew and her friends' Pokemon are out of the Pokeballs.

"So it's the hard way, Wiggytuff, use Headbutt!" Cassidy calls out.

Wigglytuff charges to perform the attack.

Misty calls out, "Tentacruel, use Bubble Beam!"

Tentacruel fires and strikes at Wigglytuff.

"Jynx, use Ice Beam!" Butch calls out, and Jynx performs the attack.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, use Flamethrower!"

Charizard fires its Flamethrower and counters with the Ice Beam.

Then Lance calls out, "Dragonite, use Fire Punch!"

"Delibird, use Ice Punch on that Dragonite!" Butch calls out.

Delibird flies over and tries to Ice Punch Dragonite.

"Not so fast! Growlithe, use Flame Wheel!" Tomo calls out.

Growlithe charges and makes a wheel of Flame that strokes at Delibird with full force.

Then Cassidy calls out, "Mr. Mime, use Psybeam!"

Mr. Mime strikes at Growlithe with full force and makes it fall to the ground, looking confused.

Then Cassidy calls out, "Now, use Confusion!"

"Muk, use Sludge Bomb!" Mew calls out.

Muk throws the Sludge Bomb at Mr Mime and strikes at Mr. Mime.

Then Tomo calls out, "Now Riolu, use Meal Claw!"

Riolu charges and strikes at Mr. Mime with full force.

Mew turns her head to the Pokemon, "Pikachu. Eevee. Get the others to safety!"

Pikachu and Eevee nod their heads, and instruct the Pokemon to get to safety. Eevee also carries Goomy on her back. The Pokemon begins running away as Mew and the others battle against Team Rocket. As the Pokemon are running away, Axew trips and falls over, being left behind.

Unfortunately, Butch notices it, "Well, an Axew. They're not seen in this part. Well, might as well catch this one."

Then calls out, "Jynx, freeze that Axew in its track with Ice Beam!"

Hearing this leave Mew and her friends in shock. With that, Jynx begins the attack towards Axew. Axew sees the attack and is terrified.

Mew runs over as she cries out, "Axew!"

Just then, Mew runs in front of Axew and prepares to protect it. Axew notices that it's not been hit by the Ice Beam Attack. When it turns its head, it becomes shocked to see Mew has been frozen by the attack.

The others cry out in shock, "Mew!"

Pikachu, Eevee, and the others are shocked to see Mew has been turned into a human popsicle.

To Axew, it's devastating to see Mew has been frozen, and by an Ice Type Pokemon at that.

Soon, Axew begins to have a flashback on the day his mother died. The Team Rocket members are wearing hats, and are capturing the Pokemon. When Haxorus intervenes, it tries to fight them off to protect Axew, who they try to capture next. Haxorus tells Axew to run, and begins running. When it turns around, it becomes shocked to see his mother frozen. Then Axew continues running with tears going down his face.

Seeing Mew frozen now, has Axew in tears. To Axew, Mew has become a mother to him. Then he glares at Cassidy and Butch, and determind to not to lose Mew like he lost his mom. With that, it steps forward in anger.

Then cries out in anger, "AXEW!" (Hey you!)

The others notice Axew's anger and tears on his face.

Then Axew call Team Rocket out in rage, "Axew Axew Axew Ew Ew Axew! Ew Axew!"

"Woah!" Tomo says, shocked.

"What is it, Tomo?" Misty asks.

Misty, Brock, and Lance help out with their Pokemon. Tomo and the others wait as Mew's ice prison becomes unfrozen and melted. Soon enough, Mew is unfrozen and collapses on the ground. Mew groans and sits up. Then shivers a bit.

"S-S-So c-c-cold," Mew says, shivering.

"Are you okay, Mew?" Tomo asks.

"I… I think so. Where's Axew?" Mew asks.

"Pika Pikachu," (Fighting Cassidy and Buch!) Pikachu says.

Then Eevee says, "Eevee Eevee Eevee!" (And boy is he mad!)

"Axew is what?!" Mew exclaims.

Mew turns her head to see Axew is fighting against Wigglytuff.

Cassidy calls out, "Wigglytuff use, Double Slap!"

Hearing Mew's call, makes Axew surprised, but quickly follows the command, and performs Crunch on Wigglytuff. Then turns to see Mew is no longer frozen. A little chilly, but okay. Axew cries and runs to Mew in relief. Then jumps into her arms.

"It's okay Axew, it's okay. I'm sorry I scared you," Mew says.

Axew doesn't care. He is actually crying in joy. Happy to see he hasn't lost another mother yet. Axew snuggles his cheek on Mew's chest and is very relieved.

Mew looks down on Axew and asks, "Are you okay?"

"Axew Axew Axew? Axew AxewAxew!" What about you, are you alright? I thought I lost you!" Axew says, relieved and hugs Mew some more.

"I'm alright. I'm glad you're safe," Mew says.

"Axew Axew… Axew!" (I'm glad you're still here… mommy.) Axew happily says.

Just then, Axew begins to glow, catching Mew and her friends by surprise.

"What's going on?" Misty asks.

Then Lance says, "Axew is evolving."

Axew soon begins to grow in size as it's shape changes. It's tail grows a little longer, it's tusk grows, and so does its body. Soon, the glow disappears and Axew is now a bipedal, draconic Pokémon with long, gray tusks with red tips protruding from the sides of its mouth. These tusks are capable of breaking boulders. It has dark eyes with red irises, a gray face, and a cowl-like feature of green segments on its head, neck, back, and chest. Its arms have three red fingers, and its lower body is gray, with red speckles on the underbelly. It has red toes and a red tip on its tail.

"Axew evolved," Brock says, surprised.

"It's a Fraxure now," Lance confirms.

Mew says, surprised, "You.. you evolved…" Then brings out her Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Fraxure, the Axe Jaw Pokemon and the evolved form of Axew. A Dragon Type. Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure's favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time."

"Wow. You evolved," Mew happily says.

Then hugs Fraxure, "I'm so proud."

"Fraxure," (Thanks.) Fraxure happily says.

Just then, Cassidy says, "Hey! If you're done with the mushy stuff! We still have a battle to finish!"

"Why you…" Mew angrily says.

Just then, Fraxure steps forward and performs a Giga Impact at the four Pokemon, and strikes them all with full force. Then performs a few powerful Dragon Type moves and with one strike, knocks all the Pokemon out. Mew and the others are shocked and amazed.

"What movie was that?" Misty asks.

"That's Dragon Pulse," Brock says.

"Fraxure probably learned that move after evolving," Lance says.

Mew says in amazement, "Wow Fraxure, you've learned Dragon Pulse!"

Cassidy and Butch are still stunned to see this.

"I say we get out of here with the…" Butch says.

However, when they turn around. They notice the bag with the Pokemon is missing.

"Where are the Pokemon?!" The two exclaim in shock.

They turn to see that the Pokemon is able to sneak the Dragon Pokemon away and with Growlithe and Charizard's help, those who have been frozen are free and unharmed.

Lance turns to Mew, "Hey Mew, let's finish this up together."

"Right!" Mew says.

Lance calls out, "Dragonite!"

"Fraxure!" Mew calls out.

Then they call out, "Dragon Pulse!"

With that both Dragon Pokemon fire their attacks at the same time, and blast them with one blow. Soon, the blast themes them flying out of the cave and into the air.

They both scream, "We're blasting off like those losers!"

Soon, Team Rocket is gone.

After that, Lance leads Mew and the others outside of the cave. Soon, Mew and her friends can see a town and see the stadium, a few distances away.

We're almost there," Mew says.

As it turns out Dreepy, Goomy, Bagon, and Deino want to go with Mew and the others. Mew is holding Dreepy with Dratini, Pikachu and Eevee are standing next to her with Fraxure. Goomy is sitting on Misty's shoulder with Pichu and holding Togepi. Brock is holding Bagon, and Tomo is standing with Meloetta and Deino, with Skwovet on his shoulder.

Mew and her friends continue on with the adventure to the Pokemon League on their minds, especially Mew. Mew and her friends each gain a Dragon Type Pokemon, and Axew has evolved to Fraxure. Chapter 80: Episode 74: All Fired Up!

Mew and her friends continue to walk on the path road and finally reach the Indigo Plateau, home of the Pokemon League. Everyone is very excited, but none of them is more excited than Mew is.

"So Mew, are you excited to compete in the Pokemon League?" Misty asks.

"I am excited, but to be honest, I'm a little nervous too," Mew says.

"Nervous?" Tomo asks.

"Yeah. I am excited that I'm going to be at the Pokemon League and compete with my Pokemon, but I'm also nervous about the competition I'm going to have to face," Mew says.

"You're right about that. There's going to be a lot of trainers who have strong Pokemon and have already got eight badges from all over the Kanto Region," Brock says.

"Let's not forget Gary. He already got his eight badges and I wouldn't be surprised if he's already there," Misty says.

"Yeah. I also need to think about what Pokemon I want to use, and know the rules of the League," Mew says.

"I'm sure you'll find out what you need to do as soon as we get there," Brock says.

"So until then, let's go to the Pokemon League," Misty says.

"You're right. I need to get registered before anything else," Mew says.

Soon enough, Mew and her friends reach the town outside of the stadium, where the competition is going to take place. When they arrive, they see tons of people, each on a different side of the street.

"What's this?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure. Maybe some event or parade is coming up before the League," Mew says.

Suddenly, they hear the crowd cheering and run right past Mew and her friends. They all turn to see a male jogger carrying a torch to the stadium with a Hitmonchan by his side. Office Jenny is riding on a motorbike with another vehicle behind.

"What is it?" Tomo asks.

"It's the torch," Brock says.

"The torch?" Mew asks.

"They use it to light the flame that burns during the whole Pokémon League competition," Misty answers.

Then Brock explains, "The flame's supposed to inspire all the trainers and Pokémon who compete in the Pokémon League. Being one of the torch bearers is a huge honor."

"There's a legend that says the flame comes from way back in ancient times from the flames of Moltres," Misty says.

"Moltres…?" Mew softly says to herself.

Then says, "Oh, I remember reading about it. Moltes is a legendary Pokemon."

She takes out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Moltres, The Flame Pokemon. A Fire and Flying type. A legendary bird Pokémon known as the 'firebird.' Every time it flaps, its wings flare and burn brightly. Its virtues symbolize the Pokémon League competitions."

Mew then looks at the torch and imagines about the legendary bird Pokemon that it has come from.

"If that flame really is lit from the flames of Moltres, then it's more than just a legend. Moltres has to be real," Mew says.

"And you want to catch one…" Misty suspects.

"Maybe, but Legendary Pokemon like Moltress deserve to be free. I always believe that many Legendary and Mythical Pokemon deserve to roam free in the wild. Although, I think Shaymin is an exception," Mew says.

"You're right, Shaymin really likes you and wants to stay," Misty says.

"You can say that again," Brock says.

Mew looks at the torch, "I wish I could carry the torch for the Pokemon League. It would have been a huge honor to carry the same as Moltres."

"Maybe someday, you will," Misty says.

"We better move out of the way. Here they come," Brock says.

Everyone agrees and moves out of the way for the torch runner to come through. Everyone cheers for excitement to see the torch running carrying the torch of the Pokemon League. Suddenly, a giant hole caves down from under him and the jogger falls down into the hole, sending the torch flying.

"Oh no!" Misty exclaims.

"The torch!" Brock says, shocked.

Mew gasps and quickly runs over and catches the torch before it falls to the ground. Mew finds herself sitting on the ground and is holding the torch in the air. Everyone is surprised, but soon cheers to see the torch has been saved. Misty and Brock hurry to the hole to help the jogger with Hitmonchan's help. Tomo and the Pokemon run to Mew.

"Are you okay, sis?" Tomo asks.

"I'm fine, but I wonder where that hole came from," Mew wonders.

Suddenly, they hear James' voice, "Up here twerps!"

"Thanks for catching the torch for us," Jessie's voice speaks up.

Mew, Tomo, and everyone else look up to see Team Rocket's hot air balloon, including Team Rocket inside the basket. With that, Team Rocket performs their motto.

Beedrill is happy to hear the compliment.

"That is quite an impressive attack young lady," A voice says.

The group turns to see an elderly man with long gray hair and a long beard too. He is wearing a red jacket, green shorts, white socks with sneakers, and a purple cap pulled behind on his head.

"Oh, hello. Who are you?" Mew replies.

Officer Jenny comes over and says, "This is the Honorable Mr Charles Goodshow, president of the Pokemon League in all the regions."

"Anyway, the runner has been injured and so I decided to ask you a favor Mew," Mr. Goodshow says.

"A favor?" Mew says, confused.

Mr. Goodshow nods his head and says, "Yes. How would you like to become a torchbearer?

"Me?" Mew says, surprised.

Then Mew became embarrassed, "I well…"

Brock then says to Mew, "You should do it. Being a torchrunner is an honor."

"Tomo and Brock are right. This is a once in a lifetime opportunity," Misty says.

Soon, Mew, and her Pokemon are backed against the wall.

Soon, Team Rocket fires.

Misty and Tomo cry out, "Mew, look out!

Soon, Mew quickly tries to protect her Pokemon, but soon, she opens her eyes to find herself in the flames, but isn't getting burned or feeling the heat. Mew and her Pokemon are shocked and yet, relieved.

Mew turns to her Pokemon, "We're okay!"

Team Rocket are especially shocked.

"What happened?" Meowth asks.

"The kid should be crisp," Jessie adds.

Soon appearing in the flame is the firebird/ legendary Pokemon, Moltres.

Mew becomes surprised and ends up smiling, "Moltres!"

Moltres then performs a dive bomb towards Team Rocket.

Frightened, Jessie says, "I, think our plan."

"Backfired!" James finishes.

Team Rocket panics as Moltres reaches towards them. With one fell swoop, Team Rocket's robot explodes and sends them flying.

They all scream, "Looks like Team Rocket's blasting off again!"

The central torch flies off as the robot is destroyed and returns to its position, and Moltres lands in the flame, lighting it.

The announcer says, "Ladies and gentlemen, the opening ceremonies will now continue. Here is President Goodshow to greet our competitors."

On the stage, Mr. Goodshow announces, "Welcome, one and all. This stadium is a very special place, a place where those who truly love Pokémon come to compete. Here, the glow from the flame of Moltres burns bright to light up their hearts and their spirits. Battle valiantly, and keep that fire alive, in your hearts and in your spirits!"

Mew, who is among the trainers, says in thought, "Thank you, Moltres. I'll keep the fire alive."

She then turns to her Pokemon and says, "Pikachu. Eevee. We finally made it to the Pokémon League."

And so the Opening Ceremony of the Pokemon League comes to a close. Chapter 81: Episode 75: Round One - Begins!

Last time, Mew and her friends have reached the Indigo Plateau where Mew will be competing in the Pokemon League. But during the opening ceremony Team Rocket tries to steal the central torch, but has been stopped by Moltres. And now, the Pokemon League can begin, with Mew as a competitor.

Back in Pallet Town, Daisy, Adrianna, Professor Oak, some of the townsfolk, many of Mew's Pokemon, including Zeraora and Gardevoir holding her large Pokemon egg are watching the TV broadcast of the Pokemon League.

"Welcome, Pokémon fans, to our live coverage of the Pokémon League competition. Right now, the trainers are about to learn where they will be competing in their first round battles and who their first opponents will be." The announcer says.

Daisy notices Mew and her friends on the screen, "Look, there's Mew! Hi!"

Back at the competition, Mew and her friends are at one of the desks to registrar.

Welcome to Pokémon Village. I need your identification so I can check you in, please," The receptionist says.

But Brock gets out in her way, " Mew can check in while I check out your beautiful smile. I could check that out all day." leaving the lady dumbfounded.

Then Misty pulls Brock aside, "It's checkout time for you, Brock.

Mew giggles with a sheepish smile and hands the receptionist her Pokedex.

The woman asks, "Is this your first time in the Pokémon League?

"Yes!" Mew answers.

The receptionist puts Mew's Pokedex into the machine and enters the information.

Once she's done, the receptionist hands Mew her Pokedex, "Well, that's it. You're all checked in."

"Thank you," Mew says.

Then she asks, "Um, miss. What are the rules for the Pokemon League?"

Just then, Brock comes in, "I can explain to you the rules."

"Sure Brock," Mew says.

Then Brock says, "At the Indigo Plateau Conference of the Pokémon League, they use four different battlefields. Rock, grass, water, and ice. You have to win your matches on all four battlefields before you can battle in the Indigo Stadium."

Then turns to the lady with a smile, "Isn't that right?"

"Oh I see. So it's like a preliminary round?" Mew replies.

"That's one way to say it," Brock says.

Then asks, "How you know that thought?"

"Because I studied this!" Brock says, and brings out a book that is titled, 'Pokémon League Trainer's Book' Then explains, "The Pokémon League Trainer's book! The source for everything, every trainer needs to know about the Pokémon League. Right, Miss?"

"That's right," The receptionist says, sweating drops.

Then Misty comes in and pushes Brock away, "Come on Brock. There's still a lot for you to…"

Mew nervously laughs to see Misty pushing Brock away. Tomo and the others are just laughing.

Mew then turns to the receptionist, "So miss, what fields do we have to battle on, first?

"All you have to do is press this button. One at a time, please. Wherever the light stops is where your first matches are. Good luck, Mew," The receptionist says.

Mew looks at the screen to see the light flashing at the four different fields. Mew then presses the button and the light slows down. Soon, the screen lands on the water drop.

Chapter 83: Episode 77: The Fourth Round Rumble

The Pokemon League at the Indigo Plateau continues on as the fourth round matches continue. Today, Mew and her friends are at the Rock Field for an important match. Gary is competing against a trainer named Melissa to decide which one of them will be the winner. And each has only one Pokemon left. Gary is using Nidoking and Melissa is using Golem.

The announcer says, "Now, Gary and Melissa are down to just one Pokémon each! Whoever wins this battle wins the match!"

"Could Gary win?" Misty asks.

"That Melissa's pretty tough," Brock says.

Mew looks at the battle stadium with a serious look, "Come on Gary, I know you can do it."

Melissa calls out, "Golem, use Stone Edge!"

Golem then begins to perform the attack.

"Quick Nidoking, use Brick Break!" Gary calls out.

Nidoking then uses Brick Break to break through the Stone Edge attacks.

Melissa calls out, "Now use Rollout!"

Golem then rolls into a ball and speed rolls towards Nidoking.

"Grab the Rollout!" Gary calls out.

With that, Nidoking grabs the Rollout and the rollout is still in process from Golem.

"Now, give it the Seismic Toss!" Gary calls out.

Nidoking then jumps in the air and performs the Seismic Toss, sending Golem crashing into the ground with a large thud. Nidoking lands on the ground as two trainers watch to see what happens. When the smoke clears, Golem is knocked out, cold.

The referee calls the result, "This battle goes to Gary!"

Everyone cheers and confetti begins to fall.

The announcer says, "He's done it! After a grueling battle, Gary Oak has won a last minute upset over Melissa for his fourth Pokémon League victory!

Mew happily cheers, "Yay!"

Gary sighs in relief to see the results. For a minute, he actually thinks he isn't going to make it.

After the match, Mew and the others arrive to greet and congratulate him.

"Congratulations Gary," Mew happily says, and gives him a hug.

Gary laughs and says, "Thanks. But getting past the four rounds is only part of it."

"I remember. I'm just happy to see you won your four matches," Mew says.

"Don't forget, you still have one more match to get to the Indigo Stadium. So how are the other friends?" Gary asks.

"We're doing fine. A.J, Otoshi, Joe, and even Nurse Joy from Fuchsia City also made it past their rounds as well," Mew says.

"Great. I assume your last round is at the Grass Field," Gary says.

"That's right," Mew says.

Mist then says, "Then we better hurry. It's going to start soon."

"Right," Mew says with a nod.

Mew thinks and suddenly, she has an idea.

Mew throws her Pokeball and calls out, "Muk, I choose you!"

With that, Muk comes out of its Pokeball, shocking Mew and the others.

"Hey, I didn't know Mew brought his Muk to the competition!" Misty says, surprised.

Professor Oak says, "Mew thought she might need Muk during this match, so she called me yesterday and asked me to transport it here."

"That's a great idea, Muk had an advantage over grass type Pokemon. So Muk will be perfect to counter Jeanette's Bellsprout," Gary says.

"I'm surprised Mew thought ahead without telling us about it," Misty says.

Tomo cheers, "Go Mew! Go Muk!"

At the battlefield, Mew says, "Okay! Ready, Muk?"

Soon, both Pokemon approach the center.

The referee calls out, "Begin!"

Jeanette calls out, "Alright, Bellsprout, Flying Muk Kick!"

Bellsprout charges and attacks, but the attack has no effect on Muk's body.

The annoncer takes notice, "And the tables have been turned on Jeanette's Bellsprout! Now Muk is absorbing the energy of Bellsprout's attacks!"

Bellsprout then begins to perform the attack over and over, but Muk isn't even feeling the attack

"Muk's taking a licking, but Bellsprout keeps on kicking!" The announcer says

Bellsprout continues to perform the attack over and over. It even picks up Muk and slams it repeatedly on the ground, but the attack is not effective at all.

"Keep it up, Muk! You're doing great!" Mew cheers.

Bellsprout even tries using Razor Leaf, but the attack bounces off, shocking both Jeanette and Bellsprout.

Then Mew calls out, "Okay, Muk, time for a Body Slam attack!"

Muk approaches Bellsprout, much to the small Pokemon's shock, and performs Body Slam and covers Bellsprout with its entire body.

Jeanette calls out "Bellsprout!"

Bellsprout then desperately tries to fight out Muk, but it's trapped under the sludge. Eventually, Bellsprout stops moving, shocking Jenaette and the whole gang. Eventually, Muk moves out of the way, revealing that Bellsprout has been knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Bellsprout is out of the match, and the fourth round victory goes to green trainer, Mew!"

Soon, it shows that Mew has won this battle.

"Yeah!" Mew cheers.

Everyone erupts in cheers.

"Alright!" Tomo cheers.

"She did it!" Daisy says.

"I can't believe Mew won on all four fields!" Misty happily says.

"That was her best match," Brock says.

Mew goes on the field and happily says, "We did it, Muk!"

"Muk Muk Muk!" (We sure did!) Muk happily says.

Then lands on Mew and gives her a hug.

Mew laughs and says, "Now I understand how that Bellsprout felt!"

Professor Oak says, "That Muk can really smother you with affection!"

Jeanette picks up her Bellsprout and says, "I'm very proud of the way you battled, Bellsprout. Let's go home."

Jeanette then proceeds to leave the field.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket has finished selling their stock.

"Well, we sold out everything," Jessie says.

"Let's face it, we're much more successful at selling stuff than we are at stealing stuff," James says.

"You're right. It's fun, and profitable, too!" Jessie says.

"Ha! The next thing you know, you two will want to open a fast food joint!" Meowth says.

Jessie takes an interest in the idea, "That's not a bad idea! We can call it Jessie's!"

"James'," Meowth says.

Then begins talking like they're doing their Team Rocket Motto.

Jessie:

Want a burger and fries without trouble?

James:

If you're really hungry, make it double.

Jessie:

To protect the world from hunger and thirst.

James:

Our food isn't bad, at least, not the worst.

Jessie:

The Team Rocket restaurant, blast in for a bite.

Jessie and James:

We stay open all day, we stay open all night.

As Jessie and James walk out of the arena, Mew and her friends are in the locker room

"You really did a great job," Misty says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

Then Misty says, "But if it wasn't for Muk, you'd have been out of luck."

With that, Muk tries to hug Misty, but the girl tries to get Muk off of her, and everyone begins laughing in reply.
