Chapter 84: Episode 78: A Friend In Deed

After being able to win all four of her matches, Mew and the others are heading back to Pokemon Village to celebrate the victory. Now that Mew and Gary have won their four matches, they can move on to the Indigo Stadium for their battles.

"Hey, I'm really hungry," Misty says.

"We should all have a big meal to celebrate you guys' big victories!" Brock says.

"Yeah. Let's eat out today and have some fun," Mew says.

Everyone else is excited as well. Once they reach the cabin, they see Adriana, Daisy, Professor Oak, Zeraora, and Gardevoir.

"Hi papa," Mew happily says and runs to Zeraora.

Zeraora walks over and the two instantly hug each other.

Mew turns to Gardevoir, "Hi Gardevoir."

"Gardevoir," (Hello.) Gardevoir says with a smile.

Adraiana walks to Gary and says, "Hi Gary."

"Hello," Professor Oak says.

"Hey mom. Hi sis. You too, grandpa," Gary says.

"I was quite impressed with the way you battled out there, Mew," Professor Oak says.

Adriana happily sas, "I'm so proud of you both."

"I am too. You both did a great job with your matches," Daisy says.

"Thanks," Mew and Gary say.

Then Adriana happily says, "You have to keep your strength up while you both compete, so I'm making your favorite meals for you.

"You are?" Mew and Gary say, confused.

Adriana laughs and says, "Leave that to me."

Later on, Mew and her friends arrive at the tallest building of Pokemon Village, more specifically on the tenth floor. Adriana is actually cooking up the storm in the kitchen for Mew and Gary, leaving the kitchen staff speechless.

Confused, the chef says, "Our customers, do not come here to cook."

"Well, maybe they should try it. Gary, Daisy, Mew! Dinner's almost ready!" Adriana says.

Everyone is practically sweating bullets to see this.

"We sure can't wait," Mew and Gary says, a little surprised.

"This is either gonna be very good or very bad," Misty says.

Daisy chuckles and says, "Trust me, my mom makes the best food."

In no time at all, everyone is seated at the table and amazed to see the food before them.

"Well, how does it look?" Adriana asks.

"It looks great!" Everyone answers.

Soon, everyone begins to eat dinner. Everyone, even the Pokemon are even enjoying it.

"These croquettes are excellent!" Brock says.

"No wonder the chef asked for the recipe!" Misty says.

"This food is the best," Tomo says.

"These are so good! Nobody cooks like you do," Mew says.

"Yeah. Mom, you're the best," Gary says.

"And use a napkin," Adriana says.

Professor Oak turns to Gary and Mew and asks, "You know, if you two win your next battles, you'll both be allowed to use up to six Pokémon per match. Have either of you decided which Pokémon you'll choose?"

"Hmm, I'm not sure yet. Maybe I'll know once I know who I'm up against. Then, I can come up with a strategy," Mew says.

"Sounds like a good idea," Gary says.

"Tomorrow, they decide who everybody battles," Brock says.

Professor Oak nods his head and says, "Don't forget to let me know if either of you need any more Pokémon. Just call me, and I'll transport them to you both, right away."

"We will," Mew and Gary answer.

Later after dinner , Mew and the others arrive at the elevator. Professor Oak presses the down button to activate the elevator.

"If you both just remember to always do your best, you're both winners even if one or both of you lose. That's the important thing," Professor says.

"But, try to win," Adriana says.

"Right," Gary and Mew answer with a nod.

With that, the elevator doors open and everyone walks inside.

"We'll make sure Mew does," Misty says.

"And Mew will make sure of it too," Brock says.

Just then, a young boy is running towards the elevator. The trainer has brown hair and blue eyes. He wears a teal short-sleeve shirt with light yellow trim and a silver zipper, a dark teal vest with a light green collar, a black belt with a silver buckle, teal pants with light yellow pockets, dark blue and indigo sneakers with red dots, dark blue fingerless gloves with aqua borders, and a purple cap with a light yellow band and red buttons.

He calls out, "Hold the door, please! I'm going down stairs, too!"

"Sure," Professor Oak says.

With that, the boy is able to get inside the elevator before the door closes. Then it begins to go down.

"Thank you very much," The boy says.

"No problem," Professor Oak replies.

Then the boy notices Pikachu and Eevee, "A Pikachu. And an Eevee. Whose is it?"

"Oh, Pikachu and Eevee are with me," Mew says.

"You're really lucky," The boy says.

Mew smiles and says, "Thanks.

Then the boy asks, "Mind if I pet them."

"Sure," Mew says.

With that, the boy reaches to Pikachu and Eevee and begins petting them, and they like it.

"Looks like you're rubbing Pikachu and Eevee the right way," Misty says.

"I can see you did a really great job raising your Pikachu and Eevee," The boy says.

Mew chuckles and says, "Thanks. They're my great friends."

Suddenly, the elevator comes to a stop and the lights turn off.

"What's going on?" Mew asks, surprised

"The power went out!" Brock says.

"Let's try the emergency call," Gary says.

"Right," Brock says, and walks over to the elevator's buttons.

He presses the button and says, "Hello, can anybody there hear me?" But no one answers.

Then tries again, "Hello there? Hey!" but nothing.

Brock turns to the others, "Looks like it's busted, too."

"It's probably just a power outage," Professor Oak says.

Adriana asks, "What should we do?"

"I guess we're stuck here until someone restores the electricity," Professor Oak says, crossing his arms.

"What? Oh no," Misty says, shocked.

Brock soon notices the boy is fiddling with the cables in the elevator.

"What are you doing?" Daisy asks.

The boy then turns to Mew and asks, "Excuse me, but can I borrow your Pikachu for a second?"

"Um sure," Mew says.

She then picks up and asks, "Why do you need Pikachu for?"

"I want to use Pikachu's Thunder Shock to jump start the elevator. That should get us to the lobby," The boy says.

Professor Oak is impressed and says, "Say, there. You've got an interesting idea. Let's try it, Mew."

"Good idea," Mew says.

Then says, "Pikachu, Thunder Shock."

Pikachu then uses Thunderbolt to send jolts through the wires and soon enough, the elevator turns on and begins to move. Everyone is soon amazed and relieved.

"We're moving!" Mew happily says.

Soon enough, the elevator reaches the ground floor, and the door opens. Mew and the others happily walk out in relief.

"We made it!" Misty happily says.

"I'm glad we held the door open for you!" Brock says.

"We can't thank you enough!" Adriana says.

"Don't thank me, thank Pikachu," The boy says.

"Thank you," Mew says.

Then introduces herself, "My name is Mew. What's your name?"

The boy chuckles and says, "Oh, yeah. My name's Richie. I gotta go. See ya!"

And hurries off.

"Bye" Mew happily says.

"What a sweetie," Adriana says.

"Very mature for a boy his age," Professor Oak says.

"He must be around our age from the looks of it," Gary says.

"I was really impressed with the way he handled Pikachu," Brock says.

"I'm glad he helped us, otherwise we'll be stuck in the elevator. Right papa," Mew says, turning to Zeraora.

Zeraora growls with a calm smile.

Suddenly, they hear an announcement coming from outside, a woman's voice and it's familiar, "Your attention, please! May I have your attention, please?

"This is an emergency announcement for all participants in the Pokémon League competition! This is not only a test!" The other familiar voice says.

Outside, there is a large van outside, with the speaker making the announcement.

The female voice says, "All trainers must bring their Pokéballs to the Pokémon pavilion for official inspection immediately!"

"I wonder why they want to inspect Pokéballs?" Misty asks.

"I'm not sure. I don't remember the Pokemon League doing that," Gary says.

"I don't know, but the voices sound very familiar. I sense there might be trouble," Mew says.

Then says, "Let's go find out."

The female announcer continues, "It is important that you bring all Pokéballs to the pavilion as quickly as possible."

"And make it snappy," Male announcer says.

Inside the van, the announcers are really Jessie and James in disguise and are up to another scheme.

"This is our shcemiest scam yet for getting primo Pokémon!" Meowth says.

Team Rocket chuckles in reply.

Later on, the van is parked outside of the pavilion with all the Pokemon trainers who are participating in the league. Soon, Mew and Gary arrive on the scene.

"I wonder why we had to come here so quickly," Mew wonders.

"Beats me," Gary says, shrugging his shoulders."

Just then, they spot Gary.

Mew calls out, "Hey, Richie!"

Ritchie notices her, "Hey, Mew! How's it going?"

"We didn't know you'd be here. Glad to see you," Mew happily says.

"I have to guess you're in the league too," Gary says.

"Yep. What's your name? Ritchie asks.

"My name is Gary," Gary says.

Outside of the van, Jessie and James, who are in disguise, are on a small platform. James is holding a bag while Jessie is holding a megaphone.

Jessie announces, "We must now collect all your Pokémon to perform the required physical examination. Please deposit all of your Pokémon in the bag held by this official looking man with the moustache."

"Something's kinda weird," Gary says.

"I feel the same way, and that voice is very familiar," Mew says.

"Nobody ever said anything about a Pokémon exam to me," Ritchie says

Then Jessie says, "Any trainers who fail to turn in all their Pokémon will be disqualified from the league."

Mew, Gary, and Ritchie turn to each other with confused looks.

James presents the bag, "Drop all your Pokéballs in here."

":Let's hurry, trainers," Jessie says.

With that, the trainers place their Pokeballs in the bag.

James sees this and says, "Good, just toss them all in."

"All of them. That's the rule," Jessie says.

Then James comes up to Mew, Gary, and Ritchie, "You too, twe.." but quickly corrects himself, "I mean, young men and young lady."

Gary and Ritchie decide to place their Pokeballs in the bag. However, Mew steps back, so does Pikachu and Eevee.

"Something's not right about this," Mew says.

Just then, Jessie comes up to Mew, "And I'll just take this Pikachu and Eevee."

"Uh I'm okay. I like to have my Pokemon with me," Mew says.

"Oh, don't you worry they'll be perfectly safe," Jessie says, and picks up Pikachu and Eevee.

However, they both give Jessie a double shock, before she stuffs them in the sack.

"That, was easy," Jessie says, a little surprised.

James ties it in the bag and says, "We finally got Pikachu, Jessie!"

"Did you say Jessie?!" Gary says.

"Hey, he's right," Ritchie says.

"I knew you two look familiar. You're Team Rocket," Mew says.

Soon, Jessie and James realize they've been found out.

Jessie says, "The truth is about to come out."

Then James says, "I just hate it when that happens."

Soon Jessie starts with the motto.

Jessie:

I can't hold it in any longer. I HAVE to say prepare for trouble!

James:

Oh yes, Jess, and make it double!

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation!

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above!

With that, they both remove their disguises.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth: (pops up in the driver's window)

Meowth! That's right!

Mew, Gary, and Ritchie hurry to the van.

"Not you guys again!" Gary says.

"Give us back our Pokéballs!" Ritchie says.

"And give back Pikachu and Eevee," Mew demands.

"We'll give them back," Jessie says.

"After we remove your Pokémon, that is!" James says.

And they both laugh.

Then James says, "Smog them, Weezing!"

Weezing appears and uses it's Smog attack to blind everyone.

Jessie and James hurry into the van as they say, "Suckers!"

Weezing then follows after them. With that, Team Rocket drives the Van away.

But Mew notices them, "They're getting away! Hold it!" and chases after them through town.

Mew calls out, Stop that van! Somebody call the police, there's been a robbery!"

Soon, the van drives off the premise of Pokemon Village.

But Mew continues to follow and calls out, "Come back!"

Suddenly she hears a familiar voice, "Mew!"

"Mew!" Another voice calls out.

Mew turns her head to see, "Gary! Ritchie!"

Soon, Mew and the others come to a from the top of the hill to see Team Rocket's van below.

"We can't catch them on foot," Mew says.

"Not unless we cut straight down the side of the mountain," Ritchie says.

"We don't have much of a choice. I say we do it," Mew says.

Ritchie panics, "What?! It's too dangerous!"

"I can't let them get away with Pikahu and Eevee, or your Pokemon either," Mew says.

And with that, Mew chases down the hill.

"Mew! Hey, wait!" Ritchie calls out and chases after them.

"Hold on, Mew!" Gary calls out, and follows them too.

Mew calls out, "Come on!"

The three begin to pick up some speed as they race down the side of the hill.

"Mew! Slow down!" Ritchie calls out.

"We gotta cut them off before it's too late!" Mew calls out.

Soon, Ritchie notices, "Mew, look out!"

Ritchie quickly grabs Gary and jumps on to Mew. The three continue to slide down until they reach the edge of the cliff. The three look up and become surprised to see how close they are.

Mew sighs, "Thanks Ritchie, we could have fallen off."

"No problem," Ritchie says.

"Okay. One: Ritchie, you didn't have to pull me down like that. And second: Mew, you're just as reckless as ever," Gary says.

Mew nervously laughs in reply.

They both get up and begin to climb down the cliff.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is still driving along in the van, proud of how their scheme has worked.

James happily says, "Ah, success at last."

"If at first you don't succeed, lie, lie again," Jessie says.

"I think we've got a hundred Pokéballs in there!" Meowth says.

Meanwhile, Mew, Gary, and Ritchie continue to climb down the cliff while Team Rocket is singing a song about their success, until they notice Mew and the boys, blocking their way, shocking them.

The three shouts, "STOP!"

"Those twerps!"" Jessie panics.

James quickly turns the wheel and goes off in order to lose then, but the three trainers continue to give chase.

Soon, the Van goes down the hill and soon falls into the river.

"Good driving," Jessie says.

Jessie and Meowth turn their heads to see James has been hit on the head and is knocked out.

Mewoth panics, "He's out cold!"

Jessie quickly takes the wheel as they drive down the river. Soon, Mew and the boys find the river and begin to keep pursuing the van.

Their chase has taken them too late in the night, and now Mew and the boys are walking down the river.

"Team Rocket must have gotten pretty far. I don't see them anywhere," Mew says.

"Me either, and it's very dark outside right now. We'll never find them like this.

"Hey guys, why don't we quit for the night and get some sleep?" Ritchie suggests.

Mew stops and turns to Ritchie, "You're right. We can't find them like this."

"We can set up camp here," Gary says.

"I got extra sleeping bags right here. When you travel around as much as me, you always carry an extra," Ritchie says.

A little later, Mew and the others set up camp.

Mew giggles and says, "Sorry about me running down the hill like that. I guess that's pretty crazy huh."

"That's okay," Ritchie says.

Gary turns to Ritchie, "Well, you were a bit crazy yourself too. You tried to stop Team Rocket by jumping in front of their van."

"So did we, Gary," Mew says.

"That's true," Gary says.

Mew says, "Well, when it comes to my Pokemon friends, I kind of get a little crazy."

"Kind of the same, but in a different way," Gary says.

"I'm that way, too," Ritchie says.

"I guess we're just a trio of Poke-maniacs," Mew says.

Soon, the three laugh with smiles on their faces.

Ritchie then passes cans of food to the others "Let's eat. Here, guys."

"Oh, thanks," Gary says.

"Thank you," Mew says.

With that, Mew, Gary, and Ritchie begin to have their meal.

Mew looks up at the stars and the moon and says, "I do hope we find them."

"Don't worry Mew, once we're rested, we can look for them tomorrow," Ritchie says.

"Yeah. I know we can find them," Gary says.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are having a feast of their success.

"A toast. To the trio with the brio!" Jessie says.

"Here here!" James replies.

"Yeah! Whatever that means," Meowth says.

Then James says, "Well, fellow rocketeers, we've procured plenty of Pokémon!"

"And we've finally snatched that sniveling twerp's precious Pikachu along with that Eevee!" Jessie says.

"Let's Poke-partay!" Mowth cheers, eating some meat.

Jessie laughs and says, "Team Rocket has finally come up with the biggest Poke-haul of all!"

"Yeah!" James and Meowth say.

With that, Team Rocket begins celebrating.

Meanwhile, the group have gone off to bed, but no one can sleep, especially Mew. She stares at the stars until she hears Ritchie giggling. She turns to notice him moving his finger. Gary notices it too.

Mew asks, "What are you doing?"

"See what Pokémon you can see when you connect up the stars," Ritchie says.

Mew and Gary look up at the stars to see the star constellation.

Gary is the first to guess, "Looks like, an Onix!"

"Yeah," Ritchie says

Then says, "Connect those two bright ones to the ones down over there."

Mew guesses, "Wow! It's Pikachu!"

"Right!" Ritchie says.

"I guess you think about Pokémon as much as we do," Mew says.

Ritchie nods his head, "Pokémon are amazing. I think about their different personalities and strengths and witnesses so much that I even dream about them."

"Really. That's kind of cool. I've been thinking about, no, been with Pokemon practically my whole life," Mew says.

"Really?" Ritchie asks.

"Yeah. Believe it or not, I was really raised by Pokemon since I was a baby," Mew says.

"You were?" Ritchie asks.

"Yeah. Mew actually knows a lot more about Pokemon, maybe even more than me. I've learned a lot from my grandpa, he's an expert in Pokemon," Gary says.

"Sounds cool. And I'm gonna be a great trainer," Ritchie says.

Gary laughs and says, "Well I'm gonna be the best Pokémon trainer there ever was."

"You'll have to battle me in the Pokemon League first," Ritchie says.

Then turns to Mew, "What about you Mew?"

"Well, I do plan on becoming a great Pokemon trainer, but I also plan on doing what I can to learn and help Pokemon," Mew says.

"Sounds great. I can already tell you did a great job in raising Pokemon," Ritchie says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

The next day, Mew, Gary, and Ritchie continue to search for Team Rocket.

"They got to be here somewhere," Mew says.

Suddenly, Ritchie spots something, "Hey, look!"

Mew and Gary look to see tire tracks.

"Tire tracks!" Ritchie says.

"They go into the woods!" Mew says.

Then Gary says, "Let's follow them!"

Mew and Ritchie nod their heads. They follow the tracks and soon find Team Rocket, fast asleep at their campsite.

"It's them," Ritchie whispers.

"But where are the Pokémon?" Mew wonders in concern.

"Probably still in the van," Gary says.

Mew says, "I say let's check it out. But we need to do it quietly. We don't want to wake them out," Mew says.

With that, Mew, Gary, and Ritchie begin tiptoeing past Team Rocket, they quietly sneak past them until they reach the back of the van. Mew unlocks it and gently opens the door.

Mew peeks inside and calls out quietly, "Hey! Pikachu! Eevee!"

Suddenly, they hear the two Pokemon, and notice a sack is willing.

Mew hurries over and says, "Don't worry, I'll get you out."

Mew unties the sack, and opens it. Then Pikachu and Eevee happily jump into her arms.

Mew hugs them in relief, "Pikachu! Eevee! I was so worried!"

"And the Pokéballs?" Ritchie asks.

Gary grabs the bag and says, "Don't worry, they're all here in the bag."

"Let's grab them and go!" Ritchie says.

Suddenly, they hear Jessie laugh and the three trainers and Pokemon turn to see Team Rocket has spotted them.

After the laughter, Jessie says, "Look who just creeped into our campsite!"

"We're taking the Pokéballs back to their trainers!" Mew says.

"Pika/Eev!" (That's right!) Pikachu and Eevee say.

"The only thing you four are taking is a ride!" Meowth says.

"Bye-bye!" James adds.

Team Rocket quickly leaves and shuts the door.

"Hold it!" Mew says, and grabs the knob.

She tries turning it and then tries to bang on it.

"We're locked in!" Mew says.

"There must be some way out!" Ritchie says.

Suddenly, the van begins to move, with Team Rocket driving.

"Once we get rid of the twerp trio, we'll have Pikachu, Eevee and the other Pokémon all to ourselves," Jessie says.

In the back of the van, Mew says, "We gotta think of something, fast!"

"If only we could stop the van," Ritchie says.

Mew says, "Maybe our Pokemon can help. See if you two can find yours in the bag."

Then brings out her Pokeball, "Luckily, I still have mine."

She then calls out, "Go Cinderace!"

Then Cinderace comes out and calls out, "Cinderace."

"That's a cool Cinderace, I've never seen one in person before," Ritchie says.

"Thanks," Mew says.

Just then, Ritchie picks out his Pokeballs, "Guys, all my Pokéballs are right here."

"How can you tell?" Gary asks.

"I put these stars on them so I can tell they're mine," Ritchie says.

Mew and Gary look to see if his Pokeballs have Star stickers on it.

"Sounds like a good idea," Gary says.

Just then, Pikachu and Eevee begin smelling the Pokeballs and soon, each pick one up and hand it to Gary. Then, they hand over another, and finally two more."

"Pika Pi," (These are yours.) Pikachu says.

Mew says, "Pikachu says these are yours.

Gary says, "Thanks."

Then Gary throws his Pokeball, "Go Pokeball!"

With that, a Pokemon has come out. The Pokemon is a bipedal, portly Pokémon that appears to be made of wood. A shaggy white mane covers most of its face and trails down its back. Long pointed ears poke out the top of its mane, and it has a long, pointed nose and a large mouth with teeth that are usually bared. Its eyes are yellow with black sclerae. This Pokémon's feet resemble Japanese tengu-geta. Three broad leaves with brown spokes form each of its hands.

The Pokemon calls out, "Shiftry."

"Wow. It's a Shiftry," Ritchie says.

Mew asks, "Hey Gary, did your Seedot evolve?"

"It sure did," Gary says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Shiftry, the Wicked Pokemon and the final evolved form of Seedot. A Grass and Dark Type. Shiftry's large fans generate awesome gusts of wind at a speed close to 100 feet per second. The whipped-up wind blows anything away. This Pokémon chooses to live quietly deep in forests."

"Sounds cool. Now let's get out of this place," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Cinderace, use Double Kick!"

Cinderace then kicks, but it's not working.

Ritchie then brings out his Pokeball, "Let my Pokémon try!"

Then throws his Pokeball as he calls out, "Zippo, I choose you!"

"Zippo?" Mew and Gary say, confused.

And out of the Pokeball, Zippo is a Charmaner.

Then Ritchie calls out, "Zippo, use your Slash attack!"

Zippo then performs the Slash Attack and causes large gash marks, causing the wall to collapse and reveal Team Rocket in the driver seat.

Team Rocket cries out, "Hey! This van's a rental!"

"Too bad, the ride's over!" Mew says.

"The ride may be over, but over for you! Go get them, James," Jessie says, getting out of her seat.

But James says, "But I'm driving!"

Jessie growls in frustration, "Arbok, go!

Arbok then comes out of the Pokeball.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, Thunderbolt attack!"

Pikachu prepares to launch the attack, but James swerves, "Turn attack!"

That causes Pikachu to lose his balance, and Arbok to attack. Pikachu lands on the ground.

"Pikachu, are you okay?!" Mew asks.

"Pika!" (I'm good!) Pikachu answers.

Jessie turns to James, "Nice driving!"

"I should get a license!" James says

Then Ritchie calls his Pokemon, "Sparky, Lilac, you're on!"

Coming out of his Pokeballs are an Eevee and a Pikachu.

"A Pikachu?" Mew says, surprised.

"And an Eevee too?" Gary says, surprised.

Sparky turns to Pikachu, "Pi Pika!" (Let's rumble!)

Growth says in shock, "There's two?!"

"One's tough enough!" James says.

"It's twice as nice!" Jessie says.

Then Jessie says, "Arbok, give them trouble and make it double!"

"Sparky, confuse Arbok with your Agility!" Ritchie calls out.

Sparky performs Agility as well.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, give them Agility, in stereo!"

The two Pikachus begin to use their agility to circle Arbok. Together, that causes Team Rocket and Arbok to panic.

James panics, "Are there two or twenty?!"

Soon, Arbok begins to get dizzy.

"Yes!" Mew says.

Gary grins and says, "I think you two should finish this up."

"Right!" Mew and Ritchie reply.

Ritchie then calls out, "Sparky! Lilac!"

Then Mew does the same, "Pikachu! Eevee!"

Then they both say, "Thunderbolt attack!"

The four Pokemon perform four times the thunderbolt, shocking Team Rocket and Arbok. That causes the van to explode, sending the three cooks and Arbok blasting once again.

Team Rocket screams, "We're blasting off again!"

Mew rushes out, "That took care of Team Rocket."

"Yeah. But we're not out of the woods yet," Gary says.

"He's right. Look, Mew! Up ahead!" Ritchie agrees.

Everyone looks to see a cliff coming up ahead.

"Oh no!" Mew panics.

Quickly, Mew calls out, "Charizard!"

Charizard comes out.

Gary calls out, "Fearow!"

Then Fearow comes out.

Then Ritchie calls out, "Happy!"

With that, Ritchie calls out Butterfree.

"That's a nice Butterfree!" Mew complements.

"Maybe they can be our Pokémon parachutes!" Ritchie says.

Mew and Gary nod their heads, agreeing to the idea. Mew and her friends are able to escape the van in the nick of time. All three watch as they see the van crash into the woods. Unfortunately, Ritchie's Butterfree is having trouble supporting Ritchie's weight. Luckily, Mew is able to catch him with Charizard's help.

"You okay Ritchie!" Mew asks.

"I'm fine," Ritchie says.

Soon, Fearow and Charizard land on the ground and everyone hopes off.

"Everyone, okay?" Mew asks.

Pikachu, Eevee, and Cinderace nod their heads in reply.

"We're okay, too," Ritchie says.

"Same here," Gary says.

"That was too close, but we saved the Pokemon, and we kind of saved each other," Mew says.

"You can say that again," Gary says.

Ritchie says, "Yeah, but it might take us a while to get back to the Pokemon League."

Suddenly, Eevee hears a sound and looks over younger, "Eevee?" (What's that sound?)

Mew and the others soon hear the sound and look to see a group of jeeps heading towards them. In the jeeps are Misty, Brock, Tomo, and all the participants of the Pokemon League.

Misty calls out, "Hey, Mew!"

"Are you guys okay?!" Brock calls out.

"Yeah, we're just fine!" Mew calls out.

"And we got back all the trainers' Pokéballs!" Ritchie says.

"And we stopped Team Rocket!" Gary says.

Soon, Mew, Gary, and Ritchie smile at each other with glee.

Later on, Mew and everyone are in the Pokemon Pavilion, where they look at the board to see the sixteen trainers left in the competition and who they'll be battling against. Some of them have already gone and are in the battling box. On A-1 is A.J battling against a girl trainer, Joe is A-2 battling against a male trainer. Richie is on A-3, and hasn't got an opponent to fight yet. Otoshi is on B-2, battling a different trainer. Nurse Joy of Fuchsia City is on B-3, and finally Gary is on B-4.

Just then, the receptionist calls out, "The next trainer will be Mew from Pallet Town."

"Okay," Mew replies.

Mew walks over to the fish tank with a fishing pole and throws the line in. She waits for a minute until she gets a bite. She pulls the fishing rod to see that she has caught a Magikarp that reads A-3 on it's side.

"A-3. That means your next opponent is going to be.." The receptionist says.

Soon, Mew's picture appears on the screen. And the picture appears next to her, is Richie. Mew and her friends, including Richie, are shocked. They barely become friends and now they have to battle against each other. Mew and Richie are battling against each other in the next round.

Mew turns to Richie with a serious look. Richie does the same.

Then Mew smiles and says, "Let's give it everything we got out there, Richie."

Richie smiles and says, "You too, and I won't be holding back."

Mew and Richie reach their hand out and give each other a shake of good luck.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket are stuck in a tree.

"I just don't understand it," Jessie says, defeated.

James feels the same, "How can we feel so low.."

"When we're up so high?" Meowth adds.

Soon, they all begin singing the sad reprise of the song they sang earlier, and from the looks of it, they're going to be stuck there for a while.

Chapter 85: Episode 79: Friends to the End: Mew Vs. Ritchie

Not long ago, Mew, Gary, and the other trainers had to choose who they're battling against. When Mew turns and fishes out the choice of her battle, she ends up battling her new friend, Ritchie. Even though they plan to give it their all, Mew is still feeling skeptical about battling a new friend.

Later that night, Mew is looking at the moon and stars with a sigh.

Tomo walks over and asks, "Still a little skeptical about battling Ritchie?"

"I bit. I'm glad that Ritchie and I are planning to give our best, but for my first battle, I have to battle him," Mew says.

Suddenly, Misty calls out, "Hey, Mew, check this out."

Mew, Tomo, and the Pokemon turn to see Misty on the computer.

Mew asks, "What are you doing?"

"I clicked on the Pokemon League database, and it has lots of information about all the trainers, including Ritchie," Misty says.

"Something about Ritchie?" Mew asks, walking over.

Tomo and the others walk over to a peek.

On the computer, they can see all of Ritchie's information so far in the Pokemon League.

"Ritchie won all four rounds without losing any Pokemon. This kid's amazing," Brock says.

"Wow. I only lost one Pokemon out of my four rounds, and that's because I underestimated how strong that Bellsprout is," Mew says.

"Ritchie must be pretty tough," Tomo says.

"And Ritchie only used Four Pokemon. Butterfree, Charmander, Eevee and Pikachu," Misty says.

"Happy? Zippo? Sparky? And Lilac? He only used them?" Mew replies, surprised.

"Who?" Misty says, confused.

"Ritchie named his Pokemon. The Butterfree is named Happy. The Charmander is Zippo, Sparky is the Pikachu, and Eevee's name is Lilac," Mew answers.

"Sounds cool that he named them," Tomo says.

"Yeah. Pikachu is an electric type. Charmander is a flame type. Eevee is a Normal Type. Lastly, Butterfree is a Bug and Flying type." Brock says.

Then turns to Mew, "They're almost the same kind of Pokemon you use, Mew."

"That means it all depends on which one's the better trainer," Misty says.

Then turns to Mew, "But you have a lot more Pokemon than Ritchie, and used various different ones in your rounds, and Ritchie seems to only use the same ones, so they must be strong.

"In other words, without a plan, I'll be in trouble," Mew says.

"So which Pokemon are you planning to use?" Tomo asks.

Mew places her hand on her chin and says, "Well with Butterfree being a Bug and Flying type. Flying, Fire, Electric, Fire, and Ice will have an effect. Pikachu is weak to ground types, and Charmander is weak to Water, Ground, and Rock."

"But you'll have to choose carefully. You can only have three Pokemon from this match," Brock says.

"I know," Mew says.

Throughout the night, Mew has been thinking very hard on which Pokemon should Mew battle against. Been thinking for the longest time, even if it is her friend, she knows that she needs to give it her all. And she knows Ritchie will do the same.

The next day, Mew is already at the Pokemon Center and makes some arrangements to have her Pokemon switched to the ones she'll be using for her match.

Suddenly, she hears Ritchie's voice, "Excuse me, Miss. I'd like to pick up the Pokemon I left yesterday, please."

"I have them all right here waiting for you, Ritchie, and they're ready for your big battle today," Nurse Joy says.

"Great. Thank you very much," Ritchie says.

"Good luck," Nurse Joy says.

"Thanks," Ritchie says.

Mew smiles and walks over, Hi Ritchie."

"Hey Mew," Ritchie says.

Mew asks, "So um, are you ready for the match?"

Then Ritchie says, "Listen, Mew, because we're friends, we should promise each other to make this the best battle that we've ever had."

"Okay. That's a promise, Ritchie," Mew says with a happy nod.

"I'll see you later at the stadium," Ritchie says.

"Okay. Bye," Mew says.

Ritchie then hurries off as he says, "Bye."

Mew smiles and says, "That's right. We agreed to give it our all.

Suddenly, Nurse Joy says, "I think you're lucky to be battling a friend. Even if you don't win the match yourself, you can still be happy your friend won. That makes it nice."

"Yeah," Mew says.

"And I'm sure you and Ritchie will do your best," Nurse Joy says.

"We will," Mew happily says.

Later on, Mew and the others have arrived at the stadium, but the reason why they're here early is because some of their friends are battling before Mew and they want to see them battle the best they can and give it their all.

The first one to be battling is A.J who is battling against a trainer from Cerulean City. A.J hasn't lost a single Pokemon, and the female trainer is on her last Pokemon. At the battlefield, A.J is using his Sandshrew, while the female trainer is using a Vaporeon. Normally, Sandshrew is weak against Water, but not A.J's.

A.J calls out, "Sandshrew, use your Take Down attack.

The trainer calls out, "Vaporeon, use Bubble Beam!"

Vaporeon performs Bubble Beam, but Sandshrew rolls into a ball and the attacks strike, but the attack doesn't bother it at all.

The announcer says, "Wow. The Bubble Beam has no effect on Sandshrew, and it keeps going.

"Go for it, Sandshrew!" A.J calls out.

Sahdshrew continues and performs the Take Down attack, and strikes at Vaporeon. Vaporeon falls and is knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Vaporeon is out. The winner of the match is Sandshrew."

"And with the outstanding performance, A.J and his Sandshrew have defeated all of the trainer's Pokemon and are moving on to the next round," The announcer says.

Sahdshrew jumps into A.J's arms.

A.J says, "You were great, Sandshrew."

Mew and her friends soon cheer for A.J and Sandshrew.

Next Joe is battling against a male trainer from Seafoam Island. As of now, they're both down to one Pokemon, and the battle they have will decide the winner. Joe is using a Farfetch'd while the male trainer is using a Weepinbell.

The trainer calls out, "Weepinbell, use Stun Spore!"

Weepinbell then uses Stun Spore.

"Farfetch'd, use Gust to blow away the spore!" Joe calls out.

Farfetch'd uses its wings to create a powerful wind and blows the Stun Spore away, shocking the trainer and his Pokemon.

Then Joe calls out, "Now Farfetch'd use, Peck!"

Farfetch'd charges and uses Peck multiple times.

"Now, Furry Attack!" Joe calls out.

Farfetch'd continues to use Furry Attack and for the final blow, smacks it with it's Leek. Soon, Weepinbell is knocked out.

The Referee calls the results, "Weepinbell is unable to battle, Farfetch'd wins. The winner is Joe."

"Joe has made an incredible comeback to win this match and is moving on to the next round," The announcer says.

Joe smiles and congratulates Farfetch'd

In the Locker room, Mew and Ritchie have their Pokemon ready for their match today. They know that the next match is her against Ritchie.

Mew turns to Ritchie and says, "Goodluck Ritchie, may the best trainer win.

"You to Mew, may the best trainer win," Ritchie says.

A little while later, everyone in the audience, especially Misty, Brock, Tomo, and Gary watch, are rather anxious. They know well that the next match is Mew and Ritchie, battling against each other.

The announcer says, "And now it's time for our Third Match…."

Just then, Ritchie walks out from the left side.

"On the red side we have Ritchie from Fordomar City," The announcer says.

Many people and trainers are cheering with excitement. Soon, Mew walks out from the right side with Pikachu and Eevee on her shoulders.

"And on the green side, we have Mew from Pallet Town" The announcer says.

The crowd also cheers along with Mew's friends with excitement. Ritchie and Mew walk towards their side of the battlefield. They stare at each other with determined looks and calm smiles. Mew nods her head and Ritchie nods his head. They both decide that despite being friends, they are going to give it their wall.

The referee calls out, "Let's the battle… begin!"

Ritchie throws his Pokeball and calls out, "Go, Happy!"

With that, Happy the Butterfree comes out.

Mew throws her Pokeball and calls out, "I choose you, Pansear!"

With that, Pansear comes out of his Pokeball.

"A Pansear, huh," Ritchie says, and brings out his Pokedex.

Dexter says, "Pansear, the High Temp Pokemon. A Fire Type. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit."

The announcer says, "And it's Ritchie's Butterfree, Happy, and Mew's Pansear going head to head to start things off!"

Indeed, both Pokemon charge and begin to attack each other. Happy nails Pansear, but Pansear retaliates. Soon, both of their attacks are going back and forth.

The announcer says, "Both Pokémon are launching a rapid flock of Poke attacks!"

Ritchie calls out, "Happy, Sleep Powder attack!"

Happy flaps its wings to put Pansear to sleep.

But Mew calls out, "Pansear, use Flamethrower!"

Pansear then performs the attack, and it counters and repels the Sleep Powder.

Ritchie calls out, "Now give it your Whirlwind Attack!"

Happy then begins to flap its wings as hard as it can. Pansear stands its ground from the harsh wind.

"Pansear, stand your ground!" Mew calls out.

Pansear nods his head as he hangs on.

Then Ritchie calls out, "Alright Happy, Double Edge!"

Happy then begins to perform Double Edge. Pansea quickly dodge the attack. Happy performs again, and Pansear dodges. When Happy uses the attack a third time, it ends up hitting Pansear on the side. Luckily, Pansear is able to land on the ground, and only has a scratch on the side.

Mew quickly calls out, "Quick Pansear, use Flame Burst!"

Pansear then begins to use Flame Burst with full force and is able to nail Butterfree and consume it in fire. Soon, Butterfree has been burned and falls to the ground with a dizzy expression.

Ritchi calls out, "Happy!"

The referee looks at Buttercup that is out and says, "Butterfree is unable to battle, Pansear is the winner!"

On the screen, it shows that Ritchie has lost one Pokemon, and only has two more.

"Wow. Talk about a counter attack. And now, Ritchie only has two Pokemon left to play with!" The announcer says.

"Just two Pokémon left. Okay," Ritchie says to himself, and calls back Happy into its Pokeball.

He then brings out his second Pokeball and says, "Now it looks like I'll have to fight fire with fire! Zippo, go!"

With that, Zippo comes out and it's a Charmander.

Mew calls out, "Hey Pansear, want to take this battle too?"

Pansear nods his head in reply. Soon, it becomes a two Fire Pokemon Battle.

Just then, Mew calls out, "Pansear, watch out!"

Pansear turns to see Charmander is using a Flamethrower and begins to attack.

Mew calls out, "Pansear, use Flamethrower!"

"Zippo, use Flamethrower too!" Ritchie calls out.

With that, both Pokemon perform the attack and they both counter with one another.

"Both Pansear and Charmander used Flamethrower at the same time! Can they keep this up?" The announcer says.

Just then, they both stop their Flamethrower and soon begin to attack.

Ritchie calls out, "Zippo, use your Scratch Attack!"

"Pansear, use Fury Swipe!" Mew calls out.

With that, both Fire Type Pokemon begin to attack each other with their Normal Type Attacks. Then they both begin fighting and ramming at one another.

On the stands, Misty and the others are rather surprised to see how this is turning out.

"Wow. Talking about a flaming battle," Misty says.

"Pansear and Zippo are really fighting out there," Tomo says.

"Yeah. I wonder how Mew is going to beat Zippo with Pansear," Brock says.

"I have to wonder what Ritchie's last Pokemon is if she manages to beat it," Gary says.

"You're right. We know the four Pokemon Ritchie mainly uses, but it might be a problem if Ritchie pulls a surprise on Mew," Brock says.

"Hmm. Yeah. But I know Mew will figure something out," Gary says.

Tomo smiles, "Yeah. Mew can do it."

Just then, Ritchie calls out, "Zippo, use Flame Wheel!"

With that, Zippo performs Flame wheel and charges towards Pansear.

"Quick Pansea, use Fire Blast!" Mw calls out.

Pansear then performs the Flame Blast as the Flame Wheel is close to it. When both attacks interact, it releases a flaming explosion. Everyone watches and waits to see what has happened as the smoke and fire disappear. To Mew, Ritchie, and everyone's shock, both Fire Type Pokemon are knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Both Pokemon are unable to continue."

With that, Mew has only two Pokemon, and Ritchie is down to his last one.

The announcer says, "Unbelievable! both Pokemon ended up being knocked out. Now Mew only has two Pokemon, and Ritchie is down to his final Pokemon."

Ritchie then brings out his Pokeball,"Return Zippo!"

"You did great, Pansear. Return," Mew says, and calls it back to his Pokeball.

Ritchie says, "I only have one Pokemon left. I have to make this count."

Ritchie then brings out his final Pokeball and calls out, "Go Aqua!"

With that, Richie's last and final Pokemon isn't Sparky or Lilac, but it's really…

"A Tentacool?!" Mew, Misty, Brock, and Tomo say in surprise.

Even Pikachu and Eevee are surprised, "Eevee?/Pika" (Tentacool?)

Confused, Mew says in thought, "Tentacool, huh. I never expected that."

"Tentacool are weak to Ground Type and Electric Types. Still, I shouldn't be too hasty. I can use Pikachu or Sandshrew. Yet, I need to make this count because I have two Pokemon," Mew says.

She then says, "It's a risk, but I have a feeling I can pull this out."

Mew then brings out her Pokeball and calls out, "Sandshrew, I choose you!"

With that, Sandshrew comes out of its Pokeball. Misty and the others are surprised to see Sandshrew on the battlefield.

The announcer says, "Ritchie has chosen Tentacool and Mew is going with Sandshrew. This is going to be an interesting battle."

On the stand, Misty says, "That's a surprise, I thought Mew would choose Pikachu."

"Yeah. Pikachu can beat Tentacool," Tomo says.

"Maybe, but it's also good to use Sandshrew in some cases. But it's a risk. Sandshrew is a Ground Type and weak to Water Types. However, Tentacool is weak against Ground Types. It's going to come down to who battles better," Brock says.

The referee waves the flags and says, "Begin!"

Ritchie calls out, "Aqua, use Bubble Beam!"

With that, Aqua fires the Bubble Beam.

Mew calls out, "Sandshrew, dodge and use Rollout!"

Sandshrew begins to dodge the attack as it performs Rollout.

"Aqua, use Water Pulse!" Ritchie calls out.

Aqua then performs Water Pulse and strikes at Sandshrew. Sandshrew rolls and is feeling a little soak.

"Are you okay, Sashshrew?" Mew asks.

Sandshrew shakes the water and nods his head in reply.

"Great. Then let's do our best," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Sandshrew, use take down."

Sandshrew then charges and prepares to do a Take Down attack.

But Ritchie says, "Aqua, use Water Gun!"

Aqua then begins to perform the Water Gun Attack. Sandshrew then runs as it dodges the attack. Aqua continues to fire the Water Gun as Sandshrew continues to dodge the attack and not making it easy for it to attack. Then jumps up and rolls into a ball. Then with that, strikes at Aqua with full force. Aqua falls and is able to get up. Sandshrew then lands on the ground, but ends up slipping a bit. Mew and Ritchie notice that the battlefield is soaked with water, and some parts of the battlefield looks like mud.

"This is a surprise, the multiple Water Gun attacks has the battlefield soaked and it might make it slipper for Sandshrew to get around," The announcer says.

Ritche then calls out, "Aqua, use Sludge Bomb!"

"Dodge!" Mew calls out.

Aqua begins to perform Sludge Bomb and Sandshrew quickly moves out of the way. Just then, Sandshrew slips on the water and falls to the ground.

"Sandshrew, are you okay?" Mew asks.

Sandshrew stands and shakes himself. He is still up for a battle.

But then, Ritchie calls out, "Aqua, use Wrap!"

Before Sandshrew can reach, Aqua has Sandshrew wrapped around its tentacles.

"Sandshrew!" Mew says shocked.

"Wow! Tentacool has Sandshrew trapped in it's Wrap attack!" The announcer says.

At the stand, Misty says, "If Mew loses this match, she'll have to change Pokemon."

"How is Sandahrew going to get out of this?" Tomo asks.

"I don't know," Brock replies.

Gary simply watches Mew and wonders how Mew is going to win this match, and how she's going to help Sandshrew get out of this.

"If I don't do something, Sandshrew will end up getting poisoned by this Aqua. There has to be some way for Sandshrew to slip out of…" Mew thinks.

But has an idea, Mew calls out, "Sandshrew, use Rapid Spin!"

Sandshrew curls up into a ball and begins to spin as fast as it can. Aqua is struggling to hang on.

"Hang in there, Aqua!" Ritchie calls out.

But Aqua continues to struggle to hang on.

"Look at that, despite being trapped, Sandhrew continues to use a Rapid Spin and Tentacool is unable to hold on for much longer!" The announcer says.

And soon enough, Sandshrew is able to break free and smacks Aqua on the head. Aqua falls back and is barely hanging on. Sandshrew is able to break free, lands on the ground, and uncurls itself.

Mew happily says, "You did it, Sandashrew!"

"Sandshrew," (Sure did.) Sandshrew says.

Suddenly, Sandshrew begins to glow, catching everyone especially Mew and her friends by surprise. Soon, Sandshrew begins to change his shape.

At the stand, Misty asks in surprise, "Brock is Sandshrew…"

"Yeah. Sandshrew is evolving," Brock answers.

Sandshrew begins to grow and gain very sharp claws. Soon, Sandshrew has evolved right in front of everyone in the stadium.

"Sandshrew evolved into Sandslash!" Mew says, happily.

"Pika! Pika," (Wow! Sandshrew evolved!) Pikachu says.

"Eevee!" (It's Sandslash!) Eevee says.

The announcer says, "Wow Folks, this is sure to be an unexpected turn around. Sandshrew is able to break free from tentacool's wrap and suddenly evolves. Mew sure is full of surprises!"

"Must admit, that caught me by surprise, but we still have a battle to finish," Ritchie calls out.

"Right!" Mew says.

Ritche then calls out, "Aqua, use Bubble Beam!"

"Quick Sandslash, dodge!" Mew calls out.

Instead, Sandslash then uses an attack that creates a large amount of Sand, almost like a large tomb tornado of sand. With that, Sandslash aims the attack at Aqua and surpasses the Bubble Beam. Then Aqua is caught in the attack.

"That's Sand Tomb!" Gary says from the stand.

Mew says, amazed, "You learned a new move!"

Sandslash nods his head.

Aqua is barely able to stand, but is able to fight.

"Aqua, use Poison Jab!" Ritchie calls out.

With that, Aqua charges for the attack.

Mew calls out, "Sandslash, use Slash!"

Sandslash charges for the attack.

The two Pokemon charge towards each other and it looks like the attack that will decide the winner. With that, they both end up striking at each other with the attack. Once done, they both stand beside each other. Everyone waited anxiously on the result. Just then, Aqua collapses and is soon knocked down.

The referee looks at Aqua and sees it knocked out.

Then the referee announces, "Tentacool is unable to battle, Sandslash wins! Mew is the victor!"

"What an outstanding battle! Mew is able to make a turn around and win her match!" The announcer says.

Sandslash runs to Mew and Mew kneels down and hugs him.

She happily says, "You were great Sandslash! You won your battle and evolved, and you learned a new move!"

"Sandslash Sandslash," (We're both great, Mew!) Sandslash happily says.

"Maybe, but you're the winner today," Mew says.

Ritchie is disappointed that he lost, but he smiles and says, "Well, we gave it our all."

Then returns Aqua to her Pokeball.

Ritchie then walks to Mew who is in the middle of hugging. Mew looks up to see Ritchie. Mew lets go of the embrace and stands up.

He holds his hand out and says with a smile, "I guess I lost. Congratulations Mew. You really gave me an amazing battle."

"Thanks Ritchie You did too," Mew says.

She then takes Ritchie's hand and they both shake on it. Everyone, including Misty and the others clap and cheer to see the two trainers shaking their hands with smiles and congratulate each other with a smile.

"Now that's what being a trainer is all about. Mew and Ritchie shake hands and they put on a match they'll never forget!" The announcer says.

Mr. Goodshow sees it and smiles, "He is right. That is what being a trainer is all about whether they win or lose."

Sometime later, Mew and the others are watching the rest of the matches.

They soon see Otoshi with his match. Otoshi has Marowak at the battlefield and his opponent as a Dodrio. At the end, Otoshi and Marowak are victorious in this match.

Then, they see Nurse Joy from Fuchsia City. She uses her Pokemon, and surprisingly, the Pokemon she also has out is Chansey, and at the end, she and Chansey move on to the next match.

Lastly, Gary is battling against another trainer who is using a Scyther. Gary however is using his Arcanine. The two Pokemon battle hard and the two trainers are down to one Pokemon. At the end, Gary is able to win his match, and moves up.

As a result of the next round of the competition: A.J vs. Joe. Mew is against a female trainer. Otoshi battling against a male trainer. And Nurse Joy is battling against Gary.

Among the games are Mew and her friends, Pikachu Eevee, Misty along with Togpei and Pichu, Tomo with Meloetta and Skwovet, and Brock. Mew and the others have just left Pokemon Village and are heading to the stadium.

After the match, Mew along with Misty, Brock, Tomo, and the Pokemon are sitting at the table having their dinner for the day.

She begins to think on how she can battle A.J and which Pokemon she could use. She suspects Sandshrew will be one of them. She remembers from the last time she had a battle with A.J and Sandshrew. And from seeing his matches, she can tell Sandshrew has gotten stronger. She knows that originally Sandshrew are weak against Water, Grass, and Ice, but also remembers that Water and Grass don't have any effect on it. And some of his Pokemon are also Normal Types, Bug Types, and she remembers him having some fighting types. She's going to have a difficult time deciding how to win this match.

"Hmm, how am I going to battle Sandshrew and his other Pokemon?" Mew says to herself in thought.

Just then, Mew has an idea, "I think I have an idea on which Pokemon to use."

A.J and Mew stare from opposite sides of the field towards each other. They each have their Pokeball out and plan to give it everything they got.

And so, the battle between the two trainers begins, which one will win and which will make it to the finals.

Cinderace then kicks a rock and turns it into a fireball. Then kicks it towards Hitmonchan. Hitmonchan gets hit and is pushed back.

"Hitmonchan, you alright?" A.J asks.

Hitmonchan throws air punches, letting A.J know that it still can fight.

"Alright then, time to give it your Focus Punch!" A.J calls out.

Hitmonchan charges and begins to use the attack.

"Cindrrace, watch out!" Mew calls out.

Cinderace sees the Pokemon. Hitmonchan then begins to throw multiple Focus Punch Attacks as Cinderace dodges the attack. After multiple attempts, Hitmonchan is able to strike a Focus Punch at Cinderace's face and sends it flying and falls to the ground.

"Cinderace!" Mew cries out.

Cinderace sits and then stands up as she rubs the face where she's been punched.

Just then, A.J calls out, "Now Hitmonchan, give it your Mega Punch!"

Hitmonchan then charges and prepares the Mega Punch.

Mew calls out, "Quick Cinderace, dodge the attack!"

Cinderace quickly dodges the attack by jumping into the air.

"Now, Double Kick!" Mew calls out.

Cinderace then gives Hitmonchan the Double Kick from behind that is causing damage.

"Now, use Blaze Kick!" Mew calls out.

Cinderace then performs a powerful Blaze Kick and strikes at Hitmonchan. Soon, Hitmonchan falls to the ground and is knocked out.

The referee sees the knocked down Pokemon and says, "Hitmonchan is out of the match. Cinderace wins."

Soon, the screen shows A.J's other Pokemon have been defeated. Then the screen shows that A.J has only one Pokemon left, and Mew still has her four remaining Pokemon.

"Talk about an outstanding fighting battle. Now A.J has only one Pokemon left, while Mew still has four Pokemon remaining," The announcer says.

Mew calls out, "You did great, Cinderace."

Soon, Mew notices how tired Cinderace is looking and is taking deep breaths.

Mew brings out her Pokeball and calls out, "Cinderace, you did a great job. Get some rest."

Soon, Cinderace has been called back into her Pokeball.

"And it appears Mew is calling back her Cindrace, wondering which Pokemon she'll use next and what will A.J's last Pokemon be," The announcer says.

At the stand, everyone is anxious and excited.

"Mew just needs to defeat A.J's last Pokemon and she'll be in the finals," Misty says.

"I wonder what A.J's last Pokemon she'll use," Brock says.

"Whoever it is, Mew will be able to defeat it," Tomo says.

Ritchie says, "I know Mew can win."

"Yeah, but A.J's Pokemon are very tough," Joe says.

The others remember that well. Zeraora and Gardevoir watch with calm expressions as Mew continues her battle. Zeraora thinks in his thoughts of what her next move should be.

A.J then brings out his last Pokrmon and calls out, "Tentacruel, I choose you."

"Alright Steenee, I choose you!" Mew calls out

Out of A.J's Pokeball is Tentacruel, while Mew has Steenee.

"It looks like Mew is using Steenee that originated in the Alola Region while A.J is using Tentacruel," The announcer says.

At the stand, Brock says, "This is going to be interesting. Steenee has the Type advantage, but Tentacruel looks very strong."

"Yeah, but I know Steenee is strong too," Misty says.

"Go Mew!" Tomo happily calls out

Steenee and Tentacruel are soon ready to battle each other.

The referee raises the flags and shouts, "Begin!"

A.J calls out, "Tentacruel, use Bubble Beam!"

Tentacruel fires the Bubble Beam Attack!"

"Steenee dodge and use Magical Leaf!" Mew calls out.

Steenee quickly dodges the Bubble Beam Attack.

Then performs Magical Leaf at Tentacruel.

"Quick Tentacruel, deflect the Magical Leaf!" A.J calls out.

Tentacruel uses its tentacles to deflect the Magical Leaf.

Then A.J calls out, "Tentacruel, use Headbutt!"

Tentacruel then begins to charge for a Headbutt, and before Steenee can interact, Twntacruel's attack strikes at her and Steenee then falls towards the ground.

"Steenee!" Mew calls out.

Stenee quickly stands up and adjusts herself to stand.

Then A.J calls out, "Tentacruel, use Poison Jab!"

Tentacruel then begins to perform Poison Jab towards Steenee.

"Steenee dodge and use Double Slap!"" Mew calls out.

Steenee quickly dodge away from the attack and is able Double Slap at Tentacruel. Tentacruel is pushed back, but it soon stands back up.

"Alright Tentacruel, it's time to give it your Water Pulse Attack!" A.J calls out.

Tentacruel then fires the Water Pulse. Steenee begins to dodge from one Water Pulse to another, and the battlefield is starting to get wet. However, so many are coming out at once that Steenee has been hit by a few of them. Steenee soon falls down to the ground.

"Steenee, are you alright?" Mew calls out.

Steenee then comes up, but notices something off with her. She's having trouble standing on her feet and is looking dizzy.

"Steenee?" Mew asks, concerned.

At the stand, Misty asks, "Brock, what happened?"

"I think being hit by the Water Pulse is making Steenee confused," Brock says.

Mew calls out, "Steenee, hang in there."

Steenee shakes a bit and is able to stand, but she still feels a little confused.

Then A.J calls out, "Tentacruel, use Headbutt!"

Tentacruel begins to charge towards Steenee.

Mew cries out, "Steenee, look out!"

Despite being confused, Steenee slowly dodges away.

Then A.J calls out, "Use Poison Jab!"

Tentactuel then begins to use Poison Jab. Steenee tries her best to dodge the attack, despite being dizzy and confused.

The announcer notices, "Well look at that, Steenee is very confused, and is still trying to dodge the attacks!"

Just then, Steenee ends up jumping on top of the Tentacruel's tentacle and it retraces back to it. Steenee still feels dazed that it ends up stepping on Tentacruel's head.

"Steenee!" Mew says, worried.

A.J surprised, "What is that Pokemon doing?"

"This is shocking, Steenee ends up on Tentacruel's head!" The announcer says.

Steenee looks down to see the blue blur she is standing on.

Mew calls out, "Steenee, be careful! You're on Tentacruel's head!"

Hearing Mew's voice, Steenee begins to step on Tentacruel's head. She lifts her legs up and begins to stomp on it. She stomps, and she stomps. Tentacruel tries to shake Steenee off, but Steenee refuses to move. Steenee continues to stomp, and stomp, and stomp.

Mew calls out, "You can do it Steenee!"

Steenee continues to stomp on Tentacruel's head, and suddenly, her legs begin to glow after each stomp.

"That looks like the move, Stomp," Mew says, surprised.

At the crowd, Mew's friends are surprised.

"Is Steenee learning a new move?" Daisy asks.

"I think she is," Adriana says.

"That looks like Stomp. Steenee is learning the move, Stomp," Professor Oak says.

"Look at Steenee go," Misty says.

"Steenee has learned Stomp," Brock says.

Mew calls out, "You can do it Steenee!"

Steenee continues to stomp, but suddenly stops in surprise. Soon, Steenee's body begins to glow and her shape begins to change.

When the transformation stops, Steenee is now a bipedal, plantlike Pokémon with a humanoid appearance. Its torso, arms, and legs are dark purple, while its hips and head are white. It has heavy-lidded, dark purple eyes with purple eyelids and long purple eyelashes, but has no visible mouth or nose. The lower part of its face is hidden behind a short ruff extending up from its body. While its arms are slender with rounded, digit-less hands, its legs are long and powerful. The upper portions of its legs have three pointed projections just before the hips, creating the impression of long boots. The lower portions of its legs taper into small, pointed feet. It has wide hips made up of six segments that resemble the flesh of a mangosteen. And not only that, but has now snapped out of its confusion.

The Pokemon calls out, "TSAR!"

She brushes the bang and answers, "Tsareena!"

"Mew happily says, "Steenee, you evolved!"

Misty says, amazed," Amazing."

"Steenee has evolved," Brock says.

Mew brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Tsareena, the Fruit Pokemon and the evolved form of Steenee. A Grass Type. Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously."

"And it looks like you've also learned a new move as well," Mew says.

Mew then calls out, "Alright Tsareena, let's go."

"Tsareena!" (Let's win this!) Tsareena says.

Tsareena then stomps on Tentacruel. Then jumps off of it and stands before it.

"Alright Tentacruel, use Poison Jab!" A.J calls out.

Tentacruel then performs the Poison Jab attack!"

"Tsareena dodge!" Mew calls out.

Tsareena dodges the attack with speed and grace. Then ends up kicking the Poison Jam away by the tentacle.

"Now let's try out your new move, use Trop Kick!" Mew calls out.

Tsareena quickly speeds towards Tentacruel and kicks Tentacool on the side of it's head, and sends it flying. Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee are surprised to see Tsareena's attack. Meanwhile, Tentacruel struggles to get up.

A.J asks, "Tentacruel, can you still battle?

Tentacruel stands up and is still ready to battle.

"Now then, use Poison Sting!" A.J calls out.

Tentacruel then fires the attack.

"Tsareena, dodge!" Mew calls out.

Tesareena then dodges the attack by jumping in the air.

"Now use Magical Leaf!" Mew calls out.

Tsareena then performs Magical Leaf and strikes at Tentacruel with full force.

"Tsareena, use Double Sleep!" Mew calls out.

Tsareena then begins to use Double Slap.

"Now, us Trop Kick!" Mew calls out.

Tsareena then performs a powerful kick at Tentacruel that sends it flying and then it crashes to the ground. With that, Tsareena then has one of her legs on Tentacroel's head and has her small hands on her hips.

The referee looks to see Tentacruel is all knocked out, and calls out, "Tentacruel is unable to battle, which means Tsareena wins, and the victor goes to Mew."

Soon, it shows that A.J has all of his Pokemon defeated and Mew still has her four Pokemon.

"And there you have it, Mew is the winner of the match and is now moving on to the finals!" The announcer calls out.

Soon, everyone, including Mew's friends and family, cheer with excitement to see an amazing battle and Mew's win. Mew, Pikachu, and Eevee hurry to Tsareena and happily hug her.

"Tsareena, you were great. You surely have gotten strong," Mew happily says.

"Tsareena," (Thank you) Tsareena says, and brushes off her long leaves.

A.J is disappointed that he lost, but he smiles and says, "Tentacruel return!" and returns his Pokemon to his Pokeball.

Mew, Pikachu, Eevee, and Tsareena are happy to know that they won, then turn to see A.J walking towards them.

A.J reaches his hand out and says, "That was a great battle Mew. Good luck in the Finals."

"Thanks A.J," Mew says, and shakes A.J's hand.

Everyone cheers and claps with excitement. Pikachu, Eevee, and Tsareena are happy. Now that Mew has defeated A.J, she is now going to be in the finals of the Pokemon League.
