Chapter 88: Episode 82: Indigo Plateau Finals Preparations

At the Pokemon Center, Mew has the Pokemon she's using brought over so they can get treated. Mew and her friends wait and in no time, Nurse Joy brings out the tray that has her Pokeballs and Chansey brings out the stretcher that has Pikachu and Eevee on them.

Nurse Joy happily says, "All your Pokemon are back to perfect health."

Pikachu and Eevee happily jump off of the stretcher and onto Mew's shoulders.

Mew happily says, "Glad to see you two are all better."

"Pika Pika," (So are we.) Pikachu says.

"Eevee Eevee," (We feel a lot better now.) Eevee says.

"I wish you good luck in the finals, and hope you'll do great at it," Nurse Joy says.

"Thank you Nurse Joy. I'll do my best at the finals," Mew says.

Mew turns to her friends, "Come on guys, we better get going."

"Yeah. Gary's match will be beginning soon," Brock says.

"Let's hurry," Misty says.

"Let's go!" Tomo cheers.

The Pokemon happily cheers as well.

A little time later, Mew and the others are in the stadium and are watching Gary Oak compete in the Semi finals of the Pokemon League against Otoshi.

First Gary uses his Nidoking that is using Megahorn as Otoshi uses a Ninetales that uses Flamethrower. Gary then uses Golem that uses its Rollout Attack, while Otoshi has Dodrio that uses its Drill Peck Attack. Next Gary uses Blastoise that uses Hydro Pump as Otoshi has Kangaskhan that uses an Outrage Attack. Then Gary uses Arcanine that uses Fire Blast, and Otoshi uses a Starmie that performs a Bubble Beam Attack.

Throughout the match, Gary and Otoshi are able to knock each other's Pokemon out. Now the screen shows that Gary has only two Pokemon left while Otoshi has only one Pokemon left. At the battlefield, Otoshi is using his companion, Marowak while Gary has a Scyther.

And on the battlefield, Marowak and Scyther are battling each other rather hard. Scyther uses it's scythes to attack Marowak, but Marowak either dodges or uses its bone to block the attacks.

Otoshi calls out, "Marowak, use Bone Rush!"

Maorwak then begins to use Bone Rush and begins the attack on Scyther.

Gary calls out, "Scyther, deflect it!"

Scyther then uses its white scythes arms to deflect the attack.

Gary then calls out, "Now Scyther, use X-Scissor!"

Scyther then begins to use X-Scissor to get a hard blow on Marowak. Marowak then falls to the ground and is soon knocked out.

The referee says, "Marowak is unable to battle, which means Scyther is the winner and the victor goes to Gary."

Soon, the screen shows Otoshi has no more Pokemon to battle.

"What an outstanding battle. Gary Oak is able to gain his victory and now is moving on to the finals," The announcer says.

Gary smiles and knows that he is now going to compete in the finals, against Mew.

Otoshi walks to Marowak and helps him up. Marowak is disappointed that they lost.

But Ootshi smiles and says, "Do not worry Marowak, you have done an excellent job and gave it your all."

Marowak calmly smiles and nods its head, knowing that they've both done their best.

Mew and her friends clap and cheer with excitement on how great the battle is.

Misty says, "Gary is now going to compete in the finals."

"Yeah. He and Mew are going to be in the finals, and it all comes down to who battles best tomorrow," Brock says.

Mew smiles and is glad Gary is now going to be in the finals. Of course, she knows that both she and Gary are going to compete together for the final battle of the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League Competition.

After the second round of the semi finals, Mew and her friends are walking around the town close to the stadium to see the many food stands, shop booths, and a few game areas.

"Wow. There are a lot of booths today," Misty says.

"Yeah. There are many different games, shops, and lots of different food," Mew says.

Tomo then asks, "Hey Mew, can we get something to eat."

"Sure," Mew happily says.

Mew and her friends look around and soon buy some snacks like corn dogs, popcorn, drinks, and cotton candy. Mew and the others also give some of the food to the Pokemon, much to their delight.

Mew asks, "The cotton candy tastes good, huh guys?"

"Pika Pika," (It tastes very good.) Pikachu happily says.

Eevee happily says, "Eevee," (It's very sweet.)

"So guys, what do you want to do next?" Brock asks.

Mew turns her head and notices the booth, "Hey guys, look over there."

The others turn their heads to notice some people gathering around a booth. The booth has two people that have many different prizes behind them. On the table, there is a marble lottery and a few more prizes on the table.

Tomo asks, "What's that?"

"It's a lottery game. You turn the well to the marble lottery and depending on what color marble comes out, you win a prize," Brock says.

"Sounds fun. Let's go check it out," Mew says.

Mew and her friends decide to check out the booth, and they can see so many different prizes. There are Pokemon keychains, jewelry, Evolution Stones, flutes, pearls, and other items, there's even a few Pokemon Eggs, Pokeballs, a few bicycles, and other stuff that are being offered for prizes. There's also a few Pokeballs with Pokemon inside of them.

Interested, Mew says, "So, any of you guys wanna play?"

"Sure. It sounds fun, and maybe you can win me a new bike," Misty says.

Mew laughs, "Right. I still owe you for frying your bike."

"Hey Mew, can I go first?" Tomo asks.

"Sure. I think I have more than enough for both of us. And it seems that it's Five dollars for three tries and two dollars for one," Mew says.

"I want to do it three times," Tomo says.

"Sure," Mew says.

After paying the man, Tomo is the first to turn the wheel on the marble lottery game. Then turn the wheel the opposite direction. Soon, a small white marble comes out. He does the same thing again, and ends up with another white marble. Finally, after a third time, he ends up with a green marble.

The vendor says, "Two whites and a green. It's a good win. Now you can pick anything you like from the white section and the green section."

Tomo looks to see that the white section has some berries, small key chains, postcards, and other small stuff. Tomo takes two Oran berries and gives them to Meloetta and Skwovet. Tomo also looks at the green section to see a few t-shirts, hats, scarves, ascots, and bandanas, bracelets, and other accessories. Tomo then takes a blue shirt that has a Pikachu on it.

Tomo happily says, "Thank you."

"No problem. Now who's next," The vendor replies.

Misty steps forward, "I'll go next."

Misty then pays the vendor and decides to have a go. After three tries on the wheel, she ends up with one white marble, one yellow marble, and one green one. Misty then picks out a postcard that has a picture of water Pokemon from the white section. From the green section, she picks out a light blue scarf, and on the yellow section, this one has a lot of different Pokeballs. Misty picks out a Dive Ball.

Brock then has a turn with the lottery. Brock ends up with a blue marble, white marble, and a green ball. From the white section, Brock takes a geodude keychain. From the green section, he takes a wristband. From the blue section, where they have evolutionary items, Brock takes a Metal Coat.

Now finally it's Mew's turn. Mew spins the wheel three times, and ends up with a red ball, an orange ball, and a purple ball. From the red section, Mew ends up with a Pokemon that is already in a Pokeball. From the orange section, Mew has received a Pokemon Egg in an incubator. The Pokemon Egg inside has an ivory color on the top and bottom, in the middle, it has a lovely silver color. The last prize from the purple one, Mew ends up winning a bicycle for a one rider, and it comes with a basket at the front.

Mew then takes the bike and presents it to Misty, "Here you go Misty, one Bike."

"Thank you Mew," Misty says, and happily takes the bike.

Then places Togepi and Pichu in the basket, "Now there's also a basket for Pichu and Pikachu to ride in."

Togepi and Pichu are happy.

"So Mew, what you got in the Pokeball?" Brock asks.

"Yeah. What Pokemon did you get?" Tomo asks, curiously.

"Let's see," Mew says.

Then tosses her Pokeball in the air, "Come on out."

The Pokeball is tossed in the air, opens, and the Pokemon comes out. It's an artificial Pokémon that is a plain, gray cloud with a single wisp extending from the top of its head.

"It's a Castform," Mew says.

Mew holds out her Pokdex and Dexter says, "Castform, the Weather Pokemon. A Normal Type. It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather. The Sunny Form makes it a Fire Type. A Rainy Form makes it a Water Type, and the Snowy Form makes it an Ice Type."

"Wow. It's like having four different Pokemon Types in one Pokemon," Misty says.

"Yeah," Mew says.

Then turns to Castform, "Castform, let's become good friends."

"Castform," (Of course) Castform happily says.

Then Mew returns Castfrom to its Pokeball.

Then Misty asks, "So Mew, have you decided which Pokemon you want to use for your match tomorrow. Remember, you'll be fighting Gary."

"I know, but to also be honest, I'm really nervous about it. I've only known Gary for like three years now, and it feels that he's one of my best friends. I guess you can say I'm excited that I'm excited about battling him and seeing how much we've grown and raised our Pokemon, but at the same time, I'm nervous about facing one of my best friends," Mew explains.

"Don;t worry, I'm sure you'll do great tomorrow. Even if you are battling against Gary. You just need to remember that you and Gary just need to give it everything you got," Brock says.

Mew smiles, "You're right. I need to remember that my Pokemon and I have trained hard for this, and now we're in the finals. I just need to remember to give it everything I've got. I know Gary is feeling the same way."

"So Mew, did you know what kind of Pokemon you want to use," Misty says.

Mew then turns to Pikachu and Eevee, "Of course, I want to choose Pikachu and Eevee for the finals."

"And what about the other four?" Tomo says.

"Well, I'm thinking of using Charizard. And well, I've decided that Charizard and I are going wear the Key Stone and Mega Stone that Mr. Kyle handed them down to me." Mew says.

"That's a great idea. Do you think you and Chariard might be able to Mega Evolve?" Misty replies.

"To be honest, I'm not sure. But I know that Charizard has grown so much since," Mew says.

"I'm sure you two can do it," Tomo says.

Mew smiles and says, "Thanks."

Meanwhile, on the different side of Pokemon Village, Gary is also deep in thought about his final match tomorrow, and he's going up against Mew.

"Hmm, what kind of Pokemon can I use? Mew has so many different Pokemon that it's going to be hard to know which one she'll use. She makes sure to switch some when they get either very injured or tired. Still, this is a lot of thinking on what to do about tomorrow," Gary says to himself.

Then sighs, "Especially since I'm going to be battling against her."

"Hey Gary," Daisy's voice calls out.

Garty turns to see Daisy along with Adriana walking towards him.

"Hi mom. Hi Daisy, how are you doing?" Gary replies.

"We're doing fine, but I can tell you're very deep in thought," Adriana says.

"Yeah. Since the finals are tomorrow," Daisy says.

"I know. That's why I'm thinking very hard on which Pokemon to use and do some training before our match. Also well, I'm also feeling a bit weird about it," Gary says.

Adrian nods her head and says, "I know. It's rather weird battling against your best friend. Some trainers feel that way sometimes, but for your case, I can sense a little more for you."

Gary blushes and says, "I… I don't know what you're talking about."

Adriana giggles and says, "You kind of reminded me of me when I felt like that."

"Huh?" Gary and Daisy reply, confused.

Adriana then says, "I felt the same way when I was facing against your father in the finals too."

"You did?" Daisy says, confused.

"Yes. But we both agree that no matter what happens, we're going to give it everything we had. Of course, I was still uneasy because I actually developed a crush on him," Adriana says.

Then calmly smiles and says, "And I can tell that you feel the same for you."

"Oh…" Gray says, feeling a little embarrassed.

Daisy says, "Somehow I figured as much. When you leave home, you practically want to be around her and to help her out. You even read Pokemon books and watch T.V together. I suspect that you've developed feelings for her."

"I suppose… but I also need to remember that we're also rivals," Gary says, now sounding eager to battle.

"Yeah. and I'm sure Mew feels the same. Even though you're friends and rivals, you both are also trainers and need to be sure you put your heart and training you've done into your battle. I want you and Mew to give it everything you have on your match tomorrow," Adriana says.

Gary nods his head with a smile and says, "Don't worry, I won't be holding back and will show Mew what kind of match she's in for."

"So, have you decided what Pokemon to use?" Daisy asks.

"I have a few ideas, it's just a little hard to predict because Mew has so many. I suspect she'll be using Pikachu and Eevee at some point," Gary says.

"Sounds like you're in for a good start," Adriana says.

"Yeah. But I have to remember it's Mew we're talking about. She might not be easy to predict when it comes to her Pokemon," Gary says.

Later in the night, everyone else is fast asleep for the night before the finals of the Pokemon competition. Mew however is the only one who isn't sleeping. She is sitting outside of the porch in front of the cabin she is staying in.

Mew takes a deep breath and says, "Tomorrow it's going to be the finals. And tomorrow I'm going to face off against Gary. I'm so excited and yet so nervous about it. Still, it's also going to be when I show Gary and everyone how hard I've trained for this."

She smiles and says, "I just need to give it everything I've got, for myself and for my Pokemon."

Suddenly, she hears a growl sound. She turns her head to see her papa, Zeraora.

"Oh, hi papa, how are you doing?" Mew asks.

Zeraora growls, "I'm good, are you ready for tomorrow?"

"Yes papa. I think I'm ready for tomorrow. I promise to give it everything I got in my match," Mew says.

Zeraora calmly smiles and nods his head. He then begins growling like he is talking to Mew.

Whatever Zeraora says, has Mew surprised, but then smiles, "Really? Are you sure?"

Zeraora growls with a smile and agrees to it.

Mew smiles and says, "Oh, I'm so happy."

Then hugs her papa with a smile.

Suddenly, they hear someone say, "It looks like we're in for an outstanding match tomorrow."

Mew and Zeraoa turns to see Professor Oak.

Mew happily says, "Professor Oak."

"Yes. I suspected you'll be up and wanted to wish you good luck tomorrow. And it looks like everyone is in for a surprise tomorrow," Professor Oak says.

Mew laughs and says, "They sure are, especially my friends."

The next day is the day of the finals, all the people who arrive are so excited to see the finals of the Pokemon League competition about to take place. Among them, Misty, Brock, Tomo, A.J. Ritchie, Otoshi, and Joe are there. There are also Professor Oak, Adriana, Daisy, and Gardevoir holding her Pokemon Egg. Everyone is so excited to see the finals is now taking place, but some are a bit anxious because this battle is going to be two close friends and in a way rivals compete against each other, and Mew's friends are feeling those emotions.

The announcers, "Now it's the moment we've been waiting for, it's time for the Pokemon Indigo League Finals!"

Everyone claps and cheers with excitement and can't wait for the finals to take place. Soon, on the left side, Gary Oak walks out to make his entrance.

The announcer says, "On the red side we have Gary Oak from Pallet Town!"

The crowd cheers with excitement, especially Professor Oak, Adriana, and Daisy. Misty and the others clap with smiles on their faces.

Soon, walking out from the ride side of the stadium, Mew is with Pikachu and Eevee walking beside her, and to Misty and the others surprise, Zeraora is with her.

Misty is the first to speak, "Zeraora? What's he doing here?"

"You'll see," Professor Oak says.

The announcer says, "And on the right side, we have Mew from Pallet Town!"

Misty and her friends cheer with excitement.

Then the announcer says, "These two Pallet Town trainers are competing for the first time and now rise to face each other in the finals! Only six Pokemon can be used and each trainer is allowed to switch Pokemon! The winner is when all Pokemon from one side are unable to battle!"

Mew and Gary soon reach their position on the battlefield. The two young trainers from Pallet Town look at each other with calm smiles and with determination in their eyes. They not only plan to give it their all, but they all plan on winning.

Gary then brings out his Pokeball and calls out, "Nidoqueen, I choose you!"

With that, a large Pokemon comes out of its Pokeball. It's a large, bipedal blue Pokémon with distinct reptilian features. Its body is encased with extremely hard scales. It has a blunt snout, narrow brown eyes, and large ears with brown insides. There is a small horn on its forehead, a single spine on each ear, and a line of toxic spikes running down the length of its back. Each hand has three short claws and each foot has two claws. Its lower jaw, the front of its abdomen, and two plates on its chest are cream-colored. It has a thick, powerful tail.

"Wow. So he has a Nidoqueen," Mew says, impressed.

She brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Nidoqueen, the Drill Pokemon and the final evolved form of a Female Nidoran. A Poison and Ground Type. Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this Pokémon. It appears that the scales grow in cycles."

"This will be tough, but I know I have to give it my all," Mew says.

Then turns to her papa, "Ready papa?"

Zeraora growls with a nod.

Then calls out, "Alright Papa, let's go!"

With that, Zeraora jumps into the battlefield. At the stand, excluding Processor Oak and Gardevoir, Misty and the others are shocked.

"Zeraora is going to battle?!" Brock exclaims in surprise.

"I can't believe it," Misty says.

"That's so cool," Tomo says, excited.

"I never thought Zeraora was going to battle with his daughter. That's so sweet," Adriana says.

"This is going to be one interesting battle," Daisy says with a nod.

Gary is a little surprised, but simply smiles with confidence and determination.

Then say, "Well, this is quite the surprising start for the finals. And yet, I've always wanted to battle against your dad."

"Somehow, I knew you said that. But you know, my papa, my friends, and myself are going to give it everything we got," Mew says.

Gary says, "I wouldn't have it any other way."

This is surely to be a surprising event, Mew and Gary are now going to compete against each other in the finals, and Mew is going to have her papa compete in the final round of the Indigo Plateau. Who will be the victor of the finals? Gary or Mew? And how will this battle turn out? That is something on everyone's minds right now.

Chapter 89: Episode 83: Indigo Plateau Finals Part 1: Mew Vs Gary

The final battle of the Pokemon Indigo Plateau League is now beginning. The final trainers who will be battling are Mew and Gary. Gary has called out Nidoqueen for his first battle. And to everyone, especially Mew's friends' surprise, Mew has called out her papa, Zeraora to be her battle companion for the first match.

The announcer says, "Alright everyone, Gary has chosen Nidoqueen for his Pokrmon while Mew is using a rare Pokemon called Zeraroa. This will be the first Pokemon they use for the finals of the Pokemon Indigo League. Two trainers from Pallet Town and on their first time in the Pokemon League have reached the finals with spectacular battles they've performed. Who will win the League and become champion."

As the announcer states out the battle, many trainers of different kinds are watching the finals. Even many friends, and other trainers Mew and her friends have met on their journey.

All the gym leaders are watching from their separate gyms.

The Elite Four are watching in the same room.

Gisele and her classmates are watching from Pokemon Tech School, and so many other trainers and friends are seeing the finals. Many of them are watching because Mew is going to be at the finals.

At the battlefield, Mew with her papa, Zeraora, and Gary along with his Nidoquen are ready to battle.

The referee holds the flags in the air and shouts, "Let the battle begin!"

"Alright, let's go Papa!" Mew calls out.

Zeraora roars and begins to charge.

Gary calls out, "Go Nidoqueen!"

Nidoqueen then charges as well.

Gary calls out, "Alright Nidoqueen, let's start with your Mud-Shot Attack!"

Nidoqueen then performs Mud-shot at Sephora.

Mew calls out, "Papa, dodge and use Close Combat!"

Zeraora quickly dodges the attack and performs Close Combat at Nidoqueen.

"Nidoqueen, use Dynamic Punch!" Gary calls out.

Nidoqueen then uses Dynamic Punch and is able to push Zeraora back, but is still in a standing position.

"You alright, papa?" Mew asks.

Zeraora growls in reply with a nod.

"Alright, now use Brick Break!" Mew calls out.

Then Gary calls out, "Nidoqueen, use Break Break as well!"

With both Pokemon charging at each other and beginning to use Brick break at each other. There are a few hits and misses between them.

"Now use Bulldoze!" Gary calls out.

Nidoqueen then uses Bulldoze and it pushes Zeraora back.

Then Mew calls out, "Papa, use Agility!"

With that, Zeraora begins to use Agility to get some speed on the battlefield. Nidoqueen tries to attack Zeraora, but the electric Pokemon is too fast and is able to dodge it.

Gary thinks, "Zeraora is fast, but I know to slow him down."

Then calls out, "Kidoqueen, use Earth Power!"

Nidoqueen then causes Earth Power by slamming its fist to the ground and causing cracks on the ground.

"Papa! Look out!" Mew calls out.

Seeing the Earth Power Attack, Zeraora uses his agility to dodge the attack as it spreads across the field. Then jumps into the air and over Nidoqueen.

"Now, use Close Combat!" Mew calls out.

Zeraora then begins to throw multiple Close Combats without giving the other side to attack

"Papa, us Thunder Punch!" Mew calls out.

Zeraora creates electric fists in its paws and throws a hard and yet very powerful punch at Nidoqueen. Nidoqueen is pushed back and slams to the wall. Gary turns in shock to see Nidoqueen has been slammed to the wall and is knocked out.

The referee sees it, "Nidoqueen is unable to battle, which means Zeraora is the victor."

The screen shows Gary has one pokemon defeated and has only five left. And next to the picture, it shows Mew still has her six Pokemon.

Everyone claps and cheers with excitement.

Mew happily says, "You were great papa."

Zeraora growls with a calm smile.

Gary calmly smiles and returns his Pokemon, "Nidoqueen returns." Soon, the Pokemon is in his Pokeball.

Then turns to Mew, "Have to admit, your papa is strong. Course, I never expect less from the Master and protector of the forest of Pallet Town."

"Yeah. Papa is really amazing, and the best father too," Mew happily says.

Then Mew calls back, "Okay papa, you can take a break now."

Zeraora calmly nods his head and returns back to Mew's side.

Gary brings out his Pokeball, "Now then, it's time to be serious. Go Arcanine!"

With that, Arcanine comes out of its Pokeball.

"Alright then. Go Squirtle!" Mew calls out and throws her Pokeball.

With that, Squirtle comes out of his Pokeball.

The announcer says, "Gary has chosen Arcanine for his second Pokemon and Mew is going with Squirtle!"

"Alright Arcanine, go!" Gary calls out.

"Let's go Squirtle!" Mew calls out.

With that, Squrtile and Arcanine begin to charge to begin the attack.

"Alright Squirtle, use Water Gun!" Mew calls out.

Squirtle then begins to use Water Gun attack, and is able to hit Arcanine, but doesn't have much effect.

Arcanine continues to charge as Gary calls out, "Arcanine, use Headbutt!"

Arcanine charges and ends up using headbutt on Squirtle, and causes it to hit the ground.

"Squirtle, you okay?" Mew asks.

Squirtle is able to stand and shake it off.

"Alright, Squirtle, use Rapid Spin!" Mew calls out.

Squirtle then begins to use Rapid Spin and is able to strike at Arcanine and continues.

Then Mew calls out, "Squirtle, use Water Gun."

Squritle then begins to use Water Gun while still in the shell and sprays water all over.

"What an impressive combination attack," The announcer says.

Just then, Gary calls out, "Arcanine, use Iron Tail!"

Arcanine then uses Iron Tail and is able to strike at Squirtle with full force, and slams Squirtle to the ground.

"Squirtle!" Mew calls out.

Squirtle is able to come out of his shell, but Squirtle has been knocked out by the attack.

The referee calls it, Squirtle is unable to battle, Arcanine is the victor," The referee says.

Soon the screen shows that Mew has lost one Pokemon and has five remaining. And is tied with Gary.

"What an outstanding counter attack! Arcanine delivers a hard Iron Tail that knocks Squirtle out!" The announcer says.

"Return Squirtle," Mew says, returning Squirtle to his Pokeball.

Then look at it, "You did your best."

Then Mew turns to Pikachu, "Alright Pikachu, you're up!"

Pikachu answers, "Pika Pika!" (You got it!)

Pikachu then gets into the battlefield for his turn. Gary decides to keep Arcanine on. On the battlefield, the battle is about to begin.

Gary calls out, "Arcanine, use Flamethrower!"

Arcanine uses a Flamethrower to strike at Pikachu.

"Pikachu, use agility!" Mew calls out.

Piakchu then uses Agility to dodge the attack.

"Extreme Speed!" Gary calls out.

Arcanine then begins to use Extreme Speed to speed at Pikachu and strikes at it. Pikachu skids to the ground, but is still able to stand.

Then Arcanine calls out, "Arcanine, use Iron Tail!"

Arcanine then begins to use Iron Tail.

Then Mew calls out, "Pikachu, use Iron Tail too!"

Pikachu then jumps up and uses Iron Tail too. Soon, the two Iron Tails collide with one another. Pikachu is able to push Arcanine away with his Iron Tail.

Then Mew calls out, "Pikachu, use Thunderbolt!"

Pikachu then uses Thunderbolt and is able to electrically shock Arcanine.

"Now then, time to give it a Thunder Punch!" Mew calls out.

Pikachun then creates electricity that travels into its paws. Then clutches it's right paw into a fist and performs a Thunder Punch that strikes Arcanine in the face, and pushes Arcanine and has it fall to the ground.

"Arcanine!" Gary calls out.

The referee looks to see that Arcanine has been knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Arcanine is unable to battle. Pikachu wins."

Soon, the screen shows Gary has lost another Pokemon and still has four. At the same time, Mew still has her five Pokemon.

Gary calls back his Pokemon, "Return." and Arcanine is back in its Pokeball.

He brings out another and calls out, "Go Scyther!"

With that, Scyther comes out of its Pokeball. Pikachu remains on the battlefield and is ready to battle.

"Alright Pikachu, let's go," Mew calls out, and Pikachu charges.

Then Gary calls out, "Alright Scyther, let's go!"

With that, both Pokemon begin to charge and ready to attack. Scyther tries to attack Pkachu with it's scythe-like arms, but Pikachu quickly dodge the attack.

Mew calls out, "Pikachu, use Iron Tail."

Pikachu begins to use Iron Tail to deflect Scyther's attack.

Then Gary calls out, "Scyther, use X-Scissors!"

Scyther then performs X-Scissors and strikes at Pikachu with full force.

Then Gary calls out, "Now, use Air Slash!"

Scyther then performs Air Slash and strikes at Pikachu. Making Pikachu fall to the ground.

"Pikachu are you alright?" Mew asks.

Pikachu stands and is able to shake off the pain. Then position himself to battle.

Mew then says, "Alright Pikachu, Quick Attack!"

Pikachu then begins to use Quick Attack.

Then Gary calls out, "Scyther, use Fury Cutter!"

Scyther then begins to use the attack to try attacking Pikachu, but Pikachu is able to dodge the attack multiple times. When the last attack blows, Pikachu ends up getting hit on the side and falls to the ground.

"Now use Wing Attack!" Gary calls out

Scyther then charges for another attack, and strikes at Pikachu with a Wing Attack and falls to the ground.

"Pikachu, can you still fight?" Mew asks.

Pikachu struggles to get up, but is still standing.

"Now use Wing Attack once more!" Gary calls out.

Mew looks to see Scyther is heading towards Pikachu and strikes Pikachu with the attack with full force. Soon, Pikachu falls to the ground and is knocked out.

The referee sees this and says, "Pikachu is unable to battle. Scyther is the winner.

On the screen, it shows that Gary still has four Pokemon left, and now Mew now has four Pokemon in her batch. Mew walks over and picks up Pikachu in her arms.

Mew smiles and says, "It's okay Pikachu, I got you."

Pikachu feels rather dizzy and exhausted.

Mew places Pikachu in her bag at her side of the battlefield next to Eevee, "You get some rest."

Mew turns and throws her Pokeball and calls out, "Go Bulbasaur!"

With that, Bulbasaur comes out of his Pokeball.

The referee calls out, "Let's begin the battle!"

With that, Scyther and Bulbasaur begin to battle. Scyther tries to attack Bulbasaur, but Bulbasaur does the attack.

Then Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur, use Razor Leaf!"

Bulbasaur then uses Razor Leaf and the attack heads towards Scyther.

Gary calls out, "Scyther, block it!"

Scyther uses the scythes to deflect the attacks.

Then Gary says, "Now, use Fury Cutter!"

Scyther then begins to use Fury Cutter to attack Bulbasaur. Bulbasaur dodges the attack the best it could.

"Bulbasaur, use Vine Whip!" Mew calls out.

Bulbasaur then uses Wine Whip to attack Scyther, and to help dodge the attacks. Scyther then uses its scythes to attack the Wine Whip. Scyther then tries to attack, and Bulbasaur dodges.

Mew calls out, "Bulbasaur quick, use Leech Seed!"

Bulbasaur quickly dodges out of the way, and is able to launch a Leech Seed. The Leech Seed has been fired and sits Scyther on the forehead. Then the Leech Seed takes effect, and its energy is being drained.

Mew then calls out, "Now Bulbasaur, use Take Down!"

Bulbasaur then charges towards Scyther and performs the Take Down Attack. And soon, Scyther is knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Scyther is unable to battle, Bulbasaur wins."

"Alright, you did it, Bulbasaur," Mew says.

"Bulbasaur," (Alright) Bulbasaur calls out.

Gary then calls back Scyther, and calls out, "Rhydon, I choose you!"

With that, Rhydon comes out of the Pokeball.

Soon the referee calls out, "Begin!"

With that, Bulbasaur and Rhydon charge into battle.

Rhydon calls out, "Rhydon, use Bulldoze!"

Rhydon then performs Bulldoze and strikes its fist to the ground, causing it to shake, and Bulbasaur has been pushed back.

Then Gary calls out, "Use your Horn Attack!"

Rhydon then charges to give Bulbasaur a Horn Attack.

"Bulbasaur, dodge!" Mew calls out.

Bulbasaur quickly dodges the attack.

Then Mew calls out, "Use Razor Leaf!"

Bulbasaur used Razor Leaf and it seems to have a little effect.

Rhydon turns around and Gary calls out, "Use Stone Edge!"

Rhydon then performs Stone Edge and rocks rises in the air. Bulbasaur has been striked with the Stone edge rather hard and falls to the ground. Soon enough, Bulbasaur is knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Bulbasaur is unable to battle."

The screen then shows that Gary still has three Pokemon. Then shows Mew has lost one Pokemon and only has three Pokemon left. Now they're both tied.

At the stand, Misty says, "Wow. The battle is getting intense huh."

"You're right. Gary is a skilled trainer and won't make this easy for Mew," Brock says.

"And Mew and Gary have only three Pokemon left," Tomo says.

Misty says, "I hope Mew will be alright."

On the battlefield, Mew calls back Bulbasaur in her Pokeball and says, "You get some rest, you did your best."

Mw then turns to Eevee, "Ready Eevee?"

"Eevee!" (Okay!) Eevee says, excited and gets onto the battlefield.

The referee waves the flag and calls out, "Begin."

With that, Eevee and Rhydon charges and begins to set for an attack.

"Eevee use Quick Attack!" Eevee then begins to perform Quick Attack.

Gary calls out, "Rhydon, use Take Down!"

"Eevee dodge!" Mew calls out.

Rhydon begins to perform the Take Down attack but Eevee begins to dodge the attack. Eevee dodges as Rhydon continues to throw more of the attacks.

Eevee jumps in the air and Mew calls out, "Now use Swift!"

Eevee then performs Swift and is able to strike at Rhydon. Rhydon stumbles back, but it's still standing.

Then Gary calls out, "Rhydon, use Secret Power!"

Rhydon then begins to perform Secret Power and they aim towards Eevee. Eevee is able to dodge the attack.

"Alright Eevee, use Swift!" Mew calls out.

However, Eevee jumps in the air and ends up performing a different attack. Eevee's body has a golden aura around her body. Then has orbs of energy absorbed into her body. She jumps in the air, and fires a large start at Rhydon, and strikes at it with full force. Then Eevee lands on the ground.

"What attack is that?" Mew wonders.

She takes out her Pokedex and looks at it, "Last Resort."

Mew happily says, "Wow Eevee, you've learned how to use Last Resort!"

Eevee happily says, "Eevee! (Cool!)"

Soon, the referee looks to see that the new attack has knocked Rhydon down and is knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Rhydon is unable to battle. Eevee wins."

Soon, the screen shows that Gary lost another Pokemon and is down to two. At the same time, Mew still has three Pokemon left.

"Eevee!" (Alright!) Eevee happily cheers.

"Alright, you were great Eevee," Mew happily says.

Gary then calls back Rhydon and says, "Alright I only got two Pokemon and Mew still only has three. Now then…"

And brings out his Pokeball, "It's time to bring out one of my strongest Pokemon."

Then calls out, "Go Blastoise!" With that, Gary throws the Pokeball.

Soon, Blastoise is on the battlefield.

"Alright Eevee, let's go!" Mew says.

"Eevee!" (Right!) Eevee says.

The referee announces, "Begin!"

"Eevee go!" Mew calls out.

With that, Eevee begins to pick up some speed.

Gary starts the attack, "Blastoise, use Water Gun!"

Blastoise begins to throw the Water Gun Attack, and Eevee dodges them. Then Eevee jumps in the air.

Eevee, use Swift!" Mew calls out.

Eevee then performs Swift at Blastoise.

"Blastoise, withdraw!" Gary calls out.

Blastoise withdraws into the shell and the Swift attack hits it. Eevee then lands on the ground.

Then Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Flash Cannon!"

Blastoise then fires a powerful Flash Cannon.

"Eevee dodge!" Mew calls out, and Eevee quickly dodges.

Just by a hair.

Then Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Rapid Spin!"

Blastoise then performs Rapid Spin and is able to strike at Eevee before she can do anything. Eevee skids on the battlefield and struggles to stand up.

"Eevee, hang in there!" Mew calls out.

Eevee is able to stand up.

Mew then calls out, "Eevee, use Thunderbolt!"

Eevee then jumps up and performs Thunderbolt.

But Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Protect!"

Blastoise uses protect to deflect the Thunderbolt, much to Mew and Eevee's shock.

Then Gary calls out, "Now use Hydro Pump!"

Blastoise then fires the Hydro Pump at Eevee and fires it like a cannon. Eevee has been blasted and crashes to the ground. Eevee is dizzy, soaked and wet, and is knocked out.

"Eevee!" Mew calls out worried.

The referee sees that Eevee is down, "Eevee is unable to battle, Blastoise wins."

Mew walks to the stage and picks up Eevee and snuggles Eevee as says, "You did great Eevee. It's time for you to get a good rest."

Mew then walks back to her side of the battlefield and brings out a blanket to wrap Eevee in. then places her in her bag with Pikachu who is still resting as watching the match. Eevee is able to gain consciousness and look to see Mew is still battling.

The screen shows that Gary still has two, and Mew only has two left now.

The announcer says, "Now we got two out of two. Which Pokemon will Mew go to next?"

Mew turns to Zeraroa, "Wanna give it another shot papa?"

Zeraora nods his head and jumps into the battlefield. As soon as Zeraora steps on the battlefield, the battle begins. The Pokemon begin to charge towards each other.

Mew then calls out the first move, "Papa, use Spark!"

Zeraora then begins to use Spark and attempts the attack.

"Blastoise, use withdraw!" Gary calls out.

Zeraora withdraws back into his head as Zeraora throws the attack. Once the attack is done, Blastoise comes out of its shell.

Then Gary calls out, "Now, use Flash Cannon!"

With that, Blastoise uses Flash Cannone from it's cannon and fires it at Zeraora.

Mew calls out, "Papa, dodge and use Close Combat!"

Zeraora charges and quickly jumps in the air. Then performs Close Combat at Blastoise.

But Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Aqua Tail!"

Blastoise then performs Aqua Tails, sending Zeraora flying. Then Zeraora crashes to the ground. Zeraroa grunts and growls as he begins to stand back on his feet.

"Papa, can you still battle?" Mew asks.

Zeraora is able to stand up and turns to Mew with a calm nod.

"Alright, let's continue the battle," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Use Agility!"

Zeraora then begins to use Agility.

Then Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Rapid Spin!"

Blastoise begins to use Rapid Spin and spins towards Zeraora. Zeraora then uses Agility to dodge the attack. Blastoise bounces off the wall, and Zeraora dodges. Soon, Blastoise is bouncing all over the battlefield, and Zeraora quickly dodges the attack.

Mew then calls out, "Papa, use Thunderbolt!"

Zeraora then performs Thunderbolt as Blastoise comes at it, and gives it an electric shock from inside the shell. Blastoise lands on the ground as it comes out of its shell. However, Blastoise begins to stand up and struggles to stand a little.

Then Gary calls out, "Blastoise, give it your Focus Punch!"

"Papa, use Close Combat!" Mew calls out.

Balstoise and Zeraroa begins to use their attack and end up turning into a powerful fist fight. Blastoise and Zeraora are able to throw punches at each other and neither of them are backing down. Zeraora is able to dodge the Focus punch and jumps in the air.

Then Mew calls out, "Use Thunder Punch!"

Zeraroa then begins to use Thunder Punch and is able to slam Blastoise with it. Blastoise is pushed back, but is still standing.

Gary calls out, "Use Flash Cannon!"

Blastoise then uses Flash Cannon.

Mew calls out, "Dodge!"

Zeraora dodges the attack.

Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Hydro Pump!"

"Papa, use Plasma Fist!" Mew calls out.

Blastoise then sets his cannon towards Zeraora, as the electric Pokemon prepares to use his attack. Blastoise fires the cannon as Zeraroa charges and uses the Plasma Fist to split through the Hydro Pump. Zeraora is closing in on Blastoise.

Then Gary calls out, "Blastoise, use Aqua Tail!"

Blastoise uses Aqua Tail as Zeraora uses the blow of the Plasma Fist at the Pokemon. When both Pokemon collide, a huge explosion occurs of water and electricity. Water comes splashing and pouring down like rain as the smoke is exposed around the battlefield. Everyone waits anxiously for what will happen. When the smoke clears, it appears that both Zeraora and Blastoise are both knocked out.

The referee calls out, "Both Pokemon are unable to battle."

Soon, it shows that Gary and Mew lost another Pokemon, and are now down to one more Pokemon.

Gary calmly calls back his Pokemon into his Pokeball, "Return Blastoise."

He then looks at his Pokeball and says, "You did a great job, Blastoise. And you put on a great battle."

Mew walks to her papa and looks to see him regaining consciousness.

Mew calmly smiles and says, "You did a great job papa. I'm so happy you got to battle with me."

Zeraora weakly nods his head with a smile. Mew then helps Zeraora back on his feet, and helps him back back to her side of the battlefield. Pikachu and Eevee, who are feeling a little better, watch to see Mew bring her papa to the bench close by. Pikachu and Eevee decide to join Zeraora on the seat.

At the stands, Mew's friends watch to see Mew returning to the battlefield.

"Wow. That was an intense battle," Misty says.

"Yeah. And I never thought Zeraora could be beaten, but it's very strong," Brock says.

"Yeah. Mew's papa is very strong," Tomo says.

Adriana says, "This is getting really intense, now both Gary and Mew have one Pokemon left."

"And it all comes down to this. The last Pokemon that they use, will help decide on the winner," Professor Oak says.

"I'm rooting for both to give it all they got," Daisy says.

The announcer announces, "Looks like it's down to the wire. Both Gary and Mew have only one Pokemon remaining. It all comes down to their final Pokemon. Which one will they use?"

Gary says in thought, "This is it. This is my last Pokemon. I have one more Pokemon and I've saved this one for last. It's time to finish this."

"Alright, I have one more Pokemon left. And this is the final battle Gary and I will have to face. I can only hope I'm ready. I can only hope we're ready for this," Mew says.

Mew then takes out the Bracelet Ring that has the Key Stone on it. She remembers Mr. Kyle has given it to it. She then places it on her wrist.

She says, "It's time to finish this battle. My Pokemon and I have trained so hard for this."

She smiles and says, "Time to give it everything we've got."

Gary then throws his Pokeball and calls out, "Go Salamence!"

The Pokeball opens as it's been thrown towards the battlefield, and a strong Pokemon comes out. The Pokemon Gary has is a quadrupedal, draconic Pokémon with a long, tapering tail. It is primarily blue with a gray lower jaw and thickly scaled underside. There are red markings on its throat, the underside of its tail, and stripes on the inner surface of its legs. Additionally, there are raised red ridges above its eyes. Three flat fins protrude from either side of its head, possibly acting in the same manner that a Canard would on an aircraft. It has two pairs of pointed teeth, one in the upper jaw and one in the lower. Each of its short legs has three claws.

Everyone is surprised to see this, especially Mew and her friends, and Gary's family.

"That's a Salamence? When did Gary get a Salamence?" Mew says to herself.

She brings out her Pokedex and Dexter says, "Salamence, the Dragon Pokemon. A Dragon and Flying Type. Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon's cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings."

"Well then, this is starting to get more interesting," Mew says.

And brings out his Pokeball, "And now it's time to bring out my closest friend…"

Then throws her Pokeball, "Go Charizard!"

Out of the Pokeball is Charizard and he is wearing the Metal-plated collar with the Charizardite X on it, that's also been given to by Mr. Kyle.

This is the final event for the Finals of the Pokemon Indigo League. Mew is using Charizard and Gary is using Salamence. It's down to the wire. Who will win the Pokemon League and launch victorious?

Chapter 90: Episode 84: Indigo Plateau Finals Part 2: Mega Evolution Debut Battle

Last time, the finals of the Pokemon League started. It's Mew vs. Gary in the final round to see which one will become champion. The two have battled hard with their Pokemon, and now, they're both down to their very last Pokemon. Gary is using a Pokemon called Salamence, while Mew is using Charizard. It all comes down to their final Pokemon, and their training will be put to the ultimate test. Both trainers and their Pokemon stand and look at their opponent with determination and they plan to give it their all.

The referee calls out, "Begin!"

"Alright, let's go Charizard!" Mew calls out.

Charizard lets out a mighty roar and begins to spread his wings and fly to battle.

Gary calls out, "Alright Salamence, let's do this!"

Salamence lets out a roar as well and flies towards Charizard as well.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, use Flamethrower!"

Charizard then performs Flamethrower at Salamence.

Gary calls out, "Salamence, dodge!"

Salamence flies up and dodges the attack.

Gary calls out, "Use Dragon Breath!"

Salamence then performs Dragon Breath. Charizard is able to dodge, but it hits his tail a bit.

"Now, use Air Slash!" Gary calls out.

Salamence then uses Air Slash.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, use Air Slash as well!"

Charizard then performs Air Slash.

Soon, both attacks counter each other's attacks.

Gary calls out, "Use Dragon Claw!"

Salamence then uses Dragon Claw. Chariard then tries to dodge the attack, but Salamence is able to strike Charizard on the stomach. Charizard almost falls, but quickly recovers and continues to be airborne.

Then Mew calls out, "Use Dragon Breath!"

Charizard then uses Dragon Breath and is able to strike at Salamence with full force. Salamence is pushed back, but able to remain in the air.

It shows that Mew and Gary are giving everything they got in this final battle.

The announcer says, "Wow! This is a breathtaking battle, and it's now down to the wire! Who will win, Charizard or Salamence!"

At the stand, Misty and the others are surprised.

"I never knew Gary has that kind of Pokemon," Misty says.

"Yeah. And it's very powerful," Brock says.

Tomo soon notices something, "Hey guys, what's that around Salamence's neck?"

Misty, Brock, and the others look to notice a blue scarf around Salamence's neck. Attached to the scarf is a large white orb with red and blue in the middle, similar to the one Charizard is wearing.

Misty asks in shock "Is that a Mega Stone?"

"It is. Which means Salamence is able to Mega Evolve," Brock says.

"Indeed, and which also means Gary has a Key Stone as well," Professor Oak says.

"Do you think Mew and Charizard will be able to beat Gary and Salamence?" Misty asks.

"We'll just have to wait and see what happens," Brock says.

"I agree. Either one of them will have a chance to win this," Professor Oak says.

"I know Mew can give it her all. I'm sure she'll win," Tomo says, with a smile.

Meanwhile, at another stand, Mr. Goodshow is watching the battle.

"I must say, those two trainers are doing a spectacular job there. It's going to be hard to tell who's going to win," Mr. Goodshow says.

"Indeed it would," A voice says.

Mr. Goodshow turns to see all of the Elite Four: Lance, Agatha, Bruno, and Lorelei.

"Ah, you made it. I'm glad you're able to come," Mr. Goodshow says.

"I agree. And I'm amazed to see that it's Mew who has made it to the finals," Lance says.

"Indeed, the girl is strong and so are her Pokemon. She has spirit," Lorelei says.

"And that young boy must be Professor Oak's grandson. He seems to have a good head on his shoulder as well," Agatha says.

"They are both strong in their own way. It will be hard to tell who will win this match," Bruno says.

"Of course, And thank you for doing the honor of presenting the Pokemon League Trophy to our winner," Mr. Goodshow says.

"It's an honor, Mr. Goodshow," Bruno says.

Lorelei says, "I have to wonder who will win this battle since they're down to their last Pokemon."

"Well, we'll have to wait and see what happens," Lance says.

On the battlefield, Mew and Gary are still battling with everything they got.

Gary calls out, "Draco Meteor!"

Salamence raises its head and launches Draco Meteor into the sky. Then it explodes and multiple meteors are falling towards Charizard.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, dodge!"

Charizard flies in the air and begins to dodge the Draco Meteor. With Charizard speed and agility, Charizard is able to dodge all and charge towards Salamence.

"Use Dragon Claw!" Mew calls out.

"Use Dragon Tail!" Gary calls out.

Charizard charges as he throws the Dragon Claw as Salamence throws the Dragon Tail. Both attacks counter one another and they both are thrown back, but are still flying in the air.

Soon, they both call out, "Dragon Breath!"

Both Pokemon fire Dragon Breath at the same time, and they both strike at one another with full force. Soon, the attack explodes and creates a bit of smoke.

Gary calls out, "Now, Salamence, use Zen Headbutt!"

Salamence then charges with Zen Headbut and strikes at Charizard, causing him to fall and to the ground.

"Charizard, are you okay?" Mew calls out.

Charizard soon begins to get up and yet, it shows him struggling.

Gary calls out, "Talk about a tough battle, your Charizard is strong, but Salamence is even stronger."

"Maybe so, but Chairzard and I are not beaten yet," Mew calls out.

"I knew you said that," Gary says.

Then says in thought, "Mew… I've been training so hard and studying everything I need to know about the Pokemon I have and the Pokemon I've faced with their trainers. Now it's time to show you what I can do as a trainer and will do it best to give it my all.

Then Mew says in thought, "Gary… you and I have been friends since you and I met. And here I am, a Pokemon trainer and competing against you in the league. I want to show you how much I've grown since you and the professor found me, and take me in. And now… I'm going to show everything I've learned since I've started my journey, how hard my Pokemon and I trained, how much of a team we've become. Now it's time to give it everything I've got. Time for my Pokemon to give it everything they've got."

Then looks at Charizard, "And Charizard, I can tell how much you've grown, since the day I've found you. Abandoned by your former trainer, I've found and saved you, and you've saved me and my friends. You've trained hard, and have gotten stronger since then. Now you've evolved and are battling the final battle here and now. It's time to give it everything we've got."

Suddenly, she hears Charizard growls. Mew looks to see Charizard looking at her. He smiles with a growl and nods his head.

"Right. You're not going to give up, and neither am I." Mew says with a nod.

Mew calls out, "Alright Charizard, it's time to show them what we can do. Time to show them our bond connected into a fiery blaze!"

Suddenly, Mew's Key Stone begins to glow as Charizard's Mega Stone begins to glow. That catches everyone by surprise at the stands, everyone who is watching T.V in their homes are even surprised to see the glow.

At Lavender Town, Mr, Kyle as he's holding an old photograph of his youth with his Charizard, along with Reina are watching the event take place.

Mr. Kyle smiles and says, "Charizard my old friend. It's time. I've remembered…"

He then remembers the time Mew and her friends have saved him, and he has given her the KeyStone and Mega Stone that once belonged to him and his Charizard.

"I've remembered the strength I saw in her eyes," Mr. Kyle says.

Reina nods her head in reply.

"The bond of Mew and her Charizard are strong, the great force within our stones is lighting up. The power of the stones is now appearing…" Mr. Kyle says.

At the stadium, everyone is surprised to see the glows. Mew is even more surprised, but soon smiles to realize that the bond of herself and Chairzard is so strong and the power within the stones have finally awakened.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, let's show them how strong the fiery passion and our bond can do!"

Charizard nods his head.

Mew then raises her wrist with the Key Stone and taps on it.

She then calls out, "MEGA EVOLVE!"

Soon, the Mega Stone on Charizard begins to glow and now, Charizard begins to Mega Evolve. When Charizard Mega Evolves, it's body and legs are more physically fit, though its arms remain thin. Its skin turns black with a sky-blue underside and soles. Two spikes with blue tips curve upward from the front and back of each shoulder, while the tips of its horns sharpen, turn blue, and curve slightly upward. Its brow and claws are larger, and its eyes are now red. It has two small, fin-like spikes under each horn and two more down its lower neck. The finger disappears from the wing membrane, and the lower edges are divided into large, rounded points. The third joint of each wing-arm is adorned with a claw-like spike. It breathes blue flames out the sides of its mouth, and the flame on its tail now burns blue. It is said that its new power turns it black and creates more intense flames.

The announcer called out, "I don't believe it! Charizard has Mega evolved into Mega Charizard X!"

That causes the crowd to go wild. At the stand, Mew's friends are excited.

"Go Mew!" Tomo calls out.

Meloetta and Skwovet are cheering.

Mist calls out, "You can do it Mew and Charizard!"

Togepi and Pichu cheer.

"You win this!" Brock calls out.

Gary is surprised, but soon gives a confident smile, "So then, it looks like this battle is becoming more interesting!"

Then brings out a keystone that is hanging around his neck from under his shirt.

He holds the stone and says, "Time to give it our all!"

With that, the stone begins to glow. Then, the Mega Stone of Salamence begins to glow as well.

Gary calls out, "MEGA EVOLVE!"

Soon, Salamence begins to Mega Evolve as well. After the Mega Evolution Salamence's wings meld together into a single huge, crescent-shaped wing. Its face, neck, body and tail are narrower, and its tail is noticeably shorter in length. The ridges above its eyes are now far less prominent, and it no longer possesses the thick, gray scaling over its lower jaw. Instead, the smooth red flesh underneath has been left exposed, increasing its streamlined appearance. The upper pair of fins resting on the sides of its head are now elongated and tapered. The lower pair has not changed much. However, the middle set now takes the form of quarter-arches, spanning towards the bridge of the nose. The remnants of its shelled underbelly have been drastically transformed into a segmented, more aerodynamic, vest-like armored frame. This frame encases its chest and shoulders with the pieces interlocking and tucks in its front forelegs.

That causes the crowd to call out even more.

The announcer calls out, "Salamence has also Mega Evolved to Mega Salamcne, it's a Mega Evolution Battle!"

Gary then marks the first move, "Dragon Breath!"

Mega Salamence then performs a very Powerful Dragon Breath.

Mew calls out, "Dodge!"

Mega Charizard quickly dodges the attack. Mega Salamence then continues the attack.

Mew calls out, "Flamethrower!"

Mega Charizard performs Flamethrower, and counters the Dragon flies towards Mega Salamence.

Then Mew calls out, "Air Slash!"

Mega Charizard then performs Air Slash at Mega Salamence.

Then Gary calls out, "Dragon Claw!"

Mega Salamence, then uses the Dragon Claw to cancel out the Air Slash, but Mega Charizard charges towards Mega Salamence.

Mew calls out, "Use Focus Punch!"

Mega Charizard closes in on Mega Salamence and gives Mega Salamence a couple of Focus Punch.

Gary calls out, "Zen Headbutt!"

Mega Salamence charges at Charizard with Zen Headbutt and sends him back. But Charizard is still flying.

Gary calls out, "Use Dragon Claw!"

Mega Salamence charges towards Mega Charizard.

Mew calls out, "Use Dragon Claw, too!"

Soon, the two Pokemon clash their Dragon Claw at one another. Neither one of them gives an inch, same with their trainer.

"Zen Heabutt once more!" Gary calls out.

Mega Salamence gives it a Zen Heabutt, and sends it flying in the air. Soon, Mega Charizard begins to fall, but still spreading his wings.

Mew calls out, "Charizard, hang in there! It's not over yet!"
Hearing Mew's call, Mega Charizard gains his focus and flies in the air.

Gary calls out, "Don't let them rest! Use Twister!"

Mega Salamence then begins to use Twister, to attack Mega Charizard. Mega Charizard finds himself in the twister, which is pretty strong.

"Charizard, fly with the Twister!" Mew calls out.

With that, Charizard begins to fly around the Twister attack, even though he's trapped in it.

At the stand, everyone is astonished, and frightened by the battle, especially Mew's friends.

"Charizrd is trapped in the Twister! This could spell trouble," Ritchie says.

"That Twister looks very strong," A.J says.

"It's incredible," Otoshi says.

Joe replies, "Wonder how Mew and Charizard are going to get out of this?"

Tomo then says, "If Mew isn't able to come up with another move, she'll lose."

"Don't worry, Charizard is with her. And she's with Charizard. I know they'll find a way out of it," Misty says.

"Yeah. I'm sure Mew will come up with something to turn the tables around," Brock says.

Still in the Twister, Mega Charizard is flying with the wind and isn't planning on giving up. Mew feels the same.

Soon, Mr. Kyle's voice says, "Mew's strength has also become Charizard's strength and vice versa. As long as Mew has her Pokemon, and as long as her Pokemon has Mew, they all become much more powerful!"

Soon, Mega Charizard continues to fly as Mew shouts, " Now Charizard, use Dragon Claw at the Twister!"

With that, Mega Charizard uses Dragon Claw at the Twister, and is able to shatter it.

Then Gary calls out, "Salamence, use Dragon Breath!"

Song:

Sou! Tachimukatte tomo ni ikouze

(Alright! Let's face our fears and head on together)

Mega Salmence then begins to perform its Dragon Breath Attack.

Mega Charizard then fires it's Fire Blast Attack.

Song:

Mita koto no nai

(Towards the unseen side)

Mega Salamence then performs Dragon Breath and counters the Fire Blast.

Song:

Yume no mukou made

(Beyond our dreams)

But the Mega Chairzard's Fire Blast overpowers Mega Salamence's Dragon Breath, and tackles the Dragon Breath, and into Mega Salamence, resulting in a large explosion, and smoke surrounds the entire battlefield.

Everyone in the stands, or watching television from their homes are watching anxiously to see what the results are. Soon, the smoke clears as Chairzard is still flapping his wings in the air. However, to everyone's surprise, Mega Salamence is down and knocked out, soon Mega Salamence reverts back to normal.

The referee sees this and says, "Salamence is unable to battle. Charizard wins. Therefore, the winner… is Mew."

Charizard then lands on the battlefield in front of Mew to hear the results.

Soon, the screen shows that Gary now has zero Pokemon and Mew has only one Pokemon.

The announcer shouts, "What an incredible, outstanding battle! The first time in history to have the youngest Pokemon League champion at age eleven! The winner of the Indigo Plateau Pokemon League is.. MEW!

Everyone in the stadium cheers and let out cries of excitement, many even clap their hands.

Misty happily says, "Mew did it!"

"She beat Gary!" Tomo says.

"Mew has given it everything she got!" Brock says.

Daisy says, "Mew was incredible, and so was Gary."

"I'm so proud of them," Adriana says.

"And to think that young lady is now the champion of the Pokemon League," Professor Oak says.

"She was amazing," Ritchie says.

"She's tough," A.J says.

"So was her Charizard," Joe says.

Otoshi nods her head, "She and her Pokemon did spectacularly in their battle."

Mew is still surprised to see how the result happens.

Mew then smiles and happily cries out, "We won!"

Pikachu and Eevee happily cheer as they jump up and down. Zeraora smiles to see the battle his daughter performs. He couldn't be any more proud. Soon, Charizard reverts back to his normal state.

Mew happily runs to her Pokemon, "Charizard!"

Charizard happily turns to Mew as he roars, allowing Mew to jump into him, and wraps her arms around his neck and shoulders.

"We really did it, Charizard. We really won!" Mew happily says.

Charizard then nuzzles Mew's face, allowing me to place her hands on Charizard's head and snuggles it as well.

Just then, they hear familiar voices, "Pika pi/ Eevee!" (Mew!)

Mew turns to see Pikachu and Eevee running to them and jumps onto them. Eevee lands in Mew's arms and Pikachu on Charizard's shoulder.

"Pikachu! Eevee! We did it! We won the league!" Mew happily says.

Pikachu and Eevee happily smile with glee.

She turns to see Gary calling back Salamence.

Gary looks at the Pokeball and says, "You did a great job, Salamence. You get a good long rest."

Gary walks to Mew and says, "Hey, you did a great job out there."

"You too, Gary," Mew says, and walks to Gary.

Gary reaches his hand out, and says, "Congratulations Mew!"

"Thanks Gary. And thanks for an incredible battle," Mew says.

The two take each other's hand and they shake hands with smiles.

"A tremendous effort! A very powerful, spectacular battle that included a Mega Evolution Battle! These two trainers gave you a roaring good time! So let them hear you!"

Oon, everyone cheers and lets out cries of excitement.

Gary turns to Mew and asks, "Hey Mew, let's have another battle."

"Of course, Gary," Mew happily says.

The crowd continues to cheer with excitement for Mew who has become champion of this year's Pokemon League.

Later in the night, after having their celebration dinner, and happy moments, the Pokemon League Ending Ceremony is taking place. All gather at the Indigo Stadium to celebrate the ending of the League and to award the trainers who have been there.

The crowd cheers as the announcer says, "The Pokémon League now bids farewell to all the trainers and Pokémon who participated in this year's competition. Let's show all the participants just how much we appreciate their accomplishments as they enter the stadium one last time."

Then all the trainers who competed in the league comes into the field with their Pokemon partners. Among them are Ritchie, A.J, Joe, Otoshi, Nurse Joy of Fuchsia City, Gary, and Mew along with Pikachu, and Eevee. Mew's friends, including Tomo, Zeraora, and Gardevoir cheer and clap their hands with glee. Adriana is in tears of joy of her son and Mew's accomplishments. Soon, all the trainers are standing at the stadium.

The announcement says, "League President Goodshow will now present each trainer with a special commemorative badge. Wear it with pride, trainers, as a symbol of excellence and achievement."

Soon, all the trainers get up on stage to receive their special commemorative badge. Soon, Mew is on stage and has received hers. She looks at it with a smile.

Meanwhile, outside of the stadium, Team Rocket is at it again. This time, they're trying to dig their way under the stadium.

Meowth digs as he says, "Dig quicker! The ceremony's almost over!"

"We'll tunnel under the field right below all those trainers!" Jessie says.

"This will be a groundbreaking new way to steal Pokémon!" James says.

Team Rocket continues to dig faster under the tunnel.

Back at the stadium, the award ceremony continues to take place, as they give the top trainers their rewards. Third Place is A.J and he has Sandshrew with him. Second place is Gary Oak. Lastly in the middle, is Mew with Pkachu and Eevee next to them.

"And here, now, the Elite Four themselves will be presenting the awards to the top ranking trainers of this Pokemon League. And our new Youngest Pokemon Indigo League champion Mew!"

Loreli gives A.J his bronze trophy, and Agetha gives Gary a silver trophy that has a Pokeball on it. Finally, Lance walks over with a gold trophy that has a Pokeball on it.

He then presents it to Mew, "Congratulations Mew, you deserve it."

"Thank you, Lance. Thank you so much." Mew says, and takes the trophy.

Pikachu and Eevee look up to see the spectacular trophy Mew has received.

Mew kneels to her Pokemon and says, "Look guys, we got the Pokemon League trophy."

Piakchu and Eevee sniff the trophy and can't help, but be excited.

"That's right guys, and it's ours," Mew says.

Pikachu and Eevee are very happy.

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is still digging under the stadium with their Pokemon stealing scheme in their mind.

Meowth shouts, "Dig, faster!"

Team Rocket digs faster.

At the stadium, the announcer says, "Now, as this Pokémon League draws to a close, please direct your attention to our very special celebration in the sky!"

The arena soon lights out, and fireworks fly into the sky and explode. Everyone in the stadium is excited to see the colors lighting up the night sky. Down below, Team Rocket is preparing to make their move as they dig up from the ground.

Holding a stethoscope to hear the noise, Meowth says, "Sounds like we're right under them! Dig up!

Jessie and James then start digging with their shovels as Meowth shouts, "Dig, dig, dig! We'll hit it big!"

Soon, a large round object that looks like a bomb drop comes down from the ground in front of them

Jessie wonders, "What is that?"

"A Pokéball?" James questions.

Soon, the fuse begins to burn out, causing Team Rocket to panic.

Meowth screams, "Run for it!"

But it's too late, the bomb goes off, sending out a firework, and Team Rocket into the sky.

Team Rocket screams "Oh well! We're blasting off with a beautiful bang!"

Everyone, including Mew and her friends watch the fireworks with smiles, wonder in their eyes, and pride in their heart. Mew can't help, but feel that she has accomplished so much since she came to live with humans, and wonder about the many more adventures to come. And soon, there will be a big celebration for Mew's win and Gary's accomplishment. It will be a celebration to remember.
