Chapter 91: Epilogue: Pallet Town Party Celebration

It's been a few days since the Pokemon League Indigo Plateau Competition, and there is a big celebration for Mew and Gary for their own victory in the competition. At the party, practically everyone in Pallet Town along with the Pokemon are at the party at the Oak Corral.

On stage, Mew with Pikachu and Eevee, and Gary are on stage with Professor Oak, Adriana, Daisy, and Zeraroa.

Mew smiles and says, "Gary and I are very happy to be back home, and to everybody who supported us throughout the Pokemon League"

"We just want to say," Gary adds.

Then they both say, "Thank you very much."

"Pika/Eevee" (Thank you.)

"And thanks to Ash and Gary for representing us so well," Professor Oak says.

Then Adriana says, "And we all owe Professor Oak a big thank you for hosting us here today. Now, let's start the party!"

Professor Oak steps forward and says, "First, let's salute Gary for finishing in the top 2 at the Pokémon League, and Mew for winning the Pokemon League, and making Pallet Town proud! Hip hip…!"

Everyone cheers, "Hooray!"

Everyone gives a toast to Mew and Gary for their great efforts in the Pokemon League.

Mew kneels to Pikachu and Eevee, "Thank you, too, Pikachu, Eevee. And all the Pokémon."

Soon, Pikachu, Eevee, and Mew tap each other's glass.

Soon, everyone begins to chow down on the food.

Brock eats the food and says, "Pallet Town really knows how to throw a party! The food is delicious!"

Then Misty has an idea, "Hey, guys. We shouldn't be the only ones celebrating, why don't we let our Pokémon join the party, too?"

"Good idea! We couldn't have gone to the Pokémon League without them," Mew says.

"Yeah. They deserve some thanks too," Tomo happily agrees.

"You're right," Brock says.

Then calls out, "Come on out everyone, it's time to come out and chow down!"

Soon, all of Brock's Pokemon come out.

"Everyone, you're invited, too! Go!" Misty says, and throws her Pokeballs.

Tomo then calls out, "Come on out, everyone!"

"Yeah. It's time for a celebration!" Mew says, throwing her Pokeball.

Then Gary calls out, "Alright everyone, it's time to eat."

Soon, Mew, Gary, Brock, Misty, and Tomo call their Pokemon out of their Pokeballs.

Mew and Misty happily call out, "Okay, everybody! Time to dig in!"

With that, all the Pokemon split up and begins to dig in on the food.

Brock says, "Mew must be really proud."

"I think she's grown up a lot since being in the Pokémon League. Don't you all?" Misty says, turning to Brock.

"Yeah," Brock says.

Misty turns her head to notice Mew is having a plate served to Tomo. Tomo happily takes it and Mew has one for herself.

Misty smiles, "And Mew is a great big sister to Tomo."

"Yeah. They may not be siblings, but they're almost like two peas in a pod."

Meanwhile, Team Rocket is at the food stands and has another scheme going on.

"This time I think we've cooked up the perfect plan to capture Pikachu and Eevee! Don't you?" James replies, mixing the Yakisoba..

James turns over the Takoyaki and says, "Yes. It's really a hot idea."

"We've finally got the recipe for success-ipe!" Meowth says, shaking the spices on it.

Just then, Mew's voice appears, "Excuse us."

Jessie and James whisper, "Yes, young lady?"

"I like three supersize orders of everything you've got, please" Mew asks with a smile.

"Yes, ma'am!" Jessie and James say.

Then ducks to Meowth's level.

"It's working," James whispers.

"Now we'll secretly soak them with our sizzling sauces, and while their mouths melt, we'll grab that Pikachu and Eevee," Jessie whispers.

Meowth chuckles and says, "Let's get cooking."

Mew calls out, "Could you hurry up, please? There's lots of hungry people and Pokémon to feed."

"Right!" Jessie says.

She then pours some kind of sauce on the soba noodles, "Our Team Rocket Pepper-upper ought to fire this up." and chuckles.

"And just wait till they get a taste of my Molten Lava mustard," James says, brushing some mustard on it.

"And a little Super Strength wasabi sauce will make their mouths go ballistic!" Meowth says, squeezing the wasabi on the soba noodles.

Then Jessie and James pop up.

Jessie says, "Here you go, you three."

"Bon ape-tight!" James says.

And gives Mew the bags of food.

"Thank you," Mew says, and takes the bag.

Then heads back to the table.

Jessie and James happily say, "Be sure to eat it while it's hot!"

Mew walks to the table and says, "Okay, guys. This ought to be enough to get us started."

"Thanks," Brock says.

Soon, Mew and the others begin to serve the Pokemon the meals.

"Okay, guys, dig in!" Misty says.

Soon, some of the Pokemon, including Brock begin to eat the food. Just then, the spices kick in. Even Brock is being affected by the spice.

Brock panics, "Squirtle! Water! Water!"

Misty turns to her Water Pokemon, "Okay everyone, I think you better use your Water Gun attack to cool everybody down!"

With that, Staryu, Sobble, Whopper, and Ducklett spray Water Gun into everyone's flaming mouths.

"What's wrong guys?" Mew asks, confused.

Tomo looks at the food, "Is the food too spicy?"

"How spicy can they be?" Gary wonders.

Soon, Tomo and Gary eat one of the Takoyaki. Melowtta, Skwovet, and some of their Pokemon begin to kick in a well. Soon the spice begins to kick in too, and their mouths are burning.

"Tomo! Gary!" Mew panics.

Then turns one of her Pokemon, "Wartortle, Omanyte, Dratini, Kingler, uses a Water Gun."

As Mew and the others are distracted, Team Rocket uses the chance as they hide in the bushes to snag Pikachu and Eevee. Then retreat towards the stand.

"A Pikachu and Eevee in the hand is worth two in the.." Jessie says.

Then they bump into their stand. Then quickly gets behind.

Mew quickly turns her head, "Hey, look!"

Many people turn to see the stand.

Jessie:

Prepare for trouble!

James:

Make it double!

Soon, the stand begins to transform.

Jessie:

To protect the world from devastation!

James:

To unite all peoples within our nation.

Jessie:

To denounce the evils of truth and love!

James:

To extend our reach to the stars above.

Then the Team Rocket Meowth Balloon pops out from the top of the stand.

Jessie:

Jessie!

James:

James!

Then Team Rocket removes their disguise.

Jessie:

Team Rocket, blast off at the speed of light!

James:

Surrender now, or prepare to fight.

Meowth:

Meowth! That's right!

"Team Rocket!" Everyone exclaims in shock.

Then Jessie says, "I'd be glad to give you my secret recipe for those Nuclear Yakisoba Noodles."

"And my Mustard Plastered Takoyaki Meatballs," James says.

But Mew and her friends have seen enough and begin to throw their food at Team Rocket. Brock, Gary, and Tomo are first.

Then Misty's next, "It's not funny to fool around with food!"

"Yeah, let's see how you like it!" Mew adds, and throws the Takoyaki plate.

The food ends up striking Team Rocket in their mouths, and they end up with a taste of their own medicine. Their mouths are burning and after that, they quickly get in the basket of their balloon.

"Come on! Let's get out of here and fast!" Jessie says.

Meowth then presses the button on the remote, "Power, on!"

With that, the balloon begins to fly up in the air.

"Say so long, Pikachu and Eevee!" Jessie says.

With that, a compartment comes down and it reveals that Pikachu and Eevee are tied up.

"Pika Pika!" (Someone help us!) Pikachu cries out.

"Eevee Eevee!" (Get us down from here!) Eevee cries out.

Mew cries out, "Come back here!"

"Bye-bye!" Team Rocket calls out.

Mew calls out, "Squirtle. Wartortle. Use Water Gun!"

Both Water Pokemon use Water Gun, but they're not high enough to reach.

Then James says from the balloon, "Now let's make sure their party's really a BOMB!"

With that, Jessie and Meowth begins dumping bombs on to the crowd bellow, "Blasters away! Blasters away! Blasters away!"

Soon, all the party goers are going into a panic.

Adriana says, shocked, "This is awful!"

"Disgraceful!" Professor Oak says.

"Despicable!" Daisy says.

The bombs begins to fall to the ground and is practically destroying the party.

"Guys, we gotta do something to stop them!" Misty says.

"We're on it," Mew says.

Then calls out, "Alright, all those who can fly, Charge!"

With that, Aerodactyal, Pidgeotto, Charizard, Ledyba, Beedrill, and Beautifly fly into the air.

Mew calls out, "Pidgeotto, use Gust Attack!"

With that, Pidgeotto uses Gust Attack and burst their balloon. Soon, the Balloon begins to fall.

Jessie calls out, "Meowth, hit the panic button!"

"You got it! Here goes!" Meowth says, and presses the button.

With that, another balloon appears and catches them before they hit the ground.

"Quick! Don't let them get away!" Mw calls out.

Then Jessie calls out, "Arbok, Poison Sting attack!"

Arbok comes out of its Pokeball and performs Poison Sting.

"Quick Charizard, use Flamethrower!" Mew calls out.

Chariard uses Flamethrower to breathe fire and blows out the Poison Sting. With that, Team Rocket looks to see Chairzard and Aerodactyl are charging towards them. Team Rocket panic and begin to throw the bombs at them frantically. Charizard and Aerodactyl use their wings to block the bomb and fling them right back at them. Soon, the bombs fly towards Team Rocket's balloon and explode.

Team Rocket screams, "We're blasting away again!" And send flying away.

Pikachu and Eevee begin to fall, but Ledyba, Beautifly, and Beedrill catch them in the nick of time.

"Good work everyone. You can come down now," Mew says.

With that, the Pokemon descends to the ground and Pikachu and Eevee jump into Mew's arms.

Mew turns to her Pokemon with a smile, "You guys were great."

"Yeah. At least we got rid of Team Rocket again," Tomo says.

The group then laughs with smiles on their faces.

Sometime after the celebration, or at least what's left of it. Mew and her friends are in Professor Oak's lab.

"That was a good party. It's too bad Team Rocket kind of spoiled it," Misty says.

"That's Team Rocket for you. They always try to steal Pokemon wherever they go, especially Pikachu and Eevee," Mew says.

"Yeah. Those jerks follow us wherever we go," Tomo says.

"I agree. They've always seemed to follow us, or we ended up finding them with another scheme to steal stuff from other people, including Pokemon," Brock says.

"No kidding," Mew replies.

Just then, they hear the doorbell ringing."

"I'll get it," Mew says.

Mew walks to the door and opens it to reveal a mail man, and he is holding a particular large bag.

"Hello sir," Mew says.

"Hello. I've got a huge mail order for you," The mailman says.

"For me?" Mew questions.

"Yes. You've received a lot of letters and presents from all over Kanto. Probably because you've become the Champion," The mailman says.

Mew blushes, "I don't know about tha, but thank you." and takes the bag.

"You're welcome. And congratulations on winning the Pokemon League," The mail man says.

"Thank you," Mew says.

The mailman walks away as Mew closes the door. Soon, Mew walks down the hall and meets up with the others. They soon notice the large bag Mew has.

"What you got there, Mew?" Professor Oak asks.

"Well, the mailman said I've got a lot of letters and packages today," Mew says.

"They're probably a bunch of fan mail because you're the Pokemon League Champion," Misty says.

Mew blushes, "Uh… I don't know about that."

"Don't worry, I'm sure it's nothing too extreme or anything like that," Brock says.

"Wonder what's inside?" Tomo replies.

"Well, we'll have to open and see what they are," Mew says, and sits down next to Misty. Pikachu and Eevee are very curious to see what kind of stuff is inside.

Mew then opens the bag and is surprised to see what's inside. Misty and the others look inside and are surprised to see the letters, postcards,packages, and presents.

"Wow. Look at them all. You must have a lot of admirers from winning the league," Misty says.

Mew takes out one of the postcards. This one has a few pictures of Psychic Type Pokemon like Abra, Jynx, Kadabra, and the Psychic Symbol in the middle.

Mew reads it and says, "Hey guys, this one from Sabrina, the Saffron City Gym Leader. She's letting us know that she congratulated me for winning the league, and said she's doing a lot better as a trainer and her psychic Pokemon are going well."

"That's good to hear," Misty says.

Brock takes a package and says, "Hey, this one is from Erika. The Celadon City Gym Leader."

The backpage is a box that is wrapped up in green wrapping paper, decorated with flowers. Mew takes it and opens it to reveal perfume bottles.

"Oh, it's a perfume bottle," Misty says.

"And a letter, she said these are presents for you," Mew says.

Tomo takes out a letter that has some Pokemon photos, "Hey Mew, these are from Todd."

"Really?" Mew asks.

Mew looks at the photographs of the Pokemon. There are plenty of flying types, grass types and ice types."

"They're beautiful, and the Pokemon are very happy," Mew says.

Mew then takes out a few more, "One of them is from Anthony and Rebecca."

Misty says, holding a letter, "Hey Mew, this one is from Melanie for you and Bulbasaur."

"And this one's for you and Squirtle from Officer Jenny and the Squirtle Squad," Brock says, holding another.

Mew holds a postcard and turns to Pikachu, "Look Pikachu, this one is for us from Lt. Surge and Raichu."

"Pika Pika." (That's great.) Pikachu happily says.

Misty soon notices some of them, "Hey, this Postcard is from my sisters. They're congratulating you too."

"And there's one from my family," Brock says, holding another letter.

Mew takes out another envelope, opens it to find two letters, "Hey Brock, there's a letter from me along with you and Vulpix from Suzie."

"Suzie?!" Brock quickly says in surprise and takes it.

Brock reads it and happily says, "Suzie says that she's doing great and has been learning a lot about being a breeder. She even sent a picture."

Brock shows a picture to the others. It's a picture of Suzie at one of the breeding centers for Pokemon.

Then Brock calls out, "Come on out, Vulpix."

Soon, Vulpix comes out of her Pokeball.

Brock shows the letter and the photo, "Look Vulpix, there's a letter to us from Suzie."

Vulpix sniffs it and is happy to recognize Suzie's scent.

Mew also says, "And there's one from Victory and Puka. And there's one from Bill, too."

"Wow. you got so many letters and presents from all the people we met," Misty says.

"Yeah. There's even one from Aya and Koga," Mew says.

After opening all the letters and packages, Mew has a lot of presents and letters from her friends. Mew is glad to hear from the friends she has made on her journey and can't wait to write them back.

Later on, the professor decides to ask them for something important.

Professor Oak asks, "Hey Mew, I wonder if you could all do a very special favor for me."

"Sure, what is it?" Mew asks.

"I need you to run a very important errand for me on Valencia Island in the Orange Archipelago," Professor Oak says.

"The Orange Archipelago?" Mew and Tomo say, interested.

"Valencia?" Misty and Brock say, interested as well.

Soon, everyone begins to day dream of them surfing, relaxing, and having a grand time on the island.

"So professor, why are we going to Valencia Island.? Mew asks.

Professor Oak explains, "I'd like you to go and visit my friend, Professor Ivy. Bring back the mysterious Pokéball that she had recently acquired so that I can begin study it."

"Can't you just have her transported to you, Professor?" Misty asks.

Professor Oak says, "For some reason, that isn't possible. Normally, I'd ask my grandson, Gary, to go. But he's already off on another Pokémon journey."

"Valencia Island? Lots of girls on the beach?" Brock asks, taking a big interest.

And begins fantasizing involving himself with girls.

Then Brock says, excited. "Let's go! I say we leave right away!"

"I'll go, too! All my Pokémon will love it!" Misty says, excited.

"Sounds exciting. And a mysterious Pokemon sounds interesting," Mew says.

Tomo happily says, "I want to go too."

"Thank you all for doing this for me," Professor Oak says.

"It's no trouble. We're more than happy to help," Mew says.

Just then, Professor Oak says, "Before you go, I've got a package for you from my cousin Samson from Melemele in the Alola Region. I've already given one to Gary, and this one's for you."

He then grabs a box and passes it to Mew. Curious, Mew opens the box, and to her surprise, it's a Pokemon egg that is inside an incubator. The egg has light green on the top dark pink on the rest, including dark green on the side.

"It's a Pokemon Egg," Misty says.

"Wow. That's a cool present," Tomo says.

"And since it's Alola, it might be an Alolan Pokemon," Mew says.

"I wonder when it's going to hatch," Tomo replies.

"Who knows, we'll just have to wait and see what happens," Mew says.

Then turns to Professor Oak, "Thank you Professor."

"You're welcome Mew," Professor Oak says.

And so, Mew and her friends are about to head off to Valencia Island to help Professor Oak with an important errand. Professor Oak, Daisy, Adriana, Zeraora, and Gardevoir are seeing them off. Mew and Zeraora hug each other with smiles.

"Bye papa," Mew says.

Zeraora growls with a smile.

Gardevoir says, "Gardevoir," (Goodbye Mew.)

"Bye Gardevoir," Mew says.

Then looks at the egg, "And goodbye little guy. Hope to see you soon."

Suddenly, the Pokemon egg begins to glow bright, and soon begins to have cracks on it.

"Oh my," Professor Oak says, amazed.

"The egg…" Misty says.

"It's hatching," Mew says.

The large egg soon bursts and two small Pokemon appear in Gardevoir's arms. They're both humanoid Pokémon with a white body. It has thin arms and legs that widen toward the feet. There is a wispy extension trailing off the back of its feet, creating the overall impression of a nightgown or oversized dress. Most of its face is covered by cyan blue hair that resembles a bowl cut, but a pair of light orange colored eyes is sometimes visible. There are two flat, orange horns on top of its head: a large one toward the front and a smaller one at the back.

"Aww, they're so cute," Misty says.

"They're Ralts," Brock says.

"And they're both Shiny Pokemon," Tomo says.

"And they're twins too," Mew says.

Mew brings out the Pokedex and Dexter says, "Ralts, the Feeling Pokemon Pokemon and the pre-evolved form of Gardevoir. A Psychic and Fairy Type. Ralts has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its Trainer is in a cheerful mood, this Pokémon grows cheerful and joyous in the same way."

"Aww, they're adorable," Mew says.

Then waves her hand, "Hello Ralts, you both look very healthy."

The two Ralts smile and turn to their mama.

"They look healthy to me," Tomo says.

"Judging by their appearance, one of them is a boy and the other is a girl," Mew says.

"How can you tell?" Misty asks.

"I can just tell," Mew says.

Then says, "Well then, it's best we get going. We'll get you that mysterious Pokeball over as soon as possible."

"I know you will. And good luck," Professor Oak says.

With that, Mew and her friends wave goodbye to their friends and head off to Valencia Island. But little do they know, this is just the beginning of a new adventure awaits them with new challenges, new friends, including Pokemon, and fun and excitement. In the world of Pokemon.
